objectives.text: Obtain the OLI cargo route documents on Interchange
Hand over the documents to Ragman

a-big-loss.guide: In this quest you have to obtain the OLI cargo route documents from the OLI logistics department office on the first floor of the ULTRA shopping mall on Interchange. A OLI logistics department office key is required to enter it. File:Interchange Database part 2 Guide.png|Office location marked on map File:Oli Offices.png|Entrance to the OLI front offices File:Oli Logistics Door.png|Door to the wanted office File:Database Part 2 Guide.png|Documents on the left side shelf
a-big-loss.briefing: Hey, brother! I was looking through some of the Ultra shipment records recently and noticed that a major shipment went missing somewhere along the way. According to the manifest, it was carrying batteries. Pretty useful stuff in our situation, if you catch my drift. The logistics department usually handles this kind of thing. Can you head to their office, dig around for the shipment routes and its current status? I won't forget the favor! The office was probably locked up. No idea where the key ended up, but you're a smart guy. I believe in you.

a-bitter-victory.guide: If you want to hand over items obtained before accepting the quest, you have to move them to a different inventory slot for the game to register them.
a-bitter-victory.briefing: Alright, well the smugglers managed to get their commander out, though not without losses. I'm heading over to talk things through and ask about you as well. But you get it, right now they need to both celebrate the win and properly remember the ones they lost. So I can't show up empty-handed. You gonna help set the table?

requirements: Must accept Jaeger's quest The Huntsman Path - Sadist to obtain this quest.

objectives.text: Do not kill Sanitar
Find 10 TerraGroup Labs access keycards in raid
Hand over the keycards
Find AHF1-M stimulant injector in raid
Hand over the injector
Find 3-(b-TG) stimulant injector in raid
Hand over the injector

a-difficult-choice.guide: By completing The Huntsman Path - Sadist, you fail and will lose access to this quest.
a-difficult-choice.briefing: Young man, wait. I knew that Jaeger would ask you to kill Sanitar, but you don't have to do it. I understand Jaeger's point of view, that he's just some kind of monster in the flesh, but he is not. I'm sure Sanitar is just trying to help the locals. Given the current circumstances, he performs the most complex surgeries and it is not surprising that they often end badly. He is a doctor with the most valuable knowledge that can save many more lives. A doctor with access to a warehouse of medicines that are extremely important to us. And he has already entered into negotiations with me and will soon begin to cooperate. But for this, I need something that will interest him and I think I know what will: the Laboratory. Access keys and samples of military stimulants, I think they are the basis on which he conducts his experiments. Can you find them for me? You can get the access keycards however you want, but the stimulants must be sealed, so you need to find them yourself.

requirements: Must be level 15 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Mark the first group of fuel tanks with an MS2000 Marker on Reserve
Mark the second group of fuel tanks with an MS2000 Marker on Reserve

a-fuel-matter.guide: In this quest you have to find and mark 2 groups of fuel tanks on Reserve. File:1st & 2nd Group of tankers.jpg|Fuel tanks marked on map File:Tarkovwiki1.png|First group of tanks next to the "Sewer Manhole" extraction File:Tarkovwiki3e.png|Second group of tanks next to the train depot
a-fuel-matter.briefing: Hey there! I'm gathering my guys to search the reserve base for fuel. They say there are stationary fuel tanks and tank cars, but I don't know where they are exactly, so I don't wanna send my guys to search for them while they're getting shot at by snipers and shit, so why not you go there yourself and quietly mark the fuel tanks with beacons? Look for the big groups of fuel cisterns.

objectives.text: Hand over the lab journal

a-healthy-alternative.guide: By completing One Less Loose End, you will lose access to this quest. The journal can be found in the laboratory on the second floor of Factory. There are multiple spawns throughout both rooms. File:One Less Loose End Factory Map.png|Laboratory location marked on map File:One Less Loose End Factory Lab.png|Entrance to the laboratory File:One Less Loose End Factory Spawn 1.png|Spawn #1: In the first room on the trolley File:One Less Loose End Factory Spawn 2.png|Spawn #2: In the first room on the chest of drawers next to the glass cabinet File:One Less Loose End Factory Spawn 3.png|Spawn #3: In the second room in the bottom compartment of the right industrial shelf File:One Less Loose End Factory Spawn 4.png|Spawn #4: In the second room in the small fridge on the floor File:One Less Loose End Factory Spawn 5.png|Spawn #5: In the second room on the right desk
a-healthy-alternative.briefing: Hello. I understand that you were tasked with finding the laboratory log from the polychemical plant. Apparently, TerraGroup is willing to pay handsomely for the extraction of their documents. I urge you to reconsider. If the corporation cares so much about this material, it must be hiding something valuable! Obviously, I mean valuable to the city and its citizens. Just leave the journal in my care.

requirements: Must be level 20 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain Prapor's package on Woods
Survive and extract from the location
Complete the task Shipping Delay - Part 1

a-helping-hand.guide: In this quest you have to find Prapor's package on Woods. It can be found in 1 of 2 locations in the northwest building of the train depot. The depot can only be accessed via the BTR Driver's taxi service. After collecting the package, you have to hand it over to Prapor in his quest Shipping Delay - Part 1, afterwards you can complete this quest. File:A Helping Hand Building Map.png|Building marked on map File:A Helping Hand Building.png|The wanted building File:A Helping Hand Spawn 1.png|First spawn under the table next to the bed File:A Helping Hand Spawn 2.png|Second spawn on the desk in the back office It is also possible to leave the depot through walking on top of the western train. When walking on top of the train it is important to stick to the center to not get hit by snipers or mines. File:WoodsTrainDepotExit.png|Way to the train File:WoodsTrainDepotExit2.png|The train
a-helping-hand.briefing: Hello. I figure you've already seen the BTR that's been driving around Tarkov. The driver used to offer his services to PMCs like you, but lately he has started working with Skier as well. The driver came to me when he was restoring the BTR. It was an quite an interesting challenge, let me tell you. But that's beside the point. He hasn't been in touch for quite some time, and now he's suddenly asked for help. Apparently, something serious has happened. Can you check in with him and find out what's going on? There aren't many men of wit and ambition left in Tarkov. People like us should stick together.

a-key-to-salvation.guide: The keycards can be bartered from Mechanic LL1 for a various number of 6-STEN-140-M military batteries. The batteries have 3 guaranteed spawns on Customs each raid: *On the roof of the three-story dorms building *Inside the new gas station *On the second floor of the Scav base (ZB-013 extraction) building Each location is defended by Scav Raiders.
a-key-to-salvation.briefing: Good afternoon. I desperately need the staff keycards from the TerraGroup laboratory, and you know full well how impossible it is to get even one of those. I heard that Mechanic is willing to trade the cards for some military equipment, but I lack the manpower to gather it currently. This is a matter of life and death. Will you help?

Hide a Horse figurine under the Christmas tree on Customs
Hide a Chainlet under the Christmas tree on Reserve
Hide an Antique teapot under the Christmas tree on Interchange
Hide an Antique vase under the Christmas tree on Shoreline
Hide a Cat figurine under the Christmas tree on Woods

a-kind-snow-maiden.guide: The Christmas trees are located on each map as follows: ===== Customs ===== Located within the courtyard of the dormitories: ===== Reserve ===== Located next to the E2 bunker: ===== Lighthouse ===== Located in the Old Landing Scav extract: ===== Interchange ===== Located inside of the Scav Camp: ===== Shoreline ===== Inside of the resort, located in the center: ===== Woods ===== Next to the sawmill on the east side of the water, on the way to the Military Camp. It is located on a dock, so keep your eyes peeled when running near the shoreline:
a-kind-snow-maiden.briefing: Greetings, mercenary! I just thought, maybe we should try to negotiate with the leaders of the Scavs? Christmas is a great occasion. Heres what I suggest: lets put the gift under the tree in a place where the leader can get it. But it needs to be so that the bandits understand who the gift is from. Let them figure out with whom it is more profitable to be friends than to fight... I hope you understand me.

objectives.text: Hand over the item: 8 Bottle of Tarkovskaya vodka
Hand over the item: 15 Bottle of Dan Jackiel whiskey
Hand over the item: 15 Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine

a-life-lesson.briefing: Wha-- Oh, it's you. Come in, don't just stand there... We've lost our dividends, it seems... Luka's not getting in touch, the fucking bastard! We can't even check what's going on outside the cordon... I don't have any eyes there. What if there was no USEC base in the first place? Maybe this fucker Luka doesn't even have a squad... And look at us, we didn't suspect a goddamn thing. And you, fucking eagle eye... Fuck's sake. Okay... There's no fucking way we're gonna get these cocksuckers from here. Until I'm pissed and then sober again, don't count on a new plan. What, you want to help? Bring some more booze, then...

objectives.text: Locate and obtain The Unheard's laptop at the smugglers' base on Shoreline
Hand over the laptop

a-new-hope.guide: In this quest you have to find The Unheard's laptop in the smugglers' base on Shoreline. There are multiple spawns throughout the base. File:A New Hope Map.jpg|Smugglers' base location marked on map File:A New Hope Spawn 1.png|First spawn: In the southwestern warehouse on a chair File:A New Hope Spawn 4.png|Second spawn: Under the stairs of the southern red shipping container File:A New Hope Spawn 2.png|Third spawn: In the northwestern warehouse between the sofa and the armchair File:A New Hope Spawn 3.png|Fourth spawn: In the yellow truck under the white tent in the center of the base
a-new-hope.briefing: Afternoon, friend. We have had no luck intercepting this John Doe and getting the data. It's all the fault of Skier's men, those-- Ahem, sorry for the outburst again. We can check the places where the John Doe was seen. Maybe there's something out there. Can you help us again? Go to Shoreline, the perp was spotted at the vehicle moving people out of the area.

objectives.text: Launch a firework in the appropriate spot
Eat some Olivier salad
Drink some vodka

rewards.text: 2× Crye Precision AVS plate carrier (Ranger Green)

a-small-celebration.guide: In this quest you have to eat a Olivier salad box and drink a Bottle of Tarkovskaya vodka in raid, as well as shoot a firework flare into the sky while being near a Christmas Tree. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. Make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. Christmas trees can be found at the following locations: * Customs - In the courtyard of the dormitories * Interchange - On the highway * Lighthouse - Next to the sunken building * Reserve - West of the repair center (white knight) * Shoreline - In front of the administration building at the health resort * Woods - On the floating container pontoon in the big lake, near the Scav base/EMERCOM camp
a-small-celebration.briefing: Hey there, brother! Tell me, what actually went down between Prapor and Skier, huh? They stirred up one hell of a mess. Could've stayed on their bases and welcomed the New Year like normal people instead... Looks like you got dragged into it too. Good thing you made it out in one piece. Want a bit of advice, ahper? In Tarkov, any day could be your last. And yet you're still here, still breathing. So take at least one day off. Give yourself a break. You should welcome the New Year properly. I even had some fireworks lying around somewhere... here, take them! Just find a good spot. Maybe there are still some decorated trees out in the open. That'd be perfect! Set off the fireworks, have some Olivier salad, knock back a bit of vodka. Here's to things getting better in the new year.

requirements: Hand over the hard drives from compartment C-1 on Icebreaker to Mechanic in the Boreas story chapter.

objectives.text: Locate and neutralize 4 members of The Wedge's squad
Claim a trophy from The Wedge
Hand over the found item

rewards.text: 1× Accuracy International AXMC .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle
3× .338 Lapua Magnum FMJ ammo pack (20 pcs)

a-wedge-between-us.briefing: Sit down kid, got something to talk about. Partisan spotted helicopters over the bay, no markings on them. They were heading straight for some ship out there, definitely not toward the city. Those were combat birds, not belonging to the UNTAR troops or any PMC, that's for certain. He said he's only seen something like that once before, and that wasn't even in Tarkov. If this is some kind of special unit, nothing good will come from it. Most likely they're pulling in veterans from elite forces, could be SAS, Mossad, or God knows who else these days. I asked Mechanic if he knows anything about them. He's been listening in on that frequency range, managed to catch the callsign of their leader, though barely. "Wedge”... Listen, we can't let people like that dig in, not on the ship, and definitely not in the city. I'm counting on you here. Best meet fire with fire, like they say.

abandoned-cargo.guide: In this quest you have to mark 1 of 7 cargo pallets on Customs with a MS2000 Marker. ===Red customs control warehouse - Cargo 1=== File:Abandoned Cargo Map.png|Cargo 1 location marked on map File:Abandoned Cargo 1.png|Cargo 1 on the west side of the warehouse ===Warehouse 17 - Cargo 3, 6, 7=== File:Warehouse17Map.png|Warehouse 17 location marked on map File:Warehouse17.png|Warehouse 17 southern entrance File:Abandoned Cargo 7.png|Cargo 7 on the first floor File:Abandoned Cargo 3.png|Cargo 3 on the second floor in the staircase behind the wall paintings File:Abandoned Cargo 6.png|Cargo 6 on the third floor/crane ===Boiler building - Cargo 2, 4, 5=== File:BoilerBuildingMap.png|Boiler building location marked on map File:BoilerBuilding.png|The boiler building File:Abandoned Cargo 5.png|Cargo 5 outside on the north side of the building File:Abandoned Cargo 2.png|Cargo 2 next to the showers File:Abandoned Cargo 4.png|Cargo 4 (barrels) next to the chimneys
abandoned-cargo.briefing: Good afternoon, young man. I have received information about a recent suspicious shipment of TerraGroup cargo. According to the description, it could contain valuable records and even medical samples. Every such shipment should have been prioritized for extraction, yet for some reason this shipment was left near the customs terminal. I have to know what's inside the cargo, and to do that, I need the exact location of the shipments. Will you be able to assist with this? You will recognize the necessary shipments by the boxes with the TerraGroup logo.

objectives.text: Obtain and hand over the locked smugglers' case
Obtain and hand over the key to the locked case

accept-delivery.guide: In this quest you have to find a Locked case and a Case key and hand both over to Peacekeeper.
accept-delivery.briefing: According to the letter, Edward has been supplying the local smugglers with some kind of new goods, or selling them something at a discounted price. Either way, we need to find out what exactly he is moving. Trying to intercept the plane on its regular schedule would be far too risky, but the letter mentions another way to call it in. Use a red flare to signal the aircraft. The drop zones are not listed in the letter, but I'm sure you will be able to figure that out once you're on site. The important thing is to grab the cargo before the smugglers arrive. Bring me anything that looks like a sealed package. And one more thing. The smugglers seemed to like the older idea that Skier and I came up with, splitting large shipments into smaller locked containers. So their keys might come in handy as well.

objectives.text: Hand over any 10 items from the Food Category

acquaintance.guide: The Provisions needed for this task don't require the found in raid tag. Food items can be commonly found in many maps such as Reserve, Interchange, and Shoreline. ===Reserve=== Food can be most easily found in the kitchen wing of the black bishop building. In the locked caged rooms in the underground bunker are many loose food item spawns and Ration supply crates. These crates spawn a large amount of food. The number of supply crates in each room is written in red on the map below, as well as the location of the kitchen being circled. File:3D Map by loweffortsaltbox-FOOD.png ===Shoreline=== Lots of food items can be found scattered throughout the admin/theatre building at the resort. File:Map Shorline-FOOD.png ===Interchange=== There is a grocery store called Goshan (red on the map) packed with food. Check all the shelving to find it. A flashlight will be helpful for all the dark corners. File:Interchange-Map-Small-FOOD.png === Woods === Food can spawn at the USEC Camp frequently as well as the camp at the south-east of the lake. File:Acquaintance food location.png|Location the USEC camp (bottom arrow)
acquaintance.briefing: Well, hello there! I could use your help right now. We're still barely acquainted, so I won't ask you to handle anything too serious just yet. I'm a solitary man, as you've probably already noticed. I try to live by my own principles and keep Tarkov clean. That takes time and effort, and sometimes my supplies run out. Usually when I least expect it. Could you find me some provisions? I don't need anything special, anything will do. The only requirement is that it's edible.

objectives.text: Eliminate 3 PMC operatives in a single raid

action-test.guide: You must kill three PMCs in one raid. PMCs that you group up with to raid together will not count towards this objective if killed. This quest can be completed on any map.
action-test.briefing: These times its important to appreciate the right people. I told my men to purge their ranks. The trustworthy ones have to stick together and help each other out. But if theres even a slight suspicion that someones a rat - you get em smoked on the spot. While theres all this commotion going on around, its the perfect time to show your loyalty. Clear the areas from stray servicemen and tourists, but dont touch my people. You do that, and well keep working together.

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 PMC operatives at Ref's camps on Woods, Customs, or Shoreline
Failure condition: Do not kill Ref's cleanup crew

rewards.text: 52 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
57 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× AK-74 5.45x39 Magpul PMAG 30 GEN M3 30-round magazine (Black)

adaptive-diplomacy.guide: In this quest you have to kill 5 PMCs anywhere on Customs, Shoreline or Woods, not just near the mentioned camps. Killing any clean up crew members will fail the quest. They are neutral to PMCs. File:Woods Capturing Outposts Location.png|Clean up crew location on Woods at the EMERCOM camp File:Every Man for Himself Map.png|Clean up crew location on Customs at the dorms area File:Shoreline Smuggler Base Map.png|Clean up crew location on Shoreline at the smuggler base
adaptive-diplomacy.briefing: Gladiator! Hope you've got time for an urgent job. I recently launched a new Arena season. You probably remember how Skier tried to intercept my shipments, right? Still, the launch went smoothly, even though he swiped some of my rewards. Success needs to be built on, so I want to set up three small arenas in different parts of Tarkov. The problem is, not everyone was willing to make a deal. Territory is always a sensitive subject. Buying Skier off was easy. I've had connections with the smugglers for a long time. But Jaeger is stubborn as hell when it comes to his little patch of forest. I even moved the arena away from the woods and over to the EMERCOM camp, and he's still sending his "hunters" after my guys. Can you help us hold the ground? The forester fuck somehow found out about all three of my camps, so they could hit us anywhere. Drop anyone you see, just don't touch my people!

objectives.text: Win 3 matches while wearing the Hexgrid armor in CheckPoint mode

rewards.text: Unlocks BlackRock chest rig (Gray) in the Armory

advertising-business-part-1.briefing: Recently, an interesting guy reached out to me, name Ragman. I'm sure you've heard of him. We worked out a little deal… he needs his product advertised. Sounds like something anyone could handle, but that's bullshit. Who's going to buy armor off some guy who got iced in the first gunfight? That's right, no one. That's why I need you, with your survivability. The task is boringly simple: use the Hexgrid.

objectives.text: Eliminate 50 enemies with headshots while using an UZI PRO or MDR 7.62x51

rewards.text: Unlocks WARTECH TV-110 plate carrier (Coyote) in the Armory

advertising-business-part-2.briefing: After his recent success in the Arena advertisement business, Ragman's saying he wants more. Real businessman! Knows this gig is profitable. This time, I need you to show some real class with his guns. Use the UZI PRO or the 7.62 MDR. Aim for the head, makes it a lot more spectacular!

objectives.text: Win 6 matches while wearing a TV-110 plate carrier

advertising-business-part-3.briefing: Ragman still can't get enough of those sales after you've been running around the Arena in his gear. He even wanted to reach out to you directly, but that's not how business is done. That's between me and him anyway. Your part's simple: just wear the shit we tell you to wear. Show up in the winners' circle in a TV-110. That's all there is to it. Ragman will pay, don't worry.

objectives.text: Win 10 matches while wearing a Banshee or A18 Skanda plate carrier

advertising-business-part-4.briefing: Alright, let's keep Ragman's advertisements going! Next up, the Banshee or the A18 Skanda plate carrier. Pick whichever you like more. Just don't forget to win. Nobody looks at losers.

objectives.text: Eliminate 30 enemies while using a T-5000M or RPDN in BlastGang or TeamFight mode

advertising-business-part-5.briefing: I've been thinking... Ragman's got a pretty nice thing going here. So I've got a little more work for you: I've got some guns that aren't exactly popular. They just keep piling up in storage, collecting dust. Show everyone a master class with one of them, make people want to get their hands on the same thing. I'll cut you in on the sales.

objectives.text: Eliminate 40 enemies with headshots while using a Velociraptor, PKP or SR-2M

advertising-business-part-6.briefing: I ran an inventory check recently. Not myself, I had my guys handle it. Turns out we still need to clear out a couple more crates. You know the drill: take the gun, make it look good on the battlefield, and I'll handle the sales. You get your percentage, same as always.

afterparty.guide: In this quest you have to kill all described bosses. For the locations of the bosses check their respective pages.
afterparty.briefing: Greetings! Haven't forgotten the big gang gathering at the car dealership yet? I've been told that they retreated from there after your visit, but are now on constant alert in their own territories. Even the former USECs joined this mob! In the past you could pass through the occupied territories while the warlords were at ease, but now all my guys are being shot on the spot. I don't really appreciate that. Why don't you get out there and whack these assholes, huh? Make 'em realize they need to learn a little chill, haha!

(Optional) Locate and obtain the key at the smugglers' base on Shoreline
Find out what happened to the champion
Survive and extract from the location

rewards.text: 1× CQC Osprey MK4A plate carrier (Assault, MTP)

against-the-conscience-part-1.guide: The champion's room is located on the second floor of the three-story dorms building on Customs, between the rooms 209 and 211. A Dorm overseer key is required to enter it. You must approach the puddle of blood on the floor next to the wardrobe to complete the objective. File:DormOverseerKeyMap.png|Room location marked on three-story dorms map File:DormOverseerKeyDoor.png|Door to the room
against-the-conscience-part-1.briefing: Hello. I hear you're working for Ref now. I've been keeping tabs on you for a while. I used to know a man who got tangled up just like you. He was Ref's previous champion for a while and then all of a sudden he disappeared. And I know for sure this had nothing to do with Kaban and Kollontay. If you don't want to vanish the same way this guy did, look for the last champion's apartment. I believe there's something of interest left there. The champion used to hang out with the smugglers in Dorms on Customs. Maybe you'll find some clues on how to get into the apartment.

objectives.text: Eliminate 100 enemies in any game mode in Arena

rewards.text: 105 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
115 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2

against-the-conscience-part-2.briefing: So you're saying you were in the last champion's apartment? All right then. I'll pretend like it never happened. Just remember, curiosity killed the cat. And the last champion, too. He was a good guy, I liked him, but he got soft, lost his touch. You should be practicing more, not wandering around the city. Otherwise, your ranking will start to drop.

aid-stations.briefing: You know, I wonder why are you working with such a scumbag as Skier! Even though I close my doors for you, young man. But I see that you want to set this unpleasant situation straight. Good... I have a task for you - do it and we'll put the past behind us. Although people will hardly forget - God only knows whose hands got these chemicals now. Basically, my colleagues are going to search all the more or less significant objects in the district, looking for supplies for the suffering people. However, they failed to gain access to some places. Find particular keys and hand them over to me, thus helping our operation. To hell with the Skier, let's help people.

requirements: This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

objectives.text: Launch a red signal flare at the old sawmill on Woods

rewards.text: 2× Zenit Klesch-2IKS IR illuminator with laser

airmail.guide: In this quest you have to shoot a red flare into the sky while being in the center of the old sawmill in the east of Woods. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 red flare provided by Mechanic via in-game mail or a 26x75mm red flare cartridge which can be bought at Ref LL3, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 red flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. File:AirmailFlareMap.png|Flare area marked on map
airmail.briefing: Hello, friend! You know how even small changes affect our isolated Tarkov world. Take, for example, the arrival of the humanitarian aid that's being dropped from airplanes. Even I couldn't get some of the components for my work before. But now you can find real treasures in these crates! By the way, I'd like to arrange for a new package. To do this, I need to make sure that the pilots work as instructed, give a drop right after the launch of the red flare. Can you help me with that?

objectives.text: Eliminate 3 enemies while mid-air

rewards.text: Unlocks B&T MP9 9x19 submachine gun in the Armory

all-for-the-show-death-from-above.briefing: Let's continue your training. Overcoming any obstacle is great, but don't forget to show your superiority over others. Everyone needs to know you're above your opponent — literally, ha! Can you imagine the crowd screaming in the stands?

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 enemies while suffering from light or heavy bleeding

all-for-the-show-heroism.briefing: Every gladiator puts on a show. The crowd needs to feel it. Drama! Suffering! A surge of emotions! And what works better for that than fear for their favorite fighter? Nothing. So come on, learn to make yourself the hero. Take a few hits, then win.

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 enemies while using grenades
Eliminate 5 enemies who are blinded by flashbang grenades

rewards.text: Unlocks Splinter Stripe Yellow weapon camouflage

all-for-the-show-major-sponsor.briefing: Lately, grenades haven't been flying well: newbies don't know how to use them and just ignore them. It frustrates me and the supplier of this stuff, and he's a major sponsor! We need to fix this, fast. Show the other fighters what advantage they're missing. Make those weaklings start training with grenades so they don't fall behind!

objectives.text: Eliminate an enemy while using grenades

all-for-the-show-pyrotechnics.guide: Kills that happen after the player's death do not count.
all-for-the-show-pyrotechnics.briefing: Ever play baseball? You know how to blow the crowd away? With a good throw of a grenade! Not literally into the stands, of course. Try that and I'll have you feeding the fish. But when someone gets turned into mush by a grenade in the Arena, the crowd screams louder than the blast itself!

objectives.text: Eliminate 50 enemies while wearing any beret in CheckPoint mode

rewards.text: Unlocks MPS Auto Assault-12 Gen 2 12ga automatic shotgun in the Armory

all-for-the-show-soldier.briefing: Too many soft types running around in flashy gear lately. That's not how it should be. Let's bring some real soldier spirit back to the Arena! Being flashy is fine, but right now the crowd wants real fighters, men, soldiers! So pick something appropriate from your gear.

objectives.text: Earn a Match MVP after eliminating 5 or more enemies with AK-12

all-for-the-show-supremacy.briefing: Everything we do here is for the crowd. And they love the smell of gunpowder, blood, explosions, screams. They want a spectacle. But more than that, they need someone to root for. What's the point of watching a fight if you're not backing anyone? The crowd remembers trademarks best. A signature weapon. A signature fighting style. And I've already come up with one for you. Grab an AK-12 and go conquer the Arena!

objectives.text: Take a sample of the chemicals from the damaged tank container on Factory
Hand over the collected sample

all-is-revealed.guide: In this quest you have to take a sample from the chemical in tank container #28 on Factory. FIle:All Is Revealed Map.jpg|Tank container location marked on map File:All Is Revealed Tank Container 28.png|The tank container File:All Is Revealed Sample.png|Sample taking location inside the tank container
all-is-revealed.briefing: Hello, young man. I've received information that one of the tank containers at the Polikhim chemical plant has been damaged. Judging by the description of the liquid inside, it doesn't look like any of the emulsions declared in the official documents. I think the substance in the tank could be hazardous, so I'm asking you to get me a sample as soon as possible. This is the only way we can be sure of our assessment of chemical safety in Tarkov.

requirements: Must reach Loyalty Level 4 with Jaeger to obtain this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate Shturman 20 times

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of SWORD International Mk-18 .338 LM marksman rifle at Jaeger LL4

all-this-filth.guide: In this quest you have to kill Shturman 20 times.
all-this-filth.briefing: Hey there, boy! Come on in. I've got a job for you, an important one. Remember when I asked you to rid the sawmill of scum? Well, it seems that they returned for good now. Shturman and his friends are once again bringing fear into people all around the area, however, I can't deal with them myself. Please, help me get rid of those bandits, and I won't disappoint with the reward. Mechanic introduced me to a new supplier, they're selling me some good and powerful western rifles, the .338 caliber ones. If you help me, you can get some of those for yourself, for shooting elephants, you know. A proper weapon for a good hunt! Well, boy, I'll be waiting for news from you.

objectives.text: Plant a WI-FI Camera at the weather station on Shoreline
Transit from Shoreline to Lighthouse
Plant a WI-FI Camera at the waterside cottage on Lighthouse

rewards.text: 1× Ops-Core FAST MT Super High Cut helmet (Black)

alloy.guide: ====Shoreline stashing location==== At the antennas next to the weather station. File:Alloy Woods Map.png|Antennas marked on map File:Signal2.png|The antennas ====Shoreline to Lighthouse transition==== In front of the "Path to Lighthouse" extraction. File:ShorelineTransitToLighthouseMap.png|Transit location marked on map File:Path to Lighthouse.png|The transit ====Lighthouse stashing location==== On a bed on the second floor of one of the western houses that is directly located at the shore. File:SeasideVacationMap.png|House marked on map File:SeasideVacationHouse.png|The wanted house File:SeasideVacationRoom.png|First room on the left when you use the little bridge
alloy.briefing: The ex-USECs have been spotted on the coast again. Even Knight and his men are involved now. It seems the Rogues are searching for something among the structures along the bay. I need you to establish surveillance on the satellite dishes at the weather station near the Health Resort. We also need to find out what the Rogues are doing in the small cottages by the water near the treatment plant. Hide the camera somewhere among the furniture. If we record audio only, the risk of detection will be lower. So don't look for a spot with a good view, better to tuck it deep into the armchair or sofa somewhere. They're clearly in a hurry. Which means you'll need to complete this assignment in a single run if we don't want to miss the opportunity.

objectives.text: Hand over 5 found in raid dry food type items
Hand over 5 found in raid clean water type items

an-alternative.briefing: I have studied the records you provided. Skier is about to launch a full-fledged recruitment drive for "volunteers”, and he is willing to invest a considerable amount of resources in it. He wants to trick hesitant residents into joining his gang and then use them in his operations. And he certainly will not spare untrained and exhausted recruits. Even at this moment, Skier's men are busy preparing assembly points where food and clothing will supposedly be distributed. However, nothing prevents them from forcing the locals into trucks and forcibly taking them to their territory. We must save the inhabitants from this fate. I have supplies of clothing and even spare rooms where I can temporarily house the newcomers. The shortage of provisions, though, remains a serious problem, and this is where I need your help. Dry provisions and clean water would be best. Obviously, we cannot offer the locals the most comfortable accommodations. Yet it would be much better if potential "volunteers” were under my roof instead of this crook's prison barracks.

objectives.text: Hand over 400,000 RUB to Therapist

an-apple-a-day-keeps-the-doctor-away.briefing: Oh, it's you? Concerned about your health? Well, this is commendable. I have several very effective imported vaccinations, but you understand what situation we are all in, it was not easy to get them, and therefore they cost a lot. But it is up to you to decide what is more important to you, money or health...

requirements: Must be level 21 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Mark the first trading post with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline
Mark the second trading post with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline
Mark the third trading post with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline

anesthesia.guide: In this quest you have to mark Sanitar's 3 treatment locations ("trading posts") with MS2000 Marker on Shoreline. The markers can be placed in any order over any number of raids. File:AnesthesiaxRiggedGameMap.png|Locations marked on map File:AnesthesiaxRiggedGameLocation1.png|1: Next to the ambulance at the resort File:AnesthesiaxRiggedGameLocation2.png|2: In the backyard of the locked cottage File:AnesthesiaxRiggedGameLocation3.png|3: In front of the office building at the pier
anesthesia.briefing: Oh, you're just in time. Maybe you have already heard that a new doctor has shown up? But this one is not some good-willed Aesculapius - he helps some people but cripples others. They say he sells medicine and does surgeries right on the street. They call him Sanitar, can you imagine? He settled on the Shoreline and interestingly enough, the local punks are very happy with him, and it's clear why: he patches them up, and even sells them drugs and first-aid kits of all sorts. This means that he has quite an inventory with him. Find out about this Sanitar, but quietly. For now, just find out where this scum hangs out. I think that he does both the selling and healing at the same spots. You interested?

objectives.text: Locate the missing courier crew on Woods
Survive and extract from the location

another-shipping-delay.guide: In this quest you have to locate Ragman's missing courier on Woods. He can be found next to his burnt-out car at the gate between the big junction and the sawmill. Walk through the gate to complete the objective. File:Another Shipping Delay Map.jpg|Objective location marked on map File:Another Shipping Delay Car.png|Objective location
another-shipping-delay.briefing: Hey, brother! You say the BTR driver wants to leave Skier's gang? You know, that kind of transport would be good for my trade. But you do realize Skier won't appreciate such a move, and it's a risk to my business. Anyway, it's a lot to think about and weigh. Though, you can make the driver's offer more convincing. I got some urgent business to take care of. I lost contact with one of my crews. The guys were running a delivery and they were supposed to be back by now. Return to me if you find any sign of them.

objectives.text: Find 3 Antique teapots in raid
Find 2 Antique vases in raid
Find 1 Axel parrot figurine in raid
Find 2 Raven figurines in raid
Hand over 3 Antique teapots to Ragman
Hand over 2 Antique vases to Ragman
Hand over 1 Axel parrot figurine to Ragman
Hand over 2 Raven figurines to Ragman

rewards.text: 1× Ars Arma CPC MOD.1 plate carrier (A-TACS FG)
Unlocks craft for NPP KlASS Bagariy plate carrier (EMR) at Lavatory level 3

antique-enthusiast.briefing: Hey. Do you remember the guy who had some business with Reshala? The one we gave the goodies last time. Yeah, so looks like he's got a taste of the luxury lifestyle now, he wants some antique vases and antique teapots, I understand it with the vases, but why the hell could he possibly need so many antique teapots? Anyway, a deal is a deal, he pays well for it. Everything has to be fresh and untouched, so find them yourself.

objectives.text: Complete the task Professional Fitness - Part 2
Complete the task To Great Heights! - Part 6
Complete the task Hold the Lead

rewards.text: 262 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
288 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2

arena-business.briefing: You really thought I'd just take you on after a few completed jobs? No, kid, I take this seriously, and that means you've still got some running to do. Help me out in the Arena, and you'll move up fast. Refuse, and… well, you get the idea. It's all in your hands.

objectives.text: Eliminate 20 enemies while wearing the Grinch, Aybolit, Fox, or Hare mask on Dorms, EMERCOM, or Base in LastHero mode

arena-masquerade.briefing: Remember those masks your new fans sent you? Forgot to tell you they didn't reveal who they are. I figured they were just regular guys, but turns out they're some big shots. And they want a real show. So here's the deal: put on a mask, get out into the Arena, and mow down everyone you see. Sounds like a kids' party, but whatever. The money's good, and you'll get your cut. Go on, get to it.

objectives.text: Claim at least 4th place in Last Hero mode 5 times
Win 5 matches in TeamFight or BlastGang mode
Win 5 matches in CheckPoint mode

rewards.text: Unlocks Graffiti ACS White weapon camouflage

arena-pantheon.briefing: You know, I've been reading this one book I found and drew some parallels with the present times. All my best fighters are like a pantheon. And you're there, too. But, unlike Olympus, you can get thrown out of my pantheon. You see, nobody's irreplaceable. So it's in your best interest to hold on tight to the Mars seat. As long as you're in first place, no one can compete with you. So go out there and show me what you're made of! Remind everyone that you're the boss! Put on a show and I'll reward you.

objectives.text: Locate and mark the first section of the cliff path with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse
Locate and mark the second section of the cliff path with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse
Locate and mark the third section of the cliff path with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse
Locate and mark the fourth section of the cliff path with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse

ask-for-directions.guide: In this quest you have to mark 4 sections of the cliff path on Lighthouse. The path is located above the blue (northern) chalet. File:Ask for Directions Map.png|Marker spots marked on map File:Ask for Directions Plant 1.png|Marker spot 1 File:Ask for Directions Plant 2.png|Marker spot 2 File:Ask for Directions Plant 3.png|Marker spot 3 File:Ask for Directions Plant 4.png|Marker spot 4
ask-for-directions.briefing: So Ragman's looking for new routes, you say? I'm thinking about that myself right now, since Skier won't let me go so easily. But there is one option that Ragman could use. I won't pass on my BTR through there, but when I was a puny pedestrian, I used to sneak around there often. You know the village by the cliffs where the cottages are? You can go up from one of the backyards, and then follow the crevice. Then, you reach those wealthy houses, you'll have to be on guard over there. There are no truly safe roads left, so I guess this one's better than nothing. Just make sure you come back to me when you've marked it, I'll double check it with my maps just to be sure.

objectives.text: Eliminate 15 PMC operatives near the Lighthouse peninsula

assessment-part-1.guide: In this quest you have to kill 15 PMC's in the specified area on Lighthouse. File:AssessmentPart1Map.png|Kill area marked on map
assessment-part-1.briefing: I managed to get in touch with Lightkeeper! He is ready to continue communication, if we do him a favor. He says that there are too many aggressive PMCs near the lighthouse approach. Can you sort it out? I'm sure it will open up such opportunities that we have never imagined before!

objectives.text: Locate and mark the first bunker with an MS2000 marker on Woods
Locate and mark the second bunker with an MS2000 marker on Woods
Locate and mark the third bunker with an MS2000 marker on Woods
Locate and mark the fourth bunker with an MS2000 marker on Woods

assessment-part-2.guide: In this quest you have to mark 4 bunkers with MS2000 markers on Woods. File:AssessmentPart2Map.png|Bunkers marked on map File:AssessmentPart2Bunker4.png|1: Bunker at the antenna in the northwest (Scav Bunker extraction) File:AssessmentPart2Bunker3.png|2: Bunker at the northern path to the mountain File:AssessmentPart2Bunker2.png|3: Bunker above the "Mountain Stash" Scav extraction, near the sniper Scav location File:AssessmentPart2Bunker1.png|4: Bunker at the wall in the southwest (ZB-014 extraction)
assessment-part-2.briefing: He's very satisfied with the way you handled the job. Yes, I told Lightkeeper that I had an assistant like you, and that you were the one who did all the work. But you know, it seemed to me that he had already known about you for a long time... And, by the way, he asks that you do one more thing. There are some bunkers in the woods near the mountain. Lightkeeper needs you to find these bunkers and mark them on the map. And you know what's weird? Some USECs tried to contact me and insisted that we not dig in that direction. My guess is that the USEC is connected to these sites. You haven't heard anything about this yourself? Huh.

objectives.text: Eliminate 7 Raiders in The Lab
Find 15 SJ1 TGLabs combat stimulant injector in raid
Find 5 SJ6 TGLabs combat stimulant injector in raid
Find 1 SJ9 TGLabs combat stimulant injector in raid
Hand over 15 SJ1 TGLabs combat stimulant injector to Mechanic
Hand over 5 SJ6 TGLabs combat stimulant injector to Mechanic
Hand over 1 SJ9 TGLabs combat stimulant injector to Mechanic

assessment-part-3.guide: In this quest you have to kill 7 Scav Raiders in The Lab and find the required stimulants in raid.
assessment-part-3.briefing: Oh, hey! You're just in time. There's another job for you from Lightkeeper... Can I tell you something frankly, so that it doesn't go out the door? I don't know how many more of these missions there will be. I thought I'd get in touch with the trader at the Lighthouse and make a partnership agreement. But for some reason we have to prove our loyalty over and over again, to demonstrate the steadfastness of our intentions. And it was I who got you into this... What's the mission? Getting into the laboratory, taking out a group of Raiders. And that's not all. You need to find combat stimulants. Lightkeeper seems to have a keen interest in them, because USEC refused to give him samples for some reason. I understand that it might not be easy, but we've already come this far. I just can't refuse.

requirements: Must be level 30 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Reach the required 10 Health skill level

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Adrenaline injector at Therapist LL4

athlete.briefing: You know, as a doctor, I treat people who have illnesses, it's my job, even in our difficult situation. However, since you sometimes run errands for me, I must be sure that your health is okay. Just to feel safer, you know, so I could be sure that you can see any task through. Prove to me that illnesses and physical conditions won't stop you.

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 Scavs on Customs
Reach the roof of the three-story dorm on Customs
Eliminate 5 Scavs on Shoreline
Reach the east wing of the Health Resort on Shoreline

atonement.guide: ====Skier questline==== In this quest you have to kill 5 Scavs and go on the roof of the 3-story dorms on Customs. File:GoldenSwagMarkedMap.png|Dorms location marked on map File:Atonement Skier Location.png|The roof ====Peacekeeper questline==== In this quest you have to kill 5 Scavs and go on the roof of the health resort east wing on Shoreline. File:HealthResortEastWing.jpg|Health resort east wing location marked on map
atonement.briefing: Hey, man. Looks like we've managed to catch the eye of some major figures. It's a fucking setup now! I thought we had a fucking democracy here at last, but no, there's always someone who'll take over everything. All right, enough moaning. We need to fix this situation before we get whacked. We'll return that phone to the base or whatever. Go to the workers' dorms and clean the place up, then find a good spot for my dogs to stash the phone. And from there, the right people will get in touch with you. We're atoning for our mistakes, I guess.

requirements: Must be level 25 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the musician gathering spot on Streets of Tarkov
Obtain the engraved guitar pick
Hand over the guitar pick to Ragman

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of CQC Osprey MK4A plate carrier (Assault, MTP) at Ragman LL3

audiophile.guide: In this quest you have to find the musician gathering spot and a guitar pick on Streets of Tarkov. The gathering spot is the music room in apartment no. 10 on the fourth floor of the Primorsky 48 apartment building. A Primorsky 46-48 skybridge key is required to enter it via the skybridge from the adjoining Primorsky 46 staircase. The guitar pick has multiple spawns throughout the music room and the adjacent bedroom. It is highly recommended to bring a flashlight with you, since the item is small and the location dark. The apartment 10 entrance door can be breached from the inside to leave. audiophile.briefing: I have another detective job for you. I have a client, a very good guy. A rocker. I used to sell their band all sorts of stuff when they were playing in our town! The guy was in Tarkov when it all started, rehearsing at someone's crib. And then the evacuation started and all that bullshit. So the guy lost his guitar pick... Yeah, man, you're gonna go looking for a plectrum. Why are you so surprised? He got that pick from either Hetfield or that hairy, what's-his-name... The hairy one, you should know! Too-doo-doo, too-doo-doo-doo-doo... Oh, man, they won't take you to Guess the Tune. Anyway, find the plectrum, it's got the AG initials on it, you won't mistake it. You have no idea how much a dude is willing to pay for that plastic shit. An address? If he could remember the address, I'd go to the address myself!

requirements: Must be level 17 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Obtain the financial records on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the journal to Ragman

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of 6B13 assault armor (Flora) at Ragman LL2

audit.guide: In this quest you have to obtain the accountant's notes in the "ФИНАНС" ("FINANCE") building on Streets of Tarkov. They can be found on the second floor, in the first office to the right. A diary with the notes is tucked in a red file folder on the floor. File:FinancialInstitutionMap.png|Building marked on map File:FinancialInstitutionBuilding.png|The building File:FinancialInstitutionOfficeStairs.png|Staircase to the second floor File:Audit2ndFloorOffice.png|The wanted office File:AuditFolderLocation.png|The wanted file folder File:Audit 5.png|Diary inside the file folder
audit.briefing: You know, you look like someone who'd help clean out a bank! Why are you so uptight, bro, that's not what I'm talking about, I'm an honest businessman! But sometimes you watch a heist movie and get so many ideas in your head... Anyway, to the point. I have information that a man from a financial institution that controls the banking sector of Tarkov kept a journal, you know, for when everything goes to shit... The data he kept was from classified official reports. So anyway, as you know, everything did go to shit, but he couldn't manage to pass the info on. Do you have any idea what kind of juice there might be in his doodles? Search the place, find me that journal.

requirements: Must be level 14 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find the unpowered secret exit on Reserve
Survive and extract from the location through the secret exit

back-door.guide: This quest requires you to extract with the "D-2" extraction on Reserve. First, turn on the power with a lever in the command part of the underground bunker system. Be aware, activating the lever has the chance to spawn Scav Raiders in the command part of the bunker. Then, press the button on the wall next to the sliding door at the extraction. You need to exit the raid with the "Survived" status to get the quest completion. The "Run Through" status will not complete the quest. To avoid the "Run Through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting. File:BackDoorD2Marked.png|D-2 extraction and power lever marked on map File:D2 Switch.png|D-2 power lever and the wall button at the extraction File:D2 Extract.png|D-2 extraction with the button on the wall
back-door.briefing: Hey there, what do you think of complex technology? I, for example, was always fascinated by this stuff, when one part depends on another, and even works without human participation, well, almost without it. So, I've been told that somewhere on Reserve there is some underground exit, which is activated from somewhere else, but from where exactly - hell knows. Anyhow, It would be great if you sniffed that place out. The base is quite a hell hole as you know, and I am willing to pay generously for any information on how to get out of there safely. I want to send people there to gather military equipment, but I'm afraid they'll just get killed if they don't find that secret exit.

requirements: Must be level 2 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Obtain the Bronze pocket watch on a chain on Customs
(Optional) Obtain the key to the fuel tanker truck
Hand over the pocket watch

background-check.guide: Head into the map Customs. The Machinery key is required to access the Bronze pocket watch. So if you do not have one, head to room 205 located on the second floor of the three-story dorms building in the south. File:Checking Map.png To enter the room you'll need to jump on top of debris blocking the hall and crouch to get inside the doorway of the room. The Machinery key can be found within the blue jackets beside the wardrobe. File:DormRoom205Entrance.png File:Dorms.png After obtaining the key, head north to the fuel tanker truck that is located at the construction site. The driver side door of the cabin can be unlocked with the Machinery key. File:Checking Map.png File:Machinery Key Door.png Inside, the Bronze pocket watch can be found laying on the floor in front of the seat. Be careful of the sniper Scav overlooking the truck from the roof of the nearby boiler building. File:Machinery key inside.png After picking up the pocket watch, it will be placed in your quest items inventory. You must successfully extract with the pocket watch to hand it in. If you die before extraction, you will have to retrieve it again. Hand the pocket watch over to Prapor to complete the quest.
background-check.briefing: How's it going, warrior? I have an errand for you. My comrade Arseny worked at the factory as a tanker driver. His family left during the evacuation while he stayed behind to make some extra money, and perished here. He lived in a three-story dormitory near Polikhim, I don't remember the room. Anyway, he had a chain watch, a family heirloom. Bragged about it to everyone. Find that watch and bring it to me, I want to send it to his kid. I want the kid to have something to remember his old man by. The watch must be either in his room or in the tanker truck somewhere at the construction site. Arseny always kept the keys in his jacket. Anyway, do the job. So long!

objectives.text: Stash the Grizzly medkit in the large barn at the old sawmill on Woods
Transit from Woods to Customs
Eliminate any 6 targets on Customs
Survive and extract from Customs

rewards.text: 52 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
57 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× AK 7.62x39 Magpul PMAG 30 GEN M3 30-round magazine (Black)

backup-plan.guide: In this quest you first have to stash a Grizzly medical kit on Woods, then transit to Customs, kill any 6 targets there and finally successfully extract. Dying or extracting at any point before completing all objectives will reset fulfilled objectives besides the stashing. The Grizzly medical kit has to be stashed inside a barn at the old sawmill in the east of Woods. It can be stashed on the first or the second floor. File:Provide Cover Woods Map.png|Barn location marked on map File:Provide Cover Woods Building.png|The wanted barn ====Woods to Customs transit==== Near the RUAF Gate extraction. File:WoodsTransitToCustomsMap.png File:WoodsTransitToCustoms.png
backup-plan.briefing: Still no contact with the convoy, and that's bad... So listen up. I sent the group with the new rewards down the river on purpose, less chance of getting spotted. The bay path is blocked by the terminal with soldiers, no way they'd make it through there. So my guys should be coming ashore somewhere near Priozersk, or worst case, customs zone. Until we know exactly where they are, we can at least give them a bit of insurance. If they land in the nature reserve, the only place they'll be able to hole up with all that gear is the old sawmill. There's a two-story barn there with a basement and a good view. I need you to stash some medical supplies there. You can get your hands on a couple of Grizzlies, right? Good. Leave them somewhere inside that building. Now if they end up going through Customs, they'll get torn apart in the shallows before they even make it out. Supplies won't help there, so your best bet is to clear the whole area near the river. Preferably leave nothing alive. And do it fast, or there won't be anyone left to help.

objectives.text: Eliminate 57 Raiders in The Lab
Eliminate 23 PMC operatives in The Lab

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of SIG Sauer ECHO1 1-2x30mm 30Hz thermal reflex scope at Jaeger LL1
Unlocks purchase of L3Harris GPNVG-18 night vision goggles at Jaeger LL1
Unlocks purchase of Armasight Zeus-Pro 640 2-8x50 30Hz thermal scope at Jaeger LL1
Unlocks purchase of Trijicon REAP-IR thermal scope at Jaeger LL1
Unlocks purchase of T-7 Thermal Goggles with a Night Vision mount at Jaeger LL1

bad-feeling.guide: In this quest you have to kill 57 Scav Raiders and 23 PMCs in The Lab.
bad-feeling.briefing: Hello. So looks like a group of Scavs managed to enter that underground lab people have been talking about. Apparently, they were looking for some secret room, but the Raiders stopped them. Now everybody's searching this Lab for that room, and somebody even unlocked the main entrance to the facility. And I'll tell you this: if the room was hidden even from their own staff, then there was definitely something incredibly dangerous going on there. I have a really bad feeling about this, so I ask you to stop the curious bandits. There are many other places to scavenge, right?

requirements: Must be level 12 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find 5 Malboro cigarettes in raid
Find 5 Strike cigarettes in raid
Find 5 Wilston cigarettes in raid
Hand over 5 Malboro cigarettes to Mechanic
Hand over 5 Strike cigarettes to Mechanic
Hand over 5 Wilston cigarettes to Mechanic

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for Bottle of OLOLO Multivitamins at Therapist LL1

bad-habit.guide: All cigarettes can commonly be found inside of: * In Buried barrel caches * In Dead Scavs * In Ground caches * In Jackets * In Plastic suitcases * In Ration supply crates * In Sport bags
bad-habit.briefing: Hello, come here a minute. I need to lay the wiring today, and plan for high power capacity, especially considering the continuous load on the grid. But that’s not the issue now, bring me some cigarettes. I want to work it hard until it’s done, and don't want to get distracted with searching. I know, smoking’s going to kill me. But is it really important enough? Well, anyway, I need around 20 packs, preferably different ones. Oh, and make sure you get the sealed ones, so look for them yourself, no traders. Was good seeing you.

requirements: Must be level 6 to start this quest

objectives.text: Locate and obtain Secure Folder 0031 in one of the bunkhouses on Customs
(Optional) Gain access to the locked room in the office hallway on the third floor on Factory
(Optional) Obtain the Portable bunkhouse key
Hand over the folder to Prapor
Survive and extract from the location

rewards.text: 3× 9x18mm PM PS gs PPO ammo pack (50 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of BelOMO PSO-1M2-1 4x24 scope at Prapor LL2
Unlocks purchase of SSSh-94 SFERA-S helmet at Prapor LL1

bad-rep-evidence.guide: In this quest you have to obtain secure folder 0031 from a bunkhouse on Customs. Even though the bunkhouse is locked, the item can be grabbed through the window, not requiring its key. File:Bad Rep Evidence Customs.png|Bunkhouse location marked on map File:Customs-Portable-cabin-portable.png|The bunkhouse File:Docs 0031 location.png|The secure folder on the table
bad-rep-evidence.briefing: Good day to you, warrior. Step inside. There's a job to do if you're interested. Need to find one piece of crap, and I'm at my wits' end how. Briefly - one of the foremen who worked on that fucking Polikhim has just in time laid his hands on some pretty important documents. You know, of course, how hard is everyone still gunning for any evidence on TerraGroup and its associates? Exactly. But the folks who tried to get the info out of that foreman happened to be more edgy than smart. The dude's ticker stopped ticking before his tongue started wagging. Can you imagine? What dimwits! How do you do business with the likes of them? Okay, back to the point. So he grabbed the docs and stashed them somewhere. Asked around a bit, those who worked with him before. In general, chances don't look too good, but who knows how lucky you can get? In a word, that foreman worked in the chemo shop. The shitmost shit, see. And somewhere on the Customs premises he and his homies had their bunkhouses. Eating there, chilling, most certainly inviting girl over, well, you get it. I figure it's holed up there somewhere, most likely. If it's not there, then we won't find crap at all. So, I want you to search the shacks on Customs and bring me these documents. I think it's best to search for the locked ones.

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 celebrating enemies while wearing the specified equipment on Interchange
Eliminate 5 celebrating enemies while wearing the specified equipment on Lighthouse
Eliminate 5 celebrating enemies while wearing the specified equipment on Reserve
Eliminate 5 celebrating enemies while wearing the specified equipment on Shoreline
Eliminate 5 celebrating enemies while wearing the specified equipment on Woods

Eliminate 5 celebrating enemies while wearing the specified equipment on Factory
Eliminate 5 celebrating enemies while wearing the specified equipment on The Lab

rewards.text: 1× Lobaev Arms DVL-10 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle

bad-santa.guide: Scavs will be circling around the Christmas trees, occasionally shooting in the air. While they make for easy targets, PMCs and "non-celebrating" Scavs will also count towards the quest. The Christmas trees are located on each map as follows: =====Customs===== Located within the courtyard of the dormitories: =====Reserve===== Located next to the E2 bunker: =====Lighthouse===== Located in the Old Landing Scav extract: =====Interchange===== Located inside of the Scav Camp: =====Shoreline===== Inside of the resort, located in the center: =====Woods===== Next to the sawmill on the east side of the water, on the way to the Military Camp. It is located on a dock, so keep your eyes peeled when running near the shoreline:
bad-santa.briefing: Did I tell you I hate all this Christmas commotion? Its like its not fighters around us but some kindergarteners, damn them all! Listen, do something for me: dress up as those fairy tale bastards - a Fake white beard, Santa or Ded Moroz hat, Santas bag, all that stuff. And then mess up some morons. Let everyone know that the only gifts theyll get are bullets in their skulls or slit throats.

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 Scavs while using a Steyr AUG on any location

rewards.text: 47 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
52 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Escape from Tarkov: Arena 3-day trial Note: Activates upon quest completion.

balancing-part-1.guide: In this quest you have to kill 5 Scavs on any location with a Steyr AUG assault rifle. Both the AUG A1 and the AUG A3 can be used.
balancing-part-1.briefing: You did a great job on my assignments. I also ran you through my databases... Just a precaution. You don't hire just anybody, you know what I mean, brother? I'm promoting you to a tester! You're gonna be testing equipment for the Arena. I've just received a good batch of bullpups for a delicious price. Go ahead and try them out on some hobos. After that, I'll decide if these rifles will go to my cleanup guys or the gladiators.

objectives.text: Eliminate 2 PMC operatives while wearing a PACA Soft Armor on any location

rewards.text: 47 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
52 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2

balancing-part-2.briefing: Right, now it's time to test some body armor. This is for the cleanup crew only. Let's see how it holds up against real mercs. Try killing a few PMCs while wearing this PACA armor. After that, I'll see what else I can come up with.

requirements: Must be level 20 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the balletmeister's apartment on Streets of Tarkov
Survive and extract from the location

rewards.text: 1× Eagle Industries MMAC plate carrier (Ranger Green)
Unlocks purchase of 6B5-15 Zh-86 Uley armored rig (Flora) at Ragman LL2

ballet-lover.guide: In this quest, you have to find the balletmeister's apartment on Streets of Tarkov. The wanted apartment is apartment no. 10 on the fourth floor of the Primorsky 48 apartment building. A Primorsky 46-48 skybridge key is required to enter it via the skybridge from the adjoining Primorsky 46 staircase. The apartment 10 entrance door can be breached from the inside to leave. File:Apartment10Map.png|Apartment 10 marked on map File:Apartment10Outside.png|Apartment 10 from outside File:UnderpassKeyMap.png|Skybridge marked on map File:UnderpassKeyUnderpass.png|The skybridge from the ground File:UnderpassKeyWay1.png|Way to the Primorsky 46 staircase 1 File:UnderpassKeyWay2.png|Way to the Primorsky 46 staircase 2 File:UnderpassKeyWay3.png|Way to the Primorsky 46 staircase 3 File:UnderpassKeyWay4.png|Primorsky 46 staircase File:UnderpassKeyStairsDoor.png|Door to the skybridge on the top floor File:UnderpassKeyUnderpassLockedDoor.png|The skybridge with the unlockable door File:UnderpassKeyDoor.png|Door to the Primorsky 48 apartment 10 File:Apartment10Living.png|Inside the balletmeister's apartment
ballet-lover.briefing: Listen, brother, can you help me find proper info on a guy? He's already left the city. Why can't I find him myself? Because his fucking name is Ivan Ivanov. Seriously, I'm not kidding. There are two hundred thousand of them all over the country with that name. If we could find his former address in Tarkov, we might be able to run him through the database. Let me see what I can find on him. I think he used to run a bar, right. I don't know the name of the bar though... Listen, I don't know how you're gonna know which bar is his. Oh, that reminds me, he was into ballet. No kidding. He went to the Mariinsky every season. Even tried to host something at our local theater, but people weren't really crazy about chicks in tutus. More specific? Brother, I'm already fucking specific! I believe in you, use your intuition.

objectives.text: Kill 50 enemies with revolvers in Last Hero or Last Hero Revolvers

barrel-warm-up.briefing: So, you've tried out the revolvers? Not great for survival, but man, what a spectacle! perfect for my Arena. The crowd liked it, so we're continuing. The more enemies you kill with the revolver, the more you get. Show everyone the Wild West, ha!

objectives.text: Find the item: 6-STEN-140-M military battery
Hand over the item: 6-STEN-140-M military battery

battery-change.guide: The quest Order From Outside from Lightkeeper will automatically fail if this quest is completed first. If you want to hand over a 6-STEN-140-M military battery which was obtained before accepting the quest, you have to move it to a different inventory slot for the "Find" objective to trigger. Bug: Accepting the quest and handing over a battery in the same raid does currently not work in local PvE game mode raids.
battery-change.briefing: How are the negotiations progressing? I mean, I understand that Prapor needs to mull it over first, but I'm running out of time! Gotta survive somehow while you're building bridges. No complaints against you, obviously. I don't even have any spare batteries now, and electronics can go to shit at any moment. I could even do with a tank battery right now, I might be able to make it work with my BTR. You think you can find one of those? Because without it, it's over for me.

objectives.text: Kill 15 enemies in Last Hero or LH: Revolvers mode in a single match
Get 6 headshot kills in Last Hero or LH: Revolvers in a single match

battle-of-the-duelists.guide: The kills have to be done with Revolvers, while the headshots can be done with any weapon.
battle-of-the-duelists.briefing: Hmm… Something's off — everyone's fighting to casually. You included. Wanna earn some cash? Then entertain the crowd properly. Show them what real gunfighter duels are all about: six of them should have your bullet in their head. And on top of that, rack up 15 corpses. All in one arena run!

objectives.text: Hand over 25 found in raid Radar station spare parts
Hand over 15 found in raid GARY ZONT portable electronic warfare devices

rewards.text: 1× Kalashnikov PKP 7.62x54R infantry machine gun (variant Zenit)

before-the-rain.guide: Radar station spare parts can be found inside special airdrop crates that get dropped at the beginning of the second mortar fire barrage on Shoreline, Woods, Reserve and Customs. The GARY ZONT portable electronic warfare devices have a chance to spawn on Rogues on Lighthouse. The Goons are guaranteed to have the devices on them.
before-the-rain.briefing: Come on in. The airdrops keep coming in, and our job is to hold on to whatever we can intercept. If these assholes have mastered mortars, they'll be unstoppable with EWs and spare parts for them. Bring me everything you can get. I'll prepare a good reward.

objectives.text: Survive and extract from Customs through Railroad Passage

belka-and-strelka.guide: In this quest you have to extract from Customs via the "Railroad Passage" extraction with the "survived" status. For the extraction to open, you have to shoot a green flare into the sky while being inside the signal flare area. Upon entering the signal flare area, a notifcation will pop up in the bottom right corner of the screen: File:KlimovStreetSignalAreaNote.png If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the extraction won't open. If the flare was fired correctly, a new notification pops up: File:FlareSuccessNote.png You can use either the handheld RSP-30 green flare provided by Prapor via in-game mail or a 26x75mm green flare cartridge fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 green flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. If you need additional flares you can buy them from Jaeger. To avoid the "run through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting. File:Belka and Strelka Map.png|Extraction marked on map File:Railroad Passage.png|The extraction File:RailroadPassageCustomsSignalArea.png|Signal flare area and extract zone map
belka-and-strelka.briefing: Hey, soldier! I've got a new reconnaissance mission for ya. I was able to arrange a deal with the fellas who control the railroad at the old customs gas station, but I haven't sent any of my couriers that way yet. We gotta check it out first. The plan is simple: you fire the green flare and extract. It's like a job Belka did... or was it Strelka? Ah, whatever, you know what I'm trying to say. I'll pay you for risking your skin, but make sure you don't get whacked before even getting to that place, and take your time on the exit itself. I've heard enough tales of mercs who shoot the flare and run to the exit immediately before the flare even lights up properly... On a completely unrelated note, may I interest you in a cheap new helmet with bullet hole vents?

beneath-the-streets.guide: ===Streets of Tarkov to The Lab=== Underground entrance in front of the Klimova 16A building with the Cosmonaut painting. TerraGroup Labs access keycard required. Transits are only available 1 min after raid start. File:StreetsTransitToLabsMap.png File:StreetsTransitToLabsUpstairs.png File:StreetsTransitToLabsDownstairs.png ===Scout the control room=== Near the the "Hangar Gate" extraction on the second level. Transits are only available 1 min after raid start. File:TheLabTranistToStreetsOfTarkovMap.png File:TheLabTranistToStreetsOfTarkov.png
beneath-the-streets.briefing: Good afternoon. I have received information that somewhere under the city there is an abandoned entrance to the Laboratory. Apparently, TerraGroup has converted one of the old bomb shelters into an emergency exit from their lab. This presents us with a unique opportunity to acquire all the precious equipment we need with minimal risk! However, I cannot send my people out without reconnaissance, it would be too dangerous. It's better to have someone experienced check this passage first and make sure the areas of interest are secure. Will you help us?

objectives.text: Eliminate 50 enemies while under the influence of Adrenaline in any game mode

berserker.briefing: I don't know what else to offer you. You know what drives me? I'll tell you – money. Lots of money. You have no idea how much cash is around here. And you absolutely have no idea how many serious people possess that cash. However, I have an idea how I can help you. It's a win-win for both of us. One of the main investors – you're not authorized to know his name – has a whole shipping container of TerraGroup experimental injectors. Combat stimulants. There are side effects obviously, but most importantly, they numb your senses. It doesn't interfere with gunfighting, but you won't remember much about the previous day. At least, that's what the med experts say. If you want, I'll get some for you. For you, warrior, I'll do my best, but don't let me down again. Show me what you're worth.

requirements: Must be level 25 to start this quest.
Obtain level 4 loyalty with Prapor

objectives.text: Eliminate any 30 enemies with AK-74 series weapons on Reserve or Lighthouse

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of ASh-12 12.7x55 assault rifle at Prapor LL4

best-job-in-the-world.guide: In this quest you have to kill any 30 hostiles with AK-74 series weapons. You can use any of the following: *AK-74 *AK-74M *AK-74N *AKS-74 *AKS-74N
best-job-in-the-world.briefing: Alright, soldier! I've got a mission for you from the Motherland! Need you to wipe out a gang or two of looters. Think that'll be easy? Don't get cocky. Keep your head down and get the job done. And don't forget to report back when it's over. No report, no reward.

objectives.text: Eliminate 150 enemies in any gamemode

best-served-cold.briefing: You didn't think I'd just leave it like that, did you? These motherfuckers are ruining my arena! Trying to dictate their rules! They almost took out one of my best champions! I've already made the necessary arrangements with the right guys. Anyway, in your next matches, you'll be facing opponents from those fuckers' gang. Your job is simple — kill as many of them as you can. How and where — that's your call. The key is to eliminate those pricks once and for all.

objectives.text: Return to the old champion's hideout on Customs
Locate and obtain the compromising information on Ref
Hand over the found info

between-two-fires.guide: By completing Decisions, Decisions or Surprise Gift, you will fail and lose access to this quest. The champion's room is located on the second floor of the three-story dorms building on Customs, between the rooms 209 and 211. A Dorm overseer key is required to enter it. File:DormOverseerKeyMap.png|Room location marked on three-story dorms map File:DormOverseerKeyDoor.png|Door to the room The compromising information can be found on the floor in a puddle of blood next to the wardrobe. File:CompromisingInformationLocation.png
between-two-fires.briefing: So you saw a dead body. Did you search it? Did you check around it? I'm just pointing out that you're blind. The champion, as far as I know, kept a journal. Yeah, like some teenager, but that's actually working in your favor. Why don't you go over there again and take a closer look? There's got to be more information in the journal about Ref, some dirt on him. Do that if you want to stop being expendable in the Arena. And one more thing: if you bring me any info on Ref that'll be worthy of my time, I'll pay you well.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain information on culinary secrets at the Beluga restaurant on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the found data

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of AK CSS knurled charging handle at Skier LL3

beyond-the-red-meat.guide: *Not all spawn locations for the quest item require this key. It is not entirely needed to complete the quest. In this quest you have to find the Chef's diary in the Beluga restaurant on Streets of Tarkov. There are multiple spawns throughout the building. File:Beluga restaurant map.png|Beluga restaurant marked on map ====First spawn==== On the second floor, on the shelf within the oval bar tucked between towels. File:BeyondTheRedMeatSpawn0201.png File:BeyondTheRedMeatSpawn0202.png ====Second spawn==== On the third floor, on the shelf under the bar. File:Beyond the Red Meat Part 1 3rd spawn far.png File:Beyond the Red Meat Part 1 3rd spawn.png ====Third spawn==== On the third floor in the kitchen, placed within a cabinet near the four sinks. File:BeyondTheRedMeatSpawn0101.png File:BeyondTheRedMeatSpawn0102.png ====Fourth spawn==== On the third floor inside the restaurant director's room, on the illuminated shelf. File:The Red Meat Part 1 4th spawn far.png File:The Red Meat Part 1 4th spawn close.png
beyond-the-red-meat.briefing: Opa, soldier boy! Since you're here and doing jack shit right now, we're gonna put you to work. Our gang has a great cook who makes divine dishes for us all, so I want to give him a present to thank him for his service to the boys. There's a fancy restaurant in the city on Klimov street, best chefs in town, all that shit. Go there, check it out, see if you can find a secret recipe or shit like that.

requirements: Must accept Skier's quest Chemical - Part 4 to obtain this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the transport with the chemicals on Customs
Mark the vehicle with an MS2000 Marker

big-customer.guide: By completing either Chemical - Part 4 or Out of Curiosity, you will fail and lose access to this quest. You can buy the MS2000 Marker from Prapor. After placing the marker, the player must stay alive for 30 seconds or they will have to place another beacon in the van. You do not need to be near the van after the marker has been placed. Find a nearby hiding spot and wait until the timer is complete. File:BigCustomerMap.jpg|Warehouse marked on map File:Depot-building customs.png|The warehouse with the vehicle inside. File:The van inside the depot-building.png|The vehicle where the beacon is placed.
big-customer.briefing: Good afternoon! Our world is really small here - I found out that you’ve been teaming up with Skier lately. Let’s go straight to business - I need to know where to get that chemical of yours, a big customer wants to buy out all the crates for a good price. I don’t care why he needs it, I’m a bit tighter on funds now than I would like to be. So, are you in? I won't disappoint with the reward, of course.

objectives.text: Locate the AVOKADO store on Interchange
Locate the KOSTIN store on Interchange
