Locate the tRend store on Interchange
Locate the DINO CLOTHES store on Interchange
Locate the TOP BRAND store on Interchange
Survive and extract from the location

big-sale.guide: Walk into each of the listed stores in the same raid and survive to complete the quest. All of the stores are on the first floor of the ULTRA shopping mall. File:BigSaleMarked.jpg|Stores marked on map File:Avokado.png|Avokado store File:Kostin.png|Kostin store File:Trend.png|tRend store File:Dinoclothes.png|Dino clothes store File:Topbrand.png|Top brand store
big-sale.briefing: You know, brother, I'll tell you what, clothes will always be of value. War or no war, people still buy that stuff. Ultra had a bunch of brand outlets, the ones folks used to hype on, and I could use the things from there now. Do a quick sweep, check if there is anything left if they're not thrashed yet. Don't worry, I'm not asking you to loot any clothes, I just want you to check if there's anything left in the stores, we will figure everything out later. Just don't go about rummaging through trash, remember, brand stuff only.

objectives.text: Find 3 Aceso Xpress semi-automatic biochemical analyzers in raid
Hand over the items

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for Money case at Therapist LL1

biochemistry.briefing: This icebreaker you've found is a real discovery! If it is located that far out, there could still be medical equipment on board that survived the blast in the city center… We will not get a second opportunity like this. In conditions of isolation and the inability to provide full hospital care, we usually rely on specialized biochemical analyzers. They allow us to perform a wide range of tests quickly and with the necessary accuracy. However, most of the reserve units in Tarkov were taken by emergency services during the evacuation. But on the icebreaker there could still be analyzers in working condition. Especially if it is connected to TerraGroup. Search for them for me, preferably several. The ship likely had its own medical section where they could have been installed.

objectives.text: Locate and mark the first heat exchanger with an MS2000 Marker on Factory
Locate and mark the second heat exchanger with an MS2000 Marker on Factory
Locate and mark the third heat exchanger with an MS2000 Marker on Factory

black-swan.guide: In this quest you have to find 3 heat exchangers in the underground tunnels on Factory and mark them with MS2000 Markers. File:Black Swan Map.jpg|Locations marked on map File:HeatExchangers1.png|First heat exchanger opposite the "Camera Bunker Door" Scav extraction File:HeatExchangers2.png|Second heat exchanger File:HeatExchangers3.png|Third heat exchanger
black-swan.briefing: I don't understand why nobody notices the obvious patterns in the platinum price change. We're facing a total crisis but I'm the one they're calling pessimistic! Well, let's see how they buy up platinum at the overprice. By the way, we have old heat exchangers under the plant, they have those old corrugated tubes from Soviet times with platinum inserts in them. At times like this, you always want to be prepared for a possible crisis. Can you help me stock up? Just mark the heat exchangers with strobes.

requirements: Must be level 6 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 15 Scavs on Customs

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Army bandage at Therapist LL2

blood-in-the-water.guide: Enter the map Customs and search for and kill fifteen Scavs whom can be found throughout the map but the most concentrated source is the construction site, the dorms and at the old gas station.
blood-in-the-water.briefing: Glad to see you once again. My people found out who was involved in all of these illegal operations with clean water. Thanks to your information, of course. In short, it's a gang of Scavs operating in the Customs area. I'm really not comfortable with this kind of request, but there are lives at stake, and these scoundrels still go on with their dirty business. We need to properly scare them off, so let them die in suffering so they would feel what they've done and what are being punished for. Will you do it?

objectives.text: Eliminate 50 enemies on Base, Dorms, or EMERCOM in LastHero mode

blood-on-the-snow.briefing: Hey, where do you think you are going like that? Wipe your feet, you're dragging in half the muddy street! You know, I am not big on winter. The whole city goes silent, people hide in their holes. Nothing going on! But our sponsors have never seen a real northern winter. We should show them one, even if it is only on the Arena. I figured red blood on white snow would make quite the picture. Eye catching stuff. That is what I want from you.

objectives.text: Eliminate 30 Bloodhounds

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of 7.62x39mm BP gzh at Jaeger LL1

bloodhounds-quest.guide: In this quest you have to kill 30 Bloodhounds. They can be found at the following locations: ====Customs==== *At the Scav base (ZB-013 extraction) building with the numerous mounted weapons *At the shipping yard premises File:BloodhoundSpawnsCustoms.jpg ====Woods==== *At the antenna in the northwest (Scav Bunker extraction) *At the dilapidated village in the north *At the Scav base (EMERCOM medical camp) *At the village in the northeast *Near the fenced off cabin southwest of the sawmill area File:BloodhoundSpawnsWoods.jpg ====Shoreline==== *At the hydroelectric power station *At the gas station *Western of the river in the area between the power station and the gas station *At the village in the west File:BloodhoundSpawnsShoreline.jpg
bloodhounds-quest.briefing: I have serious work for you. Something very dangerous. But I'll make it worth your while. The owner of a well-known Arena in the region let out his hounds, looking for two fugitives from the cleanup crew. One of them is a former PMC, my old trusted friend. The other one is a Scav, Ryzhy, the kid's name is famous now. They know a lot and are generally for the good cause. That is why they mustn't be captured.We must calm these Arena men down. But be careful, they're more dangerous than regular bandits. Can you handle it?

requirements: Must be level 50 to start this quest.
Obtain level 3 loyalty with Ragman

objectives.text: Find 10 Bottles of Tarkovskaya vodka in raid
Find 10 Bottles of Dan Jackiel whiskey in raid
Find 3 Canister with purified water in raid
Find 20 Bottles of Pevko Light beer in raid
Hand over 10 Bottles of Tarkovskaya vodka to Ragman
Hand over 10 Bottles of Dan Jackiel whiskey to Ragman
Hand over 3 Canister with purified water to Ragman
Hand over 20 Bottles of Pevko Light beer to Ragman

rewards.text: Unlocks Bottle Hideout shooting range target style

booze.briefing: Welcome, brother! Say, how do you feel about booze? I've got an order for a large batch of alcohol. Just imagine, there's war going around, but people still drink... Anyway, I need it to be fresh, so make sure you find only the good stuff. You've got golden hands, always find everything I need. So what do you think, can you find me some grog? We'll have a good drink to success after! Some vodka and whiskey would be great for a start. Oh, and get some water canisters too. For the eventual hangover, you know.

objectives.text: Eliminate 20 enemies with headshots in SBEU HERO mode

brain-matter-distribution.briefing: Our lunatic sponsor wants to see people blowing each other's brains out with those hideous guns. I promise, this is the last favor I'm doing for the guy. After this, I'm not agreeing to any more of his crazy ideas. Don't worry gladiator, I'll make sure you're paid well. Now get out there!

requirements: Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

objectives.text: Destroy the transmitter on the factory chimney near the unfinished construction site on Customs
Destroy the transmitter on the power line tower on Customs
Destroy the transmitter on top of the mountain on Woods
Destroy the transmitter on the cell tower on Woods

break-the-chain.guide: In this quest you have to destroy 4 Radio repeater placed on high points on Customs and Woods by shooting at them. File:Break the Chain Customs Map.jpg|All the transmitter marked on map. File:Break the Chain Factory Chimney Repeater.png|The transmitter visible on top of the factory chimney next to the fortress. File:Break the Chain Power Line Repeater.png|The power line tower south of custom next to the fallen train. The 2 Radio repeater on Woods. File:Break the Chain Woods Map.jpg|All the transmitter marked on map. File:Break the Chain Mountain Repeater.png|The transmitter visible on top of the mountain where a scav sniper spawn. File:Break the Chain Cell Tower Repeater.png|The transmitter visible on top of the cell tower at scav bunker.
break-the-chain.briefing: Back to our operation. I've located the sources of the radio transmissions. Those signal points weren't there before, and their placement suggests someone has built an entire network of relay stations to provide full coverage across a large area. I haven't seen these relays with my own eyes, but I'm convinced they're part of Black Division's infrastructure. They use them to coordinate operations and maintain complete situational awareness across their squads. In Tarkov, that gives them a massive advantage, and it's one we can take away. Will you help? Check the high ground and pay special attention to the tallest structures: antennas, towers, smokestacks, anything like that. Somewhere up there, Black Division has mounted their relay stations. Bring a scope with you and keep an eye out for two radios mounted together as a single unit. Once you find them, take them out.

objectives.text: Stash a DVL-10 sniper rifle at the specified spot on Customs
Stash a DVL-10 magazine at the specified spot on Customs
Stash an ELCAN SpecterDR scope at the specified spot on Customs
Stash a pack of any 7.62x51 ammo at the specified spot on Customs

rewards.text: 1× IOTV Gen4 body armor (High Mobility Kit, MultiCam)

break-the-deal.guide: In this quest you have to stash the 4 specified items on the scaffolding of the industrial plant on Customs. After accepting the quest you will be sent a set of the required items via in-game mail. It is possible to completely disassemble the DVL-10 rifle since it doesn't need to be functional to be stashed. Note: If you have a DVL-10 equipped as primary or secondary weapon, it will be used up as first for the stashing. File:Provide Viewership map.png|Location marked on map File:Break the Deal building.png|The industrial plant scaffolding File:Break the Deal spot 1.png|SpecterDR scope spot: 2nd floor at the crates in the far corner File:Break the Deal spot 2.png|DVL-10 magazine spot: 3rd floor in the broken crate File:Break the Deal spot 3.png|Ammo pack spot: 4th floor at the stacked crates next to the stairs File:Break the Deal spot 4.png|DVL-10 rifle spot: 4th floor at the crates in the far corner
break-the-deal.briefing: Yo, you doing good? You will never believe what I'm going to tell you right now. I have a job for you! Alright, jokes aside, the Reshala guy wants to jump head first into a new business. And believe me, I don't want this fucker in there. I found out this punk's planning a meeting with one of my partners with ties to the big land. Thing is, we only know the meeting spot, but we don't know when they're gonna sort their shit out. So I hired a trustworthy sniper to crash the meeting when it happens. Except that now he's in his position out there all the fucking time, can't even go down to take a piss. What's more, the stash I set up for him at the lookout spot was found by the Scavs, and they looted everything clean. You think you can drop off the rest of the gear? It's at the plant with three large pipes in the middle of the industrial zone. It's got some metal scaffolding or something around it... Hide it all over that scaffolding, alright? Shit, man, of fucking course I'll pay you for it. Work hard, and you'll earn hard, hehe.

objectives.text: Hand over the decrypted flash drive

break-through.guide: Hand over the decrypted flash drive to Skier.
break-through.briefing: The only problem with this fucking thumb drive is that it's encrypted. And I don't want to mess with it, don't want to waste my energy and money on it. Take it to Mechanic. I already spoke to him about it. Just give it to him, no need for small talk even.

objectives.text: Modify an IWI UZI to comply with the given specifications

breathing-room.guide: UZI specifications: * 100 Durability * 220 or less recoil * 60 or more ergonomics * 200 or greater sighting range * A silencer
breathing-room.briefing: You got here just in time. I've had a look at the disk. It's a build of some text game. I don't have time for it right now though, I've got too many weapon orders at hand. I'll make you a deal. You help me build one gun, and I'll give you the disk. You'll figure it out on your own. Then tell me if there's anything interesting on it. Maybe I'll take a look at it when I have time. I need an IWI UZI with specific adjustments: ergonomics over 60, recoil sum no more than 220, sighting range over 200, and slap a suppressor on that thing as well.

objectives.text: Locate the hidden recording studio on Lighthouse
Place a Signal Jammer inside the studio

broadcast-part-1.guide: In this quest you have to find the hidden recording studio on Lighthouse and place a Signal Jammer there. An Operating room key is needed to enter it. The studio can be found on the first floor of office building #1, which is located at the water treatment plant area in the north. File:OperatingRoomMap.png|Building marked on map File:OfficeBuilding1.png|Office building #1 at the water treatment plant File:OperatingRoom.png|The studio is in the northeast corner File:OperatingRoomClose.png|Inside the room
broadcast-part-1.briefing: Hello, friend. I've been thinking about something. It's starting to seem to me that I don't really understand anything in life. Come, sit down... People are saying there's a live broadcast going somewhere in the city. They say that someone is performing surgeries and filming it on their camera. I'd understand if it was an actually good willed doctor helping people. I would even understand if there was an organ trade, although that in itself is disgusting. But tell me, why stream this? Is this a kink for some perverted oligarchs? I honestly don't have an answer. But I do know that this broadcast must be shut down. Can you put a jammer near them?

requirements: Must be level 15 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the place of bloody broadcast inside the grocery store on Streets of Tarkov
Survive and extract from the location

broadcast-part-2.guide: In this quest you have to find the location of the bloody broadcast on Streets of Tarkov. The broadcast location is inside the Primorsky ave Sparja store. File:BroadCast2Map.png|Sparja store marked on map File:SparjaStoreOutside.png|The Sparja store File:BroadCast2CamLoc.png|Broadcast location as seen from main entrance File:BroadCast2Cam.png|The broadcast location
broadcast-part-2.briefing: Friend, remember when you and I shut down that broadcast with the jammer at the Lighthouse? These people started it up again. The guys showed me the tape, it's just... I'm speechless. I regret watching it. Can you find a new location where the broadcast is coming from? From the surroundings, it looks like some kind of grocery store.

requirements: Must be level 20 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the place of bloody broadcast inside the old house on Streets of Tarkov
Survive and extract from the location

broadcast-part-3.guide: In this quest you have to find the location of another bloody broadcast on Streets of Tarkov. The broadcast location is inside the "Dostoevski" restaurant at the Malevicha street. File:Broadcast3Map.png|Restaurant marked on map File:Broadcast part 3,1.png|The restaurant File:Broadcast part 3,2.png|The broadcast location
broadcast-part-3.briefing: Hello, Mechanic gave me the gist of the situation. It's horrible, gives me the creeps. But we have to get to the truth. And you know what's even worse? The camera that Mechanic's techs looked at contained not only the recordings we knew of, but also even more at different places. As if someone is playing with us and wants us to see these recordings. There was an old house, with corpses at the table, like in a biblical story. Find this place, something's not right about this.

requirements: Must be level 27 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the cultist meeting spot on Streets of Tarkov
Survive and extract from the location

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of .45 ACP RIP at Mechanic LL4

broadcast-part-4.guide: In this quest you have to find the location of the cultist meeting spot on Streets of Tarkov. The meeting spot is located on the third floor of the northern abandoned factory building in the marked room. File:AbandonedFactoryNorthernBuilding.png|Marked room location in the northern building marked on map File:FactoryMarkedRoomOutside.png|Marked room in the building and basement entrance marked File:MarkedRoomFromStairsView.png|View to the marked room from second floor staircase File:FactoryMarkedRoomDoor.png|Door to the marked room File:FactoryMarkedRoomInside2.png|Inside the marked room
broadcast-part-4.briefing: It's the same story again, a new recording, now with a strange symbol. What the hell is going on? People are being sacrificed. To whom? Why? So many questions, yet no answers. I keep thinking it's the worst we'll ever see, but every time I'm proven wrong. We've fought looters with only money on their minds. Murderers who just want to shoot innocents, too. But at least I understand the motivation there, the beast has defeated the human in their soul. But with what purpose do people become these... I cannot understand this. So, soldier, I'll look for them in the woods, you do the same in the city. Somewhere there must be their hideout. Look for the same symbol, I'm sure we'll see it again.

objectives.text: Eliminate Priest
Locate the ritual spot on Chekannaya st. on Streets of Tarkov
Stash a Cultist knife at the ritual spot
Survive and extract from the location

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for Armasight Zeus-Pro 640 2-8x50 30Hz thermal scope at Jaeger LL4

broadcast-part-5.guide: In this quest you have to kill a Cultist priest on any location and obtain a Cultist knife to stash it in the ritual spot at Chekannaya st. 13 on Streets of Tarkov. File:Mysterious marked key onmap.png|Ritual spot location marked on map File:Mysterious key building entrance.png|Entrance to the building through a window from the courtyard File:Mysterious key path1.png|Once inside, get in the corridor and move to the second room on the left File:Mysterious key path2.png|In the bedroom, go through the hole in the wall File:Mysterious key path3.png|After going through the hole, get downstairs and open the door to the left File:Mysterious key room door.png|You get in front of the door to unlock File:Mysterious key room.png|Stashing location at the cross
broadcast-part-5.briefing: All right, it's time to take the next step. We now know the Hoods are involved in this case. You get them talking! Force them to reveal themselves, you gotta do something that lets them know we're not messing around. Kill one of them, maybe one of their higher-ups. Don't even try finding them in the city though, it's impossible. But we do need to hide the trophy there, so that they get the hint. I hear these nutcases have a new ritual point. Try there, kid.

objectives.text: Locate and neutralize Reshala while using a Toy gun
Eliminate 3 Reshala's guards while using a Toy gun

bucket-of-nothing.guide: In this quest you have to kill Reshala and 3 of his guards with the "Blicky" 20x1mm toy gun.
bucket-of-nothing.briefing: Attention, soldier! W-where's your reaction? In my... uh... back in my day, we didn't even wait for the order to finish, we were already standing at attrac... attention! But you know what? Things have been way too quiet in Tarkov lately. That's when you can't let your guard down. Next thing you know, you're getting shitfaced with vodka... just out of boredom! Tell me, when was the last time you actually stepped outside your hideout for a real combat task, huh? Don't worry, I already know! Sitting on your stockpiled food, haven't fired a shot in fuck knows how long! What, you gonna tell me I'm wrong? Truth is, you're a solid warrior... if you weren't so damn lazy and trained more often, you could drop anyone with even a Makarov. Hell, not just a Makarov — even a toy pistol, the b... Blicky! Like the ones everyone had as kids, remember? Ah, who am I kidding, you don't remember shit! Alright, enough... Listen to your new orders: some thugs with no affiliation have taken up a firing position in the dorms on Customs. Your objective is to assault and clear it. Use of weapons chambered in 20 by 1 millimeters is authorized. Dismissed!

objectives.text: Sell any 50 items to Ragman
Sell any 50 items to Prapor
Sell any 50 items to Peacekeeper

building-foundations.guide: In this quest you have to sell any 50 items to Ragman, Prapor and Peacekeeper each, with the exception of ammunition and Balaclava (White). Note: Sometimes the sales count doesn't update right away. To force an update, you can ready up for a raid and immediately cancel it, or restart the game to refresh your profile.
building-foundations.briefing: You know, you've been helping me out for a while now, and I haven't even brought you up to speed with this whole situation. So, I'm working with Skier now. I deliver his goods, and sometimes I'm involved in his operations. At first it was a nice lucrative gig, but now this asshole won't let me off the hook for even a second. He thinks I'm his personal fucking mule now! He seems to have found out somehow that I'm tired of all this, and now he's brought his punks to my base to teach me a lesson. I'm not gonna put up with this shit anymore. I'd leave him a long time ago, but I do need protection and guarantees, you know. And since you're in contact with other traders, you could put in a good word for me. Can you help a friend out?

objectives.text: Eliminate a smuggler on any location
Locate the smuggler's camp on Shoreline
Obtain the evidence of the smugglers' ties to Edward

bulldogs-under-the-rug.guide: Smugglers can be found in groups of 3-4 on Customs, Woods, Shoreline, Interchange, Lighthouse, Streets of Tarkov and Ground Zero (Level 21+). File:Smuggler.png|Appearance of a Smuggler File:InterchangeSmugglerLocations2026.jpg|Interchange spawns marked on map File:ShorelineSmugglerLocations2026.jpg|Shoreline spawns marked on map File:WoodsSmugglerLocations2026.jpg|Woods spawns marked on map File:CustomsSmugglerLocations2026.jpg|Customs spawns marked on map File:LighthouseSmugglerLocations2026.jpg|Lighthouse spawns marked on map File:Streets of TarkovSmugglerLocations2026.png|Streets of Tarkov spawns marked on map The evidence has multiple spawns in the northern warehouse of the smugglers' camp on Shoreline. File:Bulldogs Under The Rug Map.png|Building location marked on map File:Bulldogs Under The Rug Spawn 1.png|1: On one of the center tables with the radio system File:Bulldogs Under The Rug Spawn 2.png|2: On a shelf next to the desk with the bench drill File:Bulldogs Under The Rug Spawn 3.png|3: In the adjacent container, on the tables with the bench grinder
bulldogs-under-the-rug.briefing: Hello. You probably have no idea how complicated my work in Tarkov can be. Balancing the demands of our partners at the UN with the interests of the local players is not exactly easy, and those compromises can be costly. But somewhere across the border there's this one... individual who seems convinced he could do my job better than I can. Edward has already tried to undermine my reputation at the council more than once. Looks like this time he has decided to take things a step further. You may have noticed that airdrops into Tarkov have become more frequent lately. On top of that, smuggler activity around the bay has picked up as well. I have a feeling all of this might somehow be connected to Edward. If he is planning something, we need to stop him before it gets out of hand. This cooperation benefits both of us, and I can assure you that you would get nothing like that from Edward. So it is very much in your own interest to help me deal with this traitor.

objectives.text: Obtain the False flash drive from the specified spot on Customs
Stash the False flash drive in the trash opposite of the stairs on the 3rd floor of the dorm on Customs
Stash 1 SV-98 sniper rifle in the trash opposite of the stairs on the 3rd floor of the dorm on Customs
Stash 1 Roler Submariner gold wrist watch in the trash opposite of the stairs on the 3rd floor of the dorm on Customs
You must not kill any Scavs on Customs while the task is active

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of CMMG Mk47 Mutant 7.62x39 assault rifle at Skier LL4
Unlocks barter for 12/70 RIP ammo pack (5 pcs) at Skier LL2
Unlocks barter for Kiba Arms Titan ballistic plate at Skier LL3

bullshit.guide: Before starting your trip to the 3-story dorms on Customs, you need to acquire the Flash drive with fake info. It can be found in the passenger side door of a blue burnt-out car on the main bridge that is located on the eastern side of the location. You can extract with the flash drive and plant it in another raid. File:BullshitFlashDriveCarMap.png|Car location marked on map File:BullshitFlashDriveCar.png|The car that contains the flash drive File:Bullshit False FD Location.png|Flash drive in the passenger side door For the duration of this quest you are only allowed to kill PMC's, not any Scavs or Scav bosses. With this in mind it's recommended that you bring a suppressed weapon to deal with PMC's and not attract Scavs. Stun grenades can be used to make Scavs temporarily harmless. Doing this quest at night also helps, as Scavs have a harder time detecting you. Be sure to put the Roler Submariner gold wrist watch in your secure container so you don't lose it if you die. It also helps to bring a friend along to deal with any Scavs in your way. Now that you're all ready it's time to head to the 3-story dorms and get up to the 3rd floor. In the middle of the 3rd floor, right across from the staircase is the trash pile where you need to plant the items. You do not need to plant all items in the same raid and they can be planted in any order. Once all items are placed, you have completed the quest. It is not required to survive the raid. File:Bullshit-Dropoff.png|Trash pile where the items need to be placed Note: Even after placing all items, killing any Scavs will result in a failure. Do not kill any Scavs until you have left the raid and turned in the quest. You may die by any means and still complete the quest.
bullshit.briefing: So, here's why I called for you. I've caught a mole in my team, this prick was leaking info about my supply channels and points of interest. Of course, I started to wonder what the fuck was going on. My men got intel off of him and found out that he was leaking the info to one of the local crews, those that settled by the dorms at the customs area. The thing is, I want to give them some bullshit info on my "next cargo", and my men will cut them down when those pricks come for it. But this intel should be delivered with no fuss no muss, as if you were one of them, get it? You will need to stash the Flash drive with the special info, it's planted in the blue car, on the big bridge on Customs. My guys got ambushed at that bridge, so they couldn't hide it anywhere closer to the dorms, sorry. Stash that thumb drive along with an SV-98 and a Roler watch in the dorm, that's how we agreed to do this. And the most important thing: do not smoke any Scavs on Customs and just leave quietly when you're done.

objectives.text: Eliminate 50 infected on any location

burn-it-down.guide: File:InfectedCivilian.png|Infected civilian File:InfectedLabTechnician.png|Infected lab technician File:InfectedPMC.png|Infected PMC
burn-it-down.briefing: So I went to see this "friend" of ours. She says she needs time. That's exactly what we don't have right now! The contagion is spreading quickly, the sick have already been seen above ground. We must forget about the old problems for a while and put all our energies into killing the scourge. Take plenty of ammunition and don't let them surround you. Until we have a cure, our only option is to kill as many as possible.

objectives.text: Use the paid vehicle extraction on Ground Zero

burning-rubber.guide: In this quest you have to extract from Ground Zero via the "Police Cordon V-Ex" extraction with the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status. By default the fee amount is 20,000 Roubles, but it can be higher or lower depending on your Scav karma. File:Burning Rubber Map.png|Police Cordon V-Ex marked on map File:Police Checkpoint.png|The extraction
burning-rubber.briefing: Looking for a job, you say? I have a little thing to take care of... I got a buddy who drives people around in his SUV from the city center, where that blue boom happened. For cash, obviously! You have to whisper something in his ear, but do it during your trip, so that no scum can overhear you. I won't trust you with anything very secret, don't even dream of it, but I don't want any rumors to spread. Job's easy enough, I'll even give you the money for the ride. You up for it?

requirements: Must be level 47 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 20 PMC operatives from over 100 meters away

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of 5.45x39mm 7N40 at Prapor LL4
Unlocks barter for Altyn bulletproof helmet (Olive Drab) at Ragman LL4

calibration.briefing: Ah, hey there, come on in. Listen, I want to ask you for something. You've already got accustomed to shooting at long-range distances, right? I need to calibrate some weapons, the zeroing is extremely important for every gun. I want you to grab your favorite rifle and shoot at enemies from at least 100 meters away. The shots have to be lethal and the targets have to be seriously trained. Write down all your results into a notebook, I'll process the data after. I'll be waiting for the results.

requirements: This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

objectives.text: Hand over the found in raid item: SSD drive
Hand over the found in raid item: USB Adapter
Hand over the found in raid item: Portable Powerbank
Hand over the found in raid item: Rechargeable battery
Hand over the found in raid item: PC CPU
Hand over the found in raid item: Electronic components
Hand over the found in raid item: Bundle of wires
Hand over the found in raid item: Capacitors
Hand over the found in raid item: NIXXOR lens
Hand over the found in raid item: RAM stick
Hand over the found in raid item: Working LCD
Hand over the found in raid item: Light bulb

camera-action.briefing: Hello there. I know some people, a documentary crew. They want to make a movie about Tarkov. They're risk-takers, but I can't change their minds. So I figured I'd better help them get it done quickly and stay alive. Equipment for them was also dropped from the airplane you called in, but the hardware is fragile and was partially damaged during the landing. Can you help me find replacement parts?

objectives.text: Fix the first reactor mixer with a Toolset on Factory
Fix the second reactor mixer with a Toolset on Factory
Fix the third reactor mixer with a Toolset on Factory

capacity-check.guide: In this quest you have to repair 3 reactor mixers on Factory with Toolsets. The repair operation has to be done at the top of the mixers, so they have to be jumped on from the rafters. Each repair takes 40 seconds and consumes a Toolset. File:CapacityCheckMap.jpg|Mixers location marked on map File:CapacityCheckLocation.png|The mixers with the to be repaired parts marked
capacity-check.briefing: Hey. I have partners who are interested in the condition of the equipment at the Factory. Not just any TerraGroup equipment, but ordinary reactor mixers, of all things! Guess the guys have found some use for them. I trust them and would like to help them. Let them at least try to carry out their plan. According to my information, the mixers themselves are intact, but the engines above are probably out of service. I know you're capable of doing this, and you've come to my rescue many times. So will you help me again?

requirements: Must be level 42 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 12 PMC operatives at any Scav base on Customs,Woods, or Shoreline

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of 9x39mm SP-6 gs at Prapor LL4

capturing-outposts.guide: Only the enemy PMCs have to be in the marked areas for the kills to count towards the objective. Any kills outside of the marked areas do not count towards the objective. File:Customs Capturing Outpost Location.png|Customs kill area marked on map File:Woods Capturing Outposts Location.png|Woods kill area marked on map File:Shoreline Capturing Outposts Location.png|Shoreline kill area marked on map
capturing-outposts.briefing: Hey there, warrior. Listen, I have a mission for you. The other day I was informed that PMCs have captured several Scav bases in the region, and they say there are tons of goods there. Can you help the old soldier? Kill those PMCs so that my dogs could grab the loot without any issues. There are three bases in total: the big fortified construction site building on Customs, the former EMERCOM medical unit in Priozersky forest, and the Azure Coast health resort. Clear the places out and let me know when it's done.

objectives.text: Find 4 Car batteries in raid
Find 8 Spark plugs in raid
Hand over the 4 batteries to Therapist
Hand over the 8 spark plugs to Therapist

car-repair.guide: Interchange is great place to go for this quest: * OLI (home improvement store) very commonly spawns car batteries and spark plugs on its shelves. * Goshan / гошан (grocery store) commonly spawns car batteries on the store shelves located south of the big fire. Drawers commonly spawn spark plugs. Reserve is a great place to loot these filing cabinets, with several in the Knight buildings, Queen building, and underground office area.
car-repair.briefing: Good afternoon, young man. I need help for a good cause. As you have long guessed, I collect food, medicine, and other necessities in order to evacuate the people. I don't want to deceive you, this is true. And now they have enough reserves for the road. And most importantly, I’ve managed to negotiate through my channels that these people would be met and let through to the other side. Can you imagine? But only the civilian population, no men under 60. Therefore, the first wave will mostly be children with mothers and a few elderly people. Almost everything is ready, except for one little detail - we need transportation. We have several vehicles, just enough to carry everyone from the first wave, but they are not running. As I was told, they have been idle for too long and need batteries and spark plugs. Even fuel is not necessary. I will make a proper list of the items we need. Can you bring them?

requirements: Must be Loyalty Level 3 to start this quest

objectives.text: Obtain the data in the computer room in the east wing of the Health Resort on Shoreline
Hand over the retrieved data to Peacekeeper

cargo-x.guide: *Both keys give you access to east wing room 306, so only one of them is required. The laptop can be found in east wing room 306 of the resort, located on a chair. Health Resort east wing room 306 key needed, alternatively Health Resort east wing room 308 key gives access to 306 via the balcony. File:HealthResortEastWing.jpg|Health resort east wing location marked on map File:Cargo X Pt 1 Laptop Location.png|The laptop on the chair
cargo-x.briefing: We have established a solid presence in Tarkov. You have helped us tremendously, mercenary. The Blue Helmets are now working closely with the locals in all areas. But as you say, time for business. You've most likely already visited the collapsed tunnel on the shore. TerraGroup attempted to move a certain shipment through there. They failed, and it is currently being held in storage temporarily, but its location is unknown. The company's temporary operation coordination headquarters was moved to the Resort. There is no one there anymore. However, they definitely did not manage to remove everything. we may be able to recover valuable information. The computer coordination center was located somewhere on the third floor of the east wing of the Resort. Find any information you can.

requirements: Must be level 12 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the TerraGroup cargo hidden inside the Health Resort on Shoreline
Survive and extract from the location

cargo-x-part-3.guide: The cargo is located near the pool in the basement of the health resort west wing on Shoreline. File:ShorelineCargoXPt3.png|Location marked on map File:CargoXPt3 Guide.png|Way to the pool from the center staircase File:CargoXPt3Hole.png|The cargo at the hole in the wall
cargo-x-part-3.briefing: We have studied the documents you brought, mercenary. Well, the manifest said that the second part of the cargo is somewhere in the basement, and locked tight. Search the resort and notify me when you find it.

requirements: Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

objectives.text: Plant a WI-FI Camera in the Ural truck near the hydroelectric power station on Shoreline
Plant a WI-FI Camera in the excavator at the stream near the smugglers' base on Shoreline
Plant a WI-FI Camera on the concrete mixer truck at the collapsed crane on Streets of Tarkov
Plant a WI-FI Camera on the bio toilet near the Rodina cinema on Streets of Tarkov
Plant a WI-FI Camera in the cargo truck cabin near Mira Ave on Ground Zero
Plant a WI-FI Camera inside the yellow bus in the underground tunnel on Ground Zero

cast-the-net.guide: In this quest you have to go on Shoreline,Streets of Tarkov and Ground Zero to place multiple WI-FI Camera at specific spots. They can be placed in any order. ===Shoreline=== File:Cast the Net Shoreline Map.png|Location of the places to place the wi-fi camera. File:Cast the Net Shoreline Camera 1.png|The excavator to place the camera at the smuggler camp. File:Cast the Net Shoreline Camera 2.png|The ural truck next to the power station. ===Streets of Tarkov=== File:Cast the Net Streets of Tarkov Map.png|Location of the places to place the wi-fi camera. File:Cast the Net Streets of Tarkov Camera 1.png|At the mixer truck next to the collapsed crane. File:Cast the Net Streets of Tarkov Camera 2.png|The bio toilets in front of the rodina cinema. ===Ground Zero=== File:Cast the Net Ground Zero Map.png|Location of the places to place the wi-fi camera. File:Cast the Net Ground Zero Camera 1.png|At the truck in the ramp leading to Streets of Tarkov transit. File:Cast the Net Ground Zero Camera 2.png|Inside the yellow bus located underground.
cast-the-net.briefing: Alright, time to gather some intel on these cocksuckers. You haven't run into them yourself out in the field, have you? Ah, never mind. You probably wouldn't have much to tell me anyway. What I do know is they aren't BEARs or USECs, and they're mainly interested in TerraGroup sites. But I need to verify all of it. Can you set up surveillance along the routes these guys are likely using? From what I've heard, they avoid open areas, so head into the city first. You've got a better chance of finding something there. And check the shore too. Those bastards managed to ambush my team there somehow...

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 pillagers
Hand over 3 found in raid painted CQCM masks

rewards.text: 52 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
57 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× AR-15 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG 40 GEN M3 STANAG 40-round magazine (Black)
2× .300 Blackout BCP FMJ ammo pack (50 pcs)

casus-belli.guide: In this quest you need to kill 5 Pillagers and hand over 3 painted CQCM masks with the found in raid status. Pillagers can be found in groups of 3-4 on Customs, Interchange, Lighthouse, Shoreline and Woods. File:PillagersCustomsMap.png|Customs spawns marked on map File:PillagersInterchangeMap.png|Interchange spawns marked on map File:PillagersLighthouseMap.png|Lighthouse spawns marked on map File:PillagersShorelineMap.jpg|Shoreline spawns marked on map File:PillagersWoodsMap.png|Woods spawns marked on map
casus-belli.briefing: Heya, warrior! Got something for you, it's urgent. I recently rolled out a new feature for the Arena, called it Seasons. Fighters aren't just chasing cash anymore, they're fighting for unique rewards. Whole system built around it... Turns out it's a big hit. I've already got Season Three lined up, just waiting on a shipment of reward gear and some upgrade schematics. And now some piece of shit caught wind of the convoys and decided to mess with me. Can you believe that? They're trying to ruin a whole season the gladiators have been waiting on since New Year's! Go take a look and find out who's behind it. You should be able to spot them by their gear, Arena rewards stand out from standard kit after all. Find those bastards, deal with them, and bring me whatever you can pull off them. At least I'll know how bad things are and which convoys they've already hit.

objectives.text: Install a WI-FI Camera to watch the first water treatment plant building entrance on Lighthouse
Install a WI-FI Camera to watch the second water treatment plant building entrance on Lighthouse
Install a WI-FI Camera to watch the third water treatment plant building entrance on Lighthouse

rewards.text: 1× IOTV Gen4 body armor (Full Protection Kit, MultiCam)

caught-red-handed.guide: In this quest you have to place 3 WI-FI cameras at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse. File:CaughtRedHandedCams.png|Placement locations marked on map File:Caught Red-Handed Location 1.png|First location at the forklift north of building #1 File:Caught Red-Handed Location 2.png|Second location at the blue barrels east of building #2 File:Caught Red-Handed Location 3.png|Third location at the white rubble bags south of building #3
caught-red-handed.briefing: Oh yes yes my friend, you are just in time! I conducted an investigation and found the source of the faulty weapons. Turns out Prapor had nothing to do with this. The imported guns in this condition and quantity are only available to those ex-USEC bandits. It seems they've decided to join the market themselves. However, they can't sell their goods on their own for obvious reasons, meaning they must have accomplices... You need to set up surveillance at their base so we can find their dealers.

requirements: Must be level 10 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Survive and extract from Streets of Tarkov through Klimov Street

cease-fire.guide: In this quest you have to extract from Streets of Tarkov via the "Klimov Street" extraction with the "survived" status. For the extraction to open, you have to shoot a green flare into the sky while being inside the signal flare area. Upon entering the signal flare area, a notifcation will pop up in the bottom right corner of the screen: File:KlimovStreetSignalAreaNote.png If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the extraction won't open. If the flare was fired correctly, a new notification pops up: File:FlareSuccessNote.png You can use either the handheld RSP-30 green flare provided by Jaeger via in-game mail or a 26x75mm green flare cartridge fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 green flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. If you need additional flares you can buy them from Jaeger. To avoid the "run through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting. File:CeaseFireMap.png|Extraction marked on map File:KlimovStreetExtraction.png|The extraction File:KlimovStreetSignalArea.png|Signal flare area and extract zone map
cease-fire.briefing: I'm stumped today, warrior. There are good people who need to escape the city. The closest they can get is through the Avenue of Death, but there are snipers overlooking the whole area. One kid told me that if you shoot a signal flare there, the snipers should let you pass through, in that particular spot. But who knows if the kid was lying? Maybe he's trying to lead us to death. how do we find out if it's true that the snipers will stop firing after the signal... I got a couple flares lying around, why don't you go check it out, eh?

objectives.text: Locate and obtain Skier and Peacekeeper correspondence in the village on Shoreline
Hand over the letter

ceasefire-information.guide: In this quest you have to find a letter on Shoreline. It can be located in one of five houses in the western village. File:Ceasefire Information Map.png|House locations marked on map File:Ceasefire Information Spawn 1.png|House no. 1: Second floor in the nightstand File:Ceasefire Information Spawn 2.png|House no. 2: First floor on the windowsill next to the bed File:Ceasefire Information Spawn 3.png|House no. 3: First floor tucked into the sofa File:Ceasefire Information Spawn 4.png|House no. 4: Second floor tucked under the book on the coffee table File:Ceasefire Information Spawn 5.png|House no. 5: First floor in the desk under the TV
ceasefire-information.briefing: The rat race that Skier and Peacekeeper have been running around here has not pleased some pretty important people. It's got to stop. You're up to your neck in this shit, so go ahead and make it up to me. Both of these crooks are running silent. We need to figure out what they're up to. According to my intel, they've been communicating with each other. You know, one of them sends a messenger, the messenger hides a note in a safe house, the other messenger picks it up. I'm sure you've done this kind of shit yourself. My people managed to find out the location of the note. Go down to the village on Shoreline and bring me their damn notes.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 5 targets while using an M4A1, UNTAR helmet and armor on Customs
Eliminate any 5 targets while using an AK-74N, Kora-Kulon DFL body armor and 6B47 helmet on Shoreline

ceasefire-part-2.guide: ====Skier questline==== The specified UN armor needs to be used while making the kills with an M4A1. You can mod the M4A1 and bring additional items to what is required. If you lose the initial set of gear, you can purchase all the specified gear from Peacekeeper. ====Peacekeeper questline==== The specified armor needs to be used while making the kills with an AK-74N. You can mod the AK-74N and bring additional items to what is required. If you lose the initial set of gear, you can purchase all the specified gear from Prapor.
ceasefire-part-2.briefing: I've been reading their girlish chat. The doves want to team up because they've lost too many people in these stupid skirmishes. We need to stop them from forming an alliance. They've done enough damage as it is. And I already have a plan. Grab your gear and go make some noise. It will make them doubt their idea.

objectives.text: Reach the required Charisma skill level of 10

rewards.text: 1× Ars Arma A18 Skanda plate carrier (MultiCam)
Unlocks barter for FORT Redut-M body armor at Ragman LL4

charisma-brings-success.briefing: Hey. I’ll tell you as a friend, that in trade what matters is how you present yourself, not being a dork or a nerd. Then, not only girls, but also customers will love you. This is my secret, feel free to use. I have a little business proposition to Elvira, the chief therapist at the hospital. But I can only trust you with this if you pump up your charisma, because right now she won’t even look at you, no offense. Gonna make a real man out of you.

requirements: Must be level 8 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find 4 Morphine injectors in raid
Hand over the 4 injectors to Therapist

charity.briefing: There is more work if you are interested. I think you have already understood, that I support the civilians remaining in shelters, who, unfortunately, didn't have the time to get out of the perimeter. In fact, all your fights are just a means of achieving the goal for me. And the goal is to help the innocent people to survive until the possible end of this nightmare. Or until the evacuation. You strike me as a more-or-less normal person, not an utterly devolved monster yet like most of your peers who come to me. Therefore, I shall ask you. I need morphine. And not for sale to drug addicts. I am a doctor, after all, young man, and gave the oath. Many civilians are injured because of your constant firefights. Stray bullets, grenade fragments. And there are women, and the elderly, and children. And they are not combat-hardened thugs, they can not, and should not, endure such pain, biting on the rifle sling. I know that USEC used to carry supplies of single-use syringes in their SUVs. Get me at least a several of those.

objectives.text: Christmas Tree level 1

cheer-up.guide: To complete this quest you have to construct the Christmas Tree module in the Hideout.
cheer-up.briefing: Have you even prepared for the holiday? And don't give me that bullshit about the fighting going on. I've seen plenty of soldiers and let me tell you this: if a man doesn't have a good soul, he won't last long in the field. You may not like holidays. You can laugh at people who talk to pictures of their relatives before they go to bed. But if there's nothing left in you but your fighting skills, you're gonna die quick. If not today, then tomorrow. Because you need a good fighting spirit. And where's it gonna come from if you don't have anything to hold on to? Ah well, I've rambled for too long, I'm getting old... But you get the point. So even if you don't have anyone to celebrate with, at least put up a Christmas tree in your bunker or wherever you live now.

requirements: Must be level 10 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Obtain information about the Deputy Chief's past life on Customs
(Optional) Locate the sleeping place of the former Deputy Chief of Security on Customs
Hand over the information to Skier
Obtain items that can help the investigation
Hand over the items to Skier

rewards.text: 1× MSA ACH TC-2002 MICH Series helmet (Olive Drab)

chemical-part-1.guide: In this quest you have to pick up a secure folder and hand over a Dorm room 220 key. The wanted folder can be found in a train car on the western side of Customs. There are multiple spawns throughout the train car. After obtaining the folder, you must successfully extract from the location. File:Chemical1 Traincar Map.png|Train car marked on map File:Chemical1Traincar.png|The train car ====First spawn==== Under a brick pallet in the northwestern corner of the train car. File:Chem1West2.png File:Chem1West.png ====Second spawn==== Under a pallet in the southeastern corner of the train car. File:Chem1East3.png File:Chem1East1.png ====Third spawn==== Between the wall and a pallet in the northeastern corner of the train car. File:Chem1East2.png File:Docs 0013-Location.png
chemical-part-1.briefing: So, Sherlock, you want a riddle? You’re our pro on these headcrackers, right? Here, look. One lame hobo came around here. Either nuts of just demented, hell if I knew. All in rags, dirty head to toe, and the stench! A walking chemical weapon. Launched one on some vector, and where he goes, everything dies off. Hehe. Oh, damn, laughter through tears. But I digress. Just wanted to dispose of him, a bit farther away so the stink wouldn’t reach us, but one of our boys recognized his former homie in that pile of turd. Imagine that! Horrid things are going on, turning people from normal beings to such rubbish, and all for nothing! But that's not the point. The dude that recognized this heap of rags, said that he was not just a regular prick, but a Deputy Head of Security for two special sensitive zones on the Polikhim! Just imagine what kind of source could he become if he could at least remember his name, not just chew snots and mumble while slapping lips like a madman. What a shame! I don't know what got to him, but here's what I think. All this time that bagger lived somewhere, sleeping on some pissed-through mattresses, right? Right! You should look for that place. Need a hazmat suit? Haha, kidding. But if it comes to it, the hazmat’s on me, and not only it.

requirements: Must be level 10 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find any evidence on Customs that could help with the investigation
Hand over the evidence to Skier
Find any information on Customs that could help with the investigation
Hand over the info to Skier

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of SOK-12 12ga SAI-02 10-round magazine at Jaeger LL2

chemical-part-2.guide: In this quest you have to find a flash drive and a letter on Customs. They can be found in room 220 on the second floor of the three-story dorms building. A Dorm room 220 key is required to enter it. You get one in the mail from Skier upon accepting this quest. The flash drive can be found plugged into the laptop on the desk, and the letter is tucked between the binders on the metal shelf. File:Chemical2Map.png|3 story dorms and room 220 marked on map File:Sliderkey Location.png|The flash drive plugged into the laptop File:Sealed Letter Location.png|The letter tucked between the binders
chemical-part-2.briefing: Got tired of waiting for you already. The documents that you got from the den of this tosspot weigh quite a bit. Pretty heavy they are. But this is a damn dangerous stuff. And there is no clarity who will be the best buyer for it. And it's not even so much about the profit, as it is about getting some enormous fuckin' problems if we choose the wrong address. So here's the key that you found there as well, and try to dig up further. My guys said it's from a dorm room. And judging from the documents, our deputy chief was seen on the second floor of the first building, the three-story one. Any info you could find in this room can come in very handy, and the prize will be impressive.

requirements: Must be level 11 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Obtain the chemical-filled syringe hidden in Factory
Hand over the chemical-filled syringe to Skier

chemical-part-3.guide: The wanted Syringe with a chemical is located in a room on the 3rd floor of the Factory offices behind a door which must be breached. There are multiple spawns throughout the room. File:HCPP5.png|Location marked on map File:The breach room.png|The door to the "breach room" where you find the syringe File:Syringe with a chemical Location.png|Syringe in the bottom compartment of the shelf to the right after entering File:Chemical Pt 3 Syringe Spawn.png|Syringe on the floor next to the stacked chairs File:Syringe with a chemical Location2.png|Syringe on the fallen over filing cabinet to the left after entering
chemical-part-3.briefing: That envelope from the dorm contained some chemical formula. And the flash drive described the reaction process. We found a guy here who’s good with the subject. So he said that they cooked up something like this at Polikhim, experimenting with some blue liquid shit, adding some other shit into it. Sorry, I wasn’t into chemistry at school! All these chemicals, valences, indecent bonds! Fuck that! Hehe. See, I even still remember some words. That was some teaching in schools back then! But whatever. It is necessary to confirm the experiment described there. And then this matter will shine upon us with new colors. This blue shit is abundantly scattered in barrels throughout the region, but nobody knows what it is. And nobody is too eager to figure that out either. But we will take our chance and find out. And make some profits with it. But this requires another stuff, It should be somewhere in the factory. There was a room filled with garbage - they had a laboratory there. Look for a bright yellow sort of syringe, looks like a pen, like a morphine syringe. Well, you get the idea.

objectives.text: Locate the transport with the chemicals on Customs
Mark the vehicle with an MS2000 Marker

chemical-part-4.guide: By completing either Out of Curiosity or Big Customer, you will fail and lose access to this quest. If you do not have one already, purchase a MS2000 Marker from Prapor. After placing the marker, the player must stay alive for 30 seconds or they will have to place another beacon in the van. You do not need to be near the van after the marker has been placed. Find a nearby hiding spot and wait until the timer is complete. File:BigCustomerMap.jpg|Warehouse marked on map File:Depot-building customs.png|The warehouse with the vehicle inside. File:The van inside the depot-building.png|The vehicle where the beacon is placed.
chemical-part-4.briefing: Here’s the thing. This whole chemical stuff worked like a charm, and it immediately became clear who do we push it to. And the receiving party is ready. Only one issue left to resolve. Find more of these yellow chemicals. The crux of the issue was partly resolved before us - someone has already tried. Don't know, intentionally or not, but if you believe the consignment notes from the same docs, the whole box of that stuff was already tried to be taken out from the factory. But this cargo was not logged on any of the checkpoints, so I figure it’s worth looking for somewhere in the warehouses on Customs. If they tried to transport it, then it's most likely still in the car, probably a van. And not just one lousy syringe, but a whole crate. Look out for some markings maybe, the crate has them. Got it? Ah, one more thing. My sweet friends Prapor and Therapist popped up, poking around. So come on, better not turncoat now. Just a bit more and we’ll be running this place. Good luck, bruv. I'll tell about you to Ragman - he'll get some good helmets for you to buy.

requirements: Obtain level 1 loyalty with Peacekeeper

objectives.text: Stash a Corrugated hose in the med lab on Customs

chemical-experiments.guide: In this quest you have to stash a Corrugated hose at any table in the experiments area on the second floor of the the laboratory building on Customs. File:MarathonSecretsOfPolikhimCustomsMap.png|Lab location marked on map
chemical-experiments.briefing: Hello again, friend. There are many people in Tarkov who are in need of my assistance. For example, a local chemist recently asked me to provide him with a hose for his equipment. This is too easy of a task for my men, and they simply do not have the time. Could you help this local from customs?

requirements: Must be level 22 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate Sanitar's office in the health resort on Shoreline
Survive and extract from the location

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for T H I C C Weapon case at Mechanic LL4

chemistry-closet.guide: In this quest you have to find Sanitar's office, which is located in the health resort on Shoreline. The wanted office is room 110 on the first floor of the resort east wing. A Health Resort office key with a blue tape is required to unlock the room. After you unlocked the door, simply walk into the room to complete the objective. After you completed the objective, you have to extract from Shoreline. File:HealthResortEastWing.jpg|Health resort east wing location marked on map
chemistry-closet.briefing: Hey, come on in. Have you heard about some new guy that appeared in the resort area? Calls himself Sanitar. Not a simple man either, definitely worked for TerraGroup when they settled in the health resort. Either a major scientist there or just close to guys who were, no info on that. I've heard he's selling some secret stimulants, this means he understands chemistry quite well. But long story short, he's got some sort of an office or stash in the health resort, and I want you to find that place. I'll send specialists, maybe they'll find some interesting devices there. Just be careful, this man is dangerous.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 10 targets while suffering from the Frostbite effect

chilly.guide: In this quest you have to kill any 10 targets while being under the 46px|Frostbite effect. The effect is caused by being exposed to snowfall. It can be avoided in shelters, near firebarrels or with alchohol. While the effect is active, the following debuffs apply: * Hands tremor effect * Decreases Endurance (-5) * Decreases energy recovery (-0.1/s) * Decreases hydration recovery (-0.1/s) * Decreases maximum stamina (-20) * Decreases stamina recovery rate (-1/s) * Lowers body temperature (-0.1 °C/s) (minimum 28 °C)
chilly.briefing: Come on in, sit down. Tea's almost ready, it'll warm you up. We haven't had such temperatures since 1873. That winter was as tough as this one, I even warmed up a stray fox here! It makes a big difference in a combat situation. You can freeze your fingers so cold that you can't even pull the trigger. Can't sit in an ambush either when you're freezing cold. If you want to survive, you gotta toughen up your body. Try to take out a few enemies when you're cold.

objectives.text: Use the transit from Customs to Reserve
Use the transit from Reserve to Woods
Use the transit from Woods to Lighthouse
Survive and extract from Lighthouse
Eliminate 5 PMC operatives while completing the other objectives

rewards.text: 1× T H I C C Weapon case

choose-your-friends-wisely.guide: In this quest you have to transit from Customs to Reserve to Woods to Lighthouse in one raid, while eliminating 5 PMCs and extracting from Lighthouse. Transits are only available 1 min after raid start. ===Customs to Reserve=== Next to the Military Base CP extraction. File:CustomsTransitToReserveMap.png File:CustomsTransitToReserve.png ===Reserve to Woods=== At the map border northwest of the train yard. File:ReserveTransitToWoodsMap.png File:ReserveTransitToWoods.png ===Woods to Lighthouse=== File:WoodsTransitToLighthouseMap.jpg File:WoodsTransitToLighthouse.png
choose-your-friends-wisely.briefing: The assault is called off. Someone tipped off the driver about the ammo crates, so this motherfucker booby-trapped them! My lads got nailed. Now we're out of both manpower and ammo. We'll have to look for shells again. The driver's gonna start his bullshit counterattack now, you need to stop him. If we let him build his route system now, he's gonna be a pain in the ass later. He's got some mercs around him again, but now they all know they're going against Skier! You need to do this quickly so that no one thinks they can oppose me and fucking survive. I got a route where you'll find all these shitheads.

objectives.text: Eliminate 25 "Smugglers"

chop-the-thieving-hand.guide: In this quest you have to kill 25 Smugglers. They can be found in groups of 3 on all locations except Ground Zero (Level File:Smuggler.png|Appearance of a Smuggler File:InterchangeSmugglerLocations.png|Interchange spawns marked on map File:ShorelineSmugglerLocations.jpg|Shoreline spawns marked on map File:Ground ZeroSmugglerLocations.png|Ground Zero (Level 21+) spawns marked on map File:WoodsSmugglerLocations.png|Woods spawns marked on map File:CustomsSmugglerLocations.png|Customs spawns marked on map File:ReserveSmugglerLocations.jpg|Reserve spawns marked on map File:LighthouseSmugglerLocations.jpg|Lighthouse spawns marked on map File:Streets of TarkovSmugglerLocations.png|Streets of Tarkov spawns marked on map
chop-the-thieving-hand.briefing: I figure you've already been approached by my partner in our deal. The transfer was sabotaged, and I found the culprits. Local smugglers thought they were the only ones who could use the unrest in the region to transport goods. We need to show them that interfering with big business is fatal. My contact in Europe is waiting for payment, and the buyer won't pay Skier without the goods. If this deal falls through, we won't have a chance to secure any major contracts going forward. This has to be dealt with immediately. Are we clear?

objectives.text: Hand over 5 Salty Dog beef sausage
Hand over 5 Can of green peas
Hand over 5 Jar of DevilDog mayo
Hand over 1 Bottle of Tarkovskaya vodka
Hand over 1 Bottle of Dan Jackiel whiskey
Hand over 3 Jar of pickles

rewards.text: 2× AK Zenit B-10M handguard with B-19 upper mount

christmas-dinner.briefing: How's it going my friend! Not cold, are you? Well, here's the thing... We're going to arrange a feast with our comrades-in-arms at the base, it's Christmas after all! But you know how it is in inventory warehouses. According to the records everything is there, but in reality there's only tushonka and a shitload of potatoes. We wanted to make olivier salad, maybe two bowls. Amd we need some booze, too. Can you get it? Just don't bring the potatoes, we have enough of it.

objectives.text: Win a round after eliminating 4 enemies in TeamFight or BlastGang

christmas-time-finale.briefing: The crowd rejoices, mate! We've got to finish it with a blast. One last challenge, and the present is yours for the taking. A one-of-a-kind! You're gonna love it. Now, onto the business at hand. You have to eliminate four opponents and then win the round. Simple as that. Come on, the magnificent prize is right here, waiting for your return.

objectives.text: Play a match in any game mode on Bay 5
Play a match in any game mode on Fort
Play a match in any game mode on Block
Play a match in any game mode on Chop Shop

christmas-time-part-1.briefing: Christmas is upon us, so let's lift the mood. I told my guys to decorate some of the arenas. The crowd's gonna love it. Go see for yourself.

objectives.text: Win 3 matches in CheckPoint

christmas-time-part-2.briefing: People always expect a miracle or at least something different before Christmas. That's precisely what I've arranged! The new fights really attracted the audience. If only you'd seen how fast all the tickets flew out! It's time for you to mix it up, too. I'll give you a Christmas bonus for it! Hats, masks, all that festive jazz... Just the way you like it.

objectives.text: Eliminate 15 enemies while wearing a Santa/Ded Moroz hat and Fake white beard in TeamFight or BlastGang
Eliminate 25 enemies while wearing a Santa/Ded Moroz hat and Fake white beard in LastHero or CheckPoint

rewards.text: Unlocks Fox mask in the Armory

christmas-time-part-3.briefing: So I've come up with another idea. This should be fun for everyone! All right, listen up. You take a festive hat, a white beard and go fight in the Arena. I'll give you the hat. I will not give you the beard. You can buy it yourself, it's pretty cheap in our Armory. Come on now, it's time for some Christmas excitement!

objectives.text: Win 3 matches in TeamFight or BlastGang

rewards.text: Unlocks Hare mask in the Armory

christmas-time-part-4.briefing: Okay, this one is very fucking straightforward. You'll handle it no problem. All you have to do is win a few times. Alright, come on, they're waiting for you in the Arena.

objectives.text: Eliminate an enemy while using an Assault rifle and wearing a Ded Moroz / Santa hat and Fake white beard
Eliminate an enemy while using a Marksman rifle and wearing a Ded Moroz / Santa hat and Fake white beard
Eliminate an enemy while using an Assault carabine and wearing a Ded Moroz / Santa hat and Fake white beard
Eliminate an enemy while using a Bolt-action rifle and wearing a Ded Moroz / Santa hat and Fake white beard
Eliminate an enemy while using a Submachine gun and wearing a Ded Moroz / Santa hat and Fake white beard
Eliminate an enemy while using a Shotgun and wearing a Ded Moroz / Santa hat and Fake white beard
Eliminate an enemy while using a Pistol and wearing a Ded Moroz / Santa hat and Fake white beard

rewards.text: Unlocks Aybolit mask in the Armory

christmas-time-part-5.briefing: We need to keep the crowd hyped up. So we're upping the stakes and adding a little more action. Here's the plan: you dress up as Santa again and go fuck your enemies up with everything you've got. Hmm, no, that would be too much. I'll remove knives, machine guns and grenades from the list. Gonna save that for later, hehe. Mission clear? Then get to it.

objectives.text: Earn a Match MVP in any game mode

rewards.text: Unlocks Grinch mask in the Armory

christmas-time-part-6.briefing: It's the final stretch. We've got to keep the crowd happy. Afterwards, I'll give you a real Christmas miracle for your help. You need to show off. Be the best, wherever you decide.

requirements: Must be level 24 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Stash 3 Golden neck chains under the mattress next to BTR-82A in Generic Store on Interchange
Stash 3 Golden neck chains in the microwave on the 3rd floor of the dorm on Customs
Stash 3 Golden neck chains in the middle wooden cabin at the sawmill on Woods
Eliminate 5 PMC operatives in the time period of 22:00-10:00 on Interchange

chumming.guide: The "microwave on the 3rd floor of dorms" is located in the "kitchen" (Big room without door) of the 3 story dorms on Customs. File:Dorm 3.png|"Kitchen" location marked on map File:Chumm micro.png|The wanted microwave File:Chumm micro2.png|The goldchains have to be placed inside the open microwave The "middle wooden cabin at the sawmill" means the wooden cabin #2 in the lumber yard on Woods. File:Wood Cabin nr 2.jpg|Cabin marked on map File:Cabin2Woods.png|Cabin #2 at the lumber yard File:Chumm woods.png|The bed with the book near the safe where the goldchains need to be placed
chumming.briefing: Come on in if you're serious, got a new task for you! Those cameras you planted actually bore some fruit. Managed to find the right men, on good terms with Scavs. In short, I want to chum them up a bit, for the sake of peace. Because nowadays they are just too fucking mental. Wasting anyone indiscriminately, scared all my customers away, those motherfuckers. The trick is, these thieving bitches are from different gangs, and all need a different approach. So far we've settled on three gold chains for each, to get the conversation going, and we'll see where it goes... I don't have enough chains for all of them, but you're a smooth operator, you'll get them in no time. I'll point you where to stash them. Also, you should make sure the Interchange is clear of PMCs at the specific time, because otherwise, the right people may not reach the stash.

objectives.text: Sell Ragman any 250 backpacks or tactical rigs

circulate.guide: In this quest you have to sell any 250 backpacks or tactical rigs to Ragman. The sales amount display may not always update immediately. A game restart forces a refresh.
circulate.briefing: You really gave me a hand with those mules back then. Now everything seems to be ready for retail, but there's not enough momentum to revitalize our economy. Let's show this town how to market!

requirements: Must be level 14 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Obtain the package with T-90M Commander control panel on Reserve
Hand over the package to Peacekeeper

classified-technologies.guide: The wanted package is located behind the dismantled rusty pipe in the underground workshop that you have to pass through to reach the D2 extraction. Once you have retrieved the package, you must extract from the location and hand it over to Peacekeeper. File:ClassifiedTechnologiesLocationMap.png|Underground map with location marked File:Experience Exchange - Package Location.png|Location of the T90M Commander control panel package
classified-technologies.briefing: Hi, my friend! One of my blue helmet colleagues made a deal with one of the state reserve signalmen before the big conflict, he wanted to borrow a certain device. I don't know much about this device, but it had something to do with the tank commander equipment. Then the conflict began, and the base was attacked. I think that the device is still inside the base. If you bring me this device and not ask any questions, I will generously pay you.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 5 targets in the old cellars while using a shotgun on Factory

claustrophobia.guide: In this quest you have to kill any 5 targets in the underground on Factory while using shotguns. Only the targets have to be in the area for the kills to count towards the quest. The only area that doesn't count is beneath the tank containers. File:Claustrophobia Map.png|Excluded area marked on map
claustrophobia.briefing: Haven't seen you in a while. I was just talking about you with my friend, talking about clever youth... He told me a story about some amateur soldiers who went raiding into the old tunnels. One got spooked by a noise and started shooting everywhere, another one threw a bad grenade and killed everyone in their group. Turns out my comrade didn't even need a tripwire in the end. Disappointing, he said. If you don't want to find yourself in a similar situation, take a shotgun and go to those tunnels at the chemical plant. If you can handle the enemy in such conditions, then cramped space will become your ally.

objectives.text: Spread the vaccine on Lighthouse
Spread the vaccine on Shoreline
Spread the vaccine on Woods
Spread the vaccine on Customs
Spread the vaccine on Factory
Spread the vaccine on The Lab

rewards.text: 1× T H I C C Weapon case

clear-conscience.guide: In this quest you have to spread (stash) the TG-Vi-24 true vaccine in the following locations: ====Lighthouse Vaccine Spot==== In the water around the dilapidated village on the eastern island. File:RadicalTreatmentLighthouseMap.png|Location marked on map ====Shoreline Vaccine Spot==== In the river next to the "Climber's Trail" extraction. File:RadicalTreatmentShorelineMap.png|Location marked on map ====Woods Vaccine Spot==== In the river that runs along the dilapidated village in the north. File:RadicalTreatmentWoodsMap.png|Location marked on map ====Customs Vaccine Spot==== In the river in the east of the location. File:RadicalTreatmentCustomsMap.png|Location marked on map ====Factory Vaccine Spot==== In the sewer in the underground where the "Transit to The Lab" is located. File:RadicalTreatmentFactoryMap.jpg ====The Lab Vaccine Spot==== In the sewer in the underground that leads to the "Sewage Conduit" extraction. File:RadicalTreatmentTheLabMap.png|Location marked on map
clear-conscience.briefing: You got it? Haha, I knew it! What kind of person would keep a cure for himself in times of plague? Now we must make the remedy strictly according to the instructions, so be careful. The entire success of our plan depends on your actions! While you were running for the recipe, I discussed the distribution issue with Mechanic. Once you've made the vaccine, you need to distribute it through the water, just like the old times. Only now instead of a well, there'll be stations and pipes.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 20 targets on Customs

clearing-the-way.briefing: Well, well. Look who decided to drop by. You had something important to chat about? It'll keep. I've got something pressing, and you fit the bill. I've got a big shipment lined up through Customs, but the lads moving it are just my usual muscle. In this weather they won't just struggle to fight, they'll barely be able to move. Funny thing is, that actually works in our favor. Less chance of bumping into anyone. That's exactly why I picked this moment. Still, the load's heavy, so I want some cover. Make sure my boys don't cross paths with anyone on Customs, yeah? And wrap up warm yourself. These frosts don't care who you are.

objectives.text: Eliminate 75 enemies in CheckPoint mode
Eliminate 75 enemies in LastHero mode
Eliminate 35 enemies in TeamFight or BlastGang mode
Win 2 matches in TeamFight or BlastGang mode
Win 2 matches in CheckPoint mode
Claim at least 4th place in LastHero mode twice

rewards.text: Unlocks Tiger Stripe Green weapon camouflage

clip-their-wings.briefing: Here comes my favorite gladiator! There's a big score coming up, you'll come in very handy for it. So long story short, I've gotten new shareholders in place of Kaban and Kollontay. Thing is, even they have gotten cocky lately, trying to redistribute power, those pricks. They're bringing out more and more of their own fighters, even for that one tournament with all kinds of big shots. I'm not happy with that. I want only my guys there, you know? So this is where you come in. Go ahead and fuck those candidates up, gladiator style. And I'll make sure you get the proper reward, a flashy new spray paint kit Tiger Stripe Green.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the delivery crew's shipment notes on Customs
Hand over the found information

closer-to-the-people.guide: In this quest you have to find the delivery crew's shipment notes on Customs. They can be found in the locker room on the first floor of the boiler building. There are multiple spawns throughout the room. File:BoilerBuildingMap.png|Boiler building location marked on map File:BoilerBuilding.png|The building File:BoilerBuildingLockerRoom.png|Door to the locker room File:Closer to the People Spawn 1.png|First spawn in the wall-mounted tool cabinet File:Closer to the People Spawn 2.png|Second spawn on the floor under the fully opened locker in the middle row File:Closer to the People Spawn 3.png|Third spawn in the locker next to the sinks File:Closer to the People Spawn 4.png|Fourth spawn on the floor next to the shelf
closer-to-the-people.briefing: Terrible news, young man. I have stopped receiving communications from my group, and the documents you brought me have been scrubbed of all the essential information. We know neither the project code, nor the detailed itinerary. Not even a summary of these boxes' contents! I cannot possibly ask you to open them yourself. What if my group's demise has something to do with their contents? Instead, I came up with another idea. The documents said that in the event of obstacles along the transit, the delivery crews could opt to deviate from the route. If the movers were attacked during transit, we might learn about it from the workers' records. Examine the places where the delivery crews may have stayed and search for this information.

objectives.text: Eliminate 20 PMC operatives while under the influence of the "Obdolbos" cocktail

rewards.text: 1× SWORD International Mk-18 .338 LM marksman rifle
Unlocks purchase of Burris FullField TAC30 1-4x24 30mm riflescope at Skier LL1
