Unlocks purchase of EOTech Vudu 1-6x24 30mm riflescope at Skier LL1

cocktail-tasting.guide: In this quest you have to kill 20 PMC's without dying while being under the influence of the Obdolbos cocktail injector.
cocktail-tasting.briefing: Opa, hey there! So listen up, there's this big chemist guy in the city. Makes all kinds of fucked-up drugs. And there's a rumor going around that he created some new stimulant. The bums say they saw a jacked-up PMC merc running around the block like a fucking lunatic, dodging bullets Neo style. But then he tripped over a rock and gone to forever sleep, can you believe it? Looks like that chemo took a toll on his health. There's a price to pay for everything in life... Find out what kind of drugs he was stoned on and if there's any reason to peddle that shit.

objectives.text: Hand over 4 Fuel conditioners to the BTR Driver

cold-start.briefing: You tried out my new heater yet? This little thingie works perfectly! But getting out on the routes now is a whole different story... I have to warm the engine for an hour, and that's not even counting the start itself! At first the old girl wouldn't start cold at all. Diesel was waxing up like a bastard. Had to double the amount of additives. And you know that stuff's not exactly growing on trees around here anymore. Every can counts now. Say, maybe you could help a friend out? Since you're not hiding in your basement right now, you should be able to track down some fuel conditioner. I doubt you need it for anything, but it'd save my ass big time.

requirements: Must be level 21 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the group that was sent to the Health Resort on Shoreline
Locate the group that was sent to the pier on Shoreline
Locate the group that was sent to the cottages on Shoreline
Survive and extract from the location

colleagues.guide: Locate the three bodies of the people Therapist hired on Shoreline. These corpses will be covered with white shrouds. All three corpses must be found in a single raid. If you leave the raid and have only found some of the corpses, the quest will reset. You must extract in the same raid in which you found all the corpses. The three corpses can be found in the following locations: File:Shoreline Colleagues-1.png|Locations marked on map File:2020-0.png|Under the tail of the helicopter in front of the resort File:18-39.png|In the backyard of the locked cottage File:17-11.png|In front of the office building at the pier
colleagues.briefing: Good afternoon. It is obvious that in the current difficult situation, everyone who has medical knowledge is worth gold, not to mention actual working doctors. And it looks like such a doctor has appeared. I was told that someone on the Shoreline is treating the locals and selling them medicine. I have hired several groups to go there. They had to find this doctor, enter into negotiations and offer the best terms. But today, none of the groups got in touch. We need these medications, I've got clients... ahem, people in need to worry about. Find my people and find out what happened.

rewards.text: Unlocks achievement Dawn of a New Era

collector.briefing: Hello, mercenary. I have been watching you for quite a while now, and I know that you are able to solve the tasks assigned to you. Don't get too cocky now, you're not the only one who knows how to follow orders. There are more fighters like you, even more competent. I want to offer you a job, to give you a chance to become a part of something bigger than you can imagine. If you are ready, then here's an assignment for you: my people operate all over Tarkov and often leave souvenirs after themselves. The mission is to obtain and deliver those items to me. No questions asked. The things are extremely rare. I hope I don't have to remind you that you have to obtain all these items by yourself? Believe me, I like no other know when people lie. You will be informed of the drop spot. And one more thing, all my partners have already mastered their skills a long time ago and proven themselves reliable, and if you want to be one of them, then prove to me that you are not inferior to them in training. Don't try to contact me, I will do it myself when the time comes.

objectives.text: Locate and neutralize any 5 Bosses (excluding The Goons, The Wedge and Partisan) while using any Goons Edition tactical rig

combat-proven.guide: In this quest you have to kill any 5 Bosses besides The Goons, The Wedge, or Partisan while using any Goons edition tactical rig.
combat-proven.briefing: Look what my guys made! The rigs look like a perfect match, but they still need to be tested. If you can beat the local hotshots with them, then it's a good product.

objectives.text: Locate and mark the first spot from Skier's route with an MS2000 Marker
Locate and mark the second spot from Skier's route with an MS2000 Marker
Locate and mark the third spot from Skier's route with an MS2000 Marker
Locate and mark the fourth spot from Skier's route with an MS2000 Marker
Eliminate any 5 targets while wearing a Pompon hat on Woods

rewards.text: 1× TDI KRISS Vector Gen.2 9x19 submachine gun

come-by-the-fire.guide: In this quest you have to mark 4 locations for Skier's route with MS2000 markers and kill any 5 targets while wearing a Pompon hat on Woods. File:Come by the Fire Map.png|Route locations marked on map File:Come by the Fire Location 1.png|Location #1 in the big tent inside the Scav base/EMERCOM camp File:Come by the Fire Location 2.png|Location #2 in the ZB-016 bunker File:Come by the Fire Location 3.png|Location #3 in the house with the antenna at the old sawmill File:Come by the Fire Location 4.png|Location #4 in one of the houses at the northeastern village
come-by-the-fire.briefing: You look half frozen, mate. Want some vodka to warm you up? Like the frost wasn't enough, now we've got this bloody blizzard on top of it. But I told you already, didn't I? If you want business to keep moving, you find opportunities where everyone else backs off. Logistics are dead for everyone right now, I heard even the BTR won't start. And that means the roads are wide open for us, as long as you've got the nerve. So listen up. I need to move a few weapon shipments through disputed ground. The route goes through Priozersk. Without a plan, my lads will end up buried in the snow out there. They'll be moving from the RUAF checkpoint by the lake, heading northeast toward the village, where the SUV driver on the bridge usually picks people up. But they need shelters. Places to hide from the storm. You probably won't run into anyone on the way, but my guys definitely won't be there. So if you do see someone, feel free to drop them. Your job is to find good spots along the route and mark them with IR strobes. If everything goes smoothly, I'll cut you in on the profit from the deal.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 enemies from less than 5 meters away in any game mode

comfort-zone.briefing: Usually I don't meddle in my crew's work. A show's a show. But I heard everyone's tired of sniper duels. They want something heavier, more brutal. Close range stuff. What do you think? Actually forget this question, just go do it. I need you taking out opponents from five meters or less. Make it messy, make the limbs fly off. That'll wake the audience right up.

objectives.text: Recon the area around the Lighthouse
Survive and extract from the location

communication-difficulties.guide: Locate the road leading to the currently closed lighthouse on Lighthouse. You need to move at least in front of the military truck to get the quest completion. ====Notes:==== * The Border Sniper will shoot at you once you enter the quest area * Make sure you are not overweight and have enough stamina to run to the quest trigger area and back * It is recommended to use painkillers before moving in * Taking cover is pointless as the Border Sniper ignores objects File:CommunicationDifficultiesMap.png|Quest area marked on map File:CommunicationDifficultiesView.png|View on the road, military truck on the left
communication-difficulties.briefing: Hey, what's up. Listen, can you help me out with some stuff? There are rumors that a new trader settled right on the lighthouse island at the cape, and he's got some serious guards with him, like some presidential security. I wanna establish communication with that guy, to cooperate, to make deals, well, you know what I mean. Can you go and contact him and check out the situation? If something doesn't go according to the plan, then come back to me right away, okay? Alright, see ya, brother.

requirements: Scav karma of -1

objectives.text: Hand over the found in raid Bottle of Dan Jackiel whiskey
Hand over the 3 found in raid Can of TarCola soda

compensation-for-damage-barkeep.briefing: Do you want people to think the "right" things about you? What do you think of yourself, mercenary? Probably thinking you're a great guy? Thinking you're the future Tarkov Legend, maybe even a hero already? You came here to bow to me, which means that you are nothing more than just an errand boy... I'm serious, you're doing everything you get told to: for money, guns, reputation... What if I told you to wipe my people's asses, for the most pimped-out gun in the whole county? Listen, I'm in a good mood today, so I'll just ask you to bring me a Cuba Libre cocktail. I'll remind you of the ingredients, just in case you've been hit on the head too much to forget such basic things. You'll need rum, coke, lime, and ice. Although... Yeah, you'll be searching for lime the whole decade. I'll make it easier for you: bring me a Jack and Coke.

requirements: Scav karma of -1

objectives.text: Hand over the 2 found in raid Colt M4A1 assault rifles

compensation-for-damage-collection.guide: To hand over a weapon it must be in usable condition. If a weapon's icon is red, it is missing vital parts and can not be turned in.
compensation-for-damage-collection.briefing: What, came to bow again, tormented by guilt? You know, merc, I'm not your image-maker or a PR manager... Alright, I can help you. One of my contacts is a big shot who collects US weaponry. Yes, he could just order fresh ones from the factory. But he needs an already used weapon, the one that still smells of gunpowder. That's why his whole collection is guns from conflict zones. Afghanistan, Iraq,... Tarkov. I want to gift him some of the local M4s, but the guy is smart, so you'll need to find the guns yourself, not from some trader. Help me, and I'll help you in return. I'll make people forget the Scav blood on your hands.

requirements: Scav karma of -1

objectives.text: Hand over the 5 found in raid BEAR PMC dogtags
Hand over the 5 found in raid USEC PMC dogtags

compensation-for-damage-trust.briefing: Hello there, mercenary. You really messed up, huh? You know what people are saying about you? you are unrealiable and not to be trusted. Simply saying, you're an idiot who shoots without thinking at everything that moves. Well, we all can't be saints, right? I'm the man who can improve your reputation. You just have to show that you wouldn't mind helping Scavs. Eliminate several PMC groups and bring me their dogtags. After that, I'll start new rumors about you, something more interesting.

requirements: Scav karma of -1

objectives.text: Eliminate 7 PMC operatives while using any AK-series assault rifle

compensation-for-damage-wager.guide: In this quest you have to kill 7 PMCs with AK series assault rifles. You can use any of the following: * AK-101 * AK-102 * AK-103 * AK-104 * AK-105 * AK-74 * AK-74M * AK-74N * AKM * AKMN * AKMS * AKMSN * AKS-74 * AKS-74N * AKS-74U * AKS-74UB * AKS-74UN
compensation-for-damage-wager.briefing: So, you want to improve your crappy rep around these parts? Two influential people made a bet on you: can you repeat your success of shooting at everything that moves, but with a specific weapon you are told to use? Lucky for you, the tossed coin didn't fall on a knife, but on a Kalashnikov rifle. A pity, honestly, I'd rather look at you running around with a knife and getting messed up every time. Would be a great redemption arc, wouldn't it? Well, since they've chosen an AK, I made a bet too: that you will handle it. Your targets are the unwanted mercs wandering around some places. So you better not screw up.

requirements: Scav karma of -3

objectives.text: Hand over 1,000,000 RUB

compensation-for-damage-wergild.briefing: You know, doing errands all day is still not enough to improve your poor situation. I think there is and easier way. Bribe the right people and they'll sing praises about how amazing you are. For example, you can compensate the friends of those you killed due to your brain disorder. Something like a wergild for murder in the Middle Ages.

objectives.text: Eliminate 50 enemies in any game mode in Arena
Take at least 3rd place in LastHero mode in Arena

rewards.text: 131 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
144 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
Unlocks purchase of Labrys access keycard at Ref LL1

competition-protection.guide: This quest is not available in the PvE game mode.
competition-protection.briefing: Hello, gladiator! I hear you're interested in those health resort cellars. I'll be honest, the idea was a good one, I might even revisit it later... But at this moment, it's not the right time for the Labyrinth. So I'm not gonna tell you anything about it, sorry. If you want to go to the entry site on your own and rummage through the garbage left there, I won't stop you. But without the access keycard, you can't get inside the Labyrinth. That's where our interests align. One of my gladiators has been getting a little starstruck lately. He thinks that nobody can beat his arena performance, and wants to up his salary. Even took to blackmailing me, the bastard! However, it's not profitable to just outright take him out of the fights. I want to show him that there are no indispensable people, and to do that, we need to make some noise in the Arena. Hopefully that'll bring this guy to his senses. You're a capable fighter, and I'll make you a fair deal: if you can get on the Arena's best gladiator ranks, I'll help you with the keycards to the Labyrinth. You up for it?

objectives.text: Win 10 rounds in TeamFight or BlastGang mode
Score 4500 points in CheckPoint mode
Claim at least 3rd place in Last Hero mode

compromise.briefing: Let me tell you what I got up to with those top brass people. But first please answer this question — what's the most important thing in this business? No... not surviving! Well, actually, I guess it is. Anyway... What's the second most important thing? Right. Damn right! Money! Cash, dough... cheese! Whatever you want to call it, it all brings joy. Now, these people. Yes, the same ones who wanted to kill you — they're willing to bet on you. But you have to show them real results: kill and rise to the top. So go do it!

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the special storage module inside The Labyrinth
Plant a hand grenade in the assembly workshop inside Labyrinth
Hand over the found information

Unlock purchase of AR-15 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG D-60 STANAG 60-round magazine at Peacekeeper LL4

Afterwards you have to stash a fragmentation grenade in the prototype weapon. Note: The F-1 hand grenade (Reduced delay) can't be used. File:Labryrinth missile area map.png|Prototype weapon area marked on map File:Confidential Info Spawn 1.png|Spawn 1: On the tool trolley next to the whiteboard File:Confidential Info Spawn 2.png|Spawn 2: On the center table closest to the whiteboard File:Confidential Info Spawn 3.png|Spawn 3: Ontop the pallet next to the grate door File:Confidential Info Spawn 4.png|Spawn 4: On the center table closest to the laptop File:Confidential Info Spawn 5.png|Spawn 5: On the tool trolley next to the missile File:Confidential Info Spawn 6.png|Spawn 6: On the table next to the laptop
confidential-info.briefing: Greetings, my friend. According to my information, you've gained access to one of TerraGroup's abandoned facilities. We've witnessed many times what happens when dangerous developments fall into the hands of unqualified people. Our partners are very concerned about what happened in Tarkov after that outbreak in the Laboratory. There's no way we're going to let this crisis happen again. That's why I have a high-priority assignment for you. I need to retrieve a storage device containing sensitive information from that facility. The details are highly classified. The client can trace an independent attempt to read the data and cancel the contract, so please do not even attempt it. In addition to the storage device, I was told that there is also a maintenance room on the site, the client has said that it should look like a workshop. It must be destroyed or at least damaged. But be careful with the explosives: we don't want you perishing with the storage device.

requirements: Unlocks 18-24 hours after completion of Silent Caliber and Hunting Trip

objectives.text: Eliminate 20 PMC operatives from over 40 meters away while using a bolt-action rifle with night or thermal scope

rewards.text: 1× Sako TRG M10 .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle
1× .338 Lapua Magnum FMJ ammo pack (20 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of Sako TRG M10 .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle at Skier LL4

connections-up-north.guide: In this quest you have to kill 20 PMCs from over 40 meters away while using a bolt-action rifle with a night or thermal vision sight. To have the kills count for this quest, the sight just needs to be installed on the gun, and not necessarily be actively used. This means you can use a sight that supports backup sights, like the Armasight Vulcan MG 3.5x Bravo night vision scope, and use any compact reflex sight of your choice on top.
connections-up-north.briefing: Greetings, mate. Tell you what, I've got special import channels - they can bring things even from Finland! My friend there has set up a shipment of some real deadly toys, not just shitty-ass Toz or Gornostay. Thing is, you can't just sell those to any random bum off the street, speaking from experience, mate. Dumb twats with hands out their asses will bring down the credibility of even the toughest merchandise. That's why I've come up with a little innocent trick. I want to start a rumor that there's a real bringer of death in Tarkov, you feel me? He shoots precisely and leaves heaps of corpses on his path. No one can even spot him in time, because the guy's a specialist, he sticks to the shadows and uses a bolty with a night sight. And then it turns out that this guy is using my guns! It's gonna make everybody think that I'm the guy who stocks up on the realest pro stuff. So I figured you'd be the perfect man for this little stunt. Make people afraid to even take a piss at night, and I'll arrange some of my hot new products for you. The first batch is free!

requirements: Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

objectives.text: Decrypt the data from the secret facility laptop
Read the data recovered from Fence's laptop
Hand over the laptop

consequences-of-our-decisions.guide: In this quest you have to find and decrypt the Laptop from an unknown facility to get Data from Fence's laptop read it then hand over the laptop to Mechanic. The laptop is located at a small ventilation chimney in an alley behind the diner on Nikitskaya Street on Streets of Tarkov. File:Final Stretch Map.png|Location of the laptop marked on map. File:Final Stretch Diner.png|Enter the diner to access the alley behind it. File:Final Stretch Ventilation.png|The ventilation chimney where the laptop spawns. File:Final Stretch Laptop Spawn.png|The laptop spawn.
consequences-of-our-decisions.briefing: Hello. I know you've been working with Fence lately. I'm not going to lecture you about the risks of dealing with him, but there is something I have to say. Somehow, he's managed to locate TerraGroup facilities that were never mentioned anywhere, and now he's hauling materials and equipment out of them. Think about what could be hidden in places like that, if even human experimentation and deadly viruses were easier to uncover than these secret sites. Fence stopped caring about the outside world a long time ago, and honestly, I don't really feel like I'm part of it anymore either. But that doesn't mean common sense goes out the window. Putting materials like these into the hands of someone who'd sell them to anyone willing to pay is an enormous risk. If you want, read these documents yourself first. I'll give you the keys to try and break the encryption. I hope you'll make the right choice and bring that laptop to me.

objectives.text: Eliminate 40 infected on night-time Woods

conservation-area.guide: In this quest you have to kill 40 infected on Woods during the time period 21:00-04:00. File:InfectedPMC.png|Infected PMC
conservation-area.briefing: Hello again. Still feeling strong? Well, keep it that way. We're not going to get much rest any time soon. Whatever's going on with the treatment of this disease, there's still a lot of sick people all over the city! That's why I once again ask for your support. The infected have been seen in our forest, and we can't let that go unnoticed. What if this virus stays in the soil? Is this what we'd leave behind? We can't let them roam the nature reserve, we have to drive them away. Try hunting them at night and see how they behave... It might make things easier.

objectives.text: Survive and extract from The Lab 15 times
Eliminate 100 Raiders in The Lab

rewards.text: +1 weekly operational task with skill reward

consolation-prize.briefing: Oh, hello there. I've gone through all my options, those fuckers are really hard to get. But we both spent a shitload of money on this whole thing. We gotta salvage our situation, this time without any fucking Lukas. Just you and me. I got a lead from inside the lab. Hey just listen to me first, you fuckhead! My lads spotted Raiders moving some junk. They must have evacuated one of their outside stashes and hid it somewhere in the lab until they can find a better place. You won't be able to find it alone, but I've got experts in this field. Just make sure they're safe. We need to clean up the lab. It'll take my fellas several days to search the place and find the stash. I don't think there'll be anything useful for you in that stash, but I'll think of something to reward you with.

objectives.text: Locate and neutralize infected Tagilla
Survive and extract from the location

contagious-beast.guide: In this quest you have to kill infected Tagilla and survive the raid. He can be found wherever there are currently other infected. File:InfectedTagilla.png|Infected Tagilla
contagious-beast.briefing: I never thought we'd have so much on our plate. Did you hear that the infected have gotten to Tagilla? He was already furious before, and now even more so. With such an active carrier of contagion, we'll soon run out of healthy people. He must be stopped. Sure, there are tons of infected everywhere now, but none of them are as dangerous as Tagilla. So I'm asking you to put everything on hold and find the bastard. And don't leave until his body stops twitching. After everything that's happened, it wouldn't surprise me if Tagilla survives several magazines and then gets up as if nothing had happened... And hey, be careful out there.

requirements: Must be level 25 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the IT firm office on Streets of Tarkov
Unravel the secret of the firm's success
Survive and extract from the location

corporate-perks.guide: In this quest you first have to find the IT firm office on Streets of Tarkov. The building is located in the Zmeisky alley, house no. 6. Afterwards you have to unravel the secret of the firm's success. To do that, you need to enter the locked "negotiation room" on the south end of the building. A "Negotiation" room key is required to access it. File:Developer's Secrets - Part 1 Map.png|Building marked on map File:Developer's Secrets - Part 1 Building.png|The building File:Developer's Secrets - Part 1 Room.png|The negotiation room
corporate-perks.briefing: Hey, mercenary. Before all the chaos happened, there was an IT firm in the city. I don't recall the name, I just remember that they made the best software in their segment. I still use it now. The company was small, so I still don't understand how they did everything so well in such a short time. They definitely had some secret and it would do me good to know it. Will you help me satisfy my curiosity, find their office and take a look around?

requirements: Must be level 17 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find the data on water pump operation
Hand over the extracted data
Find the data on pumping station operation
Hand over the extracted data

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Kalashnikov AK-104 7.62x39 assault rifle (variant RPKT mod.1) at Ref LL2
Unlocks purchase of DevTac Ronin ballistic helmet at Mechanic LL2

corporate-secrets.guide: The wanted documents are located in two different buildings at the water treatment plant in the north of the Lighthouse location. File:CorporateSecretsMap.png|Buildings marked on map ====Pumping station operation report==== The documents are located on a shelf in the left hand upstairs office of building no. 1 in the west of the plant. File:CorporateSecretsOfficeBuilding1.png|Building no. 1 File:CorporateSecretsOffice1.png|The office File:Reportclose.png|Documents between the file folders in the lower right of the shelf ====Water pump operation data==== The documents are located on a desk in the left hand upstairs office of building no. 2 in the north of the plant. File:CorporateSecretsOfficeBuilding2.png|Building no. 2 File:CorporateSecretsOffice2.png|The office File:Data.png|Documents in the file organizer on the desk
corporate-secrets.briefing: Did it ever occur to you that we are living in unique times? As if any secret can easily be revealed, the camera obscura will open up, all you need to do is put in some effort ... Let me explain, my friend. You have already poked around corporate territories, laboratories, offices, and all else. Those places have already been looted to the ground. But do you know where there still might be something interesting? In the offices of the wastewater treatment plant. Yes, that facility was also under TerraGroup. What do I want to find? Fact is, I don't even know myself yet. To begin with, let's try to find out what exactly TerraGroup was doing there. Contaminated water, chemical dump ten times over normal? Anything can open up. Prepare well - I hear there is unusually high activity in that area. Perhaps someone is guarding the territory against prying eyes.

requirements: This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.
Must be level 30 to start this quest.
Must be Loyalty Level 4 to start this quest

objectives.text: Eliminate 20 BEAR PMC operatives on Lighthouse, Ground Zero, Reserve, Shoreline, or Streets of Tarkov
Hand over 20 found in raid BEAR PMC dogtags

rewards.text: 1x AFAK tactical individual first aid kit
Unlocks purchase of AFAK tactical individual first aid kit at Peacekeeper LL4

counteraction.briefing: Mercenary, are you ready for some serious work? The matter is quite significant and requires high preparation. So, listen: the BEAR PMC operatives have been radically interfering with operations on the coast near the Lighthouse lately. I think you have already encountered them there and may have noticed their increased activity. Your task is to help us to maintain the position of the UN in this city ... Are you well prepared? Eliminating BEAR is not the same as scaring off regular bandits.

requirements: Must be level 20 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the chairman's house in the abandoned village on Shoreline
Locate the fisherman's house in the abandoned village on Shoreline
Locate the priest's house in the abandoned village on Shoreline
Survive and extract from Shoreline with the "Survived" exit status

courtesy-visit.guide: In this quest you have to locate three houses on Shoreline. All three houses must be found in a single raid. If you leave the raid and have only found some of the houses, the quest will reset. You must extract in the same raid in which you found all the houses. File:Quest courtesy visit map.png|House locations marked on map File:Chairman house.png|The chairman's house File:Fisherman house.png|The fisherman's house File:Priest house.png|The priest's house
courtesy-visit.briefing: Come in, I want to ask you for something. You know the health resort area, right? At first, the factory workers were convalescing there, and then the TerraGroup employees settled there their staff. I've been to those parts a long time ago, my classmates lived there. So, I want you to check on them, it's the old village with the church. The priest, his name is Pyotr. Misha, the fisherman. And Stepan, the local chairman. Check their houses, find out if any of them are still there.

objectives.text: Find the KOSA UAV electronic jamming device in raid
Use the transit from Shoreline to Lighthouse
Stash the KOSA device on the second floor of the yacht club cottage on Lighthouse

rewards.text: Unlocks achievement Highway to the Danger Zone

cream-of-the-crop.guide: The KOSA UAV electronic jamming device spawns in special airdrop crates that get dropped after firing a RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Special Yellow) into the sky on Shoreline. The flare also causes a mortar fire barrage on the launch location. After obtaining the device, you have to transition to Lighthouse and stash it in the designated spot. ===Special yellow flare spawn locations=== Note: When this flare is brought out of a raid, it can not be taken back in. File:SpecialYellowFlareSpawnMap.png|Spawn locations marked on map File:SpecialYellowFlareSpawn6.png|On the roof ledge of the health resort west wing File:SpecialYellowFlareSpawn5.png|On the ventilation shaft next to the staircase of the health resort east wing File:SpecialYellowFlareSpawn3.png|On top of a barrel at the antenna northeast of the weather station File:SpecialYellowFlareSpawn4.png|On top of a cable drum at the antenna northeast of the weather station File:SpecialYellowFlareSpawn1.png|On top of the weather station building File:SpecialYellowFlareSpawn2.png|On top of the weather station tower ===Shoreline to Lighthouse transition=== In front of the Path to Lighthouse extraction. File:ShorelineTransitToLighthouseMap.png File:Path to Lighthouse.png ===Lighthouse stashing location=== The stashing location is located in the bedroom on the second floor of one of the western houses that is directly located at the shore. File:SeasideVacationMap.png|House marked on map File:SeasideVacationHouse.png|The wanted house File:SeasideVacationRoom.png|First room on the left when you use the little bridge
cream-of-the-crop.briefing: Good of you to drop by! Got a job for you, cargos again. It seems someone has figured out that some of the equipment has fallen into the wrong hands. But that is not the problem. We got word of an important airdrop they will target immediately if they see it. We're gonna have to work hard to get it. Keep it as confidential as possible. The key is to make sure you don't get spotted with the package. Get a special yellow RSP flare at the coast. They're stashed at high elevations, like roofs and towers. Then find a spot somewhere out of the way and shoot it. The necessary people will recognize it and send the package. Wait for it and take whatever's in it. Then, run to stash the devices at the designated spots at the Lighthouse. Go straight from the coast, it'll be quicker. Do it all in one go, don't get killed or go back to your bunker until you've finished the job. Oh, and avoid shelling, obviously. This equipment can't be wasted. Serious people are interested in this matter, and mister Lightkeeper expects to hear from me when the task is completed.

objectives.text: Plant 3 TP-200 TNT bricks on the second floor of the cafe on Ground Zero

rewards.text: 29 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
32 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× AR-15 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG 20 GEN M3 STANAG 20-round magazine

create-a-distraction-part-1.guide: In this quest you have to plant 3 TP-200 TNT bricks on the second floor of the "Olive" restaurant on Ground Zero. File:Distraction1MapGuide.png|Restaurant location marked on map File:Distraction1RestaurantGuide.png|The "Olive" restaurant File:Distraction1LocationGuide.png|Stashing location on the second floor
create-a-distraction-part-1.briefing: Look, you're starting to feel like family to me. Like a brother! I think I can hook you up with some serious work. I've got some co-founders in the Arena, Kaban and Kollontay, maybe you know them. Thought they were cool guys, but now they decided to play politics. They want to put their champion in the Arena, can you imagine? And a good champion brings in so much money, you'd know. It's gonna take a lot of time and money to rebuild the business. We need to put a scare into these guys so they realize they're crossing the line. Take some explosive bricks and plant them inside the cafe in the city center. Without detonators. We're not gonna blow anything up, but just make it look like a big deal. Let them run around with their asses on fire.

objectives.text: Eliminate 2 of Kaban's or Kollontay's guards on Streets of Tarkov
Do not harm Kaban or Kollontay

create-a-distraction-part-2.guide: In this quest you have to kill 2 guards from Kaban or Kollontay without harming either of the main bosses. Harming them while the quest is active will cause it to fail. Be aware that the premises of the LexOs car dealership where Kaban is located are riddled with Claymores. File:KabanSpawnsStreets.png|Kaban's spawn location marked on map File:LexOsClaymoreOverview.png|LexOs complex overview File:KollontaySpawnsStreets.png|Kollontay's spawn locations marked on map
create-a-distraction-part-2.briefing: Kaban and Kollontay shit themselves alright, but that wasn't good enough for me. I'd like to finish them off. You don't have to help me with that, of course, but... I already have a plan. You need to go down to their places and shoot their bodyguards or whatever they're called. Everyone in there is a trusted person for those two, so they're the perfect targets. BUT! Make sure Kaban and Kollontay themselves are unharmed!

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 enemies while under the influence of the Adrenaline stimulant
Eliminate 10 enemies while under the influence of the AHF1-M stimulant

creator-inspiration-part-1.briefing: Got a job you're gonna enjoy. You hear what's going on in town right now? One of my, uh, associates is going on a real rampage out there. You can't do shit like that without any performance enhancer, I'll tell you that. I've been thinking of ways to cheer up the audience. Sometimes even veteran fights lack excitement, it's like they're too afraid to put their best foot forward. So I'll make you a simple deal: kill everyone you see, but use stimulants first. We'll see what happens. We need to put on a show that makes the Minotaur carnage seem dull. I know you won't disappoint me.

objectives.text: Win 2 matches in TeamFight mode
Win 2 rounds as attackers after the device is planted in BlastGang mode
Eliminate 10 enemies in BlastGang mode
Earn 3000 points in CheckPoint mode

creator-inspiration-part-2.briefing: You never cease to amaze me... Ready for a new challenge? Listen to this, then. A couple of your victories were caught on camera, and I showed the video to that friend of mine from Tarkov. He found your rampage fascinating, and that's not an easy feat to impress him! So he slipped me a little something to help you get into those crazy dungeons under the health resort. Think of it as an invitation. But you do realize I'm not just gonna give it to you for nothing, right? Make sure you get a standing ovation at the Arena, and this keycard is yours.

requirements: Must be level 38 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find 3 Portable defibrillators in raid
Find 3 Ophthalmoscopes in raid
Find 2 LEDX Skin Transilluminators in raid
Find 20 Piles of meds in raid
Find 10 Bottles of OLOLO Multivitamins in raid
Hand over the 3 ophthalmoscopes
Hand over the 3 defibrillators
Hand over the 2 LEDX
Hand over the 20 Piles of meds
Hand over the 10 multivitamins

rewards.text: Unlocks craft for ETG-change regenerative stimulant injector at Medstation level 2

crisis.guide: There are multiple ways to get the items needed. LEDX Skin Transilluminator can be found on The Lab in the center area and within the locked rooms you can open with TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue) and TerraGroup Labs keycard (Green). On Shoreline they can spawn in the Resort and on Sanitars body after killing him. On Interchange they also have multiple spawn locations, especially in the ULTRA medical store. You can also craft the LEDX Skin Transilluminator.* The Portable defibrillator can be found on the Lab, Streets of Tarkov, and on Interchange. You can also Craft the Portable defibrillator For Ophthalmoscope, Pile of meds and Bottle of OLOLO Multivitamins you don't need to look for specific locations since they spawn everywhere where you can find medical items. You can also craft the Pile of meds. * The LEDX craft requires a Silicon Optoelectronic Integrated Circuits textbook. This item cannot be purchased on flea. One can be obtained from Lightkeeper's task Return the Favor.
crisis.briefing: Young man, are you busy at the moment? An interested party from abroad, from behind the barricades, took an interest in a big batch of valuable medical equipment. I think they will find a better use if, instead of the scum here, you understand me. I would be extremely grateful if you could find the required tools for me. Here, take this. This is the list containing all the needed tools.

objectives.text: Find 1 Military cable in raid
Find 2 Working LCDs in raid
Find 2 Power cords in raid
Hand over 1 Military cable to Mechanic
Hand over 2 Working LCDs to Mechanic
Hand over 2 Power cords to Mechanic

customer-communication.briefing: I've talked to other mercs and sketched out the general picture for future sales. Thanks for your opinion, too. Unfortunately, the problems aren't diminishing. Just a couple days ago, some drifters cut off my long distance communication channels to my suppliers. I'm gonna need some wire, mainly power cables. I'm willing to buy them from you right away.

requirements: Must be level 33 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 15 enemies while wearing a Bomber beanie and RayBench Hipster Reserve sunglasses on Streets of Tarkov
Stash a Bomber beanie inside the barber shop on Streets of Tarkov
Stash RayBench Hipster Reserve sunglasses inside the barber shop on Streets of Tarkov

dandies.guide: In this quest you have to kill any 30 entities on Streets of Tarkov while wearing a Bomber beanie and RayBench Hipster Reserve sunglasses. Afterwards you have to stash the outfit in the barber shop at the Concordia building complex. File:Dandies Map.png|Barber shop marked on map File:Dandies Barber Shop.png|The barber shop File:Dandies Stash 1.png|First stashing location at the table File:Dandies Stash 2.png|Second stashing location at the left side chairs
dandies.briefing: Hey, brother! What's up, how you doing? Good? Well I unfortunately have some guys messing with me. They've got a gang, they think they're the hippest guys in the neighborhood, and they're interfering with my business as well! We gotta show them where they belong. And it ain't in that fancy barbershop they're holed up in, that's for sure. No, no need to kick anyone out. We're gonna be subtle. Pretend to be one of them and shoot pretty much anyone you see. I need everyone in the city to start hating them. When you're done, drop the outfit off at their barbershop so people know who's the maniac shooting everything. Can you do that?

objectives.text: Eliminate any 20 targets while using the MPS Auto Assault-12 shotgun

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for MPS Auto Assault-12 Gen 2 12ga automatic shotgun at Skier LL4

dangerous-props.briefing: You're just in time. My expectations were too high, I guess. Things are so brutal around here, and people still won't buy these shotguns. One guy even told me he would never buy this "janky movie prop". Unbelievable! We gotta show everybody that this gun is well worth the money. Let's put on a real show in Tarkov, so that everyone knows that my shotguns aren't just for movies!

requirements: Must be level 15 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Survive and extract from Streets of Tarkov through Primorsky Ave Taxi V-Ex

dangerous-road.guide: In this quest you have to extract from Streets of Tarkov via the "Primorsky Ave Taxi V-Ex" extraction with the "survived" status. By default the fee amount is 20,000 Roubles, but it can be higher or lower depending on your Scav karma. To avoid the "run through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting. File:DangerousRoadMap.png|Extraction marked on map File:PrimorskyAveTaxiV-ExExtraction.png|The extraction
dangerous-road.briefing: Young man, hello! How is your health? Nothing bothering you? The thing is, one of my messengers who transports the poor stranded people in the city is worried about the lack of an escort on the next route. Could you meet with him and go for a ride with him? I promise you won't be shortchanged! He'll be waiting for you on Primorsky Avenue, in a black SUV.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 30 targets while using a TOZ-106 on night-time Factory

dark-times.guide: In this quest you have to kill 30 enemies on Nighttime Factory. Those can be either PMCs, Scavs, Tagilla or Cultists.
dark-times.briefing: Greetings, mercenary. Many think that things cannot get worse in Tarkov, but they do not have the knowledge that I do. Some changes are inevitable. That is why I seek out reliable professionals with valuable skills. There will be very few good soldiers in the future. Only those who can fully control and manage their emotions will survive. Such men are capable of the impossible, and only they can be relied upon when my predictions come true. That is why I am offering you an accelerated test. Prove to me that you are capable of fighting under unfavorable conditions, regardless of the circumstances around you. You survive – you win. And to survive, you must kill.

objectives.text: Eliminate 60 infected on Ground Zero
Eliminate 60 infected on Streets of Tarkov
Eliminate 60 infected in The Lab

rewards.text: 2× .338 Lapua Magnum FMJ ammo pack (20 pcs)
1× SWORD International Mk-18 .338 LM marksman rifle

darkest-hour-is-just-before-dawn.guide: File:InfectedCivilian.png|Infected civilian File:InfectedLabTechnician.png|Infected lab technician File:InfectedPMC.png|Infected PMC
darkest-hour-is-just-before-dawn.briefing: You doing alright? Even though I can hardly stand on my feet, I went to see my mushroom picker friend and give him some of my tea. And you know what, the old man's keeping strong and healthy! That means we can't get discouraged either. The infected are everywhere now, but there are survivors too. So, it's time to roll up our sleeves and do some dirty work. Go to every corner of Tarkov and eradicate the monsters - we'll do our best to save the few who haven't been infected yet.

requirements: This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.
Must reach Loyalty Level 2 with Skier to obtain this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the debtor on Streets of Tarkov
Locate the private prison warden's apartment on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the item: Iron gate key

debtor.guide: In this quest you first have to find the debtor on Streets of Tarkov. He can be found in room 206 on the second floor of the northern Pinewood hotel building. The room does not require a key. File:PineWoodHotelNorthMap.png|Building marked on map File:PineWoodHotelNorthBuilding.png|Northern entrance File:HotelRoom206Door.png|Door to the room File:DeadDebtor.png|The debtor on the ground Next you have to find the prison warden's apartment. The apartment is located in the Chekannaya 15 apartment building on Streets of Tarkov. A Chekannaya 15 apartment key is required to enter the apartment. The wanted apartment is the easternmost one on the second floor. It can only be accessed via the western staircase from the third floor through a hole in the floor of cell #5. The debris in the second floor hallway can only be passed by proning. File:Chekannaya15Map.png|Apartment building marked on map File:Chekannaya15ApartmentBuilding.png|The apartment building with entrance in the wall marked File:WesternStaircaseMap.png|Way to the western staircase marked on building map File:WesternStaircaseWay1.png|Way to the western staircase 1 File:WesternStaircaseWay2.png|Way to the western staircase 2 File:WesternStaircaseWay3.png|Way to the western staircase 3 File:Chekannaya15ApartmentBuildingWesternStairs.png|The western staircase File:Chek15TFHallway.png|Third floor hallway with hole in cell #5 floor marked File:Chek15SFHallway.png|Second floor hallway with debris passage marked File:Chek15AptDoor.png|The door to the warden's apartment
debtor.briefing: Looking for a bit of extra work, mate? There's this bloke who owes me a proper stack. Flash little tosser, always throwing his weight around, but when it's time to pay up, he's vanished. Been overdue for ages. Find him and have a proper word with him. You're good at that sort of thing. Last they saw the muppet, he was holed up in the downtown hotel on the second floor. Oh, one more thing. I need you to check out the flat that used to belong to the warden of the local "private" prison. You're heading that way anyway, so swing by while you're at it. And see if you can dig up the key to the cells as well.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 enemies with headshots in Last Hero mode
Win a match in CheckPoint mode

debts.briefing: You're quick, I'll give you that! Now listen up. When I first came up with the Arena, I had no idea how much cash it would actually take. And once my own money ran out, I had to dip into someone else's pockets. Long story short, I borrowed from a couple of influential investors. Then those guys disappeared for a while, and everything was fine. But now that the Arena has started paying off, guess what, the debts came back knocking! And a lot of interest piled up along the way. Sure, my first thought was to just put these “guests” down, but reputation matters in business. So I'm going to pay what I owe, especially since these gentlemen are willing to make a favorable deal. You'll be part of it too. Nothing complicated. We're working off an old, proven scheme. I place some special bets, you eliminate the right people, and everyone involved makes good money. Simple enough. Here are the details my, uh... creditors asked for.

requirements: Obtain level 1 loyalty with Prapor

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 Scavs on Woods,Ground Zero,Interchange, or Customs

debut.guide: In this quest you have to kill 5 Scavs on either Woods,Ground Zero,Interchange or Customs
debut.briefing: Hello there, soldier. I got a job that's a little too easy for my guys. But you'll do fine. Hey, don't get pissy, I don't know you that well yet to give you a normal job! The streets are crawling with lowlife bandits. They don't bother me much, but they're still a nuisance all the same. Calm down, say, five of them. I think that'll be enough for you. Dismissed, soldier!

requirements: Must accept Fence's quest Between Two Fires to obtain this quest.

objectives.text: Return to the old champion's hideout on Customs
Locate and obtain the compromising information on Ref
Hand over the found info

rewards.text: 76 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
83 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2

decisions-decisions.guide: By completing Between Two Fires or Surprise Gift, you will fail and lose access to this quest. The champion's room is located on the second floor of the three-story dorms building on Customs, between the rooms 209 and 211. A Dorm overseer key is required to enter it. File:DormOverseerKeyMap.png|Room location marked on three-story dorms map File:DormOverseerKeyDoor.png|Door to the room The compromising information can be found on the floor in a puddle of blood next to the wardrobe. File:CompromisingInformationLocation.png
decisions-decisions.briefing: I've been hearing rumors... Very unpleasant rumors. They say you're trying to dig my business up. Look, we've known each other for a while. You're like a brother to me! Don't do something you'll regret later. The less you know, the better you sleep, you hear that? Until I'm absolutely confident in you, I'm gonna have my men watching you. I don't want you pulling any stunts, champ. And if you find anything during your little date with the old champion, bring it to me. Then we can forget about this happy little accident.

requirements: Obtain level 4 loyalty with Therapist

objectives.text: Eliminate 40 any target from less than 60 meters away while wearing a gas mask or respirator on The Lab

rewards.text: Unlocks craft for M.U.L.E. stimulant injector at Medstation level 2

decontamination-service.guide: In this quest you have to kill 40 any targets from less than 60 meters away on The Lab while wearing a Respirator, a GP-5 gas mask, a GP-7 gas mask, a Gentex Ops-Core SOTR respirator, or an Avon M53A1 gas mask.
decontamination-service.briefing: I have a delicate matter for you. There is quite a commotion around the laboratories at the moment. My people continue to investigate these areas and recover anything that may be useful for civilians and others who need it. On top of that, these scum keep attacking groups associated with me. Almost as if they're doing it deliberately. I want you to teach them a lesson. Perhaps these misguided individuals can still find their way back to the right path. However, there is one condition: you must wear a chemical respirator or gas mask while doing so. They need to understand exactly who is eliminated their people, so make sure you deal with them at close range.

objectives.text: Hand over the encrypted flash drive
Find 3 PC CPUs in raid
Hand over the 3 PC CPUs
Find 3 RAM stick in raid
Hand over the 3 RAM stick
Find 2 SSD drives in raid
Hand over the 2 SSD drives

decryption-hurdles-part-1.briefing: Hello, friend. You got the flash drive? Good. You don't have to tell me what to do. Skier already sent his goons over. I told them it was gonna be a problem, but they obviously didn't follow. Decryption doesn't just happen by itself. It takes equipment, and that equipment takes power. I've got the main hardware, but I need more parts. Bring them, please. I'll give you a list.

objectives.text: Stash a Military gyrotachometer at the designated place on Reserve
Launch a signal flare at the roof of the radar station on Reserve

decryption-hurdles-part-2.guide: In this quest you have to stash a military gyrotachometer in a metal crate which is located in the radome on the roof of the radar station building on Reserve. Afterwards you have to shoot a yellow flare into the sky while being on the roof of the radar station. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which is provided as initial equipment and can be bought at Prapor LL1, or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. File:RadarStationGuide.jpg|Radar station marked on map File:DecyrptionPart2MGT.png|The metal crate in the radome
decryption-hurdles-part-2.briefing: Hi. I realize time is tight, but I'm having trouble with this flash drive. I'm gonna need some tools. You can't just find them in Tarkov, you have to know certain people. One of them needs a military gyrotachometer, so we'll barter. Take it and plant it on the Reserve base at the radar station, inside the dome. The sooner you do it, the better.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 Scavs on Customs

rewards.text: Unlocks craft for Decrypted flash drive at Intelligence Center level 1

decryption-hurdles-part-3.briefing: Hey, friend. There's been an unexpected emergency. No, I decrypted the flash drive, sent it with my guys. But somebody intercepted them. I heard on the radio they got gunned down. Horrible. The attackers were obviously after the flash drive. This is a dangerous business I've gotten myself into... Anyway, I gotta honor my promises anyway. I need your help again. The shooting happened at Customs. I don't think the attackers have gotten very far. Chase them down and take them out. You might want to just give the flash drive straight to Skier. More secure that way.

requirements: Must be level 5 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Obtain the secure folder in the Tarcone Director's office at the Customs terminal warehouse
Stash the package in the break room on the 2nd floor near Gate 3 on Factory

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of 5.45x39mm FMJ at Prapor LL2

delivery-from-the-past.guide: To begin, you need to have the Tarcone Director's office key. If you do not have one, you can find it within drawers or from Scavs. It can also be bartered for with Therapist. Once you have obtained one, head to Customs. The first place you want to visit is the red Paradigm warehouse on the east side of the map. The office is found at the top of the metal stairs. After unlocking the door there will be two rooms. The second room is the one containing the documents. Be warned though, to enter this room the door must be breached, which will create a lot of noise. After entering the room, go to the desk and look just under the table top, on top of the drawers. Leaning may help you to see it. Extract from Customs. If you die at any point after picking up the documents and you still have them in your in raid quest inventory, they will be lost and must be reacquired. If you don't want to do the second part of the quest immediately, you can move the documents into your off-raid quest inventory in the character menu under the "tasks" tab. File:Delivery from the past Customs.png|Warehouse marked on map File:Customs-Factory1-Outside-3.png|The warehouse File:CustomsOffice.png|The office File:Farming3Office.png|The second room File:Docs 0022-Delivery From the Past.png|Docs 0022 is under the desk, on top of the drawers It's time to head to Factory. You can complete this during the daytime or nighttime. With the documents in your in raid quest inventory, head towards the Gate 3 extraction. To the left of the extraction is a short metal staircase leading to a sheet metal room. This is where you must place the documents. To place them you, must hold down your use key (default F) for 10 seconds. For safety, you should lie down when placing them to be out of sight from the doorway and windows. If you die before the timer finishes, you need to retrieve the documents again. Hence, try to make sure nobody is around to disturb while you place the documents (i.e. either kill all other PMCs or wait until they have left the raid). After the placement is complete, you have to extract from the raid. The "Survived" extraction status is not required. You do not have to survive and extract on the same raid that you planted the documents, it can be done in any Factory raid. File:Delivery from the past Factory.png|Break room marked on map File:Delivery from the past dropoff.png|The sheet me
delivery-from-the-past.briefing: Stay well, fighter. Still in our sinful world, I see? But enough of that. There is this one thing. Rather sensitive, so to say. We kind of reached mutual trust with you, right? So I'll be trusting you with a serious task now. I won't go into details of why, who and for what, it's not really related to the task anyway. And the task is to procure a package and move it to another place. Doesn't sound hard, but there is a nuance. The pickup is on Customs, and the drop-off is on Factory. Customs has a big warehouse, the red one, near the garages. The package is located there on the second floor in the office. Grab it and stash it on Factory, in a metal shack near the dressing room area. Interested?

requirements: Must be Loyalty Level 3 to start this quest

objectives.text: Eliminate any 15 targets with headshots with 7.62x51 assault rifles or DMRs on Reserve

demonstration-model.briefing: Good day, mercenary. You arrived just in time. Some of my partners would like us to test the weapons before purchasing them. They require a demonstration. Take 7.62x51 assault rifles and designated marksman rifles and head to Reserve. There has been some suspicious activity reported there recently... Let us combine business with pleasure.

requirements: Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

objectives.text: Eliminate 15 Black Division operatives in The Lab

desperate-assault.guide: In this quest you have to eliminate 15 Black Division members inside The Lab.
desperate-assault.briefing: Hello. I can't ignore this anymore. We talked not long ago about the materials Black Division has been extracting from Tarkov. You already made your decision back then, but I'm asking for your help once again. According to my information, these operatives have driven every other force out of the TerraGroup laboratory, and now they return there on a regular basis. Maybe they're searching for something, or maybe they're stripping the place clean. Either way, it's nothing but a risk for us. What if the only reason the city hasn't been reduced to rubble yet is some plain gray folder with a chemical formula inside? I'd rather not test that theory firsthand. We have to clear the facility, or at least slow Black Division's operation down. I'll provide whatever resources I can, but I need you directly involved.

requirements: Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

objectives.text: Hand over the data from the Black Division rugged laptop

rewards.text: 1× T H I C C Weapon case
1× T H I C C item case

digital-puzzle.guide: In this quest you have to find obtain the Data from Black Division laptop by decrypting a Black Division rugged laptop at the hideout intelligence center lv. 1.
digital-puzzle.briefing: I think I've figured out what they're looking for. The laptops Black Division has been collecting from TerraGroup facilities each contain fragments of some kind of access code... It could be a universal key, or maybe a command used to activate a special protocol.The pattern only becomes visible after an initial decryption pass, and even then, only on some of the laptops. I simply don't have time to process enough data on my own, so I can't do this without your help.If you want to find out what Black Division is really after, look for the laptops bearing their seal. I need you to perform the initial decryption, basically applying the first few ""keys,"" before I take over the main part of the hack.I'll give you the instructions. Once you're done, transfer the data to any suitable storage device and bring it to me. I'll pay you for your work, whether or not we end up finding all the answers.

Locate and obtain The Unheard's phone on Customs
Hand over the phone
Sell any 5 weapons to Peacekeeper

ding-ding-ding.briefing: You want to earn my trust? Did you figure out who's unhappy with Skier, or did you just point your finger at the sky? Doesn't matter. Sell weapons to Skier so he can understand that he's forgiven. And get me the cell phone that his men were stashing at the dorms. Let's find out what so many people died for.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the infected blood sample in The Lab
Hand over the found item

rewards.text: 1× MPS Auto Assault-12 Gen 2 12ga automatic shotgun

dirty-blood.guide: To complete this quest, you need to collect a blood sample from one of two possible bodies in the containment block on the first level of The Lab. File:DontBelieveYourEyesMap.png|Containment block location marked on map File:DontBelieveYourEyesArea.png|The containment block ====Scav Raider body==== The Scav Raider body is located directly to the left after entering the containment block. File:DirtyBloodScavRaiderBody.png ====Scientist body==== The scientist body is located in the locked laboratory area. File:DontBelieveYourEyesLockedDoor.png|The locked door File:DontBelieveYourEyesSwitch.png|The switch to open the door File:DontBelieveYourEyesLockedArea.png|Doorway to the laboratory area File:DirtyBloodScientistWay.png|Way to the scientist from the doorway File:DirtyBloodScientistBody.png|The scientist body
dirty-blood.briefing: I don't ever want to stand in the same room with that bitch, but looks like we don't have much of a choice... At this point, our survival depends on whether or not we can defeat this infection. Collect blood samples from the infected and bring them to me. I'll go to Therapist and tell her what's going on. I think she'd be willing to help the city in the face of such a threat, even if there's no money in it for her.

objectives.text: Stash a VOG-25 Khattabka grenade at the first RPG ammo crate on Woods
Stash a VOG-25 Khattabka grenade at the second RPG ammo crate on Woods
Stash a VOG-25 Khattabka grenade at the third RPG ammo crate on Woods

discombobulate.guide: In this quest you have to stash 3 VOG-25 Khattabka improvised hand grenades at RPG ammo crates on Woods. Bug: Accepting the quest and stashing the grenades in the same raid does currently not work in local PvE game mode raids. File:Discombobulate Map.png|Stashing spots marked on map File:Discombobulate Spot 1.png|Stashing spot 1 at the sawmill File:Discombobulate Spot 2.png|Stashing spot 2 at the USEC checkpoint File:Discombobulate Spot 3.png|Stashing spot 3 at the "Junction" BTR stop
discombobulate.briefing: I was right about Skier. He's not just trying to interrupt my work, he's trying to fucking destroy the BTR! Looks like somebody supplied him with a big load of RPG rockets. Those knuckle-dragging idiots can't even shoot it properly, but so what? With enough ammo, they'll take me down if not on the first, then on the tenth attempt. However, I might have an idea where Skier is storing these rockets. Plenty of time's passed, they've already organized their firing positions, I'm sure of it. They could be anywhere in the city, but in the forest we may be able to find all of their positions. Just follow my usual driving route and check all the places they might use to ambush me. Find the rocket crates and leave some presents for those fuckers. Let them have an explosive surprise when they come for their ammo.

requirements: Must be level 15 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Obtain Medical record #1 on Reserve
Obtain Medical record #2 on Reserve
Hand over the first journal to Therapist
Hand over the second journal to Therapist

rewards.text: Unlocks Red paint Hideout wall style

disease-history.guide: The medical record journals are located in two locked rooms on the second floor of the hospital building (White Bishop) on Reserve. File:HospitalMap.jpeg|Hospital building marked on map File:Whitebishopstairs1.png|Bottom of the stairs going to second floor objective rooms File:Whitebishopstairs2.png|Stairs going to second floor objective rooms The first one is located in the RB-KSM room in the bottom right compartment of the left hand cabinet after entering. File:RB-KSM_door.png|RB-KSM door File:Disease_history_Journal_1.png|Journal #1 The second one is located in the RB-SMP room on the floor between the right hand shelves after entering. File:RB-SMP_door.png|RB-SMP door File:Disease_history_Journal_2.png|Journal #2
disease-history.briefing: Good afternoon, young man. I have been looking for someone like you just now. I have received information about a new vaccine against a rare strain of flu virus that was being tested at the Reserve base, officially... I cannot tell you what was actually tested there, but TerraGroup is somehow involved in this. The results of these tests could prove extremely valuable for humanity... and the group of my western clients. I need to find those tests, so you have to travel to the Reserve base and find the medical observation journals for patients. This documentation should be somewhere in the locked rooms of the medical unit. Will you take on this task? Of course, you will be rewarded for your work.

objectives.text: Plant a Signal jammer in Room 209 of the three-story dorm on Customs
Plant a Signal jammer in Room 210 of the two-story dorm on Customs
Plant a Signal jammer in the tables in the bottom hangar at the smugglers' camp on Shoreline
Plant a Signal jammer in the beds in the upper hangar at the smugglers' camp on Shoreline
Plant a Signal jammer inside the white shipping container at the EMERCOM camp on Woods

dish-served-cold.briefing: Oh, it's you. Come to ask me about that deal with Ref, have ya? What, you actually thought I'd roll over for a stack of cash after everything that's happened? Nah, sod that! The moment he showed up with his offer, I had a plan. Sure, I had to play along a bit, but the mug actually bought it! Brought me in on his new little venture and everything. After that, I did some digging of my own and nicked all the information I needed. Ref's planning to station his gladiators in our dorms, at the EMERCOM camp by the lake, and with the smugglers down on the shore. And me? I'm planning to make sure his broadcasts fall flat on their arse. This time we've gotta keep it quiet. Think you can plant these jammers at the spots I marked, mate?

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 enemies celebrating around the Christmas tree on Customs
Eliminate 5 enemies celebrating around the Christmas tree on Interchange
Eliminate 5 enemies celebrating around the Christmas tree on Shoreline

rewards.text: 1× TDI KRISS Vector Gen.2 9x19 submachine gun

disrupting-the-party.guide: Scavs will be circling around the Christmas trees, occasionally shooting in the air. While they make for easy targets, PMCs and "non-celebrating" Scavs will also count towards the quest. The Christmas trees are located on each map as follows: ===== Customs ===== Located within the courtyard of the dormitories: ===== Interchange ===== Located inside of the Scav Camp: ===== Shoreline ===== Inside of the resort, located in the center:
disrupting-the-party.briefing: Oi tactical, c'mere, let's talk. Those damn Scav chumps don't wanna do errands for me, only drinking and singing and dancing. In my times, when a prison cook snuck some mayo to fill my instant noodles on Christmas, this used to be a damn celebration of a lifetime for me. And now those crackheads are having fun just for the sake of it. Makes me damn sick. Go show those morons who's the boss around these parts. Showthem what happens to ass-sitters during working hours. Oh, and if you see any tourists and shit, take'em out as well - it's not a damn kid's party here.

objectives.text: Eliminate 6 members of the cleanup crew at Ref's camp on Woods
Eliminate 6 members of the cleanup crew at Ref's camp on Shoreline
Eliminate 6 members of the cleanup crew at Ref's camp on Customs

distributed-strike.guide: In this quest you have to kill 6 clean up crew members each on Woods, Customs and Shoreline. File:Woods Capturing Outposts Location.png|Clean up crew location on Woods at the EMERCOM camp File:Every Man for Himself Map.png|Clean up crew location on Customs at the dorms area File:Shoreline Smuggler Base Map.png|Clean up crew location on Shoreline at the smuggler base
distributed-strike.briefing: Good to see you back. I've heard Ref has started hiring fighters from your ranks as well... That's not a good sign. We need to move quickly and hit all of his positions at once, so he can't predict where the next blow will come from. We know for certain there are three camps: the EMERCOM camp in the nature reserve, the smugglers' camp near our health resort, and the dormitories at customs. You'll need to visit all of them and make sure Ref's people are afraid to stay there for long. How exactly you do that, I trust you already know.

requirements: Obtain level 2 loyalty with Prapor

objectives.text: Eliminate any 20 any target using Assault rifles or Assault carbines on Streets of Tarkov

district-patrol.guide: In this quest you have to kill any 20 targets on Streets of Tarkov while using Assault rifles or Assault carbines.
district-patrol.briefing: Another job for you, warrior. Ever heard of the Cardinal residential complex? That's where you'll be headed. I want to send my boys in, but first we've gotta clear out all the local trash. Think of yourself as the neighborhood cop crashing a rowdy house party.

requirements: Must be level 19 to start this quest.

Obtain the second folder with military on Reserve
Obtain the third folder with military on Reserve
Hand over the first documents to Prapor
Hand over the second documents to Prapor
Hand over the third documents to Prapor

rewards.text: Unlocks English herringbone Hideout floor style

documents.guide: In this quest you have to find and extract three military documents. They are all located in the command part of the underground bunker system on Reserve. File:DocumentsMap.png|Locations marked on underground map One is located on a desk in the glassed-in command room that is accessible from the room that has the D-2 power lever. File:Military Document 1.png One is located in the room that is connected to the glassed-in command room in the bottom compartment of a shelf in the corner of the room. File:Military Document 3-1.png|The wardrobe File:Military Document 3-2.png|The documents
documents.briefing: Hey there, fighter. There's a new task, but you'll have to go to the same place you whacked those Raiders on the state reserve base. Your previous efforts weren't fruitful enough, apparently: the Raiders dug in deep in that bunker, not letting anyone near it. However, I still do have quite an interest in that place. There's a piece of information from trusted sources that there are some classified documents there, the info is encrypted, so Raiders don't really care about it. Find me those documents, I've got serious clients for them.

objectives.text: Play a match on EMERCOM in LastHero mode
Play a match on Base in LastHero mode
Play a match on Dorms in LastHero mode

domain-expansion.briefing: Hey there, champion. Thought the Arena would quiet down because of the cold and snow? Not a chance! We keep going. Anyway, I have a job where you can help. Back when it was still warm, we set up some new gunfighting spots. You would not believe how many people we had to take care of to make the place look right... but that is on me, not you. Your job is simple: try out these new arenas and show what you can do. And try to drop as many opponents as possible. We are putting on a show here!

objectives.text: Locate the source of rumors of the living dead in The Lab
Find a way inside the quarantined section in The Lab

don-t-believe-your-eyes.guide: To complete the first part of this quest, you need to walk in front of the locked door to the laboratories in the containment block on the first level of The Lab. File:DontBelieveYourEyesMap.png|Containment block location marked on map File:DontBelieveYourEyesArea.png|The containment block File:DontBelieveYourEyesLockedDoor.png|The locked door To complete the second part of the quest, you first need to open the locked door with the switch located in the electrical operation room next to it. Afterwards walk into the now unlocked area to complete the quest. File:DontBelieveYourEyesSwitch.png|The switch to open the door File:DontBelieveYourEyesLockedArea.png|Doorway to the unlocked area
don-t-believe-your-eyes.briefing: Hello. Tell me, are you feeling healthy? There's been talk of some kind of disease, either from the Lab or somewhere else. I even had a "witness" come in, clearly gone mental. He told me about the living dead who bleed themselves and hunt people. I tell you what, I've heard many such tales before. Yet the man's grayed hair and that look in his eyes... He's definitely seen something sinister. Maybe some looters mutilated a corpse for fun, or some poor bastard spilled acid on himself. In any case, I think you should look into that story. You know how panic spreads around this place.

requirements: Must accept Prapor's quest Debut to obtain this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 15 Scavs on Woods
Obtain the encrypted drive
Hand over the device

down-the-rabbit-hole-part-1.guide: The encrypted drive is located on Woods, either in the Scav bunker under the antenna in the northwest, or in the container camp northeast of it. File:Down the Rabbit Hole Part 1 map.jpg|Scav bunker and container camp locations marked on map ====Scav bunker locations==== File:Down the Rabbit Hole Encrypted drive location 3.png|Location 1 on a package in the left back corner after entering File:Down the Rabbit Hole Encrypted drive location 2.png|Location 2 under a pillow on the sofa File:Down the Rabbit Hole Encrypted drive location 1.png|Location 3 in the cooking pot on the wooden table ====Container camp locations==== File:Down the Rabbit Hole Encrypted drive container 2.png|Container with location 4 File:Down the Rabbit Hole Encrypted drive location 6.png|Location 4 under the sack on the mattress File:Down the Rabbit Hole Encrypted drive container 1.png|Container with location 5+6 on the second floor File:Down the Rabbit Hole Encrypted drive location 5.png|Location 5 on the stool in the left File:Down the Rabbit Hole Encrypted drive location 4.png|Location 6 under the blanket on the bed in the right
down-the-rabbit-hole-part-1.briefing: Howdy. A curious letter came by a while ago... I'll tell you right up front: we're in deep shit. The letter said where and what to look for, my guys went there and got their asses kicked by some assholes. They stole the drive with the data mentioned in the letter! Looks like they're working for someone. Seems like I'm not the only one who got the letter. But let's not give up at the first sign of trouble. The letter did say something... And damn it, I need to get to the truth! I've got to get the drive back, search in the area of their base and show the Scav bums that stealing is very nice.

objectives.text: Locate the area where the documents are stashed

down-the-rabbit-hole-part-2.guide: The wanted area is located on Woods, south of the dilapidated village in the north. You have to get next to a specific tree for the objective to complete. File:Down the Rabbit Hole Part 2 Map.png|Location marked on map File:Down the Rabbit Hole Part 2 Location.png|The wanted tree
down-the-rabbit-hole-part-2.briefing: Hello, warrior! I found the techie who decrypted the drive. Not all bright minds are out of Tarkov yet. The drive is about some documents and how they can be found someplace. There's also data for the Terminal. Now, there's a connection between the letter and that recent video... Remember what the guy with the cat mask said? He's gonna contact you through the Terminal. I guess we're right on the trail! Here's the username and password: observer_unit_20 and 0fcf50356. Access the Terminal, meaning arrs.host, find out where to go for those documents.

objectives.text: Place a WI-FI Camera at the fenced area on the second floor of the car dealership on Streets of Tarkov
Place a WI-FI Camera at Kaban's office on the second floor of the car dealership on Streets of Tarkov

If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which can be bought at Prapor LL1 or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you.
down-the-rabbit-hole-part-3.briefing: A little birdie told me you were looking for something. Hey, don't cry, Tarkov's like a big village, people in one end know that someone farted in the other. Anyway, you've got a problem and I've got a solution. But I'm not just gonna hand it to you on a silver platter. Do a lil gig for me: go to the city's big car dealership and set up some cams. I think there's something going on there, so having eyes on it wouldn't hurt. Also, get the docs from there I've heard Kaban's been after them. They found it, but never shipped further. And Kaban is out of town now, know what I mean? But once you get them don't bring them to me straight up. You stash it at Customs, my buddies will take it. And be like a mouse, don't get anyone alarmed or killed. You down with that?

objectives.text: Hand over 1 BEAR Buddy plush toy

down-the-rabbit-hole-part-4.briefing: Well done, soldier, well done. You cracked that Terminal like a nut and even did some digging across the cordon! I don't give a shit who you asked for help, in all honesty. What's important is the result! The documents turned out to be TerraGroup's. Yeah, what a surprise. They put them in the fucking kid toys! Here’s the task: bring me as many of those teddy bear plushies as you can grab. We're gonna gut them the hell up. To tell you the truth, I'm looking for info on a certain person who went missing from the factory, and I suspect TerraGroup is involved.

Obtain the second flash drive on Shoreline

down-the-rabbit-hole-part-5.briefing: We found the treasure in one of the toys, the ugliest one. They sewed flash drives inside, those artists! So my guys printed out these documents for me to read. Secret developments, human experiments and all sorts of nasty stuff, all related to TerraGroup. I hope my friend is dead and not a test subject. I've already found a buyer for the flash drives, now I just need to get them to the mainland. Help me out one more time, soldier. My guys hid the flash drives near the Health Resort, by the transformer at the weather station. Had to hide them so no mutt would think I had anything to do with it. You go get them. Then give all four flash drives to the couriers. Don't do it in person, just hide them near the cars. Also, make sure no merc rat gets wind of what's going on.
