down-the-rabbit-hole-part-6.guide: In this quest you have to kill all described bosses in a single raid. This means that you have to kill them all, and extract successfully to complete the quest. They can be found on Streets of Tarkov, at the premises of the LexOs car dealership which is riddled with Claymores. Shturman is on the roof as sniper. File:KabanSpawnsStreets.png|LexOs marked on map File:LexOsClaymoreOverview.png|LexOs complex overview
down-the-rabbit-hole-part-6.briefing: So I took a look at those docs we found to figure out what game we’re hunting. All this time it's been about some powerful military stimulants. Newly developed with the blood of test subjects, maybe even my friend. Nasty stuff. But we have to find the supplies left behind in the city. I'd rather we have it all than some psychos. You and I weren't the only ones who saw that video of Mr. Cat. The warlords were obviously brainstorming alongside us and planning on taking the stimulant shipment. Motherfuckers! Gonna have to put them down. The old rat Skier somehow managed to put cameras in the city’s car dealership, he said that’s where the Scav big shots are gathering right now. Okay, you're a serious, dangerous guy. Go there and whack all of them. Call it a proactive approach, so to speak. Oh, and yeah, don’t die over there.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the chemical container at the TerraGroup warehouse on Factory
Hand over the chemical container

dragnet.guide: The chemical container can be found in the TerraGroup storage room on Factory, which is located in the underground tunnels right next to the "Camera Bunker Door" Scav extraction. A TerraGroup storage room keycard is required to enter it. There are multiple spawns throughout the room. File:TerraGroup storage room keycard map.png|Room location marked on map File:TerraGroup storage room keycard door.png|Door to the room File:Dragnet spawn location 1.png|First spawn: On the packages to the right after entering File:Dragnet spawn location 4.png|Second spawn: In the middle compartment of the left industrial shelf File:Dragnet spawn location 2.png|Third spawn: On the table File:Dragnet spawn location 3.png|Fourth spawn: On the shelf to the left after entering
dragnet.briefing: Hello, soldier. Everyone seems to be flocking to Polikhim, running around looking for secrets... I found out something interesting, too. It turns out that the TerraGroup fucks had their own warehouse in the basement for extra important cargo, and there's a vial of some rare nasty stuff in there. You know what's gonna happen when people find out about this. One will ask to retrieve it, another will try to intercept it. Now imagine it falls into the wrong hands. It's best if you and I take this stuff before anyone else and keep it under wraps. The job's important. Will you help me?

objectives.text: Find 2 Kinda Cowboy hats in raid
Find 2 Ushanka ear-flap caps in raid
Hand over 2 Ushanka ear-flap caps to Ragman
Hand over 2 Kinda Cowboy hats to Ragman

dressed-to-kill.briefing: Good day to you! Everybody’s so stylish nowadays, folks come by asking for things that weren’t much of a hit even back in peaceful times. Doesn’t matter if the thing is hit through by PM like paper, they’ll still take it as long as it makes them stand out. It turns out, people are still having a life, want to party or whatever. Look for different kinds of hats on mannequins or shelves, you know, those like in western movies, and grab our ushankas too.

drip-out-part-1.guide: In this quest you need to kill 100 Scav Raiders and hand over 50 pieces of WARTECH brand equipment with found in raid status.
drip-out-part-1.briefing: Heyo, brother. Got a new job for you. So, I've got an opportunity to open a new production line, but the problem is that some hustlers are hustling where they shouldn't hustle, and all the supplies I wanted to put into circulation have been scattered all over the city because of those pricks. Help me out, big guy?

drip-out-part-2.guide: In this quest you need to kill 100 Rogues and hand over 50 pieces of LBT brand equipment with found in raid status.
drip-out-part-2.briefing: Believe it or not, my business has taken off, and it's going strong! I'm thinking of expanding again. Help me out again, yes-yes?

objectives.text: Locate the hidden drug lab on Lighthouse
Stash a WI-FI Camera in the drug lab

drug-trafficking.guide: In this quest you have to find the hidden drug lab on Lighthouse, and place a WI-FI Camera there. It is located inside a group of stacked shipping containers in the container area of the train yard in the north. File:DrugLabMap.png|Drug lab location marked on map File:ContainerGroup.png|The group of containers with entrance marked File:InsideLab.png|Inside the lab, entrance on the left
drug-trafficking.briefing: Come on in, mercenary. I have a high suspicion that someone opened a new drug distribution point or even a whole drug laboratory in Tarkov. How do I know this? First of all, I've treated many people with somewhat familiar symptoms recently. Dilated pupils, tremors, confusion, and so on. Now secondly, my people who were evacuating the refugees from the city, noticed suspicious people near the containers in the Lighthouse territory. One of my men wanted to investigate and almost got killed. They definitely guard that place. Can you find it and place a camera overlooking the place? I'm not asking to tear down the place or eliminate those so-called cooks. Do you understand me? Do not risk your life for nothing. For now, I only need the recordings from the cameras.

requirements: Must be level 5 to start this quest.

duck-hunt.briefing: Come on in, take a seat, kid. You're just the right person for what I've got in mind. Not long ago, Partisan and I got into a disagreement. I said a strong fighter always pays attention to what's going on around him and notices anything out of the ordinary. Partisan argued that it doesn't work that way. We don't usually argue for this long, but this time we couldn't see eye to eye. So we decided to put it to the test. That's where you come in. Partisan hid toy ducks all over Tarkov. If you manage to find all of them in about a week, I win. If you don't, then he does. I'll say this up front: you'll need to look for the ducks not just in the woods, but inside all kinds of buildings too. And one more thing, the very first duck is in the Customs offices. But if anyone asks, you figured that out yourself. And also… I've heard rumors that someone found an undelivered shipment of duck pâté. They say all the cans are intact and the expiration dates are fine. It's been such a long time since I've had any decent pâté… Bring me a few cans, would you?

File:Eagle Eye Locations.png|Drones marked on map File:Firstshorelineuav.png|The first UAV is located near the smuggler base File:Secondshorelineuav.png|The second UAV is located east of the swamp village File:Shorelineuavsidepanel.png|The SAS disks can be found behind the side panels of the UAVs. Open up the panels to retrieve the disks File:SAS disk in drone.png|Opened panel with disk
eagle-eye.briefing: Okay, next job. NATO has carefully studied the conflict even before the Blue Helmets force surge and sent several drones to recon. But local air defense was apparently against democratic eyes. Two drones were shot down over the coast, now that getting to them has become possible, we can try to pull out the memory block from these. They should contain information about all movements at the beginning of the conflict. This information can make a good deal with my partners. Find their impact locations and bring me the memory disks. We have information about the estimated crash areas: the first one has to be somewhere near the local weather station near the port zone, the other one is near the bunker in the northwest.

objectives.text: Locate the helicopter at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse
Mark the helicopter with an MS2000 Marker
Eliminate any 10 targets around the helicopter area

easy-job.guide: The helicopter is located in one of the basins at the water treatment plant in the north. File:EasyJobHeliMap.png|Helicopter marked on map File:EasyJobHeliPic.png|The wanted helicopter Additionally, in this quest you have to kill 10 Rogues, Scavs, or PMC's in a specific area of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse. Any kills outside of the marked area do not count towards the objective. File:EasyJob2Map.png|Quest kill area marked on map
easy-job.briefing: Good afternoon, soldier. I've got a task for you, I advise you not to postpone it. You've heard about the water treatment plant at the coast? No, not the one at the health resort, that one is a power station. I'm talking about the one at Cape Dalniy. So, somewhere on the treatment plant's territory, there is a military MI-8, might even be working. If shit goes south in the city, you could try to start it and get the hell out of here. Anyway, I need it for different reasons: there's a gold mine of army supply crates next to it. I guess the owners didn't have time to load it all before leaving. I don't know who and why left that heli there, but my sources say that there's a craplot of valuable goods. Bring a signal marker and mark the bird, my people will deal with it after. The job is simple but important. Off you go then.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 10 targets around the helicopter area at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of AK 7.62x39 Molot Arms 75-round drum magazine at Prapor LL3

easy-job-part-2.guide: For this quest you have to kill 10 Rogues, Scavs, or PMC's in a specific area of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse. Any kills outside of the marked area do not count towards the objective. File:EasyJob2Map.png|Quest kill area marked on map
easy-job-part-2.briefing: Welcome back. Alright, I'll tell you what's going on. According to rumors, that water treatment plant is a home base of some aggressive western spec ops guys. The fact that you returned tells me that either those guys aren't home at the moment, or there's something you're not telling me. Well, in any case, my scouts said they've spotted Scavs at the helipad - looks like they found out about the supplies. The cargo from that heli is very valuable, but there's no point in sending in my people for a gunfight. Return to the helicopter and clean everything up there so that no bastard would slip away with the cargo.

requirements: Must be level 10 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Plant the Bison vs Undertaker poster in the living quarters at the Scav base on Customs

easy-money-part-1.guide: In this quest you have to stash an Arena advertisement poster in the living quarters of the Scav base (ZB-013 extraction) building with the numerous mounted weapons on Customs. 3 posters are provided by Skier via in-game mail. While a poster can't be put directly in secure containers, it can be put into a Documents case or S I C C organizational pouch to prevent losing it upon death. The poster has to be stashed at one of five beds on the first floor. File:EasyMoneyPart1CustomsMap1.png|Scav base marked on map File:ZB-013 Building.png|The Scav base File:EasyMoneyPart1CustomsMap2.png|Beds marked on first floor map File:EasyMoneyPart1CustomsBeds1.png|Middle room beds File:EasyMoneyPart1CustomsBeds2.png|Southern room beds
easy-money-part-1.briefing: Sup mate. Got a job for ya. An old pal of mine is looking for the right people for his business. I don't know the ins and outs, just the first stage of recruitment, so to speak. I see you're interested. You heard anything about the Arena yet? You gotta put up flyers around Tarkov. Like "come and check it out", shit like that, you know. Hey, serious people always start small! I've got a couple of posters ready for ya, but if you lose them, it's your own bloody problem, got it? Bring them to the Scav stronghold at the customs terminal. Off you go then.

objectives.text: Hand over 5 found in raid items from the Drinks category
Hand over 5 found in raid items from the Food category

rewards.text: 55 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
60 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2

easy-money-part-2.briefing: Hello, champion! A friend of mine gave you a little tryout assignment. Now I've decided to meet you in person. People call me Ref. Hosting the Arena and the big bucks, ha! Clearly you don't mind making money, and I'm in desperate need of new staff. Business is booming, and I'm short-handed. We're expanding! We got another fight planned soon. As they used to say in ancient Rome, "the people demand bread and circuses." The latter is fine, but the bread is running late. A little supply disruption, don't worry about it. Just get me some food and booze for the audience.

requirements: Must be level 32 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 50 targets while using an SR-2M with suppressor and KP-SR2 sight on Factory

easy-breezy.briefing: Here you are, warrior! It's been a while since you and I did some good old gun testing, huh? I got a new one, a Russian classic. Lightweight, easy to handle. That's what most guns sometimes lack. We need to test this beast in close quarters within kissing distance, hehe. Factory would be perfect for this. Let me know how it goes.

File:EnergyCrisisMap.png|Locations marked on map File:EnergyCrisisTrainyardTanks.png|The tanks are located in the northeast of the northern freight yard File:EnergyCrisisTrainyardTruck.png|The first truck is located in the east of the northern freight yard, next to the rails File:EnergyCrisisEastWaterplantTruck.png|The second truck is located at the eastern wall of the water treatment plant File:EnergyCrisisOppositeWaterplantTruck.png|The third truck is located next to the southern entrance of the water treatment plant
energy-crisis.briefing: Hey friend, I could use some help. It takes an incredible amount of energy to sustain my current activities, especially considering my farm, the one you helped me with resources for. I usually order fuel from other sources, but unfortunately, there is no way to contact the supplier at the moment. Do you think there are still unexhausted fuel tanks left somewhere? I think there should have been something left in the cape area. Can you check it out, mercenary?

objectives.text: Locate and neutralize Killa in the time period of 22:00-10:00 on Interchange
Eliminate 10 Scavs with festive masks in the time period of 22:00-10:00 on Interchange

enough-drinks-for-that-one.guide: In this quest you have to kill Killa and 10 Scavs wearing festive masks in the time period between 22:00 and 10:00. The festive masks are: * Astronomer mask * Aybolit mask * Cipollino mask * Fox mask * Grinch mask * Hare mask * Hockey player mask (Brawler) * Hockey player mask (Captain) * Hockey player mask (Quiet) * Rooster mask
enough-drinks-for-that-one.briefing: Hello again! The fairs worked well, business is booming! I was gonna make a little gift for you, but my men were intercepted by Killa and his gang. I heard they're all dressed up in Christmas clothes and partying, so I organized a new route through Ultra while they're busy, but things didn't really go according to plan. I put a lot of money into this, and a lot of deals might go south because of Killa. So, you down to help me out? If you can get rid of that psycho and his stupid friends, I'll owe you big! Just make sure you do this at night, cause they're not gonna let you anywhere near them in the daytime.

escort.guide: You must kill 2 PMC's on each listed location consecutively without dying, disconnecting, or running out the timer. If you do any of these you will have to start again. You do not have to do the maps in any order, they can be done in any fashion as long as you survive.
escort.briefing: Greetings, warrior. Get over here, I've got a job for you. As you know, I deal in gear and supplies, and I've got my boys searching every corner of Tarkov for useful loot. Problem is, order are piling up, and sending them out without protection is asking for trouble. That's where you come in. Keep my boys safe along their route. Make those former PMC mercs think twice before taking a shot at them. I'll show you the route on the map. Got it? Good. Here's the catch: you've got to do it all in only a couple runs maximum. My boys won't sit around waiting if something happens to you. Don't let me down, soldier.

requirements: Scav karma of at least +4

objectives.text: Reach 5.0 standing with Fence

establish-contact.guide: See the Scav karma section on how to increase standing with Fence.
establish-contact.briefing: Hello, mercenary. You want to take our cooperation to the next level? You know the greater the responsibility, the more important the trust. Prove your dependability.

objectives.text: Locate a good tripwire installation spot on Factory
Locate a good tripwire installation spot on Customs

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Tripwire installation kit at Jaeger LL1

every-hunter-knows-this.guide: In this quest you have to locate tripwire installation spots on Factory and Customs. There are no Tripwire installation kits required. ===Factory tripwire spot=== The spot is located in a room on the 3rd floor of the offices behind a door which must be breached. File:HCPP5.png|Location marked on map File:The breach room.png|The door to the "breach room" where you find the spot File:EHKT Factory spot.png|The spot ===Customs tripwire spot=== The spot is located in the three-story dorms, on the stairs from the 1st to the 2nd floor at the inner staircase. File:Every Hunter Knows This Map.png|Location marked on map File:EHKT Customs.png|The spot
every-hunter-knows-this.briefing: Come on in. So, how's your tripwire business going? No luck? Figures. This isn't like mindlessly shooting everyone. You've got to have a sense of intuition and know where the prey's gonna be. If you were a hunter, you'd understand. Try watching where the bandits hang out. Think about where your wire would catch the bastard off guard and how to conceal it. Take your time, use your best judgment. Only then will your hunt be fruitful. Come back when you find at least a couple good spots. I wouldn't be so quick to set these tripwires around, otherwise you'll kill some of your teammates by accident.

objectives.text: Eliminate 30 infected at the dorms area on Customs

every-man-for-himself.guide: In this quest you have to kill 30 infected at the dorms location on Customs. The quest zone includes both dorm buildings and the guard house as well as the area between and slightly outside of them. File:Every Man for Himself Map.png|Quest zone marked on map File:InfectedPMC.png|Infected PMC
every-man-for-himself.briefing: This is some fucked up shit, isn't it? Watching zombie movies was way cooler than actually seeing them in person. Obviously, it's every man for himself now and all that, but... I got a lil' stash at Customs, and if I lose it, it's over for me. And not just for me, but for my boys too! Not giving you the details, sorry for that. But if you help me clean up the dorms, I'll send my guys up to pick up the cargo. I'll pay you big bucks for your professional services though!

objectives.text: Locate the effigy of Morana on any location
Eliminate a follower of Morana

evil-spirits.guide: In this quest you have to find a bonfire and kill a follower of Morana. 3 bonfires per raid appear in different locations on Ground Zero, Customs, Woods, Shoreline, Interchange, Reserve, Lighthouse and Streets of Tarkov. Followers of Morana can be found near them. They are neutral to players until they are harmed or a bonfire in their vicinity is lit. File:Winter Tales Event Bonfire.png|Appearance of a bonfire File:Followers of Morana Infobox.png|Appearance of a Morana follower
evil-spirits.briefing: Come on in, warrior. You seeing what's going on outside? Hahaha! Looks like winter's back. But that's only the beginning. There's a rumor that there's some crazy people worshipping Morana out there. They're the reason winter's back. These pricks must have found something in Sanitar's stash, got stoned, and now they're seeing all kinds of crazy shit. One guy said that they're building a bridge between two worlds and putting up some effigies. I don't know any more details. Go take a look around, tell me what's going on exactly.

objectives.text: Win 2 matches in CheckPoint mode

examinatio-part-1.briefing: Howdy there, champion. I see you're doing well, since even the audience recognizes you from the rest of the fighters. You can't slack off at times like this, so I thought I'd do something special for you. Remember me saying that as long as the audience is happy, you and I will be happy as well, right? Together we're going to try out a new format of audience interaction. While you're the center of attention, the crowd wants to test your true strength. From now on, the audience will determine the challenges for their gladiator. Obviously, they'll be more interested in seeing you croak in the process. But if you don't break and go through whatever the spectators suggest, you'll get a special reward. It's your choice, you can always bail if you want. But trust me, there's no worse way to go than to blow your moment of glory and be left in the shadows as the crowd screams your name.

objectives.text: Eliminate 100 enemies while wearing any BattlePass 0 gear in LastHero or CheckPoint mode
Eliminate 25 enemies while wearing any BattlePass 0 gear in TeamFight or BlastGang mode

examinatio-part-2.guide: Only actual equippable gear, and not tactical clothing, from the Arena Season 0 BattlePass counts for this quest.
examinatio-part-2.briefing: I have the second challenge ready, it will require real dedication on your part. This time, they want their gladiator to stand out from the rest and put up a real fight in my Arena. Take what you've already earned in the recent contests and use it the way you know best. Apparently, our spectators are tired of watching the constant change of fighters whose success depends purely on luck. To win, you'll need to do more than just take out a couple of opponents or win a match. You'll be expected to demonstrate skills that guarantee the repeatable results you want.

objectives.text: Win 3 matches in TeamFight or BlastGang mode

examinatio-part-3.briefing: I was expecting something a little more bloodthirsty from them, to be honest. But you and I aren't the ones making the rules this time. The audience wants you to prove that you can work as a team and consistently lead your squad to victory. I don't give a shit how you get your group to listen to you. Technically, even if you take out the entire opposing team yourself, you'll fulfill the condition, so it's up to you to choose your tactics. The key is that the audience keeps betting on you and paying for what they watch.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 enemies while using assault rifles and wearing any BattlePass 0 gear in LastHero or CheckPoint mode
Eliminate 10 enemies while using marksman rifles and wearing any BattlePass 0 gear in LastHero or CheckPoint mode
Eliminate 10 enemies while using assault carbines and wearing any BattlePass 0 gear in LastHero or CheckPoint mode
Eliminate 10 enemies while using bolt-action rifles and wearing any BattlePass 0 gear in LastHero or CheckPoint mode
Eliminate 10 enemies while using submachine guns and wearing any BattlePass 0 gear in LastHero or CheckPoint mode
Eliminate 10 enemies while using shotguns and wearing any BattlePass 0 gear in LastHero or CheckPoint mode
Eliminate 10 enemies while using machine guns and wearing any BattlePass 0 gear in LastHero or CheckPoint mode

examinatio-part-4.guide: Only actual equippable gear, and not tactical clothing, from the Arena Season 0 BattlePass counts for this quest.
examinatio-part-4.briefing: Curious what they've come up this time? There is a rumor among the audience that your success is built on the fact that you always work within your area of expertise. To prove contrary, you will need to demonstrate that you are capable of winning no matter what you hold in your hands. Within reasonable limits, of course: no need to sweat it out with knives, nades and pistols. Practice at the range if you want, but you've got to perform well. The odds are against you this time, which means your victory will be more lucrative than usual.

objectives.text: Claim at least 4th place in LastHero mode thrice

examinatio-part-5.briefing: I hope you've rested up after the previous challenges. Because there's a group forming among the spectators who clearly want to kill you and score big on higher odds. To progress further, you need to last longer than the other gladiators in one of the most brutal Arena formats. On the other hand, it's all in your hands here. If you mess up, there's no one to blame but yourself.

objectives.text: Earn a Round MVP in TeamFight or BlastGang mode

examinatio-part-6.briefing: What a spectacle this fight was! Like in the very beginning, when the rules were just being established and the Arena was ruled by a savage, animalistic order... You've fulfilled the crowd's demand, and there's already a discussion in the stands about what will end our unkillable gladiator.

objectives.text: Win a round after eliminating 3 or more enemies yourself in TeamFight or BlastGang mode

examinatio-part-7.briefing: Looks like someone is feeling very butthurt by your success story... I've got a whole bunch of suggested challenges coming my way, so I'm going to close out this experimental format in a spectacular fashion. So, I've accepted two different challenges from the audience, after completing which you can earn yourself a special reward. Today, you're either going to die or make it to the grand finale. The odds are noticeably divided, and you'd better not ask me which outcome I'm betting on. The first challenge will require you to strictly follow the conditions, so proceed with a cool head. The stands are anticipating your arrival, so don't delay. Your reward will be a new weapon camouflage: Amoeba Urban.

objectives.text: Earn a Match MVP in any game mode

examinatio-part-8.briefing: As you may have realized by now, you need to pass both final challenges from the spectators to be victorious. I can't say that I often see the things the spectators are demanding of you in the Arena right now, so I won't offer any advice. Your task is to simply show that you're the best. Not just to put on a successful round or give them a bloody show, but to make sure you and the match you won are recalled even after you've got iced or quit the Arena. Only an uncompromising, complete and unconditional victory will bring you the final prize: Weapon paint set (Amoeba Green).

objectives.text: Survive and extract from Factory through the main exit

exit-here.guide: In this quest you have to extract from Factory through the "Courtyard Gate" extraction with the "Survived" status. If you extract from the raid with the "Run Through" status, the quest will not count as being completed. To avoid the "Run Through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting. File:Exit Here Map.jpg|Location marked on map File:Factory Courtyard Gate.png|The extraction
exit-here.briefing: Hey, so I've noticed that more and more people are sneaking around at the chemical plant, it's getting a little crowded for my taste... That's why I need you to scout out a new exit route in case shit goes down, you know. If you do that, you can count on a magnificent reward, trust!

requirements: Unlocks 1 hour after completion of Progression Difficulties - Part 2

objectives.text: Hand over the copy of the programmer's diary

external-interest.briefing: Hello. There are some interesting rumors going around... Yes, about you and some programmer from the reserve base. And what a coincidence: we're interested in him too. Not him, to be specific, but what he left behind in Tarkov. We need everything you've got. Everything. So would you be so kind as to pass it all along?

objectives.text: Eliminate 30 of the group responsible for the marked circles

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of GP-25 Kostyor 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher at Mechanic LL1
Unlocks purchase of 40mm VOG-25 grenade at Mechanic LL1
Unlocks purchase of M203 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher at Mechanic LL1
Unlocks purchase of 40x46mm M386 (HE) grenade at Mechanic LL1

failed-setup.guide: In this quest you have to kill 30 Cultists. While the quest is active you must not kill any Scavs or it fails.
failed-setup.briefing: Well, hello there. Come in, there's something I need you to do. An unpleasant situation has arisen. As you know, my little hobby is in demand among the remaining residents of this great city. But here's the trouble, one of the rifles I assembled fell into the wrong hands and ended up in the hands of those who draw their circles around town. Scavs found it in one of the circles and accused me of supplying the creeps with weapons. I don't need that kind of complaint. Do the job, cut through the ranks of these artists. And I'll make sure to find a decent reward. And another thing, try not to harm Scavs. Enough trouble with them as it is.

objectives.text: Hand over 50,000 EUR

fair-price-part-1.guide: Euros can be purchased from Skier with Roubles.
fair-price-part-1.briefing: Hello mate. People say you're looking for something, and that you and Mechanic desperately need this fuckin' piece of junk. What, thought I wouldn't find out? I've ran through your little project, so you two aren't gonna bullshit me with the price. If you really want it, you'll have to pay the proper price. Twenty... No, fifty grand! And no bargaining. Your little handguard is already locked up in a safe place, you won't find it on your own. So, ready to pay for your project or not?

objectives.text: Complete the task Hobby Club
(Optional) Locate the stash spot
(Optional) Locate and obtain the AK-50 handguard at the old sawmill on Woods

fair-price-part-2.guide: The handguard can be found inside a barn at the old sawmill in the east of Woods. There are multiple spawns throughout the barn. The handguard is required for the quest Hobby Club. File:Provide Cover Woods Map.png|Barn location marked on map File:Provide Cover Woods Building.png|The wanted barn File:Fair Price Spawn 1.png|Spawn #1 in the blue locker on the first floor File:Fair Price Spawn 2.png|Spawn #2 on the bench vice in the shelf on the second floor File:Fair Price Spawn 3.png|Spawn #3 on the desk with the radio equipment on the second floor
fair-price-part-2.briefing: Don't regret your investment yet? Let me give you an advice, nerds like Mechanic are the ones who pull off the most rotten schemes! He'll get his profit, and you won't even realise you've been screwed. All right, quit bitching! I'm telling you the honest bloody truth. If you're still confident about this "project", you can collect the handguard at the abandoned sawmill near the village in the nature reserve, there's a UN post not far from there. The lads have already dropped it off. But I wouldn't stay there too long, who knows what other scum's there. If someone steals it before you, don't come to me with any claims!

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 BEAR PMC operatives while wearing a Ded Moroz hat
Eliminate 10 USEC PMC operatives while wearing a Santa hat

fairy-tale-showdown.briefing: Heard the news, warrior? Those USECs are getting bold. Walking around like they own the place, shoot anyone on sight. Whats even worse is that they got more active right with New Year approaching. What do they want to tell with this? That every soldier we lose is a gift to their UN occupants? Im asking you to fulfill your duty and avenge your fallen brothers. Oh, and put on your Ded Moroz hat. Ill instruct some of your colleagues too. So that when people start asking whos tearing down the USEC ranks, everyone would answer "Hell knows, might as well be Ded Moroz!"

objectives.text: Find 5 Disposable syringe in raid
Hand over the items

fall-ailment.briefing: Good afternoon, young man. Last fall, Tarkov experienced a severe influenza outbreak. I caught it twice myself. This year, however, I managed to arrange for an influenza vaccine to be delivered through the UN peacekeepers' supply channels... Though that isn't why I asked you here. I'm planning to organize a vaccination campaign this fall, but before that, I need to vaccinate myself and everyone working at my clinic. Unfortunately, Sterile syringes are in short supply. Could you obtain five for me? Please make sure their packaging remains intact!

requirements: Must be level 14 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the warehouse of seized goods on Customs
Obtain the package of graphics cards
Hand over the package of graphics cards to Mechanic

farming.guide: The package is located within the second room (the door must be breached) of the Tarcone Directors office in the red Paradigm warehouse on Customs. There are multiple spawn locations throughout the office. You must survive and extract with the package to complete the quest. File:Delivery from the past Customs.png|Warehouse marked on map File:Customs-Factory1-Outside-3.png|The warehouse File:CustomsOffice.png|The office File:Farming3Office.png|The second room ====First spawn==== In the closet. File:Farm3Closet.png ====Second spawn==== Under the metal shelf. File:Farming part 3.png ====Third spawn==== Behind the copier. File:Farm3Copier.png ====Fourth spawn==== Behind the desk. File:Farming3Desk.png
farming.briefing: Before the conflict, I frequently ordered stuff online. Used to come regularly, I even put together a drone from parts once. The last order was 4 sets of computer components. Only 2 have made it to the city, and those are stuck somewhere in the Customs area. Now, as you can perceive, they would really come in handy. Try to search the seized goods warehouse at Customs, they could have made it through the confusion there.

requirements: Must be level 12 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find 2 Power cords in raid
Find 4 T-Shaped Plugs in raid
Find 2 Printed circuit boards in raid
Hand over 2 Power cords to Mechanic
Hand over 4 T-Shaped Plugs to Mechanic
Hand over 2 Printed circuit boards to Mechanic

farming-part-2.briefing: I think you’ve already guessed that I’m building a bitcoin farm. Thanks to the satellite "Ebambium", it’s not all surfing and memes. The more time you spend online, the more you realize the new age is upon us. Change in data distribution speed changed everything. The world has entered a new industrial revolution, though it has moved on from the real world into the virtual one. We create whole worlds, with their own economies and laws. And, looking at what is happening around us I'm almost sure the digital world is more honest and better than real. Much more depends on yourself here. It doesn’t matter just as much where you were born and who your parents were. Okay, I’m almost done with the power supply. Just need a few more details. Bring over some cables, tee-connectors, and line peripherals.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 3 targets while using the F-1 hand grenade (Reduced delay)

fearless-beast.briefing: Despite our efforts, the scum in Tarkov is not getting any weaker. Skier changed his tactics, now the stations are mobile, and we won't be able to keep up with all of them. The locals are starting to gather around him. We can't put innocent civilians in danger. There's still plenty of Scavs who don't need to be proven guilty. We need to show people what pillaging and banditry leads to. They've already lost hope, but fear is definitely still there. Partisan just came in with a couple of his experimental grenades. He took the retarder out of them, says they used to use them in Afghanistan very often. No bang delay at all. And if you make turn it into a booby trap... No one would have time to react to that. Take them and show the people what awaits those who abandon human morality. We need to make sure no one ever thinks about working with Skier. Better yet, make even the PMCs see the risks and quiet down.

requirements: Must be level 30 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find 5 Bundle of wires in raid
Find 5 Capacitors in raid
Handover 5 Bundle of wires to Mechanic
Handover 5 Capacitors to Mechanic

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of HK USP .45 ACP pistol (variant Match) at Mechanic LL3

fertilizers.guide: Wires and capacitors can most commonly be found in PC blocks, in tech stores on Interchange such as TechLight, Texho, or Rasmussen, they can also be crafted in the hideout.
fertilizers.briefing: Hey there. See what’s going on? Bitcoin plunges into the abyss. I don’t know if that’s a conspiracy or a logical pattern. This whole business was shady from the start, but well, there’s nothing left to do but to salvage what we can. To cut the long story short, my farm is acting up lately - bugs, freezes, and everything. Fix me up with some wires and capacitors. I have a little idea on how to improve the system stability. And make sure it's all new and untouched!

objectives.text: Eliminate 50 enemies in CheckPoint mode on Gate
Win a match in CheckPoint mode on Gate

field-testing.briefing: My guys are prepping a new Arena location right now. I'm gonna call it Gate. The, um... architect, Trombon, decided to check the routes, sightlines, and the overall layout ahead of time. So don't mind the place looking a bit empty for now, they just haven't had time to clutter it up yet. Your job's simple: run around, shoot a bit, and win one match. Just a routine test, pretty much.

requirements: Must be level 10 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 7 Scavs on Shoreline
Eliminate 7 Scavs on Customs
Eliminate 7 Scavs on Woods

rewards.text: 2× Leupold Mark IMS 35mm ring scope mount

fight-back.briefing: One thing I don't understand about all this bandit scum in Tarkov is how they still manage to recruit new thugs over and over again. Seems the locals have had a hard time since the start of the conflict, and now there's nowhere else to go for those who were left behind. Banditry, however, is a one way road that won't lead to any good. That doesn't change our goal. The filth has to be cleaned out, and we're the ones who'll do it. I hear the Scavs have made the most noise on the coast, at the customs district and in Priozersk. Get out there and drive the bandits back. We can't let them expand their territory.

requirements: Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the laptop from Fence's stash on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the found item

final-stretch.guide: In this quest you have to find and hand over a Laptop from an unknown facility to Fence. The laptop is located at a small ventilation chimney in an alley behind the diner on Nikitskaya Street on Streets of Tarkov. File:Final Stretch Map.png|Location of the laptop marked on map. File:Final Stretch Diner.png|Enter the diner to access the alley behind it. File:Final Stretch Ventilation.png|The ventilation chimney where the laptop spawns. File:Final Stretch Laptop Spawn.png|The laptop spawn.
final-stretch.briefing: Good thing you didn't disappear. Even with your help, they somehow spotted my people. Every last one of them got killed on the way back while crossing part of their route through the center of downtown. But before that happened, my team reported finding a rugged laptop protected by some serious security. During the attack, my boys were supposed to stash it in one of the hidden caches there in the center. I've got no reason to doubt them, so the hardware should still be there. Check those stashes, find the laptop, and bring it to me. Whatever's stored on a sealed TerraGroup site like that will be worth a great deal, even if not directly.

objectives.text: Access the sealed room with the virus in The Lab
Locate and obtain the diary inside the room
Hand over the found item

find-the-source.guide: In this quest you have to obtain a diary in The Lab. It can be found in residential unit no. 7 inside the containment block. A TerraGroup Labs residential unit keycard is required to enter it. The diary has multiple spawns throughout the room. File:DontBelieveYourEyesMap.png|Containment block location marked on map File:DontBelieveYourEyesArea.png|The containment block File:TerraGroup Labs residential unit 7 door.png|The locked door ====First spawn==== Under the mobile pedestal next to the left bed. File:FindTheSourceSpawn5.png ====Second spawn==== Under the pillow on the left lower bed. File:FindTheSourceSpawn1.png ====Third spawn==== Under the mattress of the top left bed. File:FindTheSourceSpawn4.png ====Fourth spawn==== Leaned against the books on the desk. File:FindTheSourceSpawn2.jpg ====Fifth spawn==== Under the mobile pedestal next to the desk. File:FindTheSourceSpawn3.png
find-the-source.briefing: It's good you're back. The TerraGroup information was useful, but still not enough to create a working antidote. However, I did find an important lead. The project to create this virus was highly classified, but Mechanic matched the virus codes with TerraGroup's internal division indexes. And we found an overlap. One of the key employees, not officially assigned to any open project, was a certain Vladimir O. I'm sure that a specialist of such importance kept everything important on his person, so as not to risk the spread of information. You need to thoroughly check the territory of the Laboratory, especially in the area of the block where the virus was developed. If my hunch is correct, you may find Vladimir's records there.

objectives.text: Find 4 items from the Medkits category Found In Raid
Hand over the items
Find 4 items from the Injury treatment category Found In Raid
Hand over the items

first-aid.guide: ===Medical Category=== For the Medical category you can hand over the following Found In Raid Items Salewa, Grizzly medical kit, AFAK tactical individual first aid kit, AI-2 medkit, IFAK individual first aid kit, Car first aid kit. ===Injury treatment=== For the Injury category you can hand over the following Found In Raid Items Esmarch tourniquet, Immobilizing splint, Surv12 field surgical kit, CALOK-B hemostatic applicator, CMS surgical kit, Aseptic bandage, Golden Star balm, Vaseline balm, Army bandage, Tigzresq splint.
first-aid.briefing: Greetings. Here's the thing: you can see for yourself how far out in the wilderness I live. Things happen out here. Sometimes I find a good person clinging to life, and there's nothing I can do to help. I've had people breathe their last right in my arms. I want to put together a small medical kit, something with the essentials always close at hand. Will you help me?

objectives.text: Earn a Match MVP in any game mode

first-blood.briefing: I've got some smart guys working for me, real brainiacs in glasses. Sitting around juggling numbers all day... They've never let me down, so I trust them. And they tell me the most profitable kind of fighter isn't just a winner, but a winner among winners. Those are the ones people really bet on. So your job's simple: be that fighter. Simple as.

requirements: Obtain level 1 loyalty with Therapist

objectives.text: Locate the Emercom station on Ground Zero
Hand over any 3 found in raid medicine items

first-in-line.guide: In this quest you have to find the Emercom station on Ground Zero, and hand over any 3 found in raid medical items to Therapist. The Emercom station can be found in front of the "Unity Credit" bank. File:First in Line Map.png|Location marked on map File:Ground Zero Emercom Station.png|The Emercom station
first-in-line.briefing: Greetings, young man. I need you to complete a quick assignment for me. Nothing too extraordinary yet, we have only just begun working together. There are still civilians in the city, and they're trying to get out. The best place to organize an evacuation would be the Emercom checkpoint: it should have both the vehicles and the necessary equipment. At least, I hope so. I haven't been to that part of the city very often, so I don't know exactly where the checkpoint is located. Find it for me. Once you do, I'll send my people to inspect the area. And one more thing. I'm in need of supplies for my medical duty. I can't exactly import them to Tarkov anymore, so we have to look for what we can find. It doesn't matter what you bring: consumables, medicine, stimulants. Anything useful will do. I'll be waiting.

objectives.text: Play a match in Last Hero or CheckPoint mode

first-introduction.briefing: Well hello there, fighter! Welcome to the Arena. You want to make a name for yourself here? Not so fast! First, you need to learn how things work around here. And for now, get your ass into the arena. Let's see how you handle yourself in a real fight.

requirements: Must be Loyalty Level 2 to start this quest

objectives.text: Locate the boat hidden next to the breakwater on Shoreline
Stash the MF-UNTAR body armor in the boat
Stash the multitool in the boat

fishing-gear.guide: In this quest you have to stash the 2 specified items in a rowboat at the beach near the gas station on Shoreline. After accepting the quest you will be sent a MF-UNTAR body armor and a Leatherman Multitool via in-game mail. The Leatherman Multitool is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot. Each item takes 10 seconds to stash. File:Map Shorline-Fishing-Gear.png|Rowboat stashing location marked on map File:FishingGear.png|The wanted rowboat
fishing-gear.briefing: Good afternoon, mercenary. My name is Peacekeeper, and I was referred to you by Skier. Let us not waste time and get straight to business. I need to deliver certain equipment for certain people. I am going to provide you with everything required. Your task is to leave the goods in a designated location. On the coast, next to one of the... what is the Russian word?.. Ah! Breakwaters. There is a boar there. Leave everything inside.

objectives.text: Find 2 TerraGroup Labs access keycards in raid
Hand over 2 TerraGroup Labs access keycards to Jaeger

rewards.text: 1× Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle (variant AAC SD)

fishing-place.guide: One quick way to find TerraGroup Labs access keycards in raid is to kill and loot any Scav boss.
fishing-place.briefing: Well hello there, warrior! How are you? Doing good? Listen, I've got an unusual task to do, Mechanic asked me to make one special thing for his home, and this "thing" is such a complicated one that it requires some advanced electronics. And there's no place in the city where these things could be found, damn it. But there are rumors that somewhere around here is the TerraGroup laboratory. It might have the details we need. The Laboratory is too dangerous to send you there alone, but at least bring me the access cards. Will you help? And yes, the cards should be new, not the ones you could just buy from those shady traders.

objectives.text: Take part in the Morana followers' ritual on Streets of Tarkov
Take part in the Morana followers' ritual on Interchange
Take part in the Morana followers' ritual on Customs
Take part in the Morana followers' ritual on Woods
Take part in the Morana followers' ritual on Reserve
Take part in the Morana followers' ritual on Lighthouse
Take part in the Morana followers' ritual on Shoreline

fishing-with-shishiga.guide: In this quest you have to kill a follower of Morana near a bonfire on Customs, Woods, Shoreline, Interchange, Reserve, Lighthouse and Streets of Tarkov. They are neutral to players until they are harmed or a bonfire in their vicinity is lit. 3 bonfires appear per raid. File:Winter Tales Event Bonfire.png|Appearance of a bonfire File:Followers of Morana Infobox.png|Appearance of a Morana follower
fishing-with-shishiga.briefing: Something wicked is going on. They put these masks on their faces. When you told me about those spirits, I thought it would be nice to go fishing in the woods. Sit down with a fishing rod, have a beer. But then I remember these mosquitoes, dampness and immediately I'm discouraged. I don't know how Jaeger lives there all the time. And how he wasn't dragged away by a Shishiga into the reeds yet, ha-ha. Somehow I began to remember my grandmother's stories again. Find me the places where these spirits of winter dwell. And when you come back, I'll tell you an even scarier story.

requirements: Must be level 35 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Reach the required Stress resistance skill level of 5

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for Miller Bros. Blades M-2 Tactical Sword at Skier LL4

flint.briefing: Hey, come here for a sec. As you can see, your fellow PMCs are having a hard time these days, weak ones don't make it. I tell you more: they seem like serious fighters, but if they're in some serious shit, they die like flies. Panic kills them, or tremor, fuck knows, but the result is the same. So, since we are working together I want to not worry about your back.

requirements: Unlocks 10 hours after completion of Provocation

objectives.text: Eliminate 20 Raiders
Search the weapon testing area in The Lab
Search the human experiment room in The Lab
Obtain the secured tape inside the manager's office in The Lab
Bring the tape to Lightkeeper

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for Far-forward GPS Signal Amplifier Unit at Mechanic LL4

following-the-bread-crumbs.guide: *Not all spawn locations for the quest item require this key. It is not entirely needed to complete the quest. In this quest you have to kill 20 Scav Raiders on The Lab or Reserve. Then you have to visit the weapon testing area and the human experiment room in The Lab. A TerraGroup Labs weapon testing area key and a TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black) are required to enter them. The last objective needs you to obtain a secured tape from the conference room in The Lab and bring it to Lightkeeper. A TerraGroup Labs manager's office room key is required to access 3 of the 8 possible spawns in the locked manager's area. ===Weapon testing area and experiment room location=== The wanted locations are located on the first floor. You have to enter the glassed room inside the experiment area for the objective to complete. File:BreadCrumbsBlackTestingMap.png|Locations marked on map File:Lab Key testing area (weap.) - Outside.png|The weapon testing area File:The Lab Showcase 16.png|The glassed room ===Conference room and secured tape location=== The conference room is located on the second floor. File:BreadCrumbsManagersMap.png|Conference room location marked on map File:ManagersOfficeEntrance.png|Entrance to the conference room ====First/Second spawn==== Ontop of the reception desk, tucked into a red or blue folder. File:BreadCrumbsReception.png|Red folder File:BreadCrumbsReception2.png|Blue folder ====Third spawn==== Ontop of the oval table, next to the blue folder. File:BreadCrumbsRightSideTable.png ====Fourth spawn==== Ontop of the oval table, in the back left next to the laptop. File:BreadCrumbsUnlocked1.png ====Fifth spawn==== On the floor under the back right of the table. File:BreadCrumbsFloor.png ====Sixth spawn==== In the locked manager's area, on one of the lounge chairs.
