following-the-bread-crumbs.briefing: The message found its recipient. Rats on a sinking ship began to scurry. The customers gave orders to destroy all evidence of ongoing developments. Your mission is to infiltrate TerraGroup's lab, find the data carrier containing the data we need, and deliver it to me. What are you waiting for, a candy for good luck? Hurry up!

requirements: Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the 14-4 KORD SSD
Hand over the found intel

forbidden-knowledge.guide: In this quest you have to find and hand over 3 14-4 KORD SSDs to Fence. The SSDs can be found on Black Division.
forbidden-knowledge.briefing: I liked the documents you brought me. But there'll be a lot more intel on digital storage devices, and those are definitely getting evacuated along with those little folders. They might even be tagged or sealed somehow. For now, I'm not willing to risk my own people, so this job's yours. I don't think you've got much chance of finding their camps, so the plan stays the same: intercept them in the areas you already know, and hope for a good haul. Bring me every hard drive you find with data on it. Any questions?

objectives.text: Find a way to get behind the Health Resort bunker door on Shoreline
(Optional) Assist Therapist with her investigation

forced-alliance.guide: The goal of this quest is to get a Labrys access keycard into your stash. You can acquire one by completing Hot Zone or The Tarkov Butcher.
forced-alliance.briefing: Been waiting for you. I don't know about your own search, but I think I found a way to get the keycards. Apparently, Sanitar had access to the basement beneath the health resort. That alone proves my hunch about Knossos' ties to TerraGroup. But right now, we need to find the keycards. I can't help you with that, but Therapist definitely has Sanitar's contacts. I've already reached out to her, and she's willing to help. I believe that the trail we've found is more important than our conflicting viewpoints. However, if you can find another way to get the keycards without having to deal with Sanitar, I'll wish you luck.

objectives.text: Eliminate 100 infected on The Lab

rewards.text: 1× TerraGroup Labs weapon testing area key

forced-measure.briefing: I know that everyone has put aside their former concerns for the sake of survival. But whatever is happening at the Laboratory is beyond anything that can be tolerated! There are so many infected there that the danger of new dangerous drugs spreading is extremely high. The sick are evidently losing their minds, and don't realize the risks when they smash the chemical flasks or break the rare equipment... We must take back control of the Laboratory. We're the closest we've ever been to saving the city, and we can't allow another disaster. Tarkov won't survive it. Sadly, there's no saving those already infected—eliminate as many as possible using any means at your disposal. The safety of Tarkov is at stake.

objectives.text: Eliminate 40 infected while wearing a UN uniform (UN helmet, MF-UNTAR body armor, M4A1 rifle) on Streets of Tarkov

foreign-support.guide: The specified UN armor needs to be used while killing the infected with an M4A1. You can modify the M4A1 and bring additional items to what is required. If you lose the initial set of gear, you can purchase all the specified gear from Peacekeeper. File:InfectedCivilian.png|Infected civilian File:InfectedPMC.png|Infected PMC
foreign-support.briefing: How are you doing, mercenary? If you're still able to operate, you can help me with an important matter. We need assistance in the city. According to my information, right now there is a large number of infected in the central area. The West already knows what's happening and doesn't want to stay aside. However, the convoy that was sent to contain the situation has been destroyed. I have no more men left to spare, but the task must be accomplished. And we need to do it in a way that makes our partners' involvement obvious.

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 Scavs on Lighthouse (In one raid)
Use the transit from Lighthouse to Shoreline (In one raid)
Eliminate 5 Scavs on Shoreline (In one raid)

rewards.text: 1× Magnum Research Desert Eagle L6 .50 AE pistol

forester-s-duty.guide: ===Lighthouse to Shoreline=== At the Path to Shoreline extraction. Transits are only available 1 min after raid start. File:LighthouseTransitToShoreline.png File:LighthouseTransitToShoreline2.png
forester-s-duty.briefing: Hello. I used to walk many a footpath myself, but time has bested me. The looters have cleaned out all the popular places, and now they're heading into the forests. I saw some of those Scavs the other day. They were dragging something through the swamp near Azure Coast. Even before the war, people used to call this place a death trap. Only I and my mushroom picker friend knew how to cross it in one piece and survive. Would you scare those bandits away? Make them know the forests are not for them to ravage. Make sure you cross that path I mentioned too, clean it for good.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain Prapor's cargo on Shoreline
Hand over the found cargo

forge-a-friendship.guide: In this quest you have to find Prapor's cargo on Shoreline. It can be found in the office building at the pier. There are multiple spawns throughout the building. File:PierOfficeBuildingShorelineMap.png|Office building marked on map PierOfficeBuilding.png|The wanted building ===First floor=== ====First spawn==== In the left side room on the table. File:Forge a Friendship Spawn 1.png ====Second spawn==== On the floor behind the counter. File:Forge a Friendship Spawn 2.png ====Third spawn==== On a wooden crate in the storage room in the right side of the building. File:Forge a Friendship Spawn 3.png ===Second floor=== ====Fourth spawn==== Behind the wardrobe in the left side of the building. File:Forge a Friendship Spawn 4.png ====Fifth spawn==== Under one of the desks in the right side of the building. File:Forge a Friendship Spawn 5.png
forge-a-friendship.briefing: Hello, warrior! You asked about the BTR driver, and in theory we could work together. I've already used the services of his BTR, but going against Skier is not cheap. That's why we need to solidify our intentions, so that no one slips up later! First, I need to get a package that came from outside the cordon. I'm told it's already here, somewhere in the Norvinsk port area.

objectives.text: Locate the hideout at the cottages on Lighthouse
Survive and extract from the location

forgotten-acquaintance.guide: The hideout is located on the second floor of the garage at the blue chalet on Lighthouse. It is required to get close in front of the door. The quest can be completed with the "Run Through" extraction status. File:USEC Cottage Room Key Map.png|Garage marked on map File:Blue Chalet Garage Second Floor Room Door.png|Door to the hideout
forgotten-acquaintance.briefing: Hello! Have you ever been to Cape Dalniy? Have you seen the luxury cottages there? They built a lot there, spoiled the landscape... But that's not the point. Somewhere in those houses a few people who escaped from TerraGroup are hiding. I've been tipped off by a bunch of people who hacked into the ARRS terminal. Except no one has the exact coordinates. Why don't you check it out?

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the true vaccine in Sanitar's office on Shoreline
Hand over the found item
Locate and neutralize Sanitar

rewards.text: 1× S I C C organizational pouch

forgotten-oaths.guide: In this quest you have to kill Sanitar and find his office, which is located in the health resort on Shoreline, to obtain the True vaccine recipe. The wanted office is room 110 on the first floor of the resort east wing. A Health Resort office key with a blue tape is required to enter it. The recipe has multiple spawns throughout the room. File:ForgottenOathsSpawn4.png|1: On the trolley directly left after entering File:ForgottenOathsSpawn2.png|2: In the open top drawer of the desk in the back left corner File:ForgottenOathsSpawn3.png|3: On the desk to the right File:ForgottenOathsSpawn1.png|4: In the wall shelf File:ForgottenOathsSpawn5.png|5: On the floor next to the waste bin in the bathroom
forgotten-oaths.briefing: Wait! Did you also not know that she developed this "cure" with Sanitar? I bet they made a simplified version so they could just kill all the sick people without blinking an eye, yeah? I'm not going to let this happen. I know her nature... She definitely developed a less lethal version of the drug for her own use, or for sale. But if she worked on it with this punk, that means he's the one who's keeping it! Punish the bastard and get the real version of the drug. If not the drug itself, at least find the recipe... We'll figure it out from there, probably!

objectives.text: Locate the first forklift on Factory
Locate the second forklift on Factory
Locate the third forklift on Factory
Locate the fourth forklift on Factory
Locate the fifth forklift on Factory
Locate the sixth forklift on Factory
Locate the seventh forklift on Factory
Locate the eighth forklift on Factory
Locate the ninth forklift on Factory
Locate the tenth forklift on Factory
Locate the eleventh forklift on Factory
Locate the twelfth forklift on Factory

forklift-certified.guide: In this quest you have to locate twelve forklifts on Factory. They are located on the main floor. File:Forklift Certified Map.png|Forklift locations marked on map File:FirstForklift.png|The first forklift opposite the "Gate 3" extraction File:SecondForklift.png|The second and third forklifts at gate 1 File:FourthForklift.png|The fourth forklift opposite the "Gate 0" extraction File:56911Forklifts.png|The fifth, sixth, ninth, and eleventh forklifts next to the laboratory File:SeventhForklift.png|The seventh forklift next to the offices File:EigthForklift.png|The eighth forklift below the "1986" lettering File:TenthForklift.png|The tenth forklift next to gate 2 File:TwelthForklift.png|The twelfth forklift inside the "Gate 3" extraction
forklift-certified.briefing: Hello, friend! How are you doing? Things are going well for me here. Sometimes it even seems too good to be true. Well, can't complain though! I can't play Tetriz in the old warehouse anymore, so I've found a new, bigger playground. But there's no machinery! I want to build myself a forklift from what's left in the factory. There should be enough surviving parts for one. You don't have to collect parts, just route my men through all the forklifts.

requirements: Hand over the hard drives from compartment C-1 on Icebreaker to Mechanic in the Boreas story chapter.

objectives.text: Find 5 Black Division plate carriers in raid
Hand over the items

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for Rys-T bulletproof helmet (Black) at Ragman LL1

fresh-stock.briefing: Howdy, ahper! I heard there's some serious commotion going on at some ship in the bay. Apparently some unknown group is operating there, definitely not one of your guys. You see where I'm going with this? If it's neither BEAR nor USEC, then their gear has to be something special. And special goods are the best goods, brother! If you can get to that ship and bring me back any captured armor or rigs, they'll fly off the shelves. And you'll get your cut too, you know me!

objectives.text: Eliminate 7 PMC operatives without killing Scavs, Scav Raiders, Rogues or Bosses

friend-among-strangers.guide: In this quest you have to kill 7 PMCs without killing any Scavs, Scav Raiders, Rogues or Bosses. Note: Even after killing all PMCs, killing any of the above before you have left the raid and turned in the quest will result in a failure. You may die by any means and still complete the quest.
friend-among-strangers.briefing: You've made a name for yourself, and I may have an assignment for someone like you. But before I do, I want to make sure you can tell who's an asset and who's a threat. It's simple, shoot the PMCs, but don't hurt my people. Understood?

requirements: Unlocks 24 hours after completion of Friend from Norvinsk - Part 3

objectives.text: Hand over 1,000,000 RUB to Mechanic

friend-from-norvinsk-alternative-solutio.briefing: You're taking too long to complete your task. Did the Scavs really snatch everything? Oh well, doesn't matter. My schedule is packed for the next few days, so we need to hurry up. Here's what I suggest: give me the money and I'll buy everything we need myself. It'll be faster that way. Or you can continue gathering the components yourself if you prefer.

requirements: Must be level 5 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Scout the command bunker offices on Reserve
Scout the medical building commander's office on Reserve
Scout the educational building offices on Reserve
Survive and extract from the location

friend-from-norvinsk-part-1.guide: In this quest you have to visit the 3 specified offices on Reserve and extract. File:Friend from Norvinsk - Part 1 map.png|Office locations marked on map File:Friend from Norvinsk - Part 1 command bunker.png|Command bunker offices - Underground bunker File:Friend from Norvinsk - Part 1 medical building.png|Medical building commander's office - First floor white bishop File:Friend from Norvinsk - Part 1 educational building.png|Educational building offices - Third floor white king
friend-from-norvinsk-part-1.briefing: I had a contact with a programmer from our local military base. He served there in the network and hacking unit. We met before the war started — at a hackathon in Norvinsk. After the conflict begun, he disappeared. According to my sources, he hasn't crossed the Tarkov border. I have reason to believe he's still in the city. Take a look around the reserve base. If you find any sign of him, let me know. He's got serious potential. We can't afford to lose guys like him.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain anything that could help with the investigation at the Health Resort on Shoreline
Hand over the found info

friend-from-norvinsk-part-2.guide: In this quest you have to obtain the programmer's phone from a room on the first floor of the health resort east wing on Shoreline. There are multiple spawns throughout the room. File:HealthResortEastWing.jpg|Health resort east wing location marked on map File:Friend from Norvinsk - Part 2 map.png|Room location marked on east wing first floor map File:Friend from Norvinsk - Part 2 room.png|The room File:Friend from Norvinsk - Part 2 location 1.png|First spawn on the table File:Friend from Norvinsk - Part 2 location 2.png|Second spawn on one of the chairs File:Friend from Norvinsk - Part 2 location 3.png|Third spawn on the couch File:Friend from Norvinsk - Part 2 location 4.png|Fourth spawn under the couch
friend-from-norvinsk-part-2.briefing: Glad you came by, mercenary. I have just remembered something: that friend of mine always wanted to visit the health resort. He kept saying he really needed a vacation, but he couldn't find the time. He also mentioned a project, something big, something that would "change the rules". And a meeting with someone important. Where exactly, that I don't know. You'll have to investigate.

objectives.text: Eliminate 15 Scavs
(Optional) Obtain any information on the diary from the Scavs
Locate and obtain Mechanic friend's diary
Hand over the found item

friend-from-norvinsk-part-3.guide: In this quest you have to kill 15 Scavs on any location, and obtain the programmer's diary from the church at the dilapidated village in the north of Woods. There are multiple spawns. File:Friend from Norvinsk - Part 3 map.png|Church location marked on map File:Friend from Norvinsk - Part 3 church.png|The church File:Friend from Norvinsk - Part 3 location 4.png|#1: On the roof File:Friend from Norvinsk - Part 3 location 1.png|#2: In the church tower on the floor File:Friend from Norvinsk - Part 3 location 2.png|#3: In the church tower on the green wooden crate File:Friend from Norvinsk - Part 3 location 3.png|#4: In the church tower on the floor next to the green wooden crate File:Friend from Norvinsk - Part 3 location 5.png|#5: Behind the church in the boat File:Friend from Norvinsk - Part 3 location 6.png|#6: Behind the church in the water
friend-from-norvinsk-part-3.briefing: Hey, so I'm going through his phone now. It's not a walk in the park — he specializes in encryption, he knows what he's doing. But I might have a clue. I found mention of a diary in his notes. Seems like my friend had a hunch something was gonna happen. A Moleskine diary, he always carried it with him. We need to find it. If you don't find it at the resort, that means the Scavs have probably snatched it already. I suggest you walk along the shore and "ask" the locals. Maybe someone will have it. You know how it is in Tarkov.

objectives.text: Hand over 2 found in raid PC CPUs
Hand over 4 found in raid RAM sticks
Hand over 3 found in raid Printed circuit boards or Microcontroller boards

friend-from-norvinsk-part-4.briefing: Wouldn't say we're at the finish line, but we're definitely getting close. We need additional electronics for the decryption. Hardware fails quickly, it's pretty common. I need CPUs, RAM sticks, and a graphics card. Time-wise, without these components, the decryption will take about a day. With them, it's almost instantaneous.

requirements: Unlocks 30 minutes after completion of Friend from Norvinsk - Part 4 or Friend from Norvinsk - Alternative Solution

objectives.text: Figure out the cipher and hand over the found item
(Optional) Locate the place mentioned in the cipher
(Optional) Stash the copy of the diary in the specified location

friend-from-norvinsk-part-5.guide: In this quest you have to obtain the disk with unknown data through a unique sacrifice at the Cultist Circle in the Hideout. The items that need to be sacrificed are: Programmer's diary (Copy), Expeditionary fuel tank (any durability) and Zibbo lighter. Only these 3 items must be put into the Cultist Circle for the sacrifice to work.
friend-from-norvinsk-part-5.briefing: With your help, I figured out the decryption way quicker — both in the phone and the diary. Just one last issue. I managed to extract a strange phrase: "Diary. wvyglv. oiphxifq: sbb onfz qulve. rgx: ssemddvyl". This is clearly a Vigenère cipher. It needs a key, but my friend didn't leave it anywhere in his notes. We'll have to figure it out ourselves. Here are some copies of the diary. I'll keep the original for now. If you lose it, you can have another one from me. Just don't overdo my generosity.

requirements: Obtain level 2 loyalty with Skier

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 PMCs operatives

friend-from-the-west.guide: In this quest you have to eliminate 5 PMCs on any map.
friend-from-the-west.briefing: So, ready for some serious work? Long story short, the tourists have started getting on my nerves. They're sticking their noses everywhere, taking ou my lads, messing with my supply routes. I don't like it one bit. I'll pay you nicely if you give them a proper shake-up.

objectives.text: Hand over 5,000 USD to Skier

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of TDI KRISS Vector Gen.2 .45 ACP submachine gun at Skier LL3

friend-from-the-west-part-2.guide: Dollars can be purchased from Peacekeeper with Roubles.
friend-from-the-west-part-2.briefing: Well, since we’re now best pals forever and shit, I think it makes sense to let you in on a real business that real folks are running. There are orders from a certain dude. Peacekeeper is the name - I think you know who he is. Man himself is from the UN force, which is here to prevent violence, supposedly. Can’t help laughing, ha-ha! I roll with him from the very beginning of all this fuck-up here. Working here, peddling stuff, stirring shit up, and occasionally dropping a body or two. So to the point, he’s snowed under with work and needs a tough reliable guy, just like you. Obviously, I have my cut. And, as it is easy for you to guess, the opportunity to work directly with an imported kingpin is not free. Yeah, yeah, off with that sour snot. Roll a several thousand bucks my way, and you’ll be doing business with all the benefits of Western civilization.

objectives.text: Use the transit from Ground Zero to Streets of Tarkov
Use the transit from Streets of Tarkov to Interchange
Use the transit from Interchange to Customs
Use the transit from Customs to Factory
Use the transit from Factory to Woods
Use the transit from Woods to Reserve
Use the transit from Reserve to Lighthouse
Use the transit from Lighthouse to Shoreline
Survive and extract from Shoreline

rewards.text: 1× T H I C C Weapon case

from-beginning-to-end.guide: Use every listed transit, then survive the raid on Shoreline. Transits are only available 1 min after raid start. ===Ground Zero to Streets of Tarkov=== Next to the Mira Ave extraction. File:Ground Zero to Streets of Tarkov Map.png File:Ground Zero to Street of Tarkov.png ===Streets of Tarkov to Interchange=== Southwest of the Concordia apartment complex. File:StreetsTransitToInterchangeMap.png File:StreetsTransitToInterchange.png ===Interchange to Customs=== At the southern end of the highway. File:InterchangeTransitToCustomsMap.jpg File:InterchangeTransitToCustoms.png ===Customs to Factory=== Next to the Old Gas Station extraction. File:CustomsTransitToFactoryMap.png File:CustomsTransitToFactory.png ===Factory to Woods=== At the Courtyard Gate extraction. File:FactoryTransitToWoodsMap.jpg File:Factory Courtyard Gate.png ===Woods to Reserve=== File:WoodsTransitToReserve.png File:WoodsTransitToReserve2.png ===Reserve to Lighthouse=== At the map border southwest of the train yard. File:ReserveTransitToLighthouseMap.png File:ReserveTransitToLighthouse2.png File:ReserveTransitToLighthouse.png ===Lighthouse to Shoreline=== Next to the Path to Shoreline extraction. File:LighthouseTransitToShoreline.png File:LighthouseTransitToShoreline2.png
from-beginning-to-end.briefing: Hello, mercenary. You must have heard about the "new" routes between the city and its suburbs. In reality, they've been around since the Contract Wars. All we had to do was validate and network them. Later on, I'll open it up to the public: less people will want to get their hands on my goods in popular places. But right now, I need to move one shipment across the city, pronto. You'll lead the way to secure the path for my men in dangerous areas. I've already got some of the routes under my people's control, so they can transfer your things to your Hideout.

requirements: Must be level 30 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find 2 Virtex programmable processors in raid
Find 1 Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitter in raid
Hand over 2 Virtex programmable processors to Peacekeeper
Hand over 1 Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitter to Peacekeeper

rewards.text: 2× AR-15 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG D-60 STANAG 60-round magazine

from-hand-to-hand.briefing: Hello. As you know, there were different facilities, secret and not-so-secret, within Tarkov boundaries. Many of them are hidden, and many of them have already been ransacked by scavengers. My customers are very unhappy about this. It is in their best interest that technology does not fall into the hands of... undesired persons. Therefore, we need to take that technology outside of the exclusion zone. There can be no mistakes, I need original materials only, so don't trust any resellers or third parties. Of course, those people are serious and will pay serious cash. I'll give you a list of what you need to find.

objectives.text: Score 5000 points in CheckPoint mode
Win a match in TeamFight or BlastGang mode

frost-and-sun.briefing: The clouds cleared! Rare sight around here this time of year. We can't waste the chance to make a show! Sun and snow make everything look better. Like a fairy tale, ha. I'm queueing up more matches for you. Don't mess it up. Make it look good. I'm watching.

objectives.text: Locate and mark any fuel tank near the power station with an MS2000 Marker on Interchange
Locate and mark any fuel tank in the northern territory with an MS2000 Marker on Interchange

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Hazard 4 Takedown sling backpack (MultiCam) at Ragman LL2

fuel-crisis.guide: In this quest you have to find and mark 2 fuel tanker trucks with MS2000 Markers on Interchange. File:The Blood of War Part 1 Map.jpg|Fuel tanker truck locations marked on map File:Bloodofwartanker.png|Tanker truck #1 behind the Goshan store File:Bloodofwartanker2.png|Tanker truck #2 west of the highway in the area near the "Path to River" extraction File:Bloodofwartanker3.png|Tanker truck #3 at the power station File:Bloodofwartanker4.png|Tanker truck #4 south of the trailer park
fuel-crisis.briefing: Hey there, brother! Mechanic stopped by recently. Grumpy and quiet as always, but I've gotten used to it. He's asking for fuel, and wouldn't you know it, I'm completely out! But I always know where to find more. I heard there are some tanker trucks near Ultra with German flags on them. Find them and mark them with beacons so my guys don't waste time searching.

requirements: Must be Loyalty Level 1 to start this quest

objectives.text: Hand over 5 items from the Household goods category with the Found in raid status
Hand over 5 items from the Flammable materials category with the Found in raid status

fuel-shortage.guide: If you want to find these items in raid, or search for them in raid while you're crafting them, these are some spawns for these items.
fuel-shortage.briefing: Sometimes I think back to how the locals welcomed us when we first entered Tarkov. We through the mission would be brief, but things did not go according to plan. We are currently facing shortages of supplies and fuel-related materials. Our deliveries have been disrupted, and the locals are no longer willing to assist us. We need your help, mercenary.

objectives.text: Explore the game disk's contents

game-review-part-1.guide: In this quest you have to use the Disk drive 1 at the Rest Space level 3 in the Hideout and play the game on the TV. To complete the quest, you have go to the village and speak to the woman, you will then get pointed to the elder that will ask you to get a ring. Go to the battlefield and find the ring and return to the village and hand over the ring to the elder.
game-review-part-1.briefing: Now that you have the disk, all you need to do is find time to play the game. Imagine that you are a gaming journalist who needs to write a review of the game afterwards. It always helped me. I mean back when the latest game development innovations were still being brought to Tarkov. Oh, and make sure you have everything you need to run the game. Get a proper rest space.

objectives.text: Continue exploring the disk's contents

game-review-part-2.guide: In this quest you have to use the Disk drive 1 at the Rest Space level 3 in the Hideout and play the game on the TV. To complete the quest, you have to reach the witch house in the swamps where you will be asked to return her mirror, and confront the group of men in the village (when you get the option make sure to chose "Dodge", "Focus on the fight", "Let it in" and "This is no longer your business").
game-review-part-2.briefing: You have the disk, so keep playing. And try not to die so often. I don't think you'll get an achievement for that.

objectives.text: Explore the game disk's contents

game-review-part-3.guide: In this quest you have to use the Disk with release version at the Rest Space level 3 in the Hideout and play the game on the TV. To complete the quest, you have to go to Targrad and meet the lords to deliver the prophecy from the Order of Navigators. Do not resist when you get grabbed by the guards.
game-review-part-3.briefing: Now you have the full version. You'll have to go through it all the way to the end, otherwise it won't work. We need to figure out what my friend wanted to convey and why it was so important.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 15 targets while using Shotguns at the City School 30 on Streets of Tarkov

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of TOZ KS-23M 23x75mm pump-action shotgun at Prapor LL?

gendarmerie-school-guard.guide: In this quest you have to kill any 15 targets at the City School No. 30 on Streets of Tarkov while using Shotguns. File:gendarmerie-school.png|Kill area marked on map
gendarmerie-school-guard.briefing: Hoorah, warrior. My unofficially best employee! Anyway, there's a new pain in the ass I want you to deal with. There's a few places where we need to make dead silent, if you know what I mean. You'll be the first member of our Tarkov gendarmerie division! The first task to rid School 30 of the filth. It's a personal matter, in fact - I myself studied there, and I don't want the memory of my childhood to be desecrated by any scavengers...

objectives.text: Eliminate 25 enemies in CheckPoint or Last Hero mode

general-cleanup.briefing: Well hey there, merc! Good to see you. Lately, some people have gotten into the habit of throwing all kinds of trash contenders into the fights, hell knows where they even come from. You know how it is, the spectacle really takes a hit because of that. We need to get rid of these poor excuses and, let's call it what it is, do a proper general cleanup in the arena.

objectives.text: Find 15 Cans of beef stew (Small) in raid
Hand over 15 cans to Therapist

general-wares.guide: * A high amount of Tushonka can be found inside the shopping mall on Interchange. Particularly, the "Goshan" (written "гошан" on its signs) supermarket stores a very large amount on its shelves. However, this is a hot-spot for players as many wish to take the Tushonka or loot the registers, so it should be approached with care. * Tushonka is also commonly found in "Ration supply crates" near tanks on Reserve, however like Goshan, Reserve is a highly populated map, with many threats, so it should be approached with care. * Tushonka and other food items are also plentiful at the camp on woods next to scav bunker in a ration supply crate and as loose loot. Farther south, USEC camp is also a good spot to find food items File:NewKIBALocation1.png|Goshan Store File:Location of a ration supply crate.png|The location of a Ration supply crate next to a tank on Reserve * Tushonka can be crafted in the Hideout at the Nutrition unit Lvl 1.
general-wares.briefing: Hello again. I have a temporary shortage of lasting foods in the form of canned meat. Can you help? I need a reserve of 15 cans of beef. And I know a couple of places where we could get them. From our Scav friends, of course. They used to have a storeroom at the gas station near the Factory - maybe there's still something left. Another food storage was somewhere in the dormitories, with more than canned goods there. But now I’m only interested in them, so you’re free to take the rest for yourself. Deal? I know that these two gangs are allied, but to prevent theft from the warehouses by their own people, their leaders have exchanged keys from each other's warehouses. So it should be pretty easy for you, I think.

objectives.text: Hand over the item: 30 SJ6 TGLabs combat stimulant injector
Hand over the item: 30 Obdolbos 2 cocktail injector
Hand over the item: 30 Propital regenerative stimulant injector
Hand over the item: 30 M.U.L.E. stimulant injector
Hand over the item: 30 ETG-change regenerative stimulant injector
Hand over the item: 30 SJ9 TGLabs combat stimulant injector
Hand over the item: 30 SJ12 TGLabs combat stimulant injector
Hand over the item: 30 Meldonin injector

get-a-foothold.briefing: We've got some good fucking news on our business. Luka says they took the base and even interrogated one of those pricks. They attacked during the mortar attack in Tarkov, it went quickly. They didn't seem to have blown their cover in front of the military. Our lads found out that this group belongs to some young professional criminal, and it seems that he's going to try to take the base back. I don't think he's afraid of the military at all, he's definitely well-connected. If we don't want to lose our boys, we need to give them some medicine. Luka didn't ask for anything in particular, but it's in our interest to stock them well. So bring everything you've got. They had casualties after the assault, and they can't search through the whole base right now.

objectives.text: Obtain the V3 Flash drive on Lighthouse
Reflash the Radio transmitter
Hand over the flash drive to Mechanic
Visit the lighthouse building

getting-acquainted.guide: By killing Zryachiy you will fail and lose access to this quest. *Not all spawn locations for the quest item require this key. It is not entirely needed to complete the quest. There are multiple spawns for the V3 flash drive at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse. After obtaining it, you have to reflash the transmitter at the Intelligence Center level 2 in the Hideout. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted. After the reflashing is done, the transmitter is fully functional and can be used to bypass the Claymores and Zryachiy guarding the bridge to the lighthouse peninsula, allowing you to visit the lighthouse building and meet Lightkeeper. Note: If not all members of your lobby-made group have an encoded transmitter, it will have the "blocked" state and the bridge can't be passed. ===Secure flash drive V3 locations=== ====1.Southwestern container==== =====First spawn===== Ontop of a radio system on a desk in the blue container located west of the southern tower. getting-acquainted.briefing: Come on in! Would you like some honey tea? Don't even ask how much honey cost me. In wartime the prices are like that, you know... Also, I want to reflash the transponder, but I need special software. According to my contacts, such software can be obtained from the ex-USECs at the water treatment plant. I know it's not easy, but it's worth it. When do I reflash the transponder? Buddy, you will reflash it. I don't have enough equipment here, but your Intelligence Center should have everything you need if you set it up right. I'll write down exactly what needs to be done. One more thing: the trader sends you the rules of your visit, so to speak. First: you can get to the lighthouse only while carrying the transponder, otherwise how will they distinguish you from the other PMCs? Second: do not run straight in there, make sure that the transponder worked. You will hear a beep, it means that the transponder is authorized, and you can move on. Well, good luck! I'm sure it will work out for sure this time.

requirements: Must be level 28 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 40 targets while using an RPDN with EKP-1S-03 sight on Shoreline, Interchange or Woods

rewards.text: 3× 7.62x54mm R SNB gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)

getting-some-air.guide: It's possible to use a compact reflex sight mounted on a canted rail when using the RPD DS Arms Railed Handguard instead of the EKP-1S-03 reflex sight to obtain the kills. The sight just needs to be installed to count towards the quest.
getting-some-air.briefing: Got a new toy in, been wondering where to try it out. And here you are, just in time for this. Take this RPD, go to some wooded areas, and let it rip. But make sure you run this specific build - I'm not gonna count any other setup.

objectives.text: Hand over the Documents with decrypted data

getting-to-the-core.guide: In this quest you have to hand over the documents with decrypted data to Peacekeeper. To obtain them, multiple encrypted flash drives need to be decrypted at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout. It is possible that a decryption process yields no progress at all, making the total amount of required flash drives variable.
getting-to-the-core.briefing: Good to see you, friend! I have some sad news. The files on the flash drive are encrypted, nothing can be accessed. I was hoping our troubles were over! Ahem, sorry for the outburst, back to business. We need to get to the information. Mechanic gave me instructions on how to do it. Do you have a computer? Good. Then I'm putting you on the case.

requirements: Must be Loyalty Level 3 to start this quest

objectives.text: Locate and mark the TerraGroup cargo with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse
Eliminate 10 of any targets using M203 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher on Lighthouse or Reserve

rewards.text: Unlock purchase of M203 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher at Peacekeeper LL3
Unlock purchase of 40x46mm M386 (HE) grenade at Peacekeeper LL3

gifts-from-tarkov.guide: The wanted cargo is a wooden crate that is located next to a gray shipping container on the western shore of Lighthouse. File:CargoX4Map.png|Cargo marked on map File:CargoX4Cargo.png|The cargo next to the gray container
gifts-from-tarkov.briefing: My men discovered a TerraGroup shipment hidden inside a secret wall at the Resort, but it does not fully match the manifests in our possession. We have theories about where this shipment was delivered to the Resort from, but for now, this information is completely classified. Your task in this operation is to find evidence of a TerraGroup shipment on Cape Dalniy, near the sandy shore. I believe it would be best to behind your search from the tunnel side. Also, clear the areas of Reserve and Lighthouse using our equipment. Keep in touch, my friend.

objectives.text: Eliminate 30 enemies while under the effect of a painkiller

gladiator-doping-part-1.guide: In this quest you have to kill 30 enemies in any game mode while having the 46px|on painkillers effect applied.
gladiator-doping-part-1.briefing: Now you're a full-fledged warrior, which means the expectations are higher. You want to stay at the top of your game? Use doping! I mean what did you expect? Grab the syringes and get into the fight. Time won't wait!

objectives.text: Eliminate 30 enemies while under the effect of the Propital stimulant

gladiator-doping-part-2.briefing: Let's keep looking at what can help you on the battlefield. There's a stimulant for every task. Try a different one this time, it's useful too, helps you deal with injuries. Hell, they're all useful... right up until an overdose catches up with you, ha!

objectives.text: Eliminate 30 enemies while under the effect of the Perfotoran stimulant

gladiator-doping-part-3.briefing: You know, you can actually avoid injuries altogether. Sounds like science fiction, I know, but at the very least we've got something that wont let blood loss finish you off. You've got access to that stimulant now, so go give it a try!

objectives.text: Eliminate 30 enemies while under the effect of the Zagustin stimulant
Eliminate 30 enemies while under the effect of the Propital stimulant
Eliminate 30 enemies while under the effect of the Meldonin stimulant

rewards.text: Unlocks eTG-change regenerative stimulant injector in the Armory

gladiator-doping-part-4.briefing: Alright, we're almost done with the stimulants. Just a few left, but I've got work up to my ears. So just grab them and try them out yourself in the Arena. What did you expect? I've already spent plenty of time fussing over you!

objectives.text: Win a round without dying in TeamFight, BlastGang or ShootOut mode

rewards.text: Unlocks Shattered lightweight armored mask in the Armory

gladiator-life-final-exam.briefing: I didn't call you a gladiator just for the sound of it. You can fight, and you can do it with style. But that still might not be enough. If you knew how many fighters I've seen die at this stage... That's why I'm testing your resilience now. Show me what you're really made of.

objectives.text: Eliminate 15 enemies in Last Hero mode

rewards.text: Unlocks Diamond Age NeoSteel High Cut helmet (Black) in the Armory
Unlocks Kalashnikov AKMSN 7.62x39 assault rifle in the Armory
Unlocks ANA Tactical M2 plate carrier (OD Green) in the Armory

gladiator-life-part-1.briefing: You came here for the money, right? Don't even try to deny it! Like I'm in any position to judge that, ha. If you want real cash, you need a real name. Fighting as part of a team is fine, but the only way to make it to the top is on your own! In fights where it's every man for himself, that's where skill really shows.

objectives.text: Earn 1,500 objective score in CheckPoint mode
Eliminate 20 enemies in CheckPoint mode

rewards.text: Unlocks Kalashnikov AK-101 5.56x45 assault rifle in the Armory

gladiator-life-part-10.briefing: You made a good impression on some serious people. Now they expect results, so don't let them down! And yeah, of course there will be bets. I'll cut you in on the profits, don't worry. Just focus on your job: kill, earn money... and most importantly, make it look good!

objectives.text: Capture the objective 5 times in CheckPoint mode

rewards.text: Unlocks RPK-16 5.45x39 light machine gun in the Armory

gladiator-life-part-2.briefing: Keep this in mind: mowing down opponents like it's a shooting range is nice and all, but there are hundreds of shooters like that in Tarkov. If you want real money, you need to stick in the audience's memory. And for that, you'll have to show your skills in other disciplines, so to speak. My advice? Show everyone you know how to assault objectives just as well!

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 enemies as Enforcer or Assault in CheckPoint mode

rewards.text: Unlocks SV-98 7.62x54R bolt-action sniper rifle in the Armory

gladiator-life-part-3.briefing: Let's keep exploring the Arena, ha! Tell me, why do you think I split all the fighters into classes, like in some kind of video game? Because it makes things clearer! For you, and for the audience. If you want to get popular in the Arena, you need to know how to impress. For example, by proving you can perform well in every Arena class I've set up. If you want to get popular in the Arena, you need to know how to impress. For example, by proving you can perform well in every Arena class I've set up.

objectives.text: Win a match in CheckPoint mode

rewards.text: Unlocks SIG MPX 9x19 submachine gun in the Armory

gladiator-life-part-4.briefing: Looks like you're picking up the basics just fine. Not like some... ah, forget about the others. Let's focus on you. What matters now is winning. So come on, grab your weapon and get out there. Time to take the Arena by storm!

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 enemies with headshots

rewards.text: Unlocks Magnum Research Desert Eagle L6 .50 AE pistol in the Armory

gladiator-life-part-5.briefing: I hope you've already noticed that some fighters walk around in pretty serious armor. You are not punching through that so easily. But the Arena has a great equalizer, a bullet to the eye! And you need to master that as soon as possible.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 enemies as Scout or Marksman

rewards.text: Unlocks MSA Sordin Supreme PRO-X/L headset in the Armory

gladiator-life-part-6.briefing: So, ready to keep getting familiar with the classes? Like you really have a choice... Pick your gear, grab a weapon, and get back to the Arena to smash some opponents!

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 enemies while under the effect of any stimulant or painkiller

rewards.text: Unlocks AFAK tactical individual first aid kit in the Armory

gladiator-life-part-7.briefing: Alright, time to move on to the most important part, the medicine. And stimulants. You've definitely used them already, otherwise you would not have survived this long in the Arena. Now I need to see how well you learned the lesson. Use stimulants to kill! And fine, if you patch yourself up and then take someone out, I will count that too.

objectives.text: Win 2 rounds in TeamFight, BlastGang or ShootOut mode

rewards.text: Unlocks SOG Voodoo Hawk tactical tomahawk in the Armory

gladiator-life-part-8.briefing: Some of the right people have started taking an interest in you. Asking about forecasts, wondering how far you'll go. But words are just words! Time to head out there and prove how good you really are.

objectives.text: Claim at least 5th place in Last Hero mode

rewards.text: Unlocks Beret (Olive Drab) in the Armory

gladiator-life-part-9.briefing: I'm easing you higher and higher, step by step. You better appreciate it, fighter! I pulled some strings with a few people, they're ready to take a look at you. Don't screw this up! All you have to do is stay alive in the fight as long as you can.

objectives.text: Eliminate 50 infected on Shoreline

global-threat.briefing: I'm getting reports from the terminal near Azure Coast, my people say there are more and more infected every day. Even if one sick person makes it into the harbor area, chaos will ensue. People will panic, try to use water transportation to leave. In that case, the disaster could go beyond the borders of Norvinsk region and even Russia. The port security needs help. If you help reduce the number of infected over there, I'll make sure you get a reward from my Western partners.

glory-to-cpsu.briefing: Greetings, soldier! I've got an urgent job for you. Back before all this, I had an old friend, name was Oleg. We lost touch somewhere along the way, though I know he stayed in Tarkov. Then the other night... I had a bad feeling. Call it a dream, call it a gut instinct. I need you to look for him downtown. Check his apartment and the place where he worked. I can't remember the exact addresses anymore, but you should be able to figure it out. Just look for anything with a Soviet touch. Oleg was a true patriot.

A real fighter, you and I would never reach his greatness. And what a patriot! The problem is that I haven't heard from him for a while now. I'm worried about him. Will you check on him?

objectives.text: Eliminate 25 infected with a headshot while using a shotgun on any location

gloves-off.guide: File:InfectedCivilian.png|Infected civilian File:InfectedLabTechnician.png|Infected lab technician File:InfectedPMC.png|Infected PMC
gloves-off.briefing: So, any progress on creating a cure for the infection? I hope Therapist is truly engaged in this and not just looking for a good buyer for this diary. We still can't cure Tarkov once and for all, so let's at least clean it up while we can. I've heard that the easiest way to kill these creatures is to shoot them in the head. In that sense, it's still the same as with humans. I'd take something more powerful to make sure their faces get shredded for sure. Right, take a shotgun with you! Alright, time for work. Get in the fight and help this city. Oh, and grab some of my honey tea to help your body fight off the sickness.

goals-and-means.briefing: Hello. I used to believe that staying inside clear boundaries and doing the job by the book was the highest form of professionalism. When you can pick the right tool for any task and never step out of the top league. Working only with the best equipment. But Tarkov showed me that being just a professional isn't enough. Here I learned that true mastery is forged under harsh conditions with limited resources, when the outcome can't be predicted. You start relying more on your own experience and intuition, and if you're good enough - you rise to the very top. Since the Contract Wars, I've held on to a small reserve of special weapons. But like in my line of work, they're only tools. An ordinary professional doesn't have the skills to unlock the full potential of such a piece. It takes a true master. And I'm starting to think you might be able to handle such a temperamental weapon. If you can prove that you can solve problems no matter what tools you're given - I'll open access to this special section of my arsenal.

Hand over the Golden Zibbo lighter to Skier

golden-swag.guide: In this quest you first have to find a golden Zibbo lighter on Customs. It can be found on a desk in room 303 on the third floor of the three-story dorms building. A Dorm room 303 key is required to enter it, you also will need to stash a regular Zibbo lighter in Doom room 303 File:GoldenSwagMarkedMap.png|3 story dorms, room 303 and cabin marked on map File:Gilded-Zibbo-Location.png|The lighter on a desk
golden-swag.briefing: Alright, you little criminal! I've got this one bloke who didn't like my terms and tried to get smart with me. I put him in his place once, but now he's gotten far too cocky. Time to teach him a lesson. Simple job. There's a group of Scavs holed up at the factory. One of their top dogs is some bloke called Uruguay. What a blood stupid nickname! Best put an end to his little adventure. But thanks only half the job. He's got a supposedly lucky gold-plated Zibbo, he keeps fiddling with it all the time. Even came by my place couldn't stop clicking the fucking thing. Bring it to me. Alright rere's the plan... Stop by the dorms, get inside this fucker's room 303 grab the golden Zibbo and stash a regular Zibbo in its place. Got it? Write it down if you need to. Now get out there and get to work!

objectives.text: Eliminate 50 followers of Morana

rewards.text: 3× .300 Blackout M62 Tracer ammo pack (50 pcs)

granny-s-tales.guide: In this quest you have to kill 50 followers of Morana. Followers of Morana can be found near bonfires. They are neutral to players until they are harmed or a bonfire in their vicinity is lit. 3 bonfires per raid appear in different locations on Ground Zero, Customs, Woods, Shoreline, Interchange, Reserve, Lighthouse and Streets of Tarkov. File:Winter Tales Event Bonfire.png|Appearance of a bonfire File:Followers of Morana Infobox.png|Appearance of a Morana follower
granny-s-tales.briefing: Seems like it's more complicated than I thought. I guess it's nothing terrible, but it still gives me the chills. You know, once you've served, you're not afraid of anything but the living. Though I remember when I was a kid, my granny used to scare me. She'd start telling me stories about all sorts of evil things! She was born before the revolution, she'd seen all sorts of things, maybe that's why. I was about five years old, playing with my toys. She came in, locked all the doors, covered the windows, and was like, "There's that striga again". I asked her what the word striga meant. And so she began to tell my five year old ass about some monster at night, how scary it is and how it drinks blood. Fucking why? These "spirits of winter" guarding the bonfires seem to have grown in body, but not in mind. I have an idea how to change things up. Do this, and we'll see how they react. Try shooting tracers at the bonfire at point-blank range, like 10-20 meters, to set it on fire. I think there's more of those spirits out there than meets the eye, and it probably won't make them happy. Just take the tracers and remember the basics of CQC! And when they come out, let's chase the winter away, so to speak, hehe!

Stash 1 RayBench Hipster Reserve sunglasses at the sawmill docks on Woods

Each item takes 20 seconds to stash. File:Gratitudemap.png|Pier location marked on map File:GratitudeLocation.png|The pier at the sawmill File:GrattitudeBarrels.png|Stashing location at the barrels
gratitude.briefing: Salam. Listen, I'd like to send a care package to one dude. Get him fitted with some stuff, just so he knows that Arshavir remembers. He's is not the military, just a regular dude, but he loves to dress up like he's in the Matrix sometimes. Or as that hairy-chested spy, Austin or whatever, the dude in glasses. Leave the package at the pier in the Woods, right on the wooden docks. He will pick it up, I'll let him know. Just hide it someplace between the barrels, so that nobody sees it. Here's the list of what to stash, come back when you're done. Oh, the shemagh must be green, by the way!

The ambush spot is an area that reaches from the green container with the AGS-30 grenade launcher behind the car dealership to the northeastern part of the car dealership. Be aware that the premises of the LexOs car dealership are riddled with Claymores. File:StreetsConvoyMap.png|Convoy and ambush spot with Claymores marked on map File:LexOsClaymoreOverview.png|LexOs complex overview File:StreetsConvoy.png|The convoy File:StreetsConvoyAmbushSpot.png|The ambush spot
green-corridor.briefing: Those bloody westerners! All they want to do is shoot everybody! It's already been negotiated, we even paid them to let us through! But no, they want to spill more of our blood! All right, soldier, come here and listen. A convoy was passing through town. With important cargo. Very important. Even I don't know what's in it. Somebody took money for the convoy's safe passage, and then the convoy went dark. Think about it, such bastards! Find out what's going on and if anything could be saved. And find out where the shooting came from...

grenadier.briefing: Hello, warrior. How are things on the front line? People say you're a good shot, I've even tested you myself too. But what if you have to use a grenade? You will need intuition and brains to not get flogged accidently. So, I want to see how you handle grenades, go make some noise in Tarkov.

(Optional) Locate the position of Ref's mercenaries on Shoreline

guardian-of-nature.guide: In this quest you have to find Ref’s orders in the EMERCOM camp on Woods. File:Woods Capturing Outposts Location.png|Camp location marked on map File:Ref's orders spawn.png|The wanted item
guardian-of-nature.briefing: Good to see you, kid. You've probably heard of Ref, maybe even worked for him... Well, he's decided to stick his Arena into the nature reserve. At first he wanted to negotiate, even tried to buy me off. I made my position perfectly clear through his messengers. But there was a fight near the EMERCOM camp yesterday, and I don't think that's a coincidence. If Ref doesn't understand words, then you and I may have to settle this another way. First, though, we need information. Find out who's occupying that camp now and try to learn what they're planning. It wouldn't hurt to take a look around other parts of the city as well. The more we see, the clearer the picture becomes.

gun-connoisseur.briefing: Thanks for the help with the M4, you really helped me out. Unfortunately, this mercenary never transferred the payment he promised me. I trusted him because of old acquaintances, but the guy went straight to the lab as soon as he received the weapon, and so far there is no word from him. Got too greedy, that's my guess... Well anyway, I can deal with this matter later, but I also have something else on my mind. I'm collecting feedback on my services, looking for a fresh perspective, you know? I've decided not only to do individual orders, but to sell guns in sets, fully loaded out of the box. Test it out properly, ask your colleagues maybe. Every little detail and view point is important! And be sure to check the weapons in action, I'm sure you know how....

gunsmith-ak-105.briefing: I called her Lusya - the neural network, I mean. So, when I keep silent, it does well and even reminds me to get some sleep when necessary, but as soon as I start talking to myself, it attempts to distract me, putting on music or something like that. However, I trained it with movies and phrases from them. Apparently, such a reaction is presented to us in the movies as the most appropriate, but not for me. I'll have to think about what stimuli are the best to mimic real people, rather than society and its stereotypes. But I digress, assemble an AK-105 now, with a silencer and 60-round mag. As for parameters: sighting range over 800, ergonomics above 21, recoil sum less than 500, weight 4.8 kg or less. And compact, as always, 8 slots or so.

We have, by our actions, by buying sneakers or even beet salad, supported those who build laboratories and manufacturers, and then use them to plunge us into the abyss. Okay, I'm rambling again, back to business. Get me an AKM with a Fortis Shift grip, silencer, and 30-round Magpul mag. Let's see how it turns out when I'm done. There is an order for AKS-74N with Zenit parts. gunsmith-as-val.briefing: While I was busy with the network, I started to wonder how are we different from it, and when we can replace our short-lived brains with those kinds of systems. What do you think, will this time come someday? I think it will, very soon. We already don't know what processes occur inside neural networks, there is only an entry signal and the result of its actions, and how it has learned with its own internal rules, wiring up its own neural links inside itself. How is it different from us? Would you love living in a world where your actions get limited only by your mind and imagination? The truth is, I think, living in such a world would be no better than in our own if there is no goal. And where can a goal come from if you're immortal and omnipotent... This time we need an AS VAL. GL-SHOCK buttstock, AN/PEQ-15 tactical device, NSPU-M night scope, and a 30-round magazine. Ergonomics above 27 and recoil sum less than 220.

gunsmith-hk-mp5.briefing: When I was a child, people used to say that it is not the destination that matters, but the journey itself. But what if the destination is yourself, what you know, how good you use your reflexes, and how many rounds you have in the magazine? This feels particularly true when you're supposed to survive, clinging to this world with your teeth. Well, to the point: I need an MP5. gunsmith-m4a1.guide: M4A1 specifications: *60 Durability *37 or greater ergonomics *300 or less recoil *800 or greater sighting range *3.8 kg or less in weight *A magazine with a capacity of at least 60 *A silencer
gunsmith-m4a1.briefing: Sometimes I think it's good that I got stuck here in Tarkov. The whole world feels like it’s descending into an abyss, a gaping, cold abyss. Everything has lost its meaning. People, their values, their thoughts, and their goals. They don't know anymore why they should take joy, work, have children. Everyone is tired from the illusion of choice they were offered all this time, from having to work and buy either blue or red cigarettes. It’s happening everywhere, in every corner of the world. But here in Tarkov, we are honest with ourselves. We see it all in an already exaggerated way, without false values, when you don't just decide what laundry detergent is better at removing stains, but how to keep warm at night and where to find ammo to deal with the next lowlife who wants to kill you. Only in such an honest society, people show their true selves. What do you think? Okay, thanks for hearing me out. Some folks requested a fully packed M4. They need a silencer, 60-round extended mag, ergonomics above 37, and recoil sum less than 300. And mind the weight, no more than 3.8 kg, with a sighting range of 800 or beyond.

gunsmith-master-part-12.briefing: Hello. Do you ever find yourself crossing paths with a classmate decades after high school and hardly recognizing them? Although, I'd likely shock some of the folks from my class myself. Recently, a certain guy from my school days reached out to me. After school, he went into the army, wanting to join the special forces... It was clear even then that he had a peculiar, uh, aptitude for that job. Somehow he found me here and asked me for a favor. He wants to remember his early years in basic training. I'm not a big fan of that sort of hospitality, plus I've got heaps of work to do. But let me put it this way: he was, um, very insistent. I don't need any more trouble, so I agreed to his deal, hoping you'd help me sort it all out. People say this kind of equipment used to be somewhat standard issue at his job: ORSIS T-5000, Vityaz and a Glock 17. All with the special mods, of course. The rifle was equipped with an ATACR 7-35x56 34mm scope, Harris bipod, and a suppressor, I can't recall which exact one... Well, probably doesn't matter. Just get any suitable silencer, that'll work. For Vityaz I need the Micro T-1 red dot with a spacer, Zenit RK-6 front grip and RK-3 pistol grip, PT-3 Klassika buttstock... I also need a PEQ-15, Klesch-2P flashlight, and, as you probably guessed, a suppressor, the standard Vityaz one. Ergonomics no less than 49, recoil sum no more than 400, and at least a 30-round magazine. The Glock is simple. You need to replace the barrel with the Double Diamond with their thread protector, add a Pachmayr Grip Glove, Klesch-2P flashlight, and a 21-round extendo mag. I think that's everything.

gunsmith-master-part-9.guide: M4A1 specifications: *60 Durability *40 or more ergonomics *280 or less recoil *5 kg or less in weight *A magazine with a capacity of at least 60 *KAC QDSS NT4 5.56x45 sound suppressor (FDE) *AR-15 Alexander Arms MK10 rifle length handguard *Trijicon REAP-IR thermal scope
gunsmith-master-part-9.briefing: What do you think, how much does human life cost? Not much, I guess. But what's even more surprising for me, it's the contemporary art market. The value of art pieces by renowned artists grows every year. They are definitely talented, but the more you look at it, the more it seems that anything can be art. It can be a Rothko painting, a displaced urinal, or a bunch of garbage. However, in my opinion, the most amazing pieces of art are weapons, starting from the melee - which is already universally recognized as such and can be found in many museums - to an old AK or M4, which are beautiful as they are. But a weapon only transcends to true art when it becomes unique, one-of-a-kind, in the hands of someone who knows how to use it, who modifies it for his own needs, creating a masterpiece worthy of being displayed in the best of museums. Bring me one such masterpiece, an M4A1 with a KAC QDSS NT-4 (FDE) silencer, Alexander Arms MK10 rifle-length handguard, REAP-IR thermal scope, and a 60-round magazine. Ergonomics should be not less than 40, the recoil sum less than 280, and the weight of 5 kg or less.

objectives.text: Mark the stash with new Arena rewards with 2 MS2000 Markers
Eliminate 10 PMC operatives while wearing a painted CQCM mask (Demon, Skull, Demonic Face)

habet-hoc-habet.guide: The stash with new Arena rewards where the 2 MS2000 Markers have to be placed is a yellow minibus at the container lot in the southwest of the mall on Interchange. File:Minibus1.png|The minibus
habet-hoc-habet.briefing: Things are moving along nicely on our end, we've hit a couple more convoys. So yeah, we've properly messed with Ref by now, and funny enough, my workers suddenly forgot all their complaints! But I don't just want to annoy the bugger, I want to put him flat on his back. My machine gunners caught one of the convoys on boats over at Customs, but those pricks managed to slip away toward Interchange. My lads dropped most of them, but the boats were empty. That means it was the real deal. No one bolts like that over a pile of shitty old masks! They couldn't have gone far with a load that big, so the shipment's gotta be somewhere on Interchange. Help me track down those crates, yeah? They wouldn't risk going into Ultra, so they must've stashed it nearby. There are a couple of fenced warehouses with containers by the exit toward Customs... check those out. Might've even loaded everything into a vehicle to fix it up later and make a quick getaway. If you find anything, mark it with strobes. And it's about time we show Ref that his so-called "gladiators" aren't any better than our Tarkov lads! I gave the same job to some of your lot, so wear a black mask so we know who's who. One of those trophy ones.

objectives.text: Hand over 5 found in raid military electronic items
Hand over 10 found in raid PC component items

half-empty.guide: The RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Special Yellow) provided by Prapor via in-game mail can be used to call in a special airdrop containing a few of the required items. Military electronic items: * Iridium military thermal vision module * Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitter * Military cable * Military circuit board * Military gyrotachometer *Military power filter * Virtex programmable processor PC component items: * Bundle of wires * CPU fan * DVD drive * Damaged hard drive * Electronic components * Graphics card * PC CPU * Power cord * Power supply unit * Printed circuit board * RAM stick
half-empty.briefing: So, about that cargo from across the cordon. Turns out it was only part of the shipment. The other part's supposed to be airdropped. But I suspect they didn't include everything there either, those bastards. Look, you could help me with this. The package still needs to be picked up. And if we don't actually have everything, we'll have to look somewhere else. Obviously, I'm not gonna work with these suppliers anymore, but right now I need all these electronics from the shipment. I won't forget your commitment. Who knows, maybe I'll figure out how to help comrade driver quicker after you're done.

harley-forever.briefing: Hey brother, you like motorcycles? I've got a customer who's a real fan of them. He just got his A-levels and he's ready to race. You know the song? "On the back of a Harley he took me for a ride in the sky"? That's exactly what the kid wants to do. Only they don't import Harley to us no more, you know, sanctions and all that. I promised my client I'd get him a proper bike... How's he gonna get it running, I wonder. All the equipment's blacked out, I don't know. Buy a new one? I'm not a moron. They're free in this town, you just have to find them. One Scav guy said he saw a bike in the car dealership, but he's not sure if it's a Harley or not. Anyway, look for bikes in town. There were some at the Lighthouse too. Nah, you don't need to bring 'em in. I know you, you'll bring them back with bullet holes in them. Just mark them with the strobes, my men will handle it from there.

healer.briefing: I can contact Sanitar, but he's unlikely to be accessible at the moment -- he's having some difficulty with the Scavs at the city clinic. You should help him with this matter to get a better bargaining position. He's the only one who can help you with your situation.

healing.briefing: Good afternoon, young man. I have examined the remedy you provided. It is safe and ready for use. The only question is, will you allow me to study it? It will take some time, which means I'll have to be patient for a while longer. But this way I can make more than just a single dose of the antidote and save everyone unlucky enough to be poisoned by the river. I realize the antidote is all yours since you fought hard to get it. So the decision is yours alone.

File:HCPP1.png|Ambulance locations marked on map File:Ambulance2.png|Ambulance 1 at the "Tunnel" extraction File:Ambulance1.png|Ambulance 2 at the "Tunnel" extraction File:Ambulance3.png|Ambulance 3 at the health resort File:Ambulance4.png|Ambulance 4 at the cottages
health-care-privacy-part-1.briefing: Good day, young man. Many people have tried to escape the current predicament, and some of them behaved like they were not human beings anymore, but for us, medics, nothing has changed. Our job is to save lives, no matter what the circumstances could be. When the shoreline tunnel collapsed, quite several survivors were injured. The ambulances were immediately dispatched to a distress call, but, well, I assume you know what has broken out there. Long story short, that's where they stayed. I know that there were three or four vans, and the chances are high that most of the equipment and medicine is still inside... If you happen to find them, just mark them with beacons and my people will take care of the rest.

Hand over the retrieved information

health-care-privacy-part-2.guide: The Secure Folder 0060 can be found on Shoreline, in room 306 of the west wing at the Resort, located on a windowsill. File:Inside West wing room 306.png|Folder location on the windowsill File:HealthCarePrivacyPart2Docs.png|The folder
health-care-privacy-part-2.briefing: Thanks for your assistance with the vans. We were just in time, even those Scavs didn't have time to pull them apart. While researching the aftermath of the tunnel collapse, we’ve run across a TerraGroup executive's Geländewagen. It appears that part of the company’s top managers perished there while trying to evacuate. I’m aware that medical research was one of the top priorities for the company, and I'm almost sure that they had no time to evacuate its data and materials in time. Whatever they were doing, I think it can turn out to be very valuable, both for us and for medical science in general. It can earn us a ticket from Tarkov, even more than one. I’ve regularly met up with certain TerraGroup employees to discuss health care issues, so I'm pretty familiar with some of their works. One of my acquaintances, who, by the way, directly reported to that deceased Geländewagen management, used to live in the health resort building. Let me look it up... here it is, room 306. Search it for anything that could possibly be left behind.

health-care-privacy-part-3.guide: The wanted minivan is located at the shore on the eastern side of the lake on Woods. The blood sample needs to be taken from the right sliding door. File:WoodsVanLocation.png|Minivan location marked on map File:The car by the lake.png|Minivan by the lake File:The blood sample.png|Blood sample location
health-care-privacy-part-3.briefing: While you were searching the room, have you found anything unusual? Two bodies? Such an atrocity... It can’t be just a coincidence. No wonder, though, the documents that you’ve managed to find are dedicated to some serious research in the field of Immunology, and from what we can understand, they have made some significant progress in that direction. Judging by the signature on the documents, the research was supervised by the head of the Medical Service of the health resort. Quite an elderly person, I’ve met him a couple of times on Health Care Worker Day. Although he was a venerable scholar he preferred the repose of the countryside over the bustle of laboratories and often spent time in the Woods, driving around in a white minivan. Witnessing the success, I believe, could have motivated him to start experimenting on humans, first one most likely being himself, according to medical tradition. Scientists are always like that. Find his vehicle, and, if you also happen to find his blood samples, that would be great.

objectives.text: Reach the required 4 Health skill level

health-care-privacy-part-4.briefing: Good day, young man. The degree of your deftness never ceases to leave me in admiration. Naturally, I wouldn’t want you to fall ill, so health before everything. I forgot to warn that you to be careful with the blood samples you brought. I hope you haven't cut yourself... and have washed your hands. Although, who knows how long it has been exposed to sun, wind, and whatnot. In any case, I would still advise you to pay attention to your health, otherwise, it all might end before we evacuate the people and ourselves from Tarkov.

objectives.text: Locate the drop spot on night-time Factory
Obtain 3 packs of Gunpowder "Kite" and stash them in the designated spot

health-care-privacy-part-5.guide: The required room is the "Breach Room" on Factory. Place 3x Gunpowder "Kite" while night time there. The "Breach Room" is the room between the office and the locked room on the third floor. Each Gunpowder "Kite" takes 30 seconds to place, leading to a total placement time of 90 seconds. Closing the door to the breach room is recommended while placing them, as Scavs will wander down the hallway periodically. If you wish to complete this quest with little to no resistance it is recommended to bring a squad to defend you as you plant the items. You do not have to successfully extract to complete this quest. File:HCPP5.png|Location marked on map File:The breach room.png|The door to the "breach" room where you plant the Gunpowder "Kite"
health-care-privacy-part-5.briefing: Blood is a good source of information. Not as good as proper paperwork of course, but still good enough. It’s been a while since I did my last research. I was assisting an intern virologist with his thesis. Feels like it was yesterday, and at the same time so long ago. When the Internet was invented, it made it much easier to exchange information, even with colleagues from other countries. I miss this opportunity now to sift through the Scopus database, I am pretty sure that it has the answers to my questions, emerged after that blood sample research. Where could one possibly find access to the web now, you ask? To address this issue, I was advised to contact the one going by the name of Mechanic. As it turned out, he has access to the Internet, and it’s even relatively fast. I’ve asked him to look up the necessary articles for me. He asked for a small fee for his services, in the form of gunpowder, for whatever reason. It looks like he’s supplying someone with ammunition or something like that, but I am not really interested in that. Most importantly, he will provide the information we need. Find what he asks for, and leave it at the specified spot in the Factory. The place is swarmed with Scavs in the daytime, so it’s best to do it at night.

health-care-privacy-part-6.briefing: Together with you we have come a long way on the trail of the mysteriously deceased inhabitants of Tarkov. Now I have new information. The bodies of workers at the factory were found without signs of violence. It could be a symptom of poisoning or worse... Blood samples would help shed light on the mystery of these workers' deaths. We can't take that chance. You already have good experience in collecting samples, so I'd like to entrust this case to you.

hell-on-earth-part-2.briefing: Warrior! Remember the DB you were building? I couldn't deliver it past the border. That's a bummer, the shotty is gorgeous. Speaking of, we've got plenty of demons of our own in Tarkov. Can't even take a shit in the woods at night! Why don't you take this gun out for a spin and deal with those devils?

hidden-layer.briefing: You know, I've thought it over again and I'm definitely positive there's a hidden layer to TerraGroup's connection with Knossos. Granted, we don't know what they were hiding yet, but that just means we haven't searched hard enough. We need to double-check everything again. Try to examine the Knossos facilities from the list again, you can also check out the adjacent buildings. Although last time my advice didn't lead you to a proper result... This time, you'd better trust your skills and intuition. Maybe we'll get lucky this way.

hide-in-plain-sight.briefing: Have you seen how the city's changed? Lights, fairs everywhere. It's like there was no war and they're selling next year's calendars everywhere. But all this cheerfullness is to our advantage. The fairs have been put in prominent places, and I'd like to use them to traffic my merchandise. And in order to add new spots to my itineraries, I need the exact coordinates. Can you lend me a hand with that? You help me, I help you, like brother to brother! Finding fairs is easy - just follow wherever you see the most holiday lights.

objectives.text: Eliminate 15 enemies while under the influence of the Adrenaline stimulant on Dorms, EMERCOM, or Base in LastHero mode

high-voltage.briefing: You're looking a bit sluggish, even though your reactions are still sharp. Weather getting to you or what? Yeah, it's freezing, so what? I'm not letting you relax, that's for sure. But I'll give you a tip. If you start slowing down, hit some adrenaline and get back in the fight. Just don't fool yourself into thinking it'll make you invincible. Use it smart, and don't forget about tactics.

hobby-club.briefing: Excellent, I've been waiting for you. I have a friend in the States, a very skilled weapons professional. He's obsessed with Russian firearms, and for several years now he's been working on his own project, called the AK-50. I don't think you've ever seen an AK that fires a .50 cal... The NATO one, I mean. So the project is finally finished, and he sent me a test sample. Such a heavy and specialized rifle is too risky to be imported in one piece, so we broke the package into several parts. Well guess what, things in Tarkov didn't go according to plan. Shocker, I know. The main body comes as one part, and it was seized in Atlantic waters. However I have the blueprint, so I need you to use it to build a new one for me. It certainly won't be easy in our circumstances. But at least you'll still have a copy of the blueprint for later use. The handguard comes with the gas tube, and it was somehow intercepted by Skier's thugs. This part took two years to assemble, fit, and test, and the cost of development and prototypes has already gone over a couple million. The dust cover was intercepted at one of the checkpoints already in Tarkov. I don't know which one, you'll have to search through all of them. But the barrel is definitely at the military base. Glukhar's personally organized an ambush on my convoy, and apparently knew about this shipment. You'll have to fight for it, or hope for some divine intervention. When you've collected all the parts, drop them off at the transmission tower shack near the gas station at the customs district. I'll ask my crew to deliver them from there, and after that I'll be able to manufacture the parts myself. And, of course, I won't forget your help.

objectives.text: Eliminate 75 enemies in Arena

rewards.text: 79 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
86 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2

hold-the-lead.briefing: Alright, you made yourself noticed again. I won't lie, it was impressive. You even got the attention of some big players. Not without a little help from me, of course: you should've heard how I was hyping you up! Now, if you want to earn more cash, you've got to hold your spot at the top. Show that you're ready to tear your opponents apart with your bare hands!

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 PMC operatives while dressed as Ded Moroz or Santa (hat and beard)

holiday-beyond-the-means.briefing: Hello mate. Have you seen that they've started decorating the whole town for the celebrations? As if all that pretty tinsel is worth the fuel that gives light to their garlands and lights. People are fucking stupid enough to spend all their resources on it. And apparently not just their own. The other day, some wankers tried to rob a couple of my fuel depots. My guys are repelling the attacks alright, but I'm not going to risk the goods because of some dumb celebration! You have to clearly show all those mercs that raising a hand on Skier during festivities is as dangerous as at any other time. And to make sure my message doesn't get confused with random casualties, take the appropriate outfit, something flashy.

objectives.text: Hand over 7 found in raid Christmas tree ornament (Red)
Hand over 5 found in raid Christmas tree ornament (Silver)
Hand over 3 found in raid Christmas tree ornament (Violet)

home-comfort.briefing: Hey there, come on in. Take a look at my place. Almost like it's missing something, right? It's missing coziness, friend. I want it to be like in the good old times - a New Year's tree, lights, ornaments, a table with food. Maybe you've found anything like that? No-no I don't mean salads and champagne. But maybe the tree ornaments? Oh, and happy holidays to you!
