File:HotdeliveryAvokadoMap.png|Placement location for the headsets and helmets File:Hot delivery comtac 6b47.png|Place the headsets and helmets here The body armors must be placed outside the mall, in a garbage pile next to the stage in front of the "ULTRA" store. Armor plates can be removed to reduce weight. File:HotdeliveryStageMap.png|Placement location for the armors File:Hot delivery Gzhel.png|Place the armors here
hot-delivery.briefing: Hey, I have a task for you. Not complicated, everything's gonna go smooth, don't worry. My business is quite dangerous, as you have probably understood already. You, friend, are a good fighter, that's why you can safely come to visit me whenever you want, but not all my clients can afford such luxury: one was already found in a pool of blood at the gas station, for example. It appears that many are being watched, motherfuckers know they have thick wads. So clients don't want to drop by in the open, attracting more undesired attention. But that doesn't really hinder the business: If people do not come for goods, goods come to people, ha-ha. Help a brother out, get the required items and stash them for proper folks to pick up on Interchange. They need two sets of helmets and headwear (6B47 and Peltor ComTac 2) stashed in a trash pile in the Avokado store - you've already been there, you know the place, and they also need two grey Gzhel body armors, stash them in the garbage heap near the stage on the outside, it's near the Ultra main entrance. I'll make it up to you, believe me.

objectives.text: Locate and mark the spare BTR wheels with an MS2000 Marker
(Optional) Complete the main objective as soon as possible

hot-wheels.guide: In this quest you have to find BTR wheels and mark them with a MS2000 Marker. The wheels can be found in the bigger of the two garage buildings at the repair center (white knight) on Reserve. Marking any truck wheels on Customs will cause failure of this quest. Despite the objective suggesting it, there is no time limit for this quest. File:HotWheelsMap.png|Location marked on map File:SurplusGoodsGarage.png|The garage File:HotWheelsLocation.png|The wheels in the garage
hot-wheels.briefing: So I went to the depot... Those assholes ruined the place and took my spare parts. I mean, I can understand tools or equipment. But why the fuck would someone take the fucking wheels? You're not gonna build a second BTR like that. Anyway, I need a spare wheel, and the sooner the better. You gotta find where the proper wheels could be laying around. I don't know where to look exactly, but you're not a moron, you'll figure it out. You can start with the customs area, but I haven't been there for ages, so I can't promise they'll be there.

objectives.text: Locate and mark the spare BTR wheels with an MS2000 Marker on Reserve

hot-wheels-let-s-try-again.guide: In this quest you have to find BTR wheels and mark them with a MS2000 Marker. The wheels can be found in the bigger of the two garage buildings at the repair center (white knight). File:HotWheelsMap.png|Location marked on map File:SurplusGoodsGarage.png|The garage File:HotWheelsLocation.png|The wheels in the garage
hot-wheels-let-s-try-again.briefing: We've already lost time, but if we wait any longer, the BTR's gonna stall. While you were screwing around, I did some digging and found out where we can get some proper wheels. Go to the reserve military base, the wheels we need are there. They come with rims attached, and they're a proper diameter for the BTR, too. Don't mess it up this time, the deadline's coming up.

objectives.text: Stash 12 Zulu Nylon Gear M4 RSCR chest rigs at the new gas station on Customs
Stash 12 class 4 ballistic plates on the roof of the specified repair workshop on Reserve

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for Labrys access keycard at Ragman LL1

hot-zone.guide: In this quest you have to stash 12 Zulu Nylon Gear M4 Reduced Signature Chest Rig (Ranger Green) in the new gas station on Customs and any 12 class 4 armor plates on the roof of the black knight repair workshop on Reserve. ===Customs Stashing location=== File:Hot Zone Customs Map.png|New gas station marked on map File:Hot Zone Customs Spot.png|Stashing location in the back left room ===Reserve Stashing location=== File:Hot Zone Reserve Map.png|Black knight repair workshop marked on map File:Hot Zone Reserve Spot.png|Stashing location on the roof
hot-zone.briefing: Okie-dokie, so I took some time to think about the Labyrinth and your interest in it. Things have cooled off, so I might be able to help you out. Maybe we can find some mutual benefits along the way, eh? But first, I need you to help me with a specific order. For the kind of information I'm about to give you, it's a real bargain! I've got two shipments that are sitting on hold right now. One is waiting at Customs, the other at the military base. My couriers were really badly received there. I lost one group, and from the second one, only half of them came back. The fuckers took almost all the goods! Things are too hot in those areas for my courier guys. The PMC pricks really took a liking to those places or something. It's either camping snipers, some ushanka-wearing psychos with shotguns, or fucking "grenadiers" in the military bunkers. Thing is, this order is big and important for me, I can't let it go to waste. You have good experience in this kind of work. Maybe not in one go, but I'm sure you'll do everything perfectly. And while you're at it, I'll arrange everything for your Labyrinth business! Here's the gear that survived the ambushes. Take it right away, it'll be less work later. Stash the rigs at the gas station near the road on Customs, and the plates on the roof of the military base's workshop with, uh, a black knight symbol, whatever that means.

house-arrest.guide: In this quest you first to find the place where the missing group was held captive. The wanted place is prison cell no. 1 on the third floor of the Chekannaya 15 apartment building on Streets of Tarkov. It can only be accessed via the western staircase. An Iron gate key is required to enter the cell. File:Chekannaya15Map.png|Apartment building marked on map File:Chekannaya15ApartmentBuilding.png|The apartment building with the entrance in the wall marked File:WesternStaircaseMap.png|Way to the western staircase marked on building map File:WesternStaircaseWay1.png|Way to the western staircase 1 File:WesternStaircaseWay2.png|Way to the western staircase 2 File:WesternStaircaseWay3.png|Way to the western staircase 3 File:Chekannaya15ApartmentBuildingWesternStairs.png|The western staircase File:HouseArrestCell1.png|Third floor hallway with cell no. 1 marked File:HouseArrestCell1Inside.png|The prison cell Next you have to find the debtor on Streets of Tarkov. He can be found in room 206 on the second floor of the northern Pinewood hotel building. The room does not require a key. File:PineWoodHotelNorthMap.png|Building marked on map File:PineWoodHotelNorthBuilding.png|Northern entrance File:HotelRoom206Door.png|Door to the room File:DeadDebtor.png|The debtor on the ground
house-arrest.briefing: Alright, my dear overseas employee. I've got a bit of a problem on my hands. Someone's been taking out my lads. Whole groups just disappearing. I started making some enquiries, and then I got a little note from Seva "Shket". Says he was being held in some kind of lockup, somewhere in the residential blocks. Back in the day, all sorts of businessmen used to stash their rivals there. Looks like someone else has taken over the place now. Shket was the only one from his group who managed to get out, but now he's keeping his head down and won't answer calls. Didn't even bother telling us where the rest of the boys are, the sniveling little rat. I took him in, gave him work, and the prick bailed the moment things got difficult. Find him and make him answer for everything he owes me. Oh, and find my lads while you're at it.

house-arrest-part-2.briefing: I made some background checks on the guy who runs the place. The warden's condo is in the same house. That's where he was supposed to take all the loot. You know, the payment for keeping people locked up. I'd be looking for a way into the apartment straight from the jail. So go check it out again. I'm guessing the motherfucker's still in there hiding. Okay, you know what to do with him. Anything you find in the crib is all yours. Deal?

humanitarian-supplies.briefing: Our team always works for the good of the people, or at least we try to make it look so. The Blue Helmets peacefully deliver relief supplies to our region, but sometimes, attacks happen on us as well. That’s what happened to two Ural trucks that were carrying UN-marked crates. We wouldn't be upset if not for the delicacy of the cargo, this time crates contained a little help not only for the people but also for the USEC company. You understand that we cannot allow casting a shadow on the United Nations' reputation. Find and wear UN uniform (UNTAR helmet, MF-UNTAR body armor) and teach local scum a lesson. Also, locate the spot where trucks were attacked, mark them with beacons, and bring me several MRE ration packs so I could present them as evidence, just in case. From the intelligence, one of those trucks has to somewhere in the Health Resort area, but there is no info about the other one. I think it's best to look somewhere near the port area, possibly at the construction site.

objectives.text: Locate and neutralize Shturman with a headshot from over 40 meters away while using an M700 sniper rifle with the specified scope

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Accuracy International AXMC .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle at Jaeger LL4

hunting-trip.guide: In this quest you have to kill Shturman from over 40 meters away with a headshot while using a Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle with a Burris FullField TAC30 1-4x24 30mm riflescope. To have the kill count for this quest, the Burris FullField TAC30 1-4x24 30mm riflescope just needs to be installed on the gun, and not necessarily be actively used. This means you can use a ring mount that supports backup sights, like the Recknagel Era-Tac 30mm ring scope mount, and use any compact reflex sight of your choice on top.
hunting-trip.briefing: Come on in. Want some tea? Well, whatever. So listen, here's the deal. Soon I will be hosting a few friends of mine. I want to go hunting with them, but there's just no way I can take them hunting with these MP shotguns, right? I have a couple of nice western rifles here, but I need them to be zeroed properly first. And we have just the client for that, his name is Shturman. So, test my build (Remington M700 sniper rifle with a FullField TAC30 1-4x24 scope) on this scum. Find a long-range position and make a precise shot to the head, so that the bastard wouldn't even have a chance. Don't worry, I won't disappoint you with the reward, kid.

hustle-2024.briefing: Come on in, kid. Heard the news yet? Looks like all manner of folk are paying social calls to that health resort now. Everybody wants a piece of action. The dimwits spooked them off of there. My hounds are telling me that they saw that group of misfits moving towards old reserve base. So now you gotta hurry there. Who knows when will this window of opportunity close.

Hand over 5 found in raid Labrys research notes

hypotheses-testing.guide: In this quest you have to find the prototype weapon area inside The Labyrinth and hand over 5 found in raid Labrys research notes. File:Labryrinth missile area map.png|Prototype weapon area marked on map
hypotheses-testing.briefing: I was able to decipher the signal. It's old and very faint, apparently the bunker completely blocked it until you opened the doors. For some reason, the message is on loop, but this doesn't mean anything, the equipment inside could have been damaged for a while. Besides, we still don't know what the TerraGroup team was doing in there. The message says that the facility still contains materials and data that fall under the first priority of evacuation. Moreover, it mentions reports of experiments conducted at the site. This is astonishing, we couldn't have found a better time to discover something as valuable as this! Knowing more and more people are finding out about these cellars every day, it means that soon the traders and other PMCs will want to explore the area we've discovered. Perhaps even Lightkeeper will be interested... I need those documents mentioned in the signal. Whatever you can find, please bring them to me as soon as you can.

objectives.text: Eliminate 2 enemies within 10 seconds 10 times

i-am-speed-part-1.briefing: I hate it when fighters just sit in corners like scared little rats. Long pauses are a disgusting, exhausting sight for the audience. Show me a slaughter! Speed! Adrenaline! Only speed will flush those rats out of their holes!

objectives.text: Capture 12 objectives within one match in CheckPoint mode

i-am-speed-part-2.briefing: When the game's all about holding objectives, every second counts. We've had a lot of fresh meat show up lately. Show them how to actually storm the objectives!

objectives.text: Eliminate 25 enemies within one match in CheckPoint, BlastGang, LastHero or TeamFight

i-am-speed-part-3.briefing: Admit it, there's nothing better than completely crushing an opponent, right? The easiest way to do it is by taking them out faster than they can even react. From what I've seen, you've learned to act fast, but let's make sure the result sticks.

i-need-more-power.briefing: What can you even expect when things have gotten this bad, kurwa!. Our local generators have failed. My men are experiencing interruptions with electricity and that is not acceptable. After all, time is money. But I am already working on it. Many people were conducting their operations in the Resort before us. Search for functional generators. Most likely, they are inside locked rooms on the second floor of both wings. Once you find them, simply report the room numbers to me, We also need fuel cans so the generators can keep running. That should be much easier.

ice-cream-cones.guide: The locked ZB-014 bunker on Woods mentioned by Prapor does not have a guaranteed or increased spawn chance for the wanted magazines. Obtaining them from weapon boxes, green wooden crates or bosses and their guards, for example Sanitar is usually way more reliable.
ice-cream-cones.briefing: Hey there, warrior. Still fighting? Good. There is this job, a cakewalk, really. Obviously, not of your caliber, it's gonna be a favor, so to say. I've received an order, they need some 60-rounders for 5.45 AKs. I know there definitely were some in bunkers near the sawmill, my guys stashed some goods there before. But they got driven out of there by those TerraGroup people, who then locked the bunkers with a key of some sort. Well, if you're going for the bunker, you'll need that key, I think it's hidden somewhere in dorms on Customs, people have seen some TerraGroup brass there a couple of times. Anyway, I don't care where you find them, but I need you to get them fresh and untouched by some traders. And hurry up, the order is urgent.

rewards.text: 2× U.S. Ordnance M60E6 7.62x51 light machine gun

if-i-can-t-have-it.briefing: The work Elektronik and I are doing is taking longer than expected, so I need your help once more. While I'm connected to the system, I'm receiving data from several sensors, and I can see the laboratory is crowded with lots of "visitors". The risks I warned you about haven't gone away. That's why I'm prepared to pay for the elimination of those who are stripping the laboratory of everything valuable without giving any thought to the danger they're creating.

If you leave the raid and have only found one of them, the quest will reset. You must extract in the same raid in which you found them. File:SignalPart1Guide.jpg|Locations marked on map File:Signal1.png|Antenna #1 on the roof of the health resort west wing File:Signal2.png|Antenna #2 at the weather station
ill-wisher.briefing: Yesterday, someone was banging at the closed door in the kitchen. Sounds weird, right? I absolutely understand that this was impossible, but there was a sort of irrational fear inside me. Like when you're afraid of monsters under the bed as a child. I think such fears grow stronger the farther away you are from civilization. When you're among others, as part of the society, even if you find a monster under the bed, you can tell someone about it. But when you're alone in the dark every day, it doesn't work that way. I'll tell you what that "monster" was next time since the irregularities didn't end with it. For example, someone's jamming my signal, presumably from the Shoreline territory. It's a hard trick to pull without powerful antennas. Try to look for satellite dishes, they most likely use something that looks similar. There should be at least two, about 400-450 meters away from each other.

illegal-logging.guide: All areas covered with trees count for the kills.
illegal-logging.briefing: You know what hasn't changed since the peace times? This whole Christmas mess. Everyone's stocking up on groceries like it's the last time. And even normal-looking people get the stupid idea of cutting down a live tree in the forest for their celebrations. These savages can't even tell the difference between a 200-year-old juniper and the weeds in their backyards. So they come into my woods at night in groups. I can't shoot them all by myself. I need help. You seem like an alright kid, and you're a good shot, too. Can you help me save this nature reserve?

objectives.text: Eliminate 30 enemies with headshots in any game mode

illusion-of-mercy.briefing: Good to see you, gladiator. I see you're still resisting. I've been trying to get you the very best battles. Bribing people to put some of the shittiest mercs against you. Proving something to people. And what do I get in return? What is this shit? You want to quit? To sleep in peace? It's not gonna work. Listen. I like you, and I see you're clearly a capable gunfighter. You want to have a moral high ground, so be it. All I can offer you is a little mercy. In the last few matches, a couple of big shots have been betting high on headshot kills. For you, it's quick mercy kills without suffering, and for me, it's a good opportunity to justify your involvement. And the cash, naturally.

objectives.text: Extract from the location with the "Unknown toxin" status effect

immunity-quest.guide: In this quest you have to extract from a raid while suffering from the 46px|Unknown toxin effect. The effect is inflicted by being stabbed with a Cultist knife, by either a Cultist or another player. Barbed wire in The Labyrinth also has a chance to inflict the effect upon contact. While being afflicted with the status effect, your health points will drain at a rate of 140/min. You can use a Propital injector to partially counteract the health drain for 5 minutes, or an ETG injector to fully nullify the damage for 60 seconds. It is highly recommended to bring multiple medkits.
immunity-quest.briefing: Well, you've proven you won't shoot indiscriminately. Recently, one of my men was poisoned on a mission and didn't even make it to the extraction point. We couldn't figure out what toxin caused his death. The guy went on a scouting trip to the white chalk circles. I need a more fresh sample and a tough employee who can survive the poisoning and make it back from the raid.

requirements: Must be level 35 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find 1 UHF RFID Fixed Reader in raid
Find 1 VPX Flash Storage Module in raid
Hand over 1 UHF RFID Fixed Reader to Mechanic
Hand over 1 VPX Flash Storage Module to Mechanic

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of 4.6x30mm FMJ SX at Mechanic LL4

import.briefing: I have recently stumbled upon some interesting devices... The first one appears to be some foreign storage device and the second one is apparently a reader of some sort. Extremely interesting pieces of tech, let me tell you. And most importantly, it’s the first time I’ve ever seen them. Maybe some kind of import broke through the blockade or somebody looted a secret warehouse. It's clearly not domestic production, so my money is on the latter. And hey, you'll need to find it yourself since it's high-quality equipment. You can't rely on resellers, they would fool you for sure. If you can bring them to me, I’ll make it worth your while.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 Scavs on Factory
Hand over 5 found in raid western Scav weapons with very low durability

import-control.guide: In this quest you need to kill 10 Scavs on Factory and hand over 5 western style Scav guns with found in raid status. Those are special weapons with very low durability (<15) that are modified and do not usually spawn on Scavs outside this event (and thus aren't listed on their equipment page). The western weapon's calibers are: * .300 Blackout * .338 Lapua Magnum * .357 Magnum * .45 ACP * 4.6x30mm HK * 5.45x39mm (Only SAG AK, SAG AK Short) * 5.56x45mm NATO (Besides ADAR 2-15, AK-101, AK-102) * 5.7x28mm FN * 6.8x51mm * 7.62x39mm (Only Mk47, RD-704) * 7.62x51mm NATO (Besides DVL-10, T-5000M, VPO-101) * 9x19mm Parabellum (Besides MP-443 Grach, PL-15, PP-19-01, Saiga-9, STM-9) * 12/70 (Only M3 Super 90, M590A1, M870) * 40x46mm
import-control.briefing: Hello, I'll bring you up to speed. Apparently Peacekeeper and comrade Prapor are trying to re-divide the weapon market. They're both dumping to win customers from each other. Rings a bell, doesn't it? History always repeats itself, and we are in yet another page of the book with this arms race... Well, whatever, no point in rambling now, plus this situation could prove beneficial to me. I was just about to restock my supply of imported weapons. I heard that even the Scavs at Polikhim have tuned western guns now! Can you get me some of those? I don't think anyone will mourn these bandits.

objectives.text: Hand over Aseptic bandages
Hand over Army bandages

important-patient.guide: In this quest you have to hand over as many bandages of each type as you can or want, till the community goal of 10.000.000 bandages is reached.
important-patient.briefing: It's not in my nature to be asking on behalf of others, but an acquaintance of mine desperately needs your help! She has a patient who is in critical condition and needs to be treated urgently. This person is extremely important to some... influential people. She has the medications she needs, but needs bandaging supplies. I would be very grateful if you could help!

objectives.text: Hand over 2 found in raid Radar station spare parts
Eliminate any 10 targets on any location with mortar strikes (Shoreline, Woods, Reserve, Customs)

in-and-out.guide: Radar station spare parts can be found inside special airdrop crates that get dropped at the beginning of the second mortar fire barrage on Shoreline, Woods, Reserve and Customs.
in-and-out.briefing: New mission, soldier. I want whatever it is that comes in those crates. According to the intel, there's valuable military equipment inside. Oh and yeah, don't forget to take out the competition to make sure they don't steal anything important. By the way, I got a package I thought you might need. It's a gift from a mutual friend of ours. Don't look at me like that, I'm talking about the four-eyes.

objectives.text: Locate and neutralize the "Minotaur" inside The Labyrinth
Eliminate 6 of "Minotaur's" guards inside The Labyrinth

indisputable-authority.guide: In this quest you to have to kill Shadow of Tagilla and 6 Scavs inside The Labyrinth. File:ShadowOfTagilla.png|Shadow of Tagilla
indisputable-authority.briefing: Oi, operator! There's a job for you, I don't want no tosser for this. Everyone's been checking out the dungeons under the resort, you ought to know about it by now. They say there's a bogeyman sitting there, safeguarding the whole territory, yelling like a madman and chasing everyone outta there. Nobody can put him down! Some partners of mine have started asking questions, trying to drive down prices because of this situation. But let me tell you this: the key to authority is not to fuck up the opportunity. We need to act now, and we need to do it in a way that every little prick knows his place. So we gotta take this fucker down. If you do it in my name, so to speak, everyone will understand. You've got the skills, so this "Minotaur" idiot won't be a problem for you. But still, better be careful, this bastard is no joke either.

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 Scavs on Woods
Use the transit from Woods to Reserve
Eliminate 5 Scavs on Reserve

inevitable-response.guide: ===Woods to Reserve=== Transits are only available 1 min after raid start. File:WoodsTransitToReserve.png File:WoodsTransitToReserve2.png
inevitable-response.briefing: Have you seen the new wheels? Actually, nevermind, before you fuck them up by looking at them or something. We've lost enough time, but there's a chance we can still find those half-assed engineers. I learned they came from the reserve base. If we don't hesitate, we can still catch up with them and punish them. Start in the forest and follow that path to the military base, we need to nail these assholes before they lay low.

objectives.text: Survive and extract from Woods through Bridge V-Ex
Survive and extract from Customs through Dorms V-Ex
Survive and extract from Interchange through Power Station V-Ex
Survive and extract from Streets of Tarkov through Primorsky Ave Taxi V-Ex
Survive and extract from Ground Zero through Police Cordon V-Ex
Locate and mark the first Patrol-A armored vehicle with an MS2000 Marker on Streets of Tarkov
Locate and mark the second Patrol-A armored vehicle with an MS2000 Marker on Streets of Tarkov

information-source.guide: In this quest you first have to extract via the car extractions on Woods, Customs, Interchange, Streets of Tarkov and Ground Zero with the "Survived" extraction status. Afterwards you have to find and mark 2 Patrol-A vehicles with MS2000 Markers on Streets of Tarkov. File:InformationSourceMap.png|Patrol-A locations marked on map File:InformationSourcePatrolA1.png|Patrol-A 1 File:InformationSourcePatrolA2.png|Patrol-A 2
information-source.briefing: Now, let's begin. I have heard rumors that a certain group of people have decided to stick their noses into my business. I, as you can imagine, am not satisfied with that kind of activity. Your job is to gather information from someone who's always hanging around mercenaries like you, and find out who these people are. You got to figure it out at all costs, okay? Talk to the car evac drivers, they certainly know about this kind of business. I'm sure they won't give you anything for just a hearty thanks, so you'll have to work hard. Understood? Go on, then.

requirements: Obtain level 1 loyalty with Skier

objectives.text: Install a WI-FI Camera to watch the sawmill dock on Woods
Install a WI-FI Camera to watch the Kiba Arms store entrance on Interchange

informed-means-armed.guide: Placing each camera requires you to be stationary for 20 seconds, so be sure to secure the area first. The first camera needs to be placed on top of a box in the "Brutal" store on Interchange. File:Kiba Arms store camera Interhange map.png|Map with "Brutal" store camera location File:informed means armed overlook.png|Box where the camera needs to be placed as seen from Kiba door File:informed means armed placement.png|Placement, looking out on Kiba The second camera needs to be placed in a pile of wooden planks next to the sawmill pier on Woods. File:Pier camera Woods map.png|Map with pier camera location File:Pier.png|Pile of wooden planks next to the pier where the camera needs to be placed
informed-means-armed.briefing: Oh, Hey! Come here, lemme tell you something. Seems live I've settled into the region pretty well but I still can't shake this feeling you know? No confidence about what tomorrow's gonna bring. Ah forget it. Getting all gloomy for no reason... Anyway, I'd like to have a decent picture of what's going on around here. Makes things a lot safer. I've got a couple of sketchy spots in mind where we should stick some smart cameras. Need you to watch two locations: put one camera near the pier by the sawmill in the woods. Place it right on the boards along the slope. Then set up the second one across from the entrance to Kiba. That's the shop in Ultra. You can probably get the cameras from Mechanic, I heard he was dealing them.

requirements: Must be level 12 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Reach Loyalty Level 3 with Prapor

insider.briefing: I don't like to pretend, although we all do. Sometimes in order to survive, and sometimes because we’re just afraid. You know, I'm not exactly much of a talker, especially with strangers, but you seem like a nice guy. If you managed to earn my trust, I think you'll come to terms with just about anyone. After all, only personal relationships will help us survive now. Speaking with Pavel Yegorovich, if he trusts you, perhaps I will be able to set up the supply of gunpowder.

objectives.text: Eliminate 40 targets in the time period of 21:00-06:00 on Streets of Tarkov, Lighthouse, Reserve, Ground Zero or Shoreline

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of CENS ProFlex DX5 tactical earplug at Peacekeeper LL4
Unlocks barter for SAPI level III+ ballistic plate at Peacekeeper LL4

insomnia.briefing: Good day to you, mercenary. Very soon I will have a night-time meeting on a very important matter. Unfortunately, according to my intelligence in the region, the number of night sorties of your, uh, colleagues has noticeably increased. I feel that these are the same people who do not risk operating in the daytime. I want you to deal with them. These criminals cannot disrupt my work.

requirements: Must be level 45 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 40 Scavs with headshots

rewards.text: Unlocks craft for 7.62x39mm BP gzh at Workbench level 3

intimidator.briefing: Greetings. There's quite a noticeable increase in the number of Scavs, have you noticed? Noticeable so much that my couriers can't even get through the previously safe areas, all get clapped indiscriminately can't even make a deal with them. We need to teach those bastards a lesson so that they piss their pants with any sound of gunshots in a kilometer radius. Shoot as many of those idiots as you can, and so that they know what's going on, get them in a manner they'll realize everything clearly. The shots all have to be in the head, I'll send some info on my channels so that people know who exactly sends the message.

objectives.text: Visit an active mortar strike area on any specified location (Shoreline, Woods, Reserve, Customs)

into-the-inferno.guide: In this quest you have to go into the area of an active mortar strike. Mortar strikes can appear on the following locations: ====Shoreline==== File:ShorelineMortarStrikeLocation.jpg|Mortar strike areas marked on map ====Woods==== File:WoodsMortarStrikeLocation.png|Mortar strike areas marked on map ====Reserve==== File:ReserveMortarStrikeLocation.png|Mortar strike areas marked on map ====Customs==== File:CustomsMortarStrikeLocation.png|Mortar strike areas marked on map
into-the-inferno.briefing: The soldier of fortune has come for his new task! Rumors have it that Tarkov has become even more dangerous. Who would've thought, right? Someone's started targeting certain areas with mortar fire. You better go and see what's going on. And yes, this means going right into the middle of those mortar strike areas. Yup. Alright, so we've noticed the bombardments in the nature reserve, the military base, the customs office, and the coast line. Off you go then.

requirements: Must be level 2 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find Jaeger's camp at the specified spot on Woods
Obtain Jaeger's encrypted message
Hand over the message to Mechanic

introduction.guide: In this quest you have to find Jaeger's encrypted message on Woods. The message is located under a hunting stand which is located in the eastern part of the location, near the crashed plane. Once you have obtained the message, you must extract from the location and hand it over to Mechanic. File:Hunting Stand map.jpg|Crashed plane and hunting stand marked on map File:The Location of the Hunting Camp.png|Location of the hunting stand, view from the front of the crashed plane File:JaegersHuntingStand.png|The hunting stand File:The message benath the Hunting Stand.png|Message beneath the hunting stand
introduction.briefing: Mercenary, come here, I've been waiting for you. Just a couple of hours ago, my old friend Jaeger got in touch with me and informed me that he had quite useful information for me. The package with the information I need is encrypted and is located in the Priozersk Natural Reserve area. Where exactly - Jaeger did not specify, but he left a clue: “Look where the hunter would wait for his prey. Where the iron bird has fallen”. Bring me this package and I'll introduce you to Jaeger, he'll definitely have work for you.

objectives.text: Obtain the Goshan cargo manifests on Interchange
Hand over the Goshan cargo manifests to Ragman
Obtain the OLI cargo manifests on Interchange
Hand over the OLI cargo manifests to Ragman
Obtain the IDEA cargo manifests on Interchange
Hand over the IDEA cargo manifests to Ragman

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for NFM THOR Concealable Reinforced Vest body armor at Ragman LL2

inventory-files.guide: If retrieving the manifests on different raids, make sure to turn them in before entering another raid, as death will empty your quest inventory. ===IDEA Manifest=== Head to the entrance of the IDEA office, on the left immediately after the main entrance. Once in there, look for a document on one of the center desks, perpendicular to the wall. File:Interchange Database part 1 Guide.png|Locations marked on map File:IDEA Manifest 1 Outside.png|View of the entrance to the IDEA office, under the main entrance File:IDEA Manifest 2 inside.png|The computer room where the manifest is located File:Database Part 1 Guide (3).png|The IDEA manifest is on a desk, in the IDEA computer room ===Goshan Manifest=== Head to the small corridor north of Goshan (left, if entering the store from the front where the cash registers are). There, find the computer room and look for the manifest on the desk. File:Interchange Database part 1 Guide.png|Locations marked on map File:Database Part 1 Guide (2).png|The Goshan manifest is on a desk, in the north Goshan computer room ===OLI Manifest=== Turn right after entering Oli via the main entrance. Go to the back of the store and look for a cube-shaped desk. The desk is marked by a sign over it, the manifest will be laying on the desk. File:Interchange Database part 1 Guide.png|Locations marked on map File:Oli Manifest2.png|Top of the escalator after the main entrance to the OLI store File:Oli Manifest1.png|View inside of the OLI store, where the cube-shaped desk is located File:Database Part 1 Guide (1).png|The OLI manifest is on a desk, in the information booth on the west part of the OLI
inventory-files.briefing: Oh, hey there, brother, I’ve got a nice idea: just imagine how fucking awesome it would be to have info on Ultra’s cargos. What was being shipped, where, and in what amount, you know. I used to work with records like these myself. Don't think there are any manifests for the small shops, plus they most likely were run by slackers, but the larger stores and retail chains definitely kept their records. Check out Goshan and other supermarkets, like Oli and IDEA, the docs must be somewhere in the offices. it would be mighty cool if you found some.

objectives.text: Obtain 10 M67 grenades
Hand over 10 grenades to Prapor

ironclad-proof.guide: M67 hand grenades can be bought from Peacekeeper LL3 after completing his task Your Car Needs a Service. Alternatively they can be bartered from Peacekeeper LL2 for 1 Zibbo lighter per grenade.
ironclad-proof.briefing: That last chemical deal damaged my trust in you. I'm not the type to hold grudges, but that trick you pulled was very dirty, and I don't like dirty tricks. If you want to straighten things up with me and regain my trust - do one favor for me. The customer who expected these chemicals was left in a tight spot, and on top of that, I haven't even delivered the grenades from the previous order yet. The grenades he needs are foreign-made, the green round ones, and I don't have anything like that. Get me some of these - and we'll call it even as if nothing happened.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the lost weapon crate on Interchange
Hand over the retrieved cargo

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of MPS Auto Assault-12 Gen 1 12ga automatic shotgun at Skier LL4

irresistible.guide: The lost weapon crate can be found inside a red container at the container lot in the southwest of the mall on Interchange. Activated power station power and Object #21WS keycard required. File:21WSMap.png|Container location marked on map File:21ws outside.jpg|The red container File:IrresistibleQuestStolenCase.png|The lost crate
irresistible.briefing: I got word from my buddy that there's a special merchandise in town. You like movies? Then you'll certainly recognize this gun! There's only one little issue. The cargo went missing near the Ultra mall, I think somebody snatched it up. But man do I need these shotguns. It's a damn exclusive, you know what I'm saying? Anyway, why don't you take a little trip to Ultra and find this weapon crate there? If you get it, I'll pay you real good.

requirements: Must be level 25 to start this quest.
Scav karma of at least +1

is-this-a-reference.briefing: Hello, merc. Do you ever find yourself thinking that certain places in Tarkov look suspiciously similar to something you've already seen before? One of my outside contacts has proven to be an avid admirer of such coincidences. Well, now I need someone to set up surveillance on these listed locations. Oh, one more thing. The client asked me to tell whoever takes the job to do this with "maximum effort" and something about "207 bones in the human body", whatever that means. Looks like this comedian is bored out of his mind and doesn't know what to do with himself.

objectives.text: Eliminate 20 enemies as Assault
Eliminate 20 enemies as Enforcer
Eliminate 20 enemies as Scout
Eliminate 20 enemies as Marksman

rewards.text: Unlocks RSh-12 12.7x55 revolver in the Armory
Unlocks the Arena item transfer service on Ref for seasonal characters

jack-of-all-trades.briefing: We've already gone through the classes on my Arena, and I realized I never actually tested you on that knowledge. Forgot, you see? So come on, show me what you've learned. And don't you think this is pointless. This isn't freshman philosophy class! Anyone who can't switch tactics quickly over a few fights when needed will die. Or even worse, lose money.

objectives.text: Win a round as Assault in BlastGang or TeamFight mode
Win a round as Enforcer in BlastGang or TeamFight mode
Win a round as Scout in BlastGang or TeamFight mode
Win a round as Marksman in BlastGang or TeamFight mode

jack-of-all-trades-pro.briefing: So, how are things going with the classes in the Arena? Yeah, I remember you already reported in, but the conditions back then were easier. Now I want to see how much you've grown since then. Put on a show on the main stage!

requirements: Must be level 25 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 PMCs with AK-12 with the proprietary suppressor and PS-320 scope on Lighthouse, Customs, or Reserve

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Kalashnikov AK-308 7.62x51 assault rifle at Prapor LL4
Unlocks purchase of AK-308 7.62x51 QD sound suppressor at Prapor LL4

job-for-a-patriot.guide: Only the AK-12 5.45x39 sound suppressor can be used. It's possible to use a compact reflex sight mounted on a canted rail instead of the Valday PS-320 1/6x scope to obtain the kills. The scope just needs to be installed to count towards the quest.
job-for-a-patriot.briefing: No shortage of patriots... I had a conversation with a group of BEARs the other day, we chatted about domestic weapons. Anyway, a new AK has arrived in stock, I need to test it somewhere... Mixed-use developments would be perfect. Alrighty, here's your build, go operate!

objectives.text: Eliminate 50 enemies while playing as Assault or Enforcer in any game mode
Eliminate 50 enemies while playing as Scout or Marksman in any game mode

job-that-kills.briefing: I don't know what the hell to do with your sniveling. You need to grab fate by the balls and get things done. Listen. Maybe you don't feel right because you're doing something that doesn't work for you. Arena can offer many things. You can be whoever it's easier for you to be. Everyone has a role to play. So what is yours?

objectives.text: Stash a Cultist knife in the first special place inside The Labyrinth
Stash a Cultist knife in the second special place inside The Labyrinth
Stash a Cultist knife in the third special place inside The Labyrinth

rewards.text: 1× S I C C organizational pouch

keeper-s-word.guide: In this quest you have to stash 3 Cultist knives in 3 specified locations inside The Labyrinth. One of the locations requires the Corpse room key. File:Keepers Word map.png|Stashing locations marked on map File:Keepers Word location 1.png|Location 1 at the Minotaur shrine. File:Keepers Word location 2.png|Location 2 at the Minotaur shrine. File:Keepers Word location 3.png|Location 3 in the corpse room. Corpse room key required.
keeper-s-word.briefing: I have a new job for you. Someone found a way into the cellars under the health resort. This is not a good set of circumstances for Tarkov. Excessive curiosity often ruins a man in peacetime, but in the present situation, the mistake of one will lead to the death of many. I know how to safeguard the bunker. You may not have yet met the wardens who watch the city at night. But they certainly have met you. And now I need you to leave a short message for them at the Knossos facility, with their instruments. However, just dropping these knives in the rubble won't be enough. You need places with meaning, so that the knife you stick in becomes a symbol of sorts. Which places should you choose? You'll figure it out on your own. And if you can't, why should I even work with you?

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the decommissioned stimulants on Lighthouse or The Lab
Hand over the stimulants

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for eTG-change regenerative stimulant injector at Therapist LL1
Unlocks barter for Meldonin injector at Therapist LL1
Unlocks barter for SJ6 TGLabs combat stimulant injector at Therapist LL1

key-component.guide: In this quest you have to find a case with decommissioned stimulants on Lighthouse or The Lab. You must get the case on either location and hand it over to Therapist. ====Lighthouse Water treatment plant location==== Underneath a metal shelf inside the western electrical operation shack. File:GAWShackMap.png|Shack marked on map File:GAWShack1.png|The shack File:KeyComponentLighthouseCase.png|The case ====The Lab location==== Next to the door of the laboratory block (G22) on the second floor. File:KeyComponentLabsMap.png|Location marked on map File:KeyComponentLabsCase.png|Location of the case between a wooden crate and the wall File:KeyComponentLabsCaseClose.png|The case
key-component.briefing: I've reviewed the documents you've collected. Sanitar sends his men to every medical facility in Tarkov looking for certain components. But some of the substances are now only found in combat drugs. During our brief time working together, Sanitar mentioned that he had once intentionally written off a batch of these stimulants when he worked for TerraGroup. There are two places where this shipment could be now: the Laboratory or the Lighthouse, near the water treatment plant. The USEC Rogues could have taken the drugs to the second location if they found them first. I think you already realize how necessary these components are at this time. We need to finalize the cure as soon as possible. Procure me a shipment of these combat drugs.

requirements: Unlocks 6 hours after completion of Hindsight 20/20

objectives.text: Sell any 75 items to Peacekeeper

key-partner.guide: In this quest you have to sell any 75 items to Peacekeeper, with the exception of ammunition. The sales amount display may not always update immediately. A game restart forces a refresh.
key-partner.briefing: So a birdie told me the driver is determined and is looking for a new employer. I doubt the idiot realizes all the consequences of such a transition. In any case, I never even gave him that option anyway! The only lead I've confirmed now is about Peacekeeper. You should go to him and remind him that we have common interests with him! Make him remember who his key partner is.

objectives.text: Locate the emergency access code in The Lab
Check if the emergency access code works

key-to-every-door.guide: In this quest you have to visit the system admin's office to obtain the emergency access code and visit any keypad in The Lab. ===Locate the emergency access code=== The emergency access code can be found in the system admin's office in The Lab. File:System admin's office Location.png|Office marked on a map File:System admin's office Board.png|A whiteboard with the emergency code ===Check if the emergency access code works=== Visit any keycard keypad in The Lab.
key-to-every-door.briefing: Time to find out if that bloke we squeezed was telling the truth. You wouldn't believe the strings I had to pull to get hold of that little informant… While the lab's still running on emergency power, I need you to find that emergency access code and make sure it actually works. I don't have blueprints for the place, but I've heard one of your lot's been in there before. You'll find your way around, yeah? If I were you, I'd start with the admin office. Somewhere near security, the power systems, or the main server room. Bet it's locked behind some fancy key. Right now, the important bit is finding that code and trying it on any door that's normally locked with a keycard. Got it?

requirements: This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the souvenir key to the city on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the found item

key-to-the-city.guide: In this quest you have to find the Tarkov City souvenir key in the museum on Streets of Tarkov. There are multiple spawns throughout the building. File:StreetsOfTarkovMapCPSUPart2MarkedOnMap.png|Building marked on the map File:CPSUPart2Outside.png|The museum building ===First floor=== File:TarkovCitySouvenirKeyAllDisplayCases.png|First floor key locations marked File:TarkovCitySouvenirKeyDisplayCase1.png|1: In a display case, against the inner front edge File:TarkovCitySouvenirKeyBehindBook.png|2: In a display case, behind an angled display stand File:TarkovCitySouvenirKeyExhibit.png|3: In a display case, in the inner left corner File:TarkovCitySouvenirKeyDisplayCase4.png|4: In a display case, under a book ===Second floor=== File:CPSUPart2Inside.png|Way to the stairs File:TarkovCitySouvenirKeyShelf.png|On the lowboard in the hallway File:TarkovCitySouvenirKeyTable.png|On the desk in the room with the kitchen File:TarkovCitySouvenirKeyBookShelf.png|In the middle compartment of the bedroom bookshelf
key-to-the-city.briefing: How's it going, brother? I heard the city's stirring up, collecting souvenirs, reminiscing over old times. And I just got a lead on something like this. They keep these things in museums. In the old days, each city had its own key, which the governor received at the time of establishment. I even saw one on a tour when I was a kid! They don't do that anymore, but Tarkov does have its own key, apparently! When the city was laid out, they made one for historical reference. And I know where to find it! If you bring it back, we'll make a fortune.

requirements: Unlocks 24 hours after completion of Assessment - Part 3

key-to-the-tower.briefing: I have good news and bad news, which one should I start with? I'll start with the good news! We've proved our potential. Lightkeeper is pleased with us, and wants to meet you in person... Yes, you specifically. The bad news is you can't get to him that easily, the place is rigged with land mines. Plus, a sniper shoots everyone who comes near the lighthouse. We must somehow let them know that it's you, among all the other PMCs that are sniffing around there. So we'll put together a transponder for you. He will pick up the signal, give a sign to the sniper, and disable the mines. The path will be safe. I've already written down what materials I need to assemble it. Finding the transmitter box won't be easy, but I think you could try looking somewhere where the USECs settled down.

requirements: Must be level 20 to start this quest.
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the Black Division encryption keys
Hand over the found item

key-to-understanding.guide: In this quest you have to find a document that only spawn on Black Division. They are not guaranteed to have one.
key-to-understanding.briefing: I'm sure you've already heard about the new player in Tarkov's little conflict. I wouldn't offer this kind of job to just anyone, but this unit has my attention, and I want information straight from the source. That's where you come in. So far, my people haven't managed to intercept any of these fighters. It's as if they're always in the stronger position, and you can never catch them off guard... Which means the risks for you will be higher than usual. But I want to know more about their objectives and their plans, and unlike Prapor, there's no one who can tell me to back off. The first thing we need is to listen in on their communications. For that, I need fresh encryption keys the squad leaders carry on them. Think you can get them?

objectives.text: Reach Interchange in the Khorovod mode

khorovod.guide: The Khorovod mode can be accessed in the top right corner of map-selection screen. A Khorovod armband must be equipped to enter a raid. To complete this quest, you need to refuel the generators that power the Christmas trees on Shoreline, Lighthouse, Reserve, Woods and Customs with Special 40-degree fuel and afterwards transit to Interchange in one life. When you refueled a generator, a 5 minute timer begins and you need to defend it against Scavs. The generator may break down, requiring to be repaired. A Leatherman Multitool will speed up the repair, but it is not required. It's going to happen several times during the 5 minutes. When the timer is over, use the transit to the next map and repeat till you reach Interchange. The generator on Interchange does not need to be refueled to complete the quest. You will have to use transits in this order: Shoreline > Lighthouse > Reserve > Woods > Customs > Interchange. ===Tree locations=== File:HIPSShoreline.png|Shoreline: In front of the health resort west wing. File:HIPSLighthouse.png|Lighthouse: At the convenience store next to the bridge to the water treatment plant. File:HIPSReserve.png|Reserve: At the barracks parade ground, next to the helicopter. File:HIPSWoods.png|Woods: At the sawmill. File:HIPSCustoms.png|Customs: At the "Sniper Roadblock" Scav extraction near the main crossroad. ===Transit locations=== ====Shoreline to Lighthouse==== In front of the Path to Lighthouse extraction. File:ShorelineTransitToLighthouseMap.png File:Path to Lighthouse.png ====Lighthouse to Reserve==== On the road leading to the Road to Military Base V-Ex extraction. File:LighthouseTransitToReserveMap.png File:LighthouseTransitToReserve.png ====Reserve to Woods==== At the map border northwest of the train yard. File:ReserveTransitToWoodsMap.png File:ReserveTransitToWoods.png ====Woods to Customs==== Near the RUAF Gate extraction. File:WoodsTransitToCustomsMap.png File:WoodsTransitToCustoms.png ====Customs to Interchange==== Next to the Trailer Park extraction, inside the bus. File:CustomsTransitToInterchangeMap.png File:CustomsTransitToInterchange.png
khorovod.briefing: So the officers and I couldn't resist and we've already started celebrating... We haven't touched the salad yet, and we'll still get more booze, so don't worry. We talked about the fighting spirit, so we've come up with something you'll like! Anyway, we want the whole city to have a party. Then even loners like you will think of home, even if it's just for a second. Our guys have already found the good big trees and dressed them up properly. We don't have enough fuel to keep them lit permanently, but we can still light them up all over the city for some time! Here's the plan: you take the fuel canisters, get to the holiday tree and turn on the generator. But regular gasoline won't do, you need special, industrial fuel. The tree lights up, but you have to hold it up for everyone to see. Obviously, this will attract all sorts of scum, but you're not going empty-handed. We can't surrender the trees to the bandits, you'll be the first and last line of defense. Once you're done, go straight to the next one. We've prepared the trees wherever we could. It all has to be done at once, it's the only way to have the desired effect. I'll find someone else to help you. I've dug up some special armbands so you don't shoot each other. Put them on and don't shoot the people wearing them as well.

requirements: Unlocks 6 hours after completion of Key Partner

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the package with RPG ammo on Woods
Hand over the package

killer-argument.guide: In this quest you have to pick up Lightkeeper's case from the Scav house on Woods. There are multiple spawns. The house can be found near the "Outskirts" extraction in the southwest of the location. File:Simple Side Job Woods Map.png|Scav house location marked on map File:Scav House.png|The Scav house File:Killer Argument Spawn 1.png|Spawn 1 inside the house File:Killer Argument Spawn 2.png|Spawn 2 next to the Utyos machine gun at the house File:Killer Argument Spawn 3.png|Spawn 3 at the fallen over table next to the street along the house File:Killer Argument Spawn 4.png|Spawn 4 at the circular fortification east of the house File:Killer Argument Spawn 5.png|Spawn 5 under a metal barricade next to the street along the house
killer-argument.briefing: Have you already heard that the driver has poached some of the traders over to his side? This kid's gotten a little far from his nest, so it's time to end it. I've made a deal with a certain someone to share some RPG ammo, enough to penetrate his BTR's armor. Now I need someone to deliver the package from the Scav house in Priozersk. Nobody knows about the delivery yet, so it should go smoothly. You gotta work fast, so that the driver doesn't find out what I'm preparing for him.

objectives.text: Hand over Secure Folder 0052 to Skier

kind-of-sabotage.guide: The documents are located at the lumber camp on Woods, under a bed in the wooden cabin #3. File:SupplyPlansMap.png|Map with cabin location marked File:Cabins in the lumber yard.png|The cabins inside the lumber yard File:Docs 0052 Location.png|The docs under the bed of cabin #3
kind-of-sabotage.briefing: A little bird told me that you want to find some folder and pass it on to the medic girl. We have a business here, and I have my own interest in disrupting her operations, you know. A kind of sabotage, eh? Come on, bring this folder to me, and I’ll treat you right, send some proper cash your way, and there will be more trust for you. The hell do I need it for? Don’t play dumb, take a guess. I’m opening branches here, building up the operation, and quality grub from those who’ve been preparing for all this crap in advance will sell like hotcakes through my channels. But I’m rambling, come on, go on your way, I'll be here packing your cash. Oh, and don't you be gullible to think that this woman is doing all this shit for the good of the people, I'm familiar with her business.

requirements: Must be level 22 to start this quest.
Obtain level 2 loyalty with Prapor

objectives.text: Eliminate 8 snipers on the rooftops on Streets of Tarkov

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of SV-98 7.62x54R bolt-action sniper rifle at Prapor LL2

kings-of-the-rooftops.guide: In this quest you have to kill 8 sniper Scavs on Streets of Tarkov. File:KoRSniperMap.png|Sniper Scav locations marked on the map
kings-of-the-rooftops.briefing: Oh, howdy. Help an old soldier out, will you? Those damn snipers are shooting my couriers like rabbits in an open field. Sitting on the rooftops and blasting non-stop. Take them out and I'll make it worth your while.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 enemies while using a melee

knivesout-part-1.briefing: Hey, Gladiator! You showed up at just the right time. One of my most valuable cleanup fighters seems to have fallen into some kind of depression. Says everyone's running around shooting, but real, proper gladiators fought in honest hand-to-hand combat! And I thought, you know what? In his own way, he's right! He's a valuable fighter, so we need to cheer him up. Why don't you join our new show?

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 enemies on the objective while using a melee

knivesout-part-2.briefing: So, tempted by a tougher challenge, huh? That's the right attitude. Only people like that make it around here. A real bloody massacre is great and all... but something's missing. We need a whole crowd—and all in one place! Ah, just imagining it... Come on, fighter, don't let me down!

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 enemies with a headshot while using a melee

knivesout-part-3.briefing: Gladiator! We pulled our comrade out of his gloom, but on the Arena, you either do things magnificently or not at all. And since we've already started, let's make it perfect! There's only one thing missing from this whole celebration—smashed skulls! If you hit someone in the head hard enough, the spray will be spectacular! Got the assignment? Then good luck!

objectives.text: Check if the radio transmitter works near the Lighthouse peninsula
Survive and extract from the location

knock-knock.guide: In this quest you have to check if the transponder that Mechanic gave you, works. To do that, put the transponder in a special item slot and walk up to the start of the bridge that leads to the lighthouse peninsula on Lighthouse. It is not required to go beyond the gate where Claymores are scattered. File:KnockKnockMap.png|Bridge marked on the map
knock-knock.briefing: I solemnly present you with an assembled transponder! By the way, did you hear how Peacekeeper tried contacting with Lightkeeper? He's been pushing for a meeting for months, and he's still getting turned away. He even paid someone for a pass, but got a worthless piece of paper, though I don't know if it's true or not. But you were personally invited to the Lighthouse! How cool is that? Sic itur ad astra. So say hello to Lightkeeper for me. And good luck to you.

requirements: Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

objectives.text: Hand over 5 any Black Division plate carriers

know-your-enemy.briefing: Finally some good fucking news! Those assholes showed up on a couple of cameras in the city. Whole squad dressed in black, gear's definitely not Russian, but it doesn't look like USEC equipment either. That means someone got them across the border, and they sure as hell didn't come here with friendly intentions. We need to push back before they cut off all our routes. Can you bring me some of their gear? I've got a buddy who knows his way around this kind of stuff. Maybe he'll be able to tell us who we're about to go to war with. I'll need their body armor or rigs.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 5 targets on Streets of Tarkov (In one raid)
Use the transit from Streets of Tarkov to Interchange (In one raid)
Eliminate any 5 targets on Interchange (In one raid)

know-your-place.guide: ===Streets of Tarkov to Interchange=== Southwest of the Concordia apartment complex. Transits are only available 1 min after raid start. File:StreetsTransitToInterchangeMap.png File:StreetsTransitToInterchange.png
know-your-place.briefing: Came here just when I needed you! I found a new delivery route across the city. Well, not exactly found it, per se. Someone moved a package from the city center to Ultra twice as fast as usual. These guys must have found a veteran guide who's been here before all the electronics were shut down... Maybe even someone like this crazy guerilla mushroom guy, you heard of him? He'd show up out of nowhere, even been taken captive. But he always found a way to get out and lose his pursuers. Either way, we need to take control of the route. Find the place where those smugglers emerge from, and show everyone that this is now Ragman's route! So yeah, go ahead and scare everyone off in the city and near Ultra.

objectives.text: Stash a TP-200 TNT brick at the first spot from Skier's route
Stash a TP-200 TNT brick at the second spot from Skier's route
Stash a TP-200 TNT brick at the third spot from Skier's route
Stash a TP-200 TNT brick at the fourth spot from Skier's route

knuckle-sandwich.guide: In this quest you have to plant 4 TP-200 TNT bricks at Skier's route and kill any 15 targets while wearing a Ushanka ear flap hat on Woods. File:Come by the Fire Map.png|Stashing locations marked on map File:Come by the Fire Location 1.png|Location #1 in the big tent inside the Scav base/EMERCOM camp File:Come by the Fire Location 2.png|Location #2 in the ZB-016 bunker File:Come by the Fire Location 3.png|Location #3 in the house with the antenna at the old sawmill File:Come by the Fire Location 4.png|Location #4 in one of the houses at the northeastern village
knuckle-sandwich.briefing: Good timing, soldier! We’re still short on manpower, so I’ve got a combat task for you. Skier’s either got mixed up or gone completely off the rails. Right under my nose he’s moving weapon shipments like they’re freight trains! That needs correcting, and his shiny new route needs to be sabotaged. In weather like this there’s no way they’re moving cargo in one clean run. That means there are one or more spots along the way where those bastards stop to rest and warm up. Find those places and leave one of my TNT presents there. And if you run into anyone on the route, pull the trigger. No need to sort things out politely with those pricks.

kolotun.guide: In this quest you have to extract from the listed locations while being under the 46px|Frostbite effect. The objectives can not be completed by using transits. The effect is caused by being exposed to snow. It can be avoided in shelters, near firebarrels, by drinking moonshine or by wearing one of the following items: * Beanie * Bomber beanie * Ded Moroz hat * Domontovich ushanka hat * Extreme cold weather face mask * Jack Pyke Hunting LLCS boonie hat * Kotton beanie * New Year ushanka hat * Pompon hat * Santa hat * Ski hat with holes for eyes * SSh-68 steel helmet (Olive Drab) * Tactical fleece beanie (Tan) * Ushanka ear flap hat * UX PRO beanie While the effect is active, the following debuffs apply: * Causes Hands tremor effect * Decreases Endurance (-5) * Decreases energy recovery (-0.1/s) * Decreases hydration recovery (-0.1/s) * Decreases maximum stamina (-20) * Decreases stamina recovery rate (-1/s) * Lowers body temperature (-0.1 °C/s) (minimum 28 °C) * Deals damage over time to limbs and head till they reach 1 HP
kolotun.briefing: Didn't expect you'd make it out to me in weather like this. Even the animals stay in their burrows now. The ones whose hunger drives them outside tear their paws on the crusted snow first, then die from the cold. They can't adapt to freezes like this. A human can though. Not everyone, but some can. If you don't want to get frostbite in the middle of an important task, you need to think ahead. Plan how you'll survive. Prepare your body. Walk the routes you know. Test your limits. And always have a way to warm yourself if you're left without shelter or a source of heat.

Locate and obtain the second game disk on Reserve
Hand over the found item

last-spurt-pioneer.guide: In this quest you have to hand over disk drive 1, and obtain the disk with release version on Reserve. There are multiple spawns throughout the location. ====First spawn - Radar station guard building==== File:Last Spurt - Pioneer Radar Station Map.png|Guard building location marked on map File:Last Spurt - Pioneer Radar Station Building.png|The wanted guard building File:Last Spurt - Pioneer Radar Station Spawn.png|Disk on the shelf ====Second spawn - Parade ground helicopter==== File:Last Spurt - Pioneer Helicopter Map.png|Helicopter location marked on map File:Last Spurt - Pioneer Helicopter.png|The wanted helicopter File:Last Spurt - Pioneer Helicopter Spawn.png|Disk on a folding seat next to the cockpit door ====Third spawn - Northern barracks second floor room==== File:Last Spurt - Pioneer Northern Barracks Map.png|Barracks and room location marked on map File:Last Spurt - Pioneer Northern Barracks.png|The wanted barracks File:Last Spurt - Pioneer Northern Barracks Room.png|The wanted room File:Last Spurt - Pioneer Northern Barracks Spawn.png|Disk on the chair ====Fourth spawn - Eastern barracks second floor main room shelf==== File:Last Spurt - Pioneer Eastern Barracks Map.png|Barracks and shelf location marked on map File:Last Spurt - Pioneer Eastern Barracks.png|The wanted barracks File:Last Spurt - Pioneer Eastern Barracks Spawn.png|Disk on the shelf next to the green wooden crates
last-spurt-pioneer.briefing: Fence and those behind him don't want anyone to know about it? Seems like many things are becoming clear. Now I understand why my friend wanted these things out in the open. Too bad he couldn't make it in time. You want to keep going? Another disk? It might be somewhere in Tarkov, but I don't know where. I've already given you all the information I can. Go to the reserve base again, maybe you'll find the disk there. Or maybe you won't. If you do, bring it to me, I'll copy it and distribute it. Let their plans go to hell.

objectives.text: Eliminate 150 enemies in Last Hero mode

lay-low.briefing: Alright, listen up. I've been hearing some bad rumors. Some of the top brass aren't happy with your progress. Obviously it's not your problem. You did your job and you did it well. But those who bet on their own champions lost a lot of money. It's fairly simple. They're targeting you, and they want to put their people on your team. So for now, you're gonna have to keep your head down and play in the free for all matches. Give me some time to figure out who I can trust, and keep doing what you do best — kill everyone.

letters.briefing: Come on in, friend! I've got a request for you. One of my acquaintances put himself into a really complicated situation - Sanitar is looking for him with his death squad. I wouldn't want to lose this kid, he's an excellent informant and courier, and a good person, as far as I know. As you could've already guessed, we need to deal with Sanitar to help the guy out... Who's the kid, you ask? He's one of the Scavs, nickname's Ryzhy. Alright, let's deal with this quick.

liaison.guide: In this quest you have to stash a physical bitcoin in a metal shack which is located at the weather station on Customs. Afterwards you have to shoot a yellow flare into the sky while being in the area of the weather station. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which is provided as initial equipment and can be bought at Prapor LL1, or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. File:Liaison Map.png|Shack marked on map File:Liaison Location.png|The metal shack
liaison.briefing: Hello. Remember when I was hoping the laptop would be easy to hack into? I was wrong, it's encrypted after all. I don't want to give the laptop to Mechanic, he could sell the information to an outside party. I don't want to take any more risks. I've already found the right people, but now I need your help. I need to hand these people a payment at Customs, at the weather station, and show that you've done it. Of course, this is not going to be a face-to-face meeting. I'll give you the flare launcher and pay you afterward, don't worry.
