living-high-is-not-a-crime.guide: The statues/figurines can commonly be found in the furniture displays throughout the store IDEA on Interchange. Alternatively, they, along with the Roler Submariner gold wrist watch and Golden egg can be found in Safes. They can also be very rarely be found in other containers such as Drawers, Sport bags, Dead Scavs, and more.
living-high-is-not-a-crime.briefing: Salam, there's a new sweet deal for you. Recently, I was approached by the guy who’s some sort of Reshala’s acquaintance. Posh as fuck, in a suit, and with a signet on his finger the size of a bottle cap. I’ve seen him at some gathering once, he used to drive a black BMW. He says that war or no war, his crib's gotta be all ornamented. Well, not exactly a crib, more like a hideout. Fetch me a bunch of jewelry, and I’ll hand it over to him. Look for horse statues, cats, lions, all that stuff. And look for Roler watches, the golden ones, it will be a complimentary gift: It’s best to be on good terms with such people, believe me, brother. Don't let me down, brother, or we're both in trouble.

requirements: Obtain level 1 loyalty with Ragman

objectives.text: Eliminate 4 PMCs on Interchange

long-line.briefing: Barev, brother! I need your help, and I need it quick. I sent my guys to Ultra to pick up some gear, but a group of PMCs cornered them there. My bois had no choice but to pull out empty-handed. I've got a business to run here, deliveries to make, important people waiting! Brother, deal with those fuckers for me. I'll owe you one!

requirements: Must be level 20 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 4 Scavs along the shore and the main road on Lighthouse

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Lobaev Arms DVL-10 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle (variant Urbana) at Skier LL3

long-road.guide: For this quest you have to kill 4 Scavs along the main road on Lighthouse. File:LongRoadMap.png|Approximate quest area marked
long-road.briefing: Come here already. Alright, so along the entire coast of the cape, there is a road, you've probably seen it. My guys use this road to transport merchandise to and from me. Usually, they managed to avoid trouble or calm some particular morons down, but right now it's a damn rat nest there, probably found out about my convoys. They started attacking my guys with full power, can't get through them at all. Go there and lay those whack-jobs down, will you? I'll get something nice for you in return.

requirements: Must be level 26 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find the lost group in the chalet area on Lighthouse
Survive and extract from the location

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for Grizzly medical kit at Therapist LL2

lost-contact.guide: The lost group is located on a tennis court that is part of the chalet on the hill in the south-east of Lighthouse. File:LostContactMap.png|Tennis court marked on map File:LostContactDeadBodies.png|The corpses of the lost group
lost-contact.briefing: Young man, I require your assistance. The other day, I sent a group of workers to collect supplies in the Cape Dalniy area, to the former USEC base of operations in the cottage area. I think you are more than familiar with this place, given the nature of your work. This mission is vital to getting supplies out of this zone. Unfortunately, the group has ceased all communication since yesterday. We suspect someone found out about our operation. Please, mercenary, find my people and, most importantly, their cargo.

objectives.text: Hand over 1,000,000 RUB to Skier

loyalty-buyout.briefing: Well hello-hello, little rat. That last trick you pulled was total bullshit, that's for sure. I even thought of getting a team to get rid of you, mister fancypants. Well, since you're here, I guess you want to amend for your sins. It's simple to me, like taking candy from a baby - my trust can be bought. One million in rubles - and we'll forget about past misunderstandings.

objectives.text: Locate the liquor store on Ground Zero
Locate and obtain the wine bottle in the store
Hand over the wine bottle

luxurious-life.guide: In this quest you have to find a wine bottle in the liquor store on Ground Zero. The wanted store is called "ASAP winery" and located across the street from the TerraGroup building complex. There are multiple spawns throughout the store. File:Luxurious Life Map.png|Liquor store marked on map File:ASAP Winery.png|The "ASAP winery" liquor store ====First spawn==== On the corner shelf to the left of the big bar counter. File:Luxurious Life Spawn 3.png ====Second spawn==== On the shelf to the right of the big bar counter. File:Luxurious Life Spawn 1.png ====Third spawn==== On the shelf behind the big bar counter. File:Luxurious Life Spawn 2.png ====Fourth/Fifth/Sixth spawn==== On the shelves in the storage room in the back of the store behind the big bar counter. File:Luxurious Life Spawn 4 5 6.png
luxurious-life.briefing: Hey! You did well on the first job, but it's not enough to make me happy. You're gonna have to do a little more legwork, soldier. I need to find a bottle of wine. I myself am more of a hard drinker, but I know a man who collects wine. And not just any kind, but the rarest kind! I want to give him a bottle as a gesture of goodwill. Nowadays in Tarkov, any connections with reputable people are worth their weight in gold, you know? There was a liquor store in the city center. They used to sell booze three times the price, for the elite folks. I'm sure there's some left. Go there and search the place and get me a good bottle of some French wine! And don't even try to slip me some fake shit.

objectives.text: Eliminate 30 opponents with hip-fire in CheckChamber mode

rewards.text: Unlocks achievement Such a lonely bullet...

magazines-are-for-the-weak.briefing: Alright, I've almost sorted out the whole magazine shortage. Give it a couple more days and our supply lines will be back to normal. There'll be enough gear for everyone. But until then, we're sticking with this one-round setup. You're a good shot when you've got time to line up your sights. But what happens when you don't? Can you survive—and outplay your opponent anyway? While you're keeping the Arena crowd entertained, I'll deal with the gifted geniuses responsible for this little logistics disaster.

objectives.text: Obtain the V3 Flash drive on Lighthouse
Reflash the Radio transmitter
Hand over the flash drive to Mechanic
Visit the lighthouse building

make-amends.guide: By killing Zryachiy you will fail and lose access to this quest. *Not all spawn locations for the quest item require this key. It is not entirely needed to complete the quest. There are multiple spawns for the V3 flash drive at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse. After obtaining it, you have to reflash the transmitter at the Intelligence Center level 2 in the Hideout. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted. After the reflashing is done, the transmitter is fully functional and can be used to bypass the Claymores and Zryachiy guarding the bridge to the lighthouse peninsula, allowing you to visit the lighthouse building and meet Lightkeeper. Note: If not all members of your lobby-made group have an encoded transmitter, it will have the "blocked" state and the bridge can't be passed. ===Secure flash drive V3 locations=== ====1.Southwestern container==== =====First spawn===== Ontop of a radio system on a desk in the blue container located west of the southern tower. File:GATentedMap.png|Container marked on map File:GATented.png|The container File:V3WTPTent.png ====2.Southern tower==== =====Second spawn===== On a wooden crate next to a weapon box ontop of the southern tower marked "ЗРУ". File:KTTTower.png|Tower marked on map File:BodySpawnWTPTower2.png|The tower File:GASouthernTower.png ====3.Southeastern water basin tent==== =====Third spawn===== On a table with laptops inside the military tent that is located in the southeastern water basin. File:KTTSouthEasternWaterBasinTentMap.png|Tent marked on map File:GASouthEasternWaterBasinTent.png ====4.Southeastern shack==== =====Fourth spawn===== On a metal shelf inside the southeastern electrical operation shack. File:GASouthEasternShackMap.png|Shack marked on map File:GASouthEasternShack1.png|The shack File:GASouthEasternShack2.png ====5.Building #3==== =====Fifth spawn===== In the Rogue USEC barrack room on the desk. File:BarracksKeyFar.png File:BarracksKeyClose.png File:V3FlashUSECBarrackDesk.png =====Sixth spawn===== On a metal shelf in the storage room that connects the outside stairs with the western upstairs offices. File:GABuilding3UpstairsStorage1.png File:GABuilding3UpstairsStorage2.png =====Seventh spawn===== On a rolling table in the northern office of the eastern personnel tract. File:WTPFlashBuilding32.png File:WTPFlashBuilding3.png ====6.Northeastern sha
make-amends.briefing: Lightkeeper said he's ready to accept you in again. But the old flash drive doesn't work anymore, so you'll have to find a new one, reflash the transmitter, and give it to me. I'll update your transmitter properly.

requirements: Getting the Digital secure DSP radio transmitter decoded the first time.

objectives.text: Hand over 1,000,000 RUB to Mechanic

make-amends-buyout.briefing: I hear you've pissed off Lightkeeper. Friend, I won't get involved in your personal affairs, but be very careful, okay? Stay out of trouble. You've seen for yourself what this man is capable of. Well, we can still make up for it. Remember the situation with the ransom and the extortion of the traders? I remember it well. I think we can at least bribe Lightkeeper.

objectives.text: Hand over the 4 found in raid SVDS sniper rifles

make-amends-equipment.briefing: Hello. Listen, mercenary, I've made arrangements with Lightkeeper for a test delivery of the supplies he needs from the list. I think I might be able to get close to him. That's what I wanted to talk to you about. There's a rumor going around that you two have trust issues. So let's help each other. You find me the supplies I need, and I'll handle the transportation. I'll put in a good word for you. Okay, he needs... Whoa. He needs sniper rifles, and lots of them.

objectives.text: Place a WI-FI Camera inside the quarantine zone in The Lab

make-amends-quarantine.guide: Despite the quest objective suggesting to place a WI-FI Camera in the quarantine zone (Blue keycard), it actually has to be placed in the human experiment's area (Black keycard). File:MakeAmendsQuarantineMap.png|Experiment's area marked on map File:The Lab Showcase 16.png|Placement location
make-amends-quarantine.briefing: Mercenary, by spoiling relations with the Lightkeeper, you also obstruct me. It's one thing to feud with some looters, but you don't mess with Lightkeeper, believe me. I'll tell him you're willing to redeem yourself and do some work for him. For all I know, he's collecting data on movements inside the Lab right now. We'll set up a camera inside and send a signal to Lightkeeper. Deal?

requirements: Getting the Digital secure DSP radio transmitter decoded the second time.

objectives.text: Place a WI-FI Camera at the yellow bus on the southern bridge approaching the water treatment plant on Lighthouse
Place a WI-FI Camera at the yellow bulldozer in the south-eastern part of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse
Place a WI-FI Camera at the police truck in the western part of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse
Place a WI-FI Camera at the army truck near the industrial zone in the northern part of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse

make-amends-security.guide: In this quest you have to place 4 WI-FI Cameras at different vehicles around the water treatment plant on Lighthouse. File:MakeAmendsSecurityMap.png|Vehicles marked on map File:MakeAmendsBus.png|The bus File:MakeAmendsBulldozer.png|The bulldozer File:MakeAmendsPoliceTruck.png|The police truck File:MakeAmendsArmyTruck.png|The army truck
make-amends-security.briefing: These are difficult times we live in, indeed. I can help you regain Lightkeeper's trust. I don't see the point in having a conflict. So, he wants wireless cameras placed around the perimeter of the Rogue base, apparently, for security purposes. Try to stay away from the base itself - I don't think Rogues know that you're acquainted with their friend.

requirements: Getting the Digital secure DSP radio transmitter decoded the third time.

objectives.text: Hand over 15 found in raid Secure Flash drives

make-amends-software.briefing: I understand if you and Lightkeeper have disagreements, but solving them with violence is not the answer. It taints our entire ecosystem. Okay, listen, I'm running out of software from the corporate flash drives that I use to flash transponders for Lightkeeper. Help me with these flash drives, and I'll try to change Lightkeeper's mind about you.

objectives.text: Eliminate 25 Raiders on Reserve

make-amends-sweep-up.guide: In this quest you have to kill 25 Scav Raiders on Reserve.
make-amends-sweep-up.briefing: Friend, now is not the time to spoil relations with influential people. Lightkeeper told me about your conflicts. He offers a deal - you help his allies with their personal problems, and he forgets old grudges. We need to eliminate a group of Raiders encroaching on Rogue territory. You'll have to sweep their ranks at the federal reserve base. Can you do that?

requirements: Unlocks 10 hours after completion of Spotter

objectives.text: Reach the required Bolt-action Rifles skill level of 10
Eliminate 10 Sniper Scavs from over 350 meters away

make-an-impression.guide: In this quest you have to kill 10 sniper Scavs from over 350 meters away, and reach level 10 in the bolt-action rifles skill. The Vortex Ranger 1500 rangefinder or the Wilcox RAPTAR ES Tactical Rangefinder can be used to determine the required distance. Customs, Shoreline and Streets of Tarkov are viable locations to complete this quest. File:Impression Customs guide.png|Customs sniper Scavs and shooting positions marked on map File:Make an Impression Shoreline Map.png|Shoreline sniper Scav and shooting position marked on map File:Make an Impression Streets of Tarkov Map.png|Streets of Tarkov sniper Scavs and shooting positions marked on map
make-an-impression.briefing: It seems that before my marksman decides to take risks at your prepared positions, he needs proof of your skill as an experienced spotter. Which makes sense. Time allows, thankfully. Let's just say there are snipers in and around the city who are operating out of their positions. Improve your counter-sniper skills, and then my man will trust you. Go on then, seven feet under the keel.

requirements: Obtain level 1 loyalty with Ragman

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 any target on Interchange

make-ultra-great-again.guide: Scavs can commonly be found at the front of OLI, Goshan, IDEA. Another spawn is in the main center hall of the mall, near the Kiba gun store. You can find more at power station, and also the road that runs parallel to the mall on the opposite side of the parking lot.
make-ultra-great-again.briefing: Back in the day, Ultra was awlays packed: moms with their kids, couples, random people just wandering around. I always liked that kind of energy! But now... Ah, forget the reminiscing. Time to get things done. I d'ont like how Scavs and everyone else stroll into Ultra like they own the palce, hauling off anything that isn't nailed down. Head over there and remind them it isn't their territory. Once you've cleared things up, I'll send my bois in to bring a little life back to the place.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 15 targets at the Stylobate building while using Pistols on Streets of Tarkov

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for Serdyukov SR-1MP Gyurza 9x21 pistol (variant Tactical 2) at Prapor LL4

mall-cop.guide: In this quest you have to kill any 15 targets at the Stylobate building on Streets of Tarkov while using pistols. File:gendmallcopmap.png|Kill area marked on map
mall-cop.briefing: Hoorah, warrior. My unofficially best employee! Anyway, there's a new pain in the ass I want you to deal with. There's a few places where we need to make dead silent, if you know what I mean. You'll be the first member of our Tarkov gendarmerie division! The first spot is Klimov Shopping Mall. This place has seen better days, that's for certain. Now it's just scumbags and looters, and I don't feel sorry for them in the slightest. Come on, get to it. We got a lot of work to do.

objectives.text: Score a melee kill on Tagilla
Kill 15 PMC operatives with a melee weapon

rewards.text: Miller Bros. Blades M-2 Tactical Sword

martial-arts-course.guide: * Stun grenades or a KS-23M with flashbang rounds will be useful in blinding both the PMCs and Tagilla * It is recommended to aim for the head when fighting Tagilla, since the back of his head is unprotected.
martial-arts-course.briefing: Well well, you're just in time, so listen up. Some morons out there found a secret book, from the KGB days, they say it's some kind of advanced close combat method, a secret one. Personally, I think it's all bullshit. Go to the Factory and check it out, will ya?

requirements: Must be Loyalty Level 1 to start this quest

objectives.text: Obtain the key to the closed premises of the Sanatorium on Shoreline
Hand over the key to Peacekeeper

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of HK MP5 9x19 submachine gun (Navy 3 Round Burst) at Peacekeeper LL2

master-key.guide: The Key to the closed premises of the Health Resort has to be picked up on Shoreline, laying on a chair in the bunker that is located north of the health resort. It only spawns while the quest is active. Once retrieved, you must extract and turn in the item to Peacekeeper. If you die after retrieving it and before turning it in, you will have to go and retrieve it again. File:SpaTour5BunkerMap.jpg|Bunker marked on map File:The bunker by rock passage.png|The bunker north of the health resort File:Sanatorium Key Location.png|The key on the chair
master-key.briefing: Hello, how are you? I know, probably not exactly amazing. These are difficult times. My men have discovered several interesting rooms inside the Health Resort, but unfortunately they are locked. They used to be occupied by USEC soldiers. Their keys were kept at a checkpoint, inside the concrete bunker northwest of the Resort. They evacuated in a hurry, so they may have left something behind. Bring me the keys to those rooms.

objectives.text: Locate the required computer at TerraGroup's Cardinal office on Streets of Tarkov
Install the flash drive at the computer to download the files

matter-of-technique.guide: To complete this quest, you first need to craft a Flash drive with special software at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout. Afterwards you have to stash it near the screens in the surveillance room inside the TerraGroup security post building on Streets of Tarkov. Jump onto the desk and stand right in the corner of the room. The infected cannot climb and will struggle to path to you and hit you while on top of the desk. The flash drive can be stashed from this spot. File:MatterOfTechniqueMap.png|Building marked on map File:TerraGroup security post Building.png|The building entrance File:TerraGroup security armory Way 1.png|Way to the surveillance room 1 File:TerraGroup security armory Way 2.png|Way to the surveillance room 2 File:MatterOfTechniqueLocation.png|The stashing area in the room
matter-of-technique.briefing: Tough times are upon us, huh? TerraGroup is one big box of mysteries. What could be crazier than turning a man into the living dead? I doubt Tarkov will survive this blow if we can't stand up to it. At Therapist's request, I did some research and found a working computer that might have some useful data left on it. But now we need you. Prepare the thumb drive exactly as instructed, get to TerraGroup's computer in their office in the city, and leave it there. You'll have to stay at the PC to make sure the connection is established. Once you've done your part, our mutual acquaintance and I will do the rest - all a matter of technique.

objectives.text: Eliminate 14 Rogues
Hand over the found Rogue intel

rewards.text: 2× AR-10 7.62x51 Magpul PMAG 20 SR-LR GEN M3 20-round magazine

mayday.guide: Kill 14 Rogues on Shoreline, Lighthouse or Reserve and hand over Rogue intel maps. Rogue intel maps can be found on Knight in the area from the gas station to the hydroelectric power station on Shoreline. File:Full Speed Ahead Shoreline Rogue Spawns.png|Shoreline Rogue spawns marked on map File:Full Speed Ahead Lighthouse Rogue Spawns.png|Lighthouse Rogue spawns marked on map File:Full Speed Ahead Reserve Rogue Spawns.png|Reserve Rogue spawns marked on map
mayday.briefing: After our last surveillance attempt, the Rogues reinforced their units, and now they're interfering with my people's work even away from the coast. I need you to clear the routes, otherwise I may lose several important partners in the city. And that means you lose profit as well. I still don't understand what Knight is willing to risk so much for... Try to gather more information about this operation directly from the Rogues. Though I doubt anyone outside Knight and his inner circle is carrying anything truly valuable.

objectives.text: Hand over 50,000 EUR to Peacekeeper

mentor.guide: Euros can be purchased from Skier with Roubles.
mentor.briefing: How's life treating you, mercenary? Maybe you will be interested, a friend of mine is exceptionally skilled at shooting sniper rifles. But I'm afraid that his services are not cheap. He worked as a PMC, but now he has retired and is mentoring people for cash. If you decide, I think I could arrange a meeting for you.

requirements: Must reach Loyalty Level 1 with Peacekeeper to obtain this quest.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the motor controller on Woods
Hand over the found item
Locate and obtain the single-axis fiber optic gyroscope on Woods
Hand over the found item

metal-birds.guide: In this quest you have to pick up a motor controller and a single-axis fiber optic gyroscope on Woods. The motor controller can be found on the center console of a black SUV at the USEC checkpoint west of the sawmill. File:Woods Land Lease.png|Location marked on map File:LandLease MotorCont1.png|The wanted SUV File:Controller-Woods.png|The controller on the console The single-axis fiber optic gyroscope can be found in an open weapon box located in the back of a blue pickup at the sawmill. File:Woods Land Lease.png|Location marked on map File:Lend Lease Woods Gyroscope pickup.png|The wanted pickup File:LandLease Gyroscope.png|The gyroscope in the box
metal-birds.briefing: Hello again! Modern warfare is a really high-tech enterprise. My men have spotted drones operating in Tarkov. They were shot down, but we were unable to recover them. Search the Woods for them. If you find the controller or any other components, bring them to me. You will be well compensated.

requirements: Must be level 24 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate and mark the first yellow minibus with an MS2000 Marker on Interchange
Locate and mark the second yellow minibus with an MS2000 Marker on Interchange
Locate and mark the third yellow minibus with an MS2000 Marker on Interchange

rewards.text: 1× ANA Tactical Beta 2 Battle backpack (Olive Drab)
Unlocks craft for First Spear Strandhogg plate carrier (Ranger Green) at Lavatory level 2
Unlocks barter for Interceptor OTV body armor (UCP) at Ragman LL2

minibus.guide: In this quest you have to mark 3 yellow minibuses with MS2000 Markers on Interchange. The first one is located southwest of the mall at the container lot. File:InterchangeMinibusLocations.jpg|Location marked on map File:Minibus1.png|Minibus 1 in the container lot. The other two are in the western parking garage. One of them can be found at the transition from section B to section C, close to the blocked-off down-ramp. The second one is located in section C, right next to the "Saferoom Exfil" extraction and the hole in the wall that connects the western with the eastern parking garage. File:InterchangeMinibusLocations.jpg|Locations marked on map File:Minibus2.png|Minibus 2 close to the blocked-off down-ramp File:Minibus3.png|Minibus 3 opposite of the "Saferoom Exfil"
minibus.briefing: Oh, so glad to see you. Let’s go straight to business, I have to deliver stuff quite frequently, and carrying everything as a mule is hardly an option anymore. All vehicles are dead after some kind of EMP strike during the conflict. Nothing starts no matter how hard you try, even if you take them apart and put them back together, only cars that came from outside can still run. There are bound to be some minibusses at the parking lot at the Interchange, mark at least three of them with beacons. My mechanics will examine them in detail, maybe there is a chance of success if I procure some electronics from the outside. Just do it right, don't need no pieces of trash. Look for the yellow ones, you'll figure it out.

requirements: This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the special edition of the gaming magazine on Interchange
Hand over the found item

rewards.text: 2× AWC Thor PSR XL multi-caliber sound suppressor

minute-of-fame.guide: The magazine can be found on the second floor of the ULTRA shopping mall on Interchange, in a book store called "МУЗЕЙ ИСТОРИИ" ("Museum of History"). There are multiple spawns throughout the store. File:MinuteOfFame MapGuide.png|Location of the book store marked on the map File:MinuteOfFameStore.png|The store ====First spawn==== On one of the billard tables. File:MinuteOfFame Location3.png ====Second spawn==== In the trash can in the men's restroom. File:MinuteOfFame Location4.png ====Third spawn==== On the floor in the band room, second to last seating row. File:MinuteOfFame Location2.png ====Fourth spawn==== On the floor beneath the bookshelf next to the band room. File:MinuteOfFame Location5.png ====Fifth spawn==== On the round table next to the train. File:MinuteOfFame Location7.png ====Sixth/Seventh spawn==== On both sides of the center bookshelf closest to the arcade machines. File:MinuteOfFame Location9.png|Shelf side facing the arcade machines File:MinuteOfFame Location8.png|Opposite side ====Eighth/Ninth spawn==== On both sides of the center bookshelf closest to the restroom. File:MinuteOfFame Location1.png|Shelf side facing the arcade machines File:MinuteOfFame Location6.png|Opposite side
minute-of-fame.briefing: Sup, bandit! How's life? A little birdie told me there's a special magazine in the Ultra mall at the Interchange. They wrote about our Russian video game, which is recognized all over the world! I guess the guys really came up with a great concept!

requirements: Must be level 30 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the crashed helicopter on Lighthouse
Find the informant's intelligence folder
Hand over the folder to Skier

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of AR-15 Magpul MOE Carbine stock (Black) at Skier LL3
Unlocks purchase of AK Zenit RK-3 pistol grip (Black) at Skier LL3
Unlocks purchase of Magpul MOE Carbine rubber buttpad at Skier LL4

missing-cargo.guide: The crashed helicopter is located on a hill in the south-southeast of Lighthouse. File:MissingCargoHeliMap.png|Helicopter marked on map File:MissingCargoHeli.png|The wanted helicopter The documents can be found on the first floor of the chalet that is located on the hill in the south-east of Lighthouse. File:MissingCargoChaletMap.png|Chalet marked on map File:MissingCargoChalet.png|The chalet File:MissingCargoDocuments.png|The documents are located in a black files folder on a desk to the right after you enter File:MissingCargoMilitaryDocuments.jpg|Documents in the files folder
missing-cargo.briefing: Hey, tactical, come on in! Do you remember that civilian helicopter that was shot down somewhere by the Lighthouse, according to rumors? So, the headache is that on that helicopter was a certain man with an inconspicuous folder, but it, in fact, was very much conspicuous - a lot of money was paid for it. Well, a birdie said the helicopter got shot down somewhere on the way to our meeting point. So here's your task: confirm the helicopter's whereabouts and that the rumors are true. Then find that folder for me, it's extremely important. I've got no idea who could've shot it down, honestly. Who's got the resources for that?.. USECs? I did hear that they took a liking to those cottages near the mountains, so it might be worth checking that area out. Hope those stray westerners didn't nick my goodie.

objectives.text: Stash a Pack of Arseniy buckwheat at the Scav house on Woods
Stash a Bottle of Tarkovskaya vodka at the Scav house on Woods
Stash an Iskra ration pack at the Scav house on Woods
Stash a Pack of Arseniy buckwheat at the guard barrack on Reserve
Stash a Bottle of Tarkovskaya vodka at the guard barrack on Reserve
Stash an Iskra ration pack at the guard barrack on Reserve
Stash a Pack of Arseniy buckwheat at the Path to River shack on Interchange
Stash a Bottle of Tarkovskaya vodka at the Path to River shack on Interchange
Stash an Iskra ration pack at the Path to River shack on Interchange

missing-in-action.guide: In this quest you have to stash 1 of each item provided by Prapor via in-game mail on Woods, Reserve and Interchange. ===Woods stashing location=== File:Simple Side Job Woods Map.png|Scav house location marked on map File:Scav House.png|The Scav house File:Missing in Action Woods Stashing Location.png|Stashing location ===Reserve stashing location=== File:Missing in Action Reserve Map.png|Guard barrack location marked on map File:Missing in Action Reserve Location.png|The guard barrack File:Missing in Action Reserve Stashing Location.png|Stashing location ===Interchange stashing location=== File:Missing in Action Interchange Map.jpg|Shack location marked on map File:Missing in Action Interchange Location.png|The shack
missing-in-action.briefing: Well hey there, warrior. How you holding up? Haven't frozen anything off yet? I've already got plenty of guys laid up because of these New Year frosts. We're short on hands back at base, but we'll scrape by. Out in the field though, things are a real mess, and I need your help. One squad was running an important job in the southwest. By now they should've grabbed the cargo and headed back. They're on radio silence, so there's no way to reach them. They can probably wait out the storm somewhere, but supplies might not last. There are three possible rally points they can reach once the weather clears. I need you to stash some food there so they can make it back to base without keeling over. In Priozersk, you need the little house on the outskirts, near the trail that leads toward Reserve. You also need to leave supplies at the military base; there's an old barrack right by the path from the forest, there's a room right by the entrance. Hide the stuff somewhere in the lockers so the Scavs don't steal it. They might also make it to Interchange if they follow the river. The river access is in the smuggler camp. There's a small shack near the barrier, leave everything there. And don't freeze yourself to death while you're at it. Put a hat on at least!

missing-informant.briefing: The informant set up a meeting near the car dealership, at a hidden spot? So why the hell are you still here? If he gets busted while you're still here, look for a hidden hideout, a spare key for it must be somewhere in there too. Find everything he's dug up. Don't let me down.

more-red.briefing: So tell me, what do you think matters more, quantity or quality? Everyone loves to say quality is king, right? I call bullshit. If those slow thinkers ever stepped into betting or investing, they would end up broke real fast, no risk diversification, no nothing... Right, so why am I saying all this? You do your job well, and you and I have already made a lot of money together. But I have been burned more than once by backing the same horse too often. So it's time to figure out who you really are. A lucky bastard who trips at the worst possible moment, or a real exception to the rule? Prove you can beat any odds. Drown the Arena in blood!

morituri-te-salutant.briefing: Good thing you're here. My guys made it back to me.. well, the ones who survived. The convoy got hit hard on Customs, so they had to pull out fast and took losses. They made it out on foot toward Ultra, and only there did they manage to regroup. They stashed most of the shipment at an open warehouse yard near the road to Customs. Somewhere among the containers, there should be a yellow minibus. That's where the cargo is. Check it and make sure the area's clear, would you? If you spot any signs of trouble, bring me whatever you find. The case with the templates and blueprints was hidden separately. There's an old TerraGroup container at the same yard, that's where everything was supposed to go in the first place. But they didn't make it in time, someone was on their tail. So they only managed to stash the case inside and lock it back up. Your main objective is to secure that case and bring it to me personally. I'll give you the keycard. Look for a red container, it should be somewhere up top near the minibus. And one more thing. Show that thug what real Arena fighters are capable of. I've hired other gladiators to help clear the area, so you don't start shooting each other, wear the colored masks from previous collections.

munchkin.briefing: That rich guy got in touch with me again. Apparently, plain old bloodshed isn't entertaining enough for him anymore. Now we've got to jump around, crawl on the ground... the man's got some ridiculous demands. But he's offering even more money for it. Our job's simple: put on a good show for this gentleman and squeeze as much cash out of him as we can. Go on, don't let me down.

musketeers.briefing: Hey. No point dragging out the story. My guys screwed up one of the shipments. We've got gear, guns, crates of ammo—everything. But those idiots somehow managed to lose four crates of magazines. You have no idea what that cost me... Doesn't matter though—the matches aren't stopping, so we'll have to make do. And you're gonna help me with that. This is a limited-time event, so there's no putting it off.

my-blood-type-mark-is-on-the-sleeve.briefing: Good afternoon. One of my recent patients previously worked at TerraGroup's underground facility. I tried to learn more about the laboratory and its security systems, but the man refused to cooperate. Shortly after his discharge, he was intercepted by one of the local Scav gangs. Hm, which one? Why would you assume I know the answer? I suggest you keep such speculation to yourself. What matters is that the previously sealed sections can now be accessed using the emergency override code. We are unlikely to have a better opportunity to recover the research materials I am interested in. I need blood samples labeled TG-Y. They were most likely used in one of the facility's isolated testing chambers, while processed samples may have been stored in laboratory refrigeration units. There is one more thing. Somewhere inside the facility is the office of the scientist who led the project I am investigating. Search it for notes, reports, or any other documentation related to that research.

network-provider-part-1.briefing: Hello, friend. I guess you've heard about the trader at the Lighthouse. I've got a little ambition, so to speak... I want to get in touch with him personally. No, it's still a long way to go before we meet face to face. And I don't like to leave my lair, honestly. There's a problem: the radio signal can't reach the lighthouse from here. Can you find the parts so I can put together a signal transmitter?

network-provider-part-2.briefing: So, I assembled the transmitters. Now we need to install them in the Lighthouse area. I figured out where a good place might be. Number one: inside the helicopter at the water treatment plant. Another one: an abandoned USEC cottage, it should have the right equipment, and you can tap into it to boost the retransmitter's output. And number three and four: somewhere high up, closer to the Lighthouse itself, and another one by the beach. And be careful. Don't get too close to the lighthouse itself just yet. A customer told me there was a sniper up there.

never-too-late-to-learn.briefing: So, how's your training going? I didn't think you still had so much to learn about warfare. That old saying ain't bullshit, ye? Luka and his squad could use a lesson. He said they got burned on the far side, had to retreat. Now the buggers at the base know they got competition, and they've tightened their defenses. They won't be able to take the base by surprise. That's why Luka asked to throw them some proper weapons to kill the cunts for sure. Everything they need is on the list right here. The cache must be real tough if those pricks aren't scared of even the military. Perhaps they got protection watching over them from the big land. But that protection ain't gonna reach us. From our side, the main thing is to equip Luka's squad and set up a supply line from them to Tarkov. I'll let Luka deal with the consequences himself, he's not a kid.

new-beginning-prestige-1.briefing: Hello my brother! So how's it hanging? Not bored yet? I know what'll rev you up. The effect is out of this world! Hey, don't get the wrong idea, it's nothing that was illegal in our past lives. Long story short, there are some special people making lists of the realest alphas in Tarkov. And I happen to know these special people. Rarely do I get to meet such influential figures in my life, that's for sure. With guys like that, you gotta do business in an exceptional fashion, not a single fuck-up. You mess up, you lose your chance to live a happy life ever after, if you catch my drift. Okay, so I can see you're clearly interested in finding out what this chad list is for. Tell you what, I have no fucking clue. I sure wish they'd tell me though! Anyway, you yourself can make it on this list. All you gotta do is prove you're worthy. They gave me a mission checklist, here ya go.

new-beginning-prestige-2.briefing: Hello my brother! So how's it hanging? Not bored yet? I know what'll rev you up. The effect is out of this world! Huh? I already told you that? Come on man, don't bullshit me. Wait, what? How do you know about the list? Shit, guess I really did tell you about it already. Anyway, it seems like you already have an idea of what to do. Wait, so did I also already tell you about the influential people making these lists? Man, I guess I should get more sleep. I'm running around like a squirrel over here, negotiating things, solving problems. That's my life. In fact, I've been thinking... These guys are on to you for a reason. Something big is going down, I'm telling you. So do your missions perfectly and on time. All right, back to business. Here's the list. No, it's exactly the same as the “last time”, you're just confused. Maybe you need more sleep, too.

new-paths.briefing: Greetings, mercenary. My partners desperately need to transport something important through the center of the city. You know how isolated the neighborhoods are and how dangerous the main roads are. You'll need to scout the route from the TerraGroup headquarters to the Rodina movie theater. My men have recently seen the Scavs who found a shortcut between the neighborhoods. It appears to be an old route used by USEC units during the Contract Wars. It was used for most of the supply runs, the soldiers even called it the Suez Canal amongst each other. This path will allow you to visit several different locations in one raid. Find it and make sure it's safe.

night-of-the-cult.guide: In this quest you have to kill 5 Cultists.
night-of-the-cult.briefing: About time you stopped by. You've noticed those night devils coming out of everywhere too, haven't you? They're arming themselves a lot better, huh. It's like someone's actually working with them. From above, you know? We should look into what those bastards are up to. Besides, all the better if you can reduce their numbers. Just be careful. There's a rumor among the scavengers that you can run into an invincible beast at night. They say it hunts and devours humans. I remember an Eastern story about such a demon, its nickname was, uh... "The Oni". I wouldn't have brought these stories up before. But now something's definitely brewing, and dark thoughts just keep creeping into my head.

night-sweep.briefing: Oi, come here, need to talk to you. Got a job for you, a dry one, if you ask me. My folks were looking for loot at night recently and ran into some hooded morons, and, well, shit went south. Naturally, my dudes managed to retreat in the end and even smoked some of those psychos, though we still lost around a dozen of ours. Eh, that's not the point. The guys found some kind of a dagger on one of those psychos, and apparently, some serious people are willing to pay a fortune for those. Anyway, I've got an order for those daggers. If you find any, bring'em here.

no-fuss-needed.briefing: Alright, so here's the deal. Here's the note I was talking about, bring it to the doc lady. Nothing criminal in there, just a few lines about our business. But here's the pain in the ass: if she knows that the note is from me, she'll just tear it up on the spot. Try to gain her favor first, earn some trust, and only then pass the note over. And don't lose it, I'm not writing another one.

no-gifts-for-you.guide: ====Note:==== * Killing Santa Claus will lose you significant rep with Fence (-0.50pts / -1.50pts)!
no-gifts-for-you.briefing: Come on in, kid. Ive seen lots of things during this conflict, but bribes... Someone bribed the local bandit leaders, others found out about it and started doing that too, then the others. Cowards fill the leaders pockets with goods, and now we have a whole charade of arse-licking around us. Theyre using those red backpacks to carry all those bribes, like some Christmas presents. Theyre ruining such an important symbol! Go there and confiscate these bribes from those corrupt bandit leaders.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 enemies while using an RSh-12

no-limit-to-perfection-part-1.briefing: Soft types don't last long in the Arena, so you better stay in shape! We've got a big iron here, try handling that beast if you've got the strength for it. And if you don't, drag your ass to the gym and keep at it until you do!

objectives.text: Get the first kill of the round 5 times in BlastGang or TeamFight mode

no-limit-to-perfection-part-2.briefing: Your strength's just fine, but I can see your endurance needs work. If you're crawling around slow and stopping every few steps, you'll miss all the action. Show me in the Arena that you're not snoozing out there!

objectives.text: Eliminate 50 enemies while using assault rifles

no-limit-to-perfection-part-3.briefing: When your conditioning's solid, it's time to start working on applied skills. For a good fighter, a rifle is an extension of his hands! Grab whichever one you like best and get out there to train.

objectives.text: Eliminate 50 enemies while using marksman rifles

no-limit-to-perfection-part-4.briefing: You know what a lot of fighters forget? How to fight at distance. Our Arenas aren't huge, sure, but there's still room to stretch things out. Don't waste that advantage. A talented fighter has to be good at everything!

objectives.text: Eliminate 100 enemies while aiming down sights

no-limit-to-perfection-part-5.briefing: It's not enough to just shoot from a distance, you've got to anticipate your enemy's moves! A lot of my guys rush it, starting blasting the moment they spot someone. And of course they miss! The whole point is careful aiming and understanding how your opponent behaves. I think you could use some practice too. Get to the Arena!

objectives.text: Eliminate 2 enemies within 15 seconds while using a submachine gun 20 times

no-limit-to-perfection-part-6.briefing: It's one thing to handle a weapon, but a whole other thing to understand its strengths and weaknesses. Submachine guns, for example, perform best in the hands of a mobile fighter at close range. Don't try to make a weapon do something it's not meant for — you wouldn't slice bread with a fork, would you? So get out there and practice!

objectives.text: Eliminate 50 enemies while using shotguns

no-limit-to-perfection-part-7.briefing: You know what's the deadliest weapon up close in the Arena? A shotgun! One point-blank blast and your opponent's practically scraping off the walls. Learn to handle it properly, and nothing will be able to stop you. Guess what it takes to get there? Practice, of course. Lots and lots of practice.

objectives.text: Eliminate 50 enemies with point fire while using light machine guns

no-limit-to-perfection-part-8.briefing: You've got to know how to fight with style! If you're packing a heavy caliber, then use it to the fullest. Light them up straight through cover! The crowd loves it when someone turns the place into a bloodbath without all the fancy tricks. Just go in and crush your opponents. Forget about careful aiming! Show everyone what you're capable of.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 enemies with headshots while using bolt-action rifles

rewards.text: Unlocks achievement The Time to Live and the Time to Die

no-limit-to-perfection-part-9.briefing: It's never precise enough — you've got to hit the head on the first shot, not the twentieth. Go train, fighter. You'll pick up some serious sniper skills along the way.

objectives.text: Win a CheckChamber match while placing 4th or higher on your team

no-man-is-an-island.briefing: Listen. The spectators are loving this one-round gimmick, and the bets keep getting bigger. So we'd better milk it while it's hot. Just don't forget you've got teammates. Work with your squad. Yeah, yeah, I've heard all that "one man can win the battle" nonsense, but there's a reason we pit teams against each other out here. You're part of a team now, so prove you've got what it takes as one.

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 PMC operatives at the TerraGroup HQ on Ground Zero

no-peeking.guide: In this quest you have to kill 5 PMCs at the TerraGroup HQ on Ground Zero. File:No Peeking Map.png|Kill area marked on map
no-peeking.briefing: Hello. It's good to have you here, I need some outside help. You'll do just fine. Recently, my people have noticed that someone is installing cameras in the city center. They're trying to spy on us! My men must not be seen involved in this matter, so we need your help. Take down the people who are installing the cameras. I'll pay for everything, don't worry.

requirements: Must be level 17 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 Raiders in the command bunker on Reserve

no-place-for-renegades.guide: In this quest you have to kill 5 Scav Raiders in the underground bunker on Reserve. Scav Raiders have the chance to spawn there at the start of a raid, and additional ones may appear after the "D-2" extraction switch has been activated. File:UndergroundCommandAreMap.png|Quest area marked on underground map
no-place-for-renegades.briefing: Greetings, warrior. I've got a new assignment for you, regarding that military base, the one you were checking out for me some time ago. In short, I'm not happy that my boys got killed in vain in that bunker. That's just not right. I'd like to let those Raiders know the consequences of their actions. An eye, for an eye, you know? Return to that bunker and fuck up some of them in that command offices area you found. Just so they know who they're messing with and that they better stop.

objectives.text: Survive and extract from Shoreline
Survive and extract from Lighthouse
Survive and extract from Reserve
Eliminate 10 Rogues on any location

no-smoke-without-fire.guide: Kill 10 Rogues on Shoreline, Lighthouse or Reserve and extract from each location with the "Survived" extraction status. File:Full Speed Ahead Shoreline Rogue Spawns.png|Shoreline spawns marked on map File:Full Speed Ahead Lighthouse Rogue Spawns.png|Lighthouse spawns marked on map File:Full Speed Ahead Reserve Rogue Spawns.png|Reserve spawns marked on map
no-smoke-without-fire.briefing: Hello, mercenary. My people have been reporting unusually high Rogue activity along the coast line. There are indications they may have been seen near the Reserve base as well, though that information hasn't yet been confirmed. Your task is to conduct reconnaissance around the Lighthouse and the port terminal area. While you're at it, please check the military base as well. We need to understand what they are looking for. Casualties are acceptable, the priority is to identify new Rogue positions and gather as much intelligence as possible.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 10 enemies in the base area

no-swiping.guide: In this quest you have to kill any 10 enemies in and around the smugglers base on Shoreline. File:No Swiping Map.png|Base location and kill area marked on map File:No Swiping Location.png|The base
no-swiping.briefing: Let's cut the chitchat and get straight to business. I got some buddies on Shoreline, smuggling all kinds of contraband. Useful fellas. They had to leave the base a couple days ago, left all their goods behind. I don't know what the fuck happened, plus we're not some best of buddies, so I won't tell you the details anyway. Anyway, there's a bunch of looters at the base now, taking everything they can get their hands on. Go down there and explain to them why they shouldn't steal from my boys.

requirements: Must be level 28 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate Jaeger's Health Resort room with a view of the bay on Shoreline
Obtain Jaeger's Photo album
Hand over the Photo album to Jaeger

nostalgia.guide: In this quest you have to find Jaeger's photo album in the health resort on Shoreline. It can be found in west wing room 303 on the third floor, located in the bottom drawer of a nightstand. The room is always unlocked. File:Vitamins1 Shoreline outdoor map.png|Health resort west wing location marked on map File:West Wing 303 Door.png|Door to west wing room 303 File:Jaeger Photo Album.png|Photo album in the bottom drawer
nostalgia.briefing: Hello there, come in. You know, at times, sitting by the campfire, I look back on how it all began. That time I've been on vacation in the health resort, it was in the evening, I remember that as if it was yesterday. I have just returned to the room after dinner, sat by the window to gaze at the bay. It looked marvelous. And then I hear trucks, not just a single one, a whole convoy. It was your colleagues, the USECs. They kicked everyone out of the resort, didn’t even let people pack their belongings. I don't care about my clothes as much as my photo album which remained there. Not as a service but as an act of friendship, please try to find it there. It is painfully dear to me as a memory of those calm days. My room was on the top floor of the health resort, in the west wing. The reward will be bountiful.

objectives.text: Eliminate 35 infected from over 70 meters away on Reserve

not-a-step-back.briefing: Times are hard, but you are a real warrior! Who else but you to defend our country from these monsters? I keep receiving reports of numerous enemy breakthroughs, and the least defended location is the nature reserve. You'll have to move into the area and kill as many of those freaks as you can. And yes, bring tons of ammo and stay on the high ground, you'll need it. And remember to stay at a distance, shoot them on the approach! Don't let them get too close to you.

objectives.text: Place 4th or higher in BlastGang or TeamFight mode
Place 4th or higher in CheckPoint mode
Place 5th or higher in LastHero mode

rewards.text: Unlocks Hare mask in the Armory
Unlocks Fox mask in the Armory
Unlocks Aybolit mask in the Armory
Unlocks Grinch mask in the Armory

not-below-zero.briefing: We're striking while the iron's hot. You can climb the rankings if people are betting on you. Just don't end up at the bottom or you'll lose cash. But you know what you're doing, so I'm not worried.

objectives.text: Locate Ragman's SUV on Shoreline
Survive and extract from the location

rewards.text: 1× Stich Profi Chest Rig MK2 (Recon, A-TACS FG)

nothing-fishy-about-this.guide: In this quest you have to find Ragman's lost SUV on Shoreline. It is located in the east of the swamp village, driven into a pond. File:Nothing Fishy About This Map.png|SUV location marked on map File:Nothing Fishy About This Location.png|The SUV in the pond
nothing-fishy-about-this.briefing: Hello, brother. Kinda in a bad mood today, not gonna lie. I feel like I've been ripped off! I bought an apparently running SUV for 2,000 bucks. And everything seemed fine, they brought it to Shoreline, but the driver never contacted me back after that. It's not a lot of money, but still sucks. Can you go see if the car's actually there?

objectives.text: Eliminate Peacekeeper's people on Shoreline

obstacle-course.guide: In this quest you have to kill 1 of Peacekeeper's people on Shoreline. They can be found in squads of 3-6 at one the following locations in every raid: * Near the cottages * In the east and west wing of the health resort * At the port/pier area * At the smuggler base File:Obstacle Course Map.jpg
obstacle-course.briefing: Hey, so somebody managed to get into the lab and steal the information I need. He like downloaded it all, you know what I'm saying? Anyway, I need to find this asshole, but the blueberries are trying to make peace and friendship here. They're pissing me off, getting in my way. Why don't we get rid of them?

objectives.text: Eliminate Skier's people on Customs

obstruction-destruction.guide: In this quest you have to kill 1 of Skier's people on Customs. They can be found in squads of 3-6 at one the following locations in every raid: * At the shipping yard premises * At the Scav base (ZB-013 extraction) building with the numerous mounted weapons * At the dorms area, either in one of the dorms or in the yard between them * In the area between warehouse 17 and the bridge * In the entire area east of the river File:Obstruction Destruction Map.png
obstruction-destruction.briefing: Morning. I sent my men to inspect the laboratory, but someone's gotten there first. They've destroyed all the useful data, those bastards! My men say that they must have copied it all to themselves. It's important to catch them, but Skier's rednecks are obstructing us. I'm counting on your help to rid the territories of criminal elements. Don't worry, you won't be working alone.

objectives.text: Find out what is behind the Health Resort bunker door on Shoreline
(Optional) Obtain the Labrys access keycard

offensive-reconnaissance.guide: In this quest you have to transit from Shoreline to The Labyrinth. The transit is located in the basement of the health resort west wing and requires a Labrys access keycard. The door to the transit is locked and requires the Knossos LLC facility key. Surviving the raid is not required. File:Vitamins1 Shoreline outdoor map.png|Health resort west wing location marked on map File:The Labyrinth Transit Map.png|Transit location marked on west wing basement map File:The Labyrinth Transit Door.png|Door to the transit File:The Labyrinth Transit.png|The transit
offensive-reconnaissance.briefing: You got the keycard? Perfect. Judging by how much everyone's interested in these cellars, you and I are on a truly important trail. There could be a TerraGroup warehouse or another lab that's been sealed there ever since the evacuation! We don't have time to waste. First we need to search these premises and figure out what the purpose of the facility is. TerraGroup would not be so eager to hide it if what is going on inside corresponds to their company's public profile. Try to memorize everything you see: the structure of the premises, equipment, tools, markings or other symbols... Every detail counts. I'll wait for your return and set up my surveillance system to track any information about the health resort. If anyone finds more than we do, I'll see it.

requirements: Hand over the hard drives from compartment C-1 on Icebreaker to Mechanic in the Boreas story chapter.

objectives.text: Find 5 AMG-10 hydraulic fluid in raid
Hand over the items

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for Kalashnikov AK-308 7.62x51 assault rifle at Prapor LL1

oil-change.briefing: Heya there, warrior! Since you already know about my little helicopter secret, I've got a job for you. If you want my bird to keep picking you up from the ship, it needs regular maintenance. Remember that special lubricant you brought me? You won't find that stuff in Tarkov, but there should still be some supplies left on the Icebreaker. Go take a look, check the helipad and storage areas. Anything you find in cans, bring it back to me. You've got your own interest in this too, so you won't be doing it for nothing. And if you manage to pull together a decent stock, I'll even pay extra.

requirements: Must be level 5 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate and mark any of the fuel tank trucks with an MS2000 Marker on Customs

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of 9x21mm BT gzh at Prapor LL3

oil-run.guide: In this quest you have to find and mark any of the fuel tanker trucks with MS2000 markers on Customs, and extract from a Customs raid with the "Survived" extraction status. The marker placement and the extraction can be done in separate raids. If you extract from the raid with the "Run Through" extraction status, the quest will not count as being completed. To avoid the "Run Through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting. Prapor provides a MS2000 markers via in-game mail. It is recommended to carry it in your special item slots or your secure container, where it's not lost upon death. For a marker placement to count as completed, you need to stay alive for 30 seconds after placing it. It is not required to stay anywhere near the placement location for the duration. If you die before 30 seconds have passed, you need to place a new marker. Additional ones can be bought from Prapor or Ragman. File:BP Depot Marked Map.png|Fuel tanker truck locations marked on map File:BPTanker.png|Tanker truck #1 behind the new gas station File:BPTanker2.png|Tanker truck #2 at the construction site with the fuel tanks File:BPTanker3.png|Tanker truck #3 next to the "Old Gas Station" extraction File:BPTanker4.png|Tanker truck #4 behind the garages near the "Trailer Park" extraction
oil-run.briefing: This mug looks familiar! Hello there, drifter. Good timing, I’ve been pondering on some business here. A little bird asked me to check out the area where there might still be some fuel remaining. Hot topic, you understand, not for just anybody to charge with. And here you step in! Lucky me. Cutting it short, you’ve handled beacons before, right? No rocket science - stick it somewhere out of sight, press the button, get out. Got it? Excellent, all that’s left is to find and mark the tanks. Here, take those beacons. Consider it a token of appreciation for our successful partnership.

objectives.text: Hand over 15 Physical Bitcoins

old-patterns.briefing: We did a great work together with the new gear line! Just like back in the old days when business was booming and cash was rolling in. By the way, I got an idea for a special cut to make pants pockets bigger. You want me to try it out on yours? Then you'll have to pay for them. The patterns are pretty old and expensive. You can't do that from memory!

requirements: Must be Loyalty Level 2 to start this quest

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the lab journal on Factory
Stash the journal at the old sawmill on Woods

rewards.text: Unlock purchase of SIG MPX 9x19 submachine gun (Silenced) at Peacekeeper LL2

one-less-loose-end.guide: In this quest you first have to locate and obtain a journal in Factory. Afterwards it has to be stashed on Woods. ===Factory journal location=== The journal can be found in the laboratory on the second floor. There are multiple spawns throughout both rooms. File:One Less Loose End Factory Map.png|Laboratory location marked on map File:One Less Loose End Factory Lab.png|Entrance to the laboratory File:One Less Loose End Factory Spawn 1.png|Spawn #1: In the first room on the trolley File:One Less Loose End Factory Spawn 2.png|Spawn #2: In the first room on the chest of drawers next to the glass cabinet File:One Less Loose End Factory Spawn 3.png|Spawn #3: In the second room in the bottom compartment of the right industrial shelf File:One Less Loose End Factory Spawn 4.png|Spawn #4: In the second room in the small fridge on the floor File:One Less Loose End Factory Spawn 5.png|Spawn #5: In the second room on the right desk ===Woods stashing location=== The journal has to be stashed inside a house at the old sawmill in the east of the location. File:One Less Loose End Woods Map.png|House location marked on map File:One Less Loose End Woods Building.png|The wanted house File:One Less Loose End Woods Stashing Spot.png|Stashing spot
one-less-loose-end.briefing: Hello, dear friend. There's an important job just for someone like you. You need to pick up a journal from the TerraGroup field lab at the Polikhim factory and drop it off at a specified location. It's at an old sawmill in Priozersk nature reserve. Leave the package at the house with transformers. I don't want to upset my influential customer, so I can't trust a random person with the job.

requirements: Must be Loyalty Level 2 to start this quest

objectives.text: Eliminate 15 targets with headshots while using an AUG on Factory

one-way-ticket.briefing: Hello. Things have been going very well between us. That is why I would like to involve you in one... complicated task. My men attempted to pass through the Factory, but they were not allowed through. They all died. Now I must fill out a great deal of paperwork and request reinforcements... And we must also punish those responsible. I do not know exactly who is responsible for the deaths of my men, so engage everyone you encounter, And make your shots count, headshots only. I want the enemy to understand that this was not a coincidence.

requirements: Must be level 15 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Reach Loyalty Level 2 with Ragman

only-business.briefing: Good day to you, merc! Wanna become a respected member of Tarkov's fine society? Then you'll have to do some business with me, Wanna do some trading, perhaps? Or you can help me out with a few little tasks. There's always work to be found. Well, I'll do my best to find some for you, at least.

objectives.text: Win 3 matches in any game mode

only-victories.briefing: No matter what we come up with, the betting pool brings in the real money. The more you win, the better it pays. So you've gotta stay sharp. Don't let me down. I only need wins from you – however you get them. Go wipe out everyone.

requirements: Must be level 6 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the water hidden inside of the dorms on Customs
Survive and extract from the location

operation-aquarius.guide: In this quest you have to find the hidden water on Customs. It can be found in room 206 on the second floor of the two-story dorms building. A Dorm room 206 key is required to enter it. File:OP Aquarius1 Customs.png|2 story dorms and room 206 marked on map File:Rom 206 door.png|Room 206 in the two-story dorms File:Inside-Room-206.png|The hidden water
operation-aquarius.briefing: Nice to meet you, young man. I have a well-paying job for you. Since you are already aware of the problems with the drinking water in this region and the origin of these problems, I know that I can entrust you with the following information. We found out what the source of contamination is, and we know how to stop it. We need a bit more time, but we will get it done. Qualified engineers are already on it, but until then we will have to live on the remaining reserves (which are very scarce, indeed). However, to my knowledge, some people managed to make hay and stock up on clean water prior to the contamination. These people are part of the gang which inhabits the dorms next to the factory. Several people saw them carrying large plastic barrels full of clean water to that location. Though I can't blame them for surviving any way they can, we need that water more than they do. Besides, the contamination issue will be solved very soon, so they won't be needing that water anyway. Acquiring this water will save many lives, so get out there and find where they store that water. We will all be indebted to you...

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the electronic jammer at the electromechanical warehouse on Reserve
Stash the device at the specified location on Woods

order-from-outside.guide: Completing the quest Battery Change from the BTR Driver automatically fails this quest. In this quest you first have to find a KOSA UAV electronic jamming device in the airspace control center (White King) on Reserve. There are multiple spawns. Afterwards you have to stash it on Woods, at a gravesite south of the dilapidated village in the north. ====Reserve Pickup location==== The device can be found in different spots in a storage room on the first floor of the airspace control center (White King). File:Airspace Control Center Map.jpg|Airspace control center location marked on map File:Order From Outside Room Map.png|Room location marked on map File:Order From Outside Door.png|Door to the room, way when entering from the east File:Order From Outside Spawn 1.png|Spawn 1 in the back left corner behind the green crates File:Order From Outside Spawn 2.png|Spawn 2 under the table File:Order From Outside Spawn 3.png|Spawn 3 in the back right corner in a green crate ====Woods Stashing location==== File:Protect the Sky Map.png|Gravesite location marked on map File:Order From Outside Stashing Location.png|The gravesite
order-from-outside.briefing: Surely you don't think I would be interested in petty local conflicts? I have much more important matters to attend to, and I am not going to help either of the parties. Speaking of which. I need to move an item from point A to point B. It is hidden at the electromechanical warehouse in the airspace control center at the military base. It's to be delivered to the Priozersk nature reserve. The landmark will be a small cemetery. You'll recognize it by the stretchers and the bodies around it -- not everyone has been buried in time. Since my cargo is very specific, some people may have a particular interest in it. That is why I need someone who can guarantee the safety of the cargo during transportation.

requirements: This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.
Must be level 30 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 20 USEC PMC operatives on Lighthouse
Hand over 20 found in raid USEC PMC dogtags

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of 23x75mm Zvezda flashbang round at Prapor LL3

our-own-land.briefing: Greetings, comrade. Come on in, come on in. And lock the door behind you. Gonna have a serious talk... It's time to show everyone whose land we're standing on and who's the boss around here. Because there are already more of these tourists than us - everything that's left in Tarkov has been plundered. They turned Norvink region into some garbage lot. You agree, right? It's not even about the money, it's about driving those fuckers out from our own land! Although I will make it worth your while anyway, as always. Start by clearing the area near the Lighthouse, and then we will throw them out of our other territories. So, are you in?

objectives.text: Hand over 2 found in raid GARY ZONT portable electronic warfare devices
Eliminate 10 Rogues
(Optional) Locate and neutralize Big Pipe
(Optional) Locate and neutralize Birdeye
(Optional) Locate and neutralize Knight

ours-by-right.guide: The GARY ZONT portable electronic warfare devices have a chance to spawn on Rogues on Lighthouse. The Goons are guaranteed to have the devices on them.
ours-by-right.briefing: Okay, I got word of a major fuck-up. It may not be your fault, but that's beside the point. The assholes at the water treatment plant intercepted a bunch of these crates with portable EW equipment in them. They're obviously useless at this point, but I'm not gonna let them steal government property like this. For a warrior like you, the task is feasible. Go to the WTP and get me those EW thingies. And yes, those rats need to be put down. The EWs themselves have probably already been handed over to their commanders, so you're guaranteed to get this equipment from them. Assuming you don't die, I suppose.

requirements: Must accept Skier's quest Chemical - Part 4 to obtain this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the transport with the chemicals on Customs
Mark the vehicle with an MS2000 Marker

out-of-curiosity.guide: By completing either Chemical - Part 4 or Big Customer, you will fail and lose access to this quest. You can buy the MS2000 Marker from Prapor. After placing the marker, the player must stay alive for 30 seconds or they will have to place another beacon in the van. You do not need to be near the van after the marker has been placed. Find a nearby hiding spot and wait until the timer is complete. File:BigCustomerMap.jpg|Warehouse marked on map File:Depot-building customs.png|The warehouse with the vehicle inside. File:The van inside the depot-building.png|The vehicle where the beacon is placed.
out-of-curiosity.briefing: Young man, I cannot stand aside on this one. I'm aware that you are now working with this so-called Skier. This disreputable man pursues completely lucrative interests and that is a matter of great concern to me. Especially all this story with secret experiments on a substance that you call the yellow chemical. The substance is extremely dangerous, and I have a major request for you, could you give up the coordinates of the chemicals to me? Yes, I'm aware of all the details of your adventures with the Skier. I would come up with good payment for that. Again, this is all just for the sake of our people.

out-of-time.briefing: Brother, I've got a cool job for you! There was a contemporary art expo in the city before the conflict, and they brought in some paintings of what's-his-name... Anyway, the paintings are crazy expensive. I don't know shit about art, but my friend abroad is a real expert with a bottomless purse. I've promised to smuggle him all the paintings by that snob artist that were in the expo. They look something like an abstract multicolored clock. Can you help me collect them? It's a breeze, trust me. However, these paintings were stolen during the chaos and scattered all over the region, and there are twelve of them in total.... But you can handle it, yeah?

Hand over 5 Topographic survey maps, Intelligence folder, or TerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials marked with the Found in raid status

overpopulation.guide: For this quest you have to kill 10 targets around and between the cottages on Lighthouse. File:OverpopulationMap.png|Approximate quest area marked
overpopulation.briefing: Mercenary, there is work for you. According to our intelligence, after the initial conflict, the former base of your USEC comrades, in the cottage area at Cape Dalniy, was abandoned with a lot of valuable equipment and information that could sponsor the Blue Helmets operations. The only problem is that the entire territory is currently under the control of the Scavs, and I would like to get rid of them, or at least scare them out of this zone so that my people can extract all the necessary resources without combat. This is your task, my friend. Naturally, everything that you have just heard will remain strictly between us. I look forward to your report.

overseas-trust-part-1.briefing: My colleagues are asking for a favor, and strangely enough, they recommend you, mercenary. Apparently, I'm not the only one who's heard of your deeds. So here's the deal: you're going to eliminate the local leaders of all the primitive gangs that have set sails all over Tarkov. The details aren't important for you to know. As a reward, they say they'll leave a valuable souvenir for you. Now, go on, soldier. I'll be waiting for your return.

objectives.text: Hand over 50,000 USD

overseas-trust-part-2.briefing: Oh, hey. Some serious guys came over today, said they had something for you. Don't know what you did for them, but anyway, I've got some new clothes for you now. A little expensive considering your unique measurements, but hey, this'll be my finest work yet!

paramedic.briefing: Young man, I have a task that suits your area of expertise. A friend of mine, a paramedic still early in his career, recently told me a disturbing story. Just before the catastrophe, he was transporting patients with unexplained symptoms, almost as if there had been an outbreak of a new disease. At the hospitals, unfamiliar individuals would take them away and transfer them to private wards. The young man managed to photograph their observation logs while they were collecting another patient. However, in the midst of the catastrophe, he dropped his smartphone containing all the data. He says they were on their way to pick up another patient near the Concordia residential complex. For everyone's sake, please find this phone for me. The paramedic will be waiting for you under the protection of my people, inside an SUV on Primorsky Avenue, and he will confirm its authenticity. I sincerely hope I can count on you, young man.

objectives.text: Eliminate 15 Scavs at the city clinic on Streets of Tarkov

parasites.guide: In this quest you have to kill 15 Scavs at the children's polyclinic no. 69 on Streets of Tarkov. File:Parasites Quest Kill Area.png|Kill area marked on map
parasites.briefing: You've got a message, read it carefully: "I hear you're pretty sick. If you use the rest of your brain, you'll figure out who I am and what I want. Quick hint, these random thugs at the city clinic are keeping my interns from doing their jobs. As soon as that fact stops clouding my plans, I can remember my hippocratic oath. About helping everyone in need and whatnot... You are in need after all, right?"

party-preparations.briefing: Wanna hear something hilarious? People suddenly became interested in all this Christmas stuff now: hats, white beards, all that. Whol the hell would need that in war times? Next wil be Scavs dancing and singing around campfires, and Killa with Glukhar collecting gifts from under the tree like good children they are! Hahaha! Well, anyway, I don't really care why everyone needs all that stuff. If people buy it - we make money on it. Bring me anything you find, and I'll give you some Christmas presents in return.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the customized tool set at the garage complex on Customs
Hand over the found item

passion-for-ergonomics.guide: In this quest you have to find the customized tool set at the garage complex Customs. It can be found in garage #11. There are multiple spawns throughout the garage. File:Passion for Ergonomics Map.png|Garage #11 location marked on map File:Passion for Ergonomics Garage.png|The garage File:Passion for Ergonomics Spawn 1.png|First spawn under the car File:Passion for Ergonomics Spawn 2.png|Second spawn on the ground below the shelf File:Passion for Ergonomics Spawn 3.png|Third spawn on the ground behind the car File:Passion for Ergonomics Spawn 4.png|Fourth spawn on the ground at the front of the car
passion-for-ergonomics.briefing: Hello. Do you know the feeling when you change the layout of your instrument in a seemingly insignificant way and it fundamentally changes the working comfort? The Pareto principle, right. I had a friend who was the epitome of that concept. He was always tweaking something, filing, sanding a part to win a few millimeters.... His experience made me realize how important ergonomics is in any job. I have not heard from him in a while, but I know one of his outlets, it was either a sort of car service or a workshop, right in the garage complex. He always loved cars, especially the American ones. Can you come and check the place out? He probably moved somewhere else a long time ago, but his garage might still contain some of his tools or blueprints.

objectives.text: Plant a signal jammer in the system admin's office in The Lab
Plant a signal jammer in the garage gate control room in The Lab
Plant a signal jammer in the central security monitoring room in The Lab

patch-the-vulnerability.guide: In this quest you have to plant the Local network hacking device in three locations in The Lab and eliminate 10 Black Division operatives. Black Division soldiers on Icebreaker and The Wedge's guards do not count for the kill objective. ===System admin's office=== The first hacking device has to be placed at server racks in the System admin's office on the right from the door. The room can be accessed using the emergency access code from the whiteboard in the system admin's office. File:Lab Alarm Location.png|Room marked on map File:Patch the Vulnerability Garage gate control room Plant.png|Planting location at the end of the room ===Central security monitoring room=== The third hacking device has to be placed at the server racks in the Laboratory security post (R23) room (Violet Keycard). The room can be accessed using the emergency access code from the whiteboard in the system admin's office. File:Lab Security Post Location.png|Room marked on map File:Patch the Vulnerability Central security monitoring room Plant.png|Planting location at the server racks
patch-the-vulnerability.briefing: Hello. You've undoubtedly heard what's been happening at TerraGroup's underground facility beneath the city. I never thought I'd be asking you to do this, but… we need to eliminate this vulnerability and reinforce the laboratory's security protocols. If we don't intervene, countless PMC mercenaries and bandits could unknowingly walk out of that facility carrying extremely dangerous materials. It's happened before, and Tarkov has never truly recovered from the consequences. Restoring keycard-only access is the safer options. I've already asked Elektronik for help, but without a stable connection to the facility's secure network, we won't be able to make any changes. I need you to attach these remote intrusion devices to any electronic systems that may be tied into the laboratory's security infrastructure. Don't waste your time in the server room. We already know we can't modify the security protocols from there. And if you encounter the soldiers in black, do what you can to disrupt their work. They may have ties to TerraGroup, and I doubt that bodes well for any of us.

pathfinder.briefing: You scared off some Scavs at Ultra once, remember, brother? Now people say it’s getting worse. Word is it’s crawling with all sorts of scum. Got a task for you: check out the situation on Interchange, make sure it's clear to walk around at least. Find safe paths or something. I really need it to go smoothly, okay?
