objectives.text: Locate and eliminate Glukhar
Eliminate 6 of Glukhar's guards
Shoot a yellow signal flare at the radar station
Survive and extract from Reserve through Cliff Descent

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of DevTac Ronin Respirator at Ragman LL4

payback.guide: In this quest you have to kill Glukhar and 6 of his guards. Next, you have to shoot a yellow flare into the sky while being at the radar station area on Reserve. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which can be bought at Prapor LL1 or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. Afterwards, you have to extract via the "Cliff Descent" extraction. To use it, a Red Rebel ice pick and Paracord are required and you must not wear any Armor vest. File:PaybackFlareMap.png|Flare area marked on map
payback.briefing: Well, the situation became plain enough. This group of hotshots is, as it turns out, run by Glukhar, an ex-marine who settled at the Reserve base with his crew. That's where he took the documents you planted. Who'd have thought he'd have the nerve to undermine me? Well, he signed his own sentence. Hunt them down and settle the matter. When it's done, give a signal with a flare rocket from high ground, and I'll send men to their lair to sort out their junk. We need to find out what else they've been digging up. As soon as you've fired the signal, you take the shortest possible route straight to me.

Hand over the found item

It can be found either in the central control station room, in the overseeing cabin in the engine room, or in the automation room under the engine room. ====Central control station room - Level 0==== File:Peaceful Atom Control Room Map.jpg|Room location marked on map File:Peaceful Atom Control Room Spawn.png|The log on one of the tables ====Overseeing cabin in the engine room - Level -2==== File:Peaceful Atom Overseeing Cabin Map.jpg|Cabin location marked on map File:Peaceful Atom Automation Room Code Room.png|The cabin File:Peaceful Atom Overseeing Cabin Spawn.png|The log on the shelf ====Automation room under the engine room - Level -3==== This room requires a code to be entered. The code can be found in a nearby overseeing cabin on a pinboard. The code changes every raid. peaceful-atom.briefing: Greetings. I have an urgent assignment for you. You are not yet aware of the situation, so I will need to provide some context. However, everything I am about to disclose is top secret, understood? There is a secured facility within the blockade perimeter that is of interest to my contacts in the nuclear energy sector. The issue is that it is an icebreaker ship, currently stranded in the bay. To access it, you will need to acquire suitable transport, and it is preferable to do so quietly. No one must know that the vessel is present in Tarkov's waters at all! Once you secure transport, you are to retrieve operational documentation from the ship. Search the engineering sections, there should be a logbook for the nuclear power unit control system. Do not, under any circumstances, disclose this task to anyone.

objectives.text: Eliminate 12 Scavs while using a UNTAR helmet, MF-UNTAR armor, and 5.56 UN weapons on Woods or Reserve
Eliminate 12 Scavs while using a UNTAR helmet, MF-UNTAR armor, and 5.56 UN weapons on Customs or Lighthouse
Eliminate 12 Scavs while using a UNTAR helmet, MF-UNTAR armor, and 5.56 UN weapons on Shoreline or Streets of Tarkov
Eliminate 12 Scavs while using a UNTAR helmet, MF-UNTAR armor, and 5.56 UN weapons on Ground Zero or Interchange

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for Desert Tech MDR 7.62x51 assault rifle at Peacekeeper LL4
Unlocks barter for Cult Locust ballistic plate at Skier LL4

peacekeeping-mission.guide: The specified UNTAR armor needs to be used while making the Scav kills with an 5.56 UN weapon. You can modify the weapons and bring additional items to what is required. If you lose the initial set of gear, you can purchase all the specified gear from Peacekeeper. You can use any of the following: * Colt M4A1 5.56x45 assault rifle * Colt M16A1 5.56x45 assault rifle * Colt M16A2 5.56x45 assault rifle
peacekeeping-mission.briefing: Have you seen the news? Recently, media have been pushing the agenda that "the Blue Helmets are not doing their job in Tarkov, do not follow the procedures" and so forth... Those damn bastards, kurwa! I hate these journalist scumbags. We are one step away from losing financing, which, my friend, is the opposite of profitable for us. So, we need to convince the public that the helmets are actually doing what they promised to do. You must address the issue of eliminating the illegal bandit group activities but do so under the UN flag. I’ll give you the initial set of equipment you'll need, but if you lose it, don't come asking for more.

objectives.text: Eliminate 150 enemies in any game mode

pecunia-non-olet.briefing: Looks like someone's in a gloomy mood. Where's the fire in your eyes? You and I are making so much money here that you can forget about your stupid raids and unnecessary risks. You gotta realize that income could disappear any moment. Particularly juicy money comes from sponsorship of favorites. And the favorites come and go. Or rather, they die. Hell, just think of all the hard work it took to get your name out there. I consider you the best of the best. Fill the Arena with blood, just like the old days!

perfect-mediator.briefing: Hey there, come in. Well, as you can see, it's rough times now, you can trust nobody. There are traitors and moles in every corner possible, but as far as I can see you are a good soldier, proven in action, so I can count on you. Now, I need to send some info from time to time and I need an appropriate person for this, someone who's trusted not only by me but by everyone else too. Speak with other traders, earn their trust. Will be beneficial for both of us.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 Scavs inside the main barracks on Reserve

pest-control.guide: In this quest you have to kill 10 Scavs inside, or in the close proximity of the black and white pawn barrack buildings. Getting tagged and cursed on purpose can help with getting Scavs in the quest area. File:pestcontrol.png|Kill area marked on map
pest-control.briefing: Come in, have a seat. You know how angry the local scum makes me, especially the damn looters, I can't stand them. Somebody steals from others to survive, but some do it for profit, and there are especially plenty of the latter ones in Tarkov. Take the military base, for example, I've been there before this whole conflict, it was such a beautiful sight: everything is clean, in order, the ground is almost glittering under the sun. And now the whole place is filled with all sorts of scum and marauders. I have a request for you: go there and let those looters know that you have to stay human in any situation.

pets-won-t-need-it.briefing: In these difficult times, finding the necessary chemicals has become extremely challenging. For a long time now, I've been taking whatever I can find without being selective, but even with that approach, our options are becoming more and more limited. I recently sent my people into the city to check several locations where supplies might still remain, but they weren't able to reach them. You, however... I believe you're capable of handling this task. Head downtown and search several locations: pharmacies, the vet clinic, and the workplace of a radiologist. There may still be something left there. Bring whatever you find back to me, and I'll purchase it from you. And remember, by doing this, you're helping the civilians who have suffered so much.

pets-won-t-need-it-part-2.briefing: Hello, young man. I need your help. What we found at the vet clinic and the x-ray office was not enough. Our next target is pharmacies. There were plenty of them around the city, so I don't think the thieves had time to take everything. Check out the pharmacies for me, then I'll send my men over. I know of at least three. See what condition they're in.

A Dorm room 114 key is required to enter it. File:Pharmacist Customs.png|2 story dorms and room 114 marked on map File:Carbon Case Location.png|The carbon case on the safe
pharmacist.briefing: I want to ask you for a service. Don't put up that look, of course, it's not for free! In a small dorm, yes, the one inhabited by those bandits, somewhere on the first floor used to live a young paramedic from the factory. Unfortunately, I do not know the room number - when my colleagues and I were his guests on the Medical Worker Day, it was already dark, and in the middle of a party, you see. Well, he was a young specialist, still an intern, but very enthusiastic. Planned to enroll in the Military Medical Academy in St. Petersburg. And in his safe, right there in the room, he kept a case with the particular new medical device. Issued to him by the employer. He tried to get out of town on his blue VAZ 2109 with St. Petersburg plates. I don't know if he managed to get out or not, but as far as I have heard, he either got stuck near the gas station or apprehended by the military. In any case, I could really put that tool to good use. Come the darkest hour, and you might need it as well. Not that I wish for that to happen, don’t get me wrong, but... I assume you understand everything better than I. I need you to find it. Oh yes, I almost forgot, we have common interests with Arshavir in this matter. He has a good product for you. After you complete the task, of course.

photo-hunt.briefing: Hey. A little birdie told me we've got some goddamn competition. They found out about our job somehow, now they want more information! Tarkov's like a tiny village, everybody knows everything about everything. It always pissed me off. Anyway, it's photo hunting season. We should put up cameras to catch the assholes. At the city center, that's where these guys were last seen.

It is recommended to repair them in separate raids, carrying the toolsets in your secure container. If you have a Secure container Epsilon or a Secure container Theta, you can safely place 2 per raid. playing-the-market.briefing: The other day, someone has decided to crash the market by unloading a thick wad of bitcoins. So thick that TARGox started accepting bids 10 times cheaper than the market value. Bids queue kept going while being constantly replenished with even cheaper bids. I managed to buy a couple of hundreds by chance. And today the price is back to normal as if nothing had happened. We need to get into that action while the market is being controlled like this. You already know the Factory well, there are some control boards there. To find them, look for the red emergency lights. Take a couple of toolsets and repair the panels. I'll work on the cooling system in the meantime.

objectives.text: Locate the poisoned area on Customs
Install a gas analyzer

poisoning.guide: The poisoned area is located on the eastern side of the river at Customs, north of the main bridge around a blue shipping container. The gas analyzer needs to be placed at the container. Wearing a GP-5 gas mask or a GP-7 gas mask is required to enter the area without getting damage. You will be inflicted with Unknown toxin poisoning upon entering the area even when wearing a mask. This is intended and can only be cured with Antitoxin. File:Poisoning Quest Map.png|Shipping container marked on map File:Poisoning Quest Location.png|The shipping container File:Poisoning Quest Location 2.jpg|Placement location at the container
poisoning.briefing: Good afternoon, young man. More and more patients come to me with abnormal fevers. I've never seen anything like this in my practice, but the symptoms are somewhat similar to poisoning. All the patients are from the Customs industrial area. Look for the source of where it originated. If you see anything suspicious, set up a gas analyzer to collect data. Then give me the coordinates of the location. My men will pick up the device later.

objectives.text: Eliminate 25 Scavs on Interchange, Ground Zero or Woods (This objective progress counts for all group members)

polikhim-hobo.guide: Enter Interchange, Ground Zero or Woods and kill 25 Scavs.
polikhim-hobo.briefing: The bum from Polikhim? What am I, the bloody king of every stray in Tarkov now?! Alright, I know who you're talking about, same as everyone else who's lived here. He wasn't a bad bloke, but he lost the plot when all this mess kicked off. You're looking for him, are you? I can help you out, but not out of the goodness of my heart. The Scavs have been getting under my feet lately, making things difficult. Go give them a proper scare, and then I'll tell you what I know. Here's the list of places that need clearing.

requirements: Must be level 12 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Obtain the journal containing resident details on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the journal

population-census.guide: In this quest you have to find a journal in the housing department building on Streets of Tarkov. There are multiple spawns throughout the building. File:PopulationCensusMap.png|Housing department marked on map File:PopulationCensusBuilding.png|Housing department building backside with entrance ===First floor=== ====First spawn==== Inside the second office to the right after entering, in the left bottom compartment of the shelf. File:Hall1.png File:Spawn1.png ====Second spawn==== Inside the third office to the right, on the desk with the lamp. File:PopulationCensusThirdOfficeRightLampDesk.png File:Populationcensus3spawn.png ====Third spawn==== At the reception next to the stairs, on a shelf behind the counter. File:PopCenStaircase.png File:PopCenDiary1.png ====Fourth spawn==== Inside the last office on the left side of the hallway, on the right side desk. File:PopulationCensusLastOfficeLeftDeskSpawn.png File:Spawn2.png ===Second floor=== ====Fifth spawn==== Inside the left unlocked office, underneath the desk with the fallen bookcase against it. File:ArchiveRoomStaircase.png File:PopulationCensusSecondFloorUnderFallenShelf.png File:PopCens 5th Spawn.png
population-census.briefing: Good afternoon, mercenary. You're just in time, I have an errand for you. I need to determine how many people have gone missing in the city. To do this, I need a list of all the residents of the city and subtract the already evacuated, the dead, and those who found shelter in the hospital. Your task is to find that list of residents. Bring me the journal from Primorsky District's Housing Department.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the helicopter logbook on Factory
Hand over the found information

possessor.guide: The logbook is located in the cockpit of the crashed helicopter under the roof on Factory, below the pilot seat. File:Possessor Map.jpg|Helicopter location marked on map File:Possessor Location 3.png|Helicopter as seen from the ground, emitting a red light File:Possessor Location 1.png|The helicopter in the rafters File:Possessor Location 2.png|The logbook under the pilot seat
possessor.briefing: Hey, warrior! You've probably seen a crashed chopper at the factory before, yeah? I wonder when and how it ended up there. But I know one thing for sure: they never sent helis to Tarkov to pick up anyone, neither before nor now. We should find out who was on that helicopter and what was their mission. You should go scout that heli. There's gotta be a logbook or something.

requirements: Obtain level 2 loyalty with Prapor.

objectives.text: Obtain the letter on the messenger's body on Factory
Survive and extract from the location
Hand over the letter to Therapist

postman-pat-part-1.guide: The messenger body is located in a bunker on the main floor of Factory. For orientation, the number "1986" can be seen painted above the bunker on the wall. The letter can be found next to the body on the ground. The letter must be handed over to Therapist for the quest Postman Pat - Part 2 before this quest can be completed. File:PostmanPat1 Factory.png|Bunker location marked on map File:PostmanPatLocation.png|The wanted bunker, "1986" on the wall above it File:Postman Pat Letter Location.png|The letter on the ground
postman-pat-part-1.briefing: Come on in, make yourself at home. How's the life of constant battle? No extra preternatural holes in your hide? Jolly good. No freaking use for them, eh? I’m in a bit of a tight unpleasant spot here. Will you help me out? My messenger vanished. I entrusted a job for this local waste of skin, he played so tough. In short, I’ve sent a little note to Therapist with some proposals for a mutually beneficial cooperation. Nothing special, but nothing outsiders should know either. And so this meat sack went missing, and a little bird told me that this postman got whacked somewhere in the Factory. Why the heck would he go there, that moron? Told him to take the straight path. So anyway, find the body and check it, my scribbles might still be there. And if by some miracle they are, hand them to that medic woman, will ya?

objectives.text: Hand over the letter from Prapor's messenger

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Salewa first aid kit at Therapist LL1

postman-pat-part-2.guide: The messenger body is located in a bunker on the main floor of Factory. For orientation, the number "1986" can be seen painted above the bunker on the wall. The letter can be found next to the body on the ground. Completing this quest fulfils the objective for Postman Pat - Part 1. File:PostmanPat1 Factory.png|Bunker location marked on map File:PostmanPatLocation.png|The wanted bunker, "1986" on the wall above it File:Postman Pat Letter Location.png|The letter on the ground
postman-pat-part-2.briefing: Good afternoon. Prapor told me that you are the one who will help us to reconnect and find the lost letter. Great! I will be waiting.

objectives.text: Hand over a Lega Medal to Ref

postponed-reward.briefing: Well, you fucked up with the evidence in a very embarrassing way, but sure, I'll keep my word. I'll get you your fucking container. But now I'm gonna ask you for something else, since things got so ugly.

requirements: Must be level 22 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 20 PMCs using an MP5SD on Streets of Tarkov, Ground Zero or Interchange

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of 9x21mm BT gzh at Prapor LL3

power-of-persuasion.guide: The following parts are required to be on an MP5 for it to qualify for this quest: * HK MP5SD 9x19 upper receiver * HK MP5SD 9x19 sound suppressor * HK MP5SD polymer handguard
power-of-persuasion.briefing: Greetings! Well, let's get it going, are you excited? The task is quite specific, we need to test a certain SMG for close combat in urban environment. I have customers who don't believe in the effectiveness of this toy... Can you change their minds?

objectives.text: Eliminate 12 Scavs at Skier's charity checkpoints

preemptive-strike.guide: In this quest you have to kill 12 Scavs at Skier's charity checkpoints. They are located on Shoreline, Customs and Woods. ===Shoreline=== In and around the smuggler base in the northeast. File:A New Hope Map.jpg|Smuggler base location marked on map ===Customs=== In and around the Scav base (ZB-013 extraction) building. File:Preemptive Strike Customs Map.png|Kill area marked on map ===Woods=== In and around the antenna (Scav Bunker extraction) and the container camp in the northwest. File:Down the Rabbit Hole Part 1 map.jpg|Scav bunker and container camp marked on map
preemptive-strike.briefing: I already know what's going on, no need to tell me. Elvira is "doing what's best for people" again, obviously up to something again... But those who are thinking about working for Skier have already shown their weakness. In these situations, fear works much better than charity handouts. I've asked Partisan to look at those checkpoints. There are four places: Emercom camp at the military base, the flooded village near the water treatment plant, the old cattle farm near the health resort, and some kind of construction site near the customs district, which my comrade couldn't get to. They are going to bring supplies and the recruited people there. The recruiters themselves are already in place, they don't differ from the usual Skier's mob. Partisan has other things to do right now, no less important. That's why we need your help: remove the recruiters at their gathering points. That way the residents will think three times before coming there for aid.

objectives.text: Eliminate 25 infected while using pistols or revolvers on Factory

pressured-by-circumstances.guide: In this quest you have to kill 25 infected on Factory while using a pistol or a revolver. File:InfectedPMC.png|Infected PMC
pressured-by-circumstances.briefing: It's tough everywhere right now, I know. Have you ever been fascinated by this human ability to adapt to any condition? I think it's what made man the pinnacle of evolution. But to feel like you're slowly getting used to the crowds of infected people in your hometown... It makes me sick. The demand for firearms has increased tremendously, and I'm thinking that if this epidemic drags on, there will be only handguns left in the stockpiles. Can you test to see how effective they are in the current environment?

requirements: Must be level 35 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find 1 Ophthalmoscope in raid
Find 1 LEDX Skin Transilluminator in raid
Hand over the 1 Ophthalmoscope
Hand over the 1 LEDX Skin Transilluminator

rewards.text: 1× T H I C C item case
1× Health Resort east wing room 306 key

private-clinic.briefing: Good day, young man. As a doctor, I think that the Hippocratic oath must be respected even in such a difficult time. So, I have got an idea to open a clinic. Health care is always important and even more so in these circumstances. But where do I get the necessary equipment? I will give you a list of what I need you to bring. And I don't need competition, so make sure you complete the job with no third parties involved. Of course, I will find a way to reward you for your work.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain Skier's wallet on Customs
Hand over the found item

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for Saiga-12K 12ga automatic shotgun at Skier LL4

private-club.guide: In this quest you have to find Skier's wallet on Customs. It can be found in a room on the second floor of Warehouse 17. There are multiple spawns throughout the room. File:Warehouse17Map.png|Warehouse 17 location marked on map File:Warehouse17.png|Warehouse 17 southern entrance File:Private Club Way.png|Way to the room on the second floor File:Private Club Door.png|Door to the room File:Private Club Spawn 1.png|First spawn on the floor under the shelf next to the door File:Private Club Spawn 2.png|Second spawn on the floor under the table File:Private Club Spawn 3.png|Third spawn on the table File:Private Club Spawn 4.png|Fourth spawn behind the TV on the desk
private-club.briefing: Opachki, would you look at this little character. You got any ibuprofen? My noggin's fucking killing me. What, something wrong, princess? Yes, I got hammered last night, so what? It was a major league game! They wouldn't let a twat like you anywhere near that table. Sometimes we get together to test our luck, but yesterday clearly wasn't my day. Not only did I lose a shitload of money, but also my fucking wallet. You're here for work, ye? Here, I'll give you a fucking job. Find my wallet. And don't even try any bullshit, I'd recognize mine with my eyes closed. You may still be young and don't realize it, but there are things in life worth more than cash.

objectives.text: Plant or deactivate the device 3 times in BlastGang mode

professional-part-1.briefing: Being a champion is cool, but "warm-up champion" sounds pretty sad, don’t you think? Time to go pro. And pros play for real money, in serious fights where the stakes are higher. Go on, get used to that level.

objectives.text: Win a match claiming at least 4th place in the team in BlastGang or TeamFight mode

professional-part-2.briefing: Here's a little truth for you: serious money and a reputation don't come just from showing up to the top matches. No solid results, no solid cash. So come on, get moving.

objectives.text: Earn a Round MVP in BlastGang or TeamFight mode

professional-part-3.briefing: I might disappoint you, but people talk about a lot of gladiators, not just you. In this business, you have to stay in the spotlight, or no one will remember you a week later. For now, though, you just need to claw your way up... Make a name for yourself so there's something to build the muscles of your fame on. Damn, that sounded good, didn't it? I should write that down.

objectives.text: Play a match in CheckPoint or Last Hero mode in Arena

rewards.text: 10 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
12 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2

professional-fitness-part-1.briefing: So, you ready to prove your professional chops? I'm not going to go too hard on you, don't sweat it. For starters, just step onto the Arena. Yeah, that's all, no extra tasks. Just soak in the atmosphere!

objectives.text: Eliminate 20 enemies in Arena

rewards.text: 16 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
17 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2

professional-fitness-part-2.briefing: Ready to keep going? Of course it's not over, what else did you expect? We're not messing around here, I take this seriously. So, you've smelled gunpowder, now you need to prove to me that you can kill. A lot. And, preferably, make it look good. So, you ready? Alright, I'll be keeping an eye on you in the Arena.

objectives.text: Hand over the item: 30 Graphics card
Hand over the item: 15 Physical Bitcoin

profit-retention.briefing: So you're a true field surgeon now, huh? Well, good for you. I've never liked books, much less reading other people's scribbles, I find it hard to understand. It's time to take dividends on our business! Luka and his boys repelled those thugs, he said it was a tough fight. And guess what, there's still no sign of the military, the thugs were definitely in on it with them. I guess you can find someone like our Prapor even beyond the cordon, huh? The only issues left are the good ones. They're ready to send a shipment from the other side, but it doesn't fit any of the old schemes. It's a wagonload of equipment! To get it all out, my mate demands a special fee, all in advance. The risks are too fucking high, so we have to pay. This bastard's got a bitcoin farm over there, I reckon.

requirements: Must be level 61 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Hand over 15 Trijicon REAP-IR thermal scopes

profitable-venture.briefing: Remember the first time you came to me looking for work? You've gotten smarter since then, and you've helped me out more than once. Now I have a potentially very lucrative business opportunity. But I need a reliable partner, and you could become that partner. There's a squad commander guy who's been talking to me, he's got his own team, some veterans and shit. Thing is, the lads were out of the cordon when all the war shit started. They want to do work, and they say they have a tip on an abandoned USEC base in the region. The problem is, some pricks have already taken it over. If we do everything right, Luka and his boys will be able to provide us with equipment and other goods that are in short supply here. No one in Tarkov has a force like this! They want to scout at night so they don't cause a commotion. You know, it's a quiet area, and many things could go wrong if they get spotted. However, the lads don't have any thermals, so they asked me to get some from here. If you want to get into this business, now's the time!

objectives.text: Hand over the drive with the game

progression-difficulties-part-1.briefing: Hello again. Did you play it? How was it? I hope we didn't waste our time looking for that game. Huh? You're stuck? A password? Just look in the game bro. Nothing? Hm... Alright. Hand me the disk. I'll look again on the phone and the diary. There might be something.

requirements: Unlocks 2 hours after completion of Progression Difficulties - Part 1

objectives.text: Hand over the item: Decrypted intelligence folder

progression-difficulties-part-2.guide: In this quest you have to hand over the Decrypted intelligence folder to Mechanic. To obtain it, multiple military thumb drives need to be decrypted at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout. It is possible that the decryption process fails and yields no progress at all, making the total amount of required thumb drives variable.
progression-difficulties-part-2.briefing: So, I progressed to the same stage you did. Honestly? It feels weird. It's like it's all done on purpose. Like there's a hidden layer, you know? My friend clearly went missing for a reason. And it seems like some pretty powerful people had a hand in it. I think he knew what was coming, so he set up these fool traps in his game. Looks like they tried to smuggle it out of Tarkov along with the military records. They were transferred to flash drives and encrypted. Find a few of those flash drives, and decrypt the data. It'll have the word you're looking for. And something important to me.

objectives.text: Eliminate PMC operatives at the smuggler's camp while wearing an ARENA armband on Shoreline
Eliminate PMC operatives at the dorms while wearing an ARENA armband on Customs
Eliminate PMC operatives at the EMERCOM camp while wearing an ARENA armband on Woods

rewards.text: 78 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
86 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2

project-of-the-century-consequences.guide: PvP: In this quest you have to kill as many PMCs as you can or want at the dorms on Customs, at the smuggler camp on Shoreline and at the EMERCOM camp on Woods, while wearing an Armband (ARENA). PvE: In this quest you have to kill as many PMCs as you can or want anywhere on Customs, Shoreline or Woods, while wearing an Armband (ARENA). File:Shoreline Smuggler Base Map.png|Smuggler's camp location on Shoreline File:Every Man for Himself Map.png|Dorms location on Customs File:Woods Capturing Outposts Location.png|EMERCOM camp location on Woods
project-of-the-century-consequences.briefing: I've already given you your assignment, but there's something else. Killing a few of those pricks won't stop them from coming back. We've got to stay ahead of them and keep the pressure on. If you're willing to help, your gun won't go to waste. Take out as many as you can. The faster we clear the area, the sooner we can get the fights underway. And hey, same rules as before: wear the armband, and don't shoot your own people!

objectives.text: Eliminate 2 PMC operatives at the EMERCOM camp while wearing an ARENA armband on Woods
Eliminate 2 PMC operatives at the smuggler's camp while wearing an ARENA armband on Shoreline
Eliminate 2 PMC operatives at the dorms while wearing an ARENA armband on Customs

rewards.text: 79 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
86 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2

230 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2

project-of-the-century-finale.guide: PvP: In this quest you have to kill 2 PMCs each at the dorms on Customs, at the smuggler camp on Shoreline and at the EMERCOM camp on Woods, while wearing an Armband (ARENA). PvE: In this quest you have to kill 2 PMCs each anywhere on Customs, Shoreline or Woods, while wearing an Armband (ARENA). File:Woods Capturing Outposts Location.png|EMERCOM camp location on Woods File:Shoreline Smuggler Base Map.png|Smuggler's camp location on Shoreline File:Every Man for Himself Map.png|Dorms location on Customs
project-of-the-century-finale.briefing: Tell me something, why the hell are these locals so attached to their ruins, huh? We could all be making money together instead of wasting time on this nonsense... Problems have popped up at all three construction sites, and now Skier's started stirring things up too. Then again, I never really trusted that alliance in the first place. I'm not stupid. Time to go back to the old reliable methods. You already know where my camps are. Jaeger's been sending his wookie warriors after them, and we need to hit back hard enough that they run straight back into the bushes. And remember, you can actually influence how quickly we get these venues up and running! I've hired a few other professionals for this job as well, so try not to shoot them. Put on one of our armbands too, so the boys know you're friendly. And remember: if you start backing the forester, I'll find out immediately.

requirements: This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

objectives.text: Stash a Golden rooster figurine at Prapor's WI-FI Camera on Woods
Stash a Golden rooster figurine at Prapor's WI-FI Camera on Shoreline
Stash a Golden rooster figurine at Prapor's WI-FI Camera on Factory

proper-comeback.guide: In this quest you have to place 1 Golden rooster figurine each on Woods, Shoreline and Factory. The locations are the same as in the previous quest Viewer from Prapor. (These are 40 second plant times.) On Woods it has to be placed next to a tree at a rock ledge on the mountain. File:Viewer Woodsmap.png|Location marked on map File:ViewerWoodsLocationOverview.png|Placement location surroundings File:ViewerWoodsLocation.png|Placement location On Shoreline it has to be placed at the top of the lighthouse near the pier. File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 19 Lighthouse Map.jpg|Lighthouse location marked on map File:Lighthouse.png|The lighthouse On Factory it has to be placed at the top of the office area stairs that are on the "Gate 3" extraction side, opposite the door to the catwalk. Note: Can not be completed at night at the current time. File:ViewerFactoryLocation.png|Placement location
proper-comeback.briefing: You're a good guy, I'll tell you that. I wouldn't trust another man to do this, but you're an experienced fellow, you understand what I'm saying. I heard that Prapor is now into modern technology, and he's got cameras everywhere, watching everything from his man cave. And recently he ruined one of my deals, started yelling like a damn rooster, something about the rules of trade and military order... We have to show him what a motherfucker he's become. Oops, sorry for the offensive language. Hope it doesn't disrespect your community guidelines.

objectives.text: Locate the real estate fund on Streets of Tarkov
Locate and obtain the Tarkov real estate transactions document
Hand over the obtained information

In this quest you have to find cadastral registry records in the real estate agency building on Streets of Tarkov. There are multiple spawns throughout the building. A Real estate agency office room key is required to access 2 of the 6 possible spawns in the locked office. File:Properties All Around Map.png|Building location marked on map File:Properties All Around Building.png|The real estate agency building ===First floor=== ====First spawn==== Inside the left side office, in the middle compartment of the shelf to the right after entering through the door. File:Properties All Around Spawn 1.png ====Second spawn==== Inside the left side office, in the back right corner tucked under a red file folder on the floor. File:Properties All Around Spawn 2.png ===Second floor=== ====Third spawn==== Inside the right side office, in the middle compartment of the second shelf to the right after entering. File:Properties All Around Spawn 3.png ====Fourth spawn==== Inside the right side office, in the top compartment of the small shelf in the back right corner. File:Properties All Around Spawn 4.png ====Fifth spawn==== Inside the left side locked office, in the middle compartment of the shelf to the right after entering. File:Properties All Around Spawn 5.png ====Sixth spawn==== Inside the left side locked office, on the shelf in the back right corner. File:Properties All Around Spawn 6.png
properties-all-around.briefing: Heyo, soldier! I've got a little job for you, easy as always. You probably know that TerraGroup acted honorably at first: they filed official requests, compiled documents, paid taxes, all this crap. It's only later that they went off the motherfucking rails. I have a feeling that the city's real estate fund may have kept records of the facilities bought or leased by those fucks. If you poke around, you might find something interesting. I'll bet it'll uncover a lot of hidden assets. You up for it?

objectives.text: Locate the package in the specified spot on Woods
Hand over the package

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Aklys Defense Velociraptor .300 Blackout assault rifle at Mechanic LL4

protect-the-sky.guide: The quest Simple Side Job from Lightkeeper will automatically fail if this quest is completed first. *This item will only appear in your next Woods raid after accepting this quest. In this quest you have to find a KOSA UAV electronic jamming device on Woods. There are multiple spawns at a gravesite south of the dilapidated village in the north. File:Protect the Sky Map.png|Gravesite location marked on map File:Protect the Sky Spawn 1.png|Spawn 1 next to the stretchers File:Protect the Sky Spawn 2.png|Spawn 2 in the supply crate File:Protect the Sky Spawn 3.png|Spawn 3 next to the supply crate File:Protect the Sky Spawn 4.png|Spawn 4 in the bushes towards the lake File:Protect the Sky Spawn 5.png|Spawn 5 in the green crate
protect-the-sky.briefing: You weren't being tailed, were you? Skier is definitely up to something. I'm even afraid to sleep in the BTR now! But I can't back down now. I've started setting up a new base, and this time I want to build a solid defense. Someone's willing to provide me with a decent electronic jamming system. We've already settled the payment, it's just a matter of delivering the package to me. They picked an unusual place for the transfer: a cemetery in the forest. It's not big, but you'll find it no problem. There's a stretcher and bodies lying around near it. Can you get the package from the stash? Oh, but don't go straight there from here. Go to your base, take a breather, and then go to the stash from there. Can't let anyone find out about my new purchase.

objectives.text: Eliminate 3 PMC operatives on Streets of Tarkov
Do not kill Gus or Basmach while the quest is active

protection-of-interests.guide: In this quest you must eliminate 3 PMCs on Streets of Tarkov without killing Kaban's bodyguards Gus and Basmach. Killing them will cause the quest to fail. Gus and Basmach are found at the premises of the LexOs car dealership. File:KabanSpawnsStreets.png|LexOs location marked on map
protection-of-interests.briefing: Heyo, warrior! I heard about our western colleague and his so-called "investigation". The USEC deserters decided to sell used guns and got in touch with the Scavs. They say it were Kaban's boys who set Peacekeeper up. Trouble for him, but huge profit for me! The only problem is that he found out about Gus and Basmach, and now he wants to take them out. Listen, I don't really like those thugs, but they're very useful to my business. Be a good lad, go help those boys out, will you?

objectives.text: Stash the Radar station spare parts inside the old sawmill hangar on Woods
Stash the GARY ZONT portable electronic warfare device inside the weather station tower on Shoreline

provide-cover.guide: In this quest you have to stash Radar station spare parts on Woods and a GARY ZONT portable electronic warfare device on Shoreline. ===Woods stashing location=== The spare parts have to be stashed inside a barn at the old sawmill in the east of the location. File:Provide Cover Woods Map.png|Barn location marked on map File:Provide Cover Woods Building.png|The wanted barn File:Provide Cover Woods Stashing Spot.png|Stashing spot ===Shoreline stashing location=== The device has to be stashed in the cabin at the top of the weather station tower. File:Provide Cover Shoreline Map.png|Tower location marked on map File:Provide Cover Shoreline Building.png|The wanted tower File:Provide Cover Shoreline Stashing Spot.png|Stashing spot
provide-cover.briefing: This whole trader thing is going pretty well for me, wouldn't you say? You know, If I didn't have my wits about me, I'd be dead in this hellhole a long time ago. Anyway, I'll deal with the reports later, not the first time. Right now, I need to equip the guys posted outside my territory. Bring them this new equipment we found. I'll give you a part of it, but the rest you need to get yourself - you already know where to look. No, you won't meet them face to face. Just stash the items in the designated spot.

provide-viewership.briefing: Greetings, gladiator! Judging by the fact that you're still in one piece, you've developed a good skill set. That's exactly what I need. Arena fights are thriving, but you know the human nature. The audience gets used to everything and will always ask for more! So I've come up with something more interesting. I want to broadcast the fights in real Tarkov conditions for a group of special customers. You need to set up a camera and then show them what you're made of. You can put the camera on some building near the construction site at customs. I don't care who's in your crosshairs. You yourself are the centerpiece of this show! People will cheer for you and pay good money for it. Of course, I've taken your commitment into account, so expect a reward.

requirements: Unlocks 10 hours after completion of Payback

Afterwards you have to stash a sausage, a bottle of moonshine and toilet paper in the designated locations. ====Kiba store kill area==== The kills can be done in the parking garage, as well as on the first and second floor. File:ProvocationKiba.png|Kill area marked on map ====Sausage placement location==== The Salty Dog beef sausage has to be placed at a wooden crate in the fenced off area inside the Kiba Arms store on the first floor of the mall. provocation.briefing: Time is of the essence. My cleaner crew found evidence of Glukhar's connection to the arms development that took place under the aegis of TerraGroup. The next task for you is to provoke Glukhar's contacts into doing something foolish. They probably don't know yet that Glukhar is no longer available. Go to Ultra, TerraGroup has had a staging post there since the early days. Make a mess of it, make a show of it. Use the trophy you took from the bull's body. And for the particularly savvy, leave something humiliating in place to say hello, so to speak. The mutts must know their place.

requirements: Must be level 27 to start this quest.
Obtain level 4 loyalty with Mechanic

objectives.text: Eliminate any 15 targets without dying while using a bolt-action rifle

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of 4.6x30mm FMJ SX at Mechanic LL4

psycho-sniper.guide: The kill objective can still fail through dying after completing it.
psycho-sniper.briefing: Hello, mercenary. I had an acquaintance named Dima. He worked as a sniper in many hot zones. Once he told me: "Anyone can pull a trigger, but only a few can become a true Sniper". Even if that's true, knowing how to work with bolt-action rifles won't hurt in Tarkov. And I don't mind encouraging you to develop that skill. Take out your opponents, and I'll reward you for it.

objectives.text: Locate Sanitar's letter on Shoreline
Hand over the letter

pursuit-of-power.guide: The letter is located on Shoreline in one of three locations: In the store at the port/pier area, at the hydroelectric power station or in the garden of the locked cottage. File:PursuitOfPowerMap.png|Locations marked on map File:PoPPierLetter.png|The letter in the store at the port/pier area File:PoPHEPSLetter.png|The letter at the hydroelectric power station File:PoPCottageLetter.png|The letter in the garden of the locked cottage
pursuit-of-power.briefing: Good afternoon, young man. My men have reported that Sanitar is trying to expand his influence by speculating on of poisoning. Currently, he's the only one with an antidote, so he's taking advantage of his position. But his supply is obviously not endless, so he's sent a gang to search for resources. This is our chance to learn more and speed up the drug's production. According to my intel, Sanitar is leaving instructions for his men on Shoreline at three locations: some diner in the docks, hydroelectric plant, and an unspecified location near the cottages. Please go to these locations and search for information. We could benefit greatly from it.

requirements: Obtain level 3 loyalty with Peacekeeper

Note: Only the ATMs located at marker no. 2 and 3 from the below map can currently be marked. File:Pyramid Scheme Map.png|ATM locations marked on map File:Pyramid Scheme Location 2.png|Map marker no. 2 Group of ATMs on Klimov Street File:Pyramid Scheme Location 3.png|Map marker no. 3 ATM on Klimov Street
pyramid-scheme.briefing: Well-well, look who showed up. Right on time, like you knew I needed you! I've got a proper movie-style job for us. We're robbing banks! Well, ATMs, to be precise. There used to be loads of them scattered around the city. Most of them were on Klimov Street and in the Klimov Mall. Head over there and have a look around. Maybe not all of them have been cleaned out yet.

requirements: This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

Hand over the found item

quality-standard.guide: In this quest you have to find the LEDX Skin Transilluminator (US Version) in The Lab. It is located on top of a blue barrel inside the orange dome in the main working area (O11) on the first level. File:Quality Standard Yellow Dome Map.png|Dome location marked on map File:Quality Standard Yellow Dome.png|The dome File:Quality Standard Yellow Dome Spawn.png|US LEDX on a blue barrel
quality-standard.briefing: Good afternoon. I've learned that comrade Prapor has become nostalgic lately. Although I can't find time for such things myself, your and Prapor's affairs have brought me to a good idea. When the locals found out about TerraGroup's underground laboratory, there was quite a stir! It was a breakthrough for my business, the lab is where I got my unique equipment from. Well, there may still be some original American leftover LEDX from back then. Can you get me one of those? It would really help our cause.

Spread the vaccine on Customs

Spread the vaccine on The Lab

radical-treatment.briefing: The vaccine you found is a real treasure! With the help of my former TerraGroup colleague, we managed to finalize the formula. Unfortunately, administering the drug is fatal along with neutralizing the virus. This is the only way we can save those who have not yet been affected by this terrible disease... The best place to distribute the drug is in the water supply. Dissolve it at the designated points and come back. I'll give you the recipe in case something happens to the doses you're receiving now.

Install a Radio repeater at the mountain crate on Woods
Install a Radio repeater at the mountain ravine stash on Woods
Install a Radio repeater at the mountain bunker on Woods

rewards.text: 3× 7.62x54mm R BT gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)

radio-club.guide: In this quest you have to kill 8 Scavs and place 3 radio repeaters in different locations on Woods. It is recommended to place them in separate raids, carrying them in your secure container. If you have a Secure container Epsilon, you can safely place 2 per raid. File:Radio Club Map.png|Locations marked on map RadioClubCrate.png|Mountain crate location RadioClubRavine.png|Mountain ravine stash location RadioClubBunker.png|Mountain bunker location
radio-club.briefing: Hey, pal! We did a good job, we took those blueberries down good. We captured a useful cell phone! My guys have already done some digging, found some info on a stash. We could use it. But to find it, we need to set up repeaters on the high ground in the woods. A piece of cake, yea? Oh, and there's Scavs out there, we'll have to shoot them a little bit to scare them off. But you can handle that, too. I'll give you repeaters, but if you lose them, you'll have to make new ones with Mechanic.

objectives.text: Eliminate 20 enemies in BlastGang or TeamFight modes
Eliminate 35 enemies in CheckPoint mode

rat-hunter.briefing: Long story short, the rat situation got pretty ugly. It's only gotten worse. It's like that story with the hydra, you cut off one head and two grow in its place. The people who sent guys to kill you have already sniffed out my part in it. And speaking of “sniffed out”, this whole thing reeks of shit now. Look, you can't trust anyone right now, but you can't afford to lose. Hiding isn't an option either. The smartest thing to do is show those clever bastards what you can do. And if you're lucky, you might be able to take out a few more rats.

requirements: Must be level 12 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find 3 PC CPUs in raid
Hand over 3 PC CPUs to Mechanic

Hand over 3 Rechargeable batteries to Mechanic
Find 3 Printed circuit boards in raid
Hand over 3 Printed circuit boards to Mechanic

rat-hunting.briefing: I promised to tell you about that "monster" from the other day. It was a failed controller, it flipped out and it sounded as if someone knocked at the door. That's how we create fears for ourselves. Interestingly, if I didn't go and check what that was, it would be turned off in 15 minutes by the shutdown relay. After that, it would be extremely difficult to determine the source of the night sound. That's how all those stories from newspapers are born, I assume. I can bypass the signal jammers by reconfiguring their frequency without raising suspicion of their owner as if things are still the same as they were. I need a few electronics for this and I think you can help me with this. The materials must be found silently so no one would get to know about what are we working on, only God knows, who might be involved in this. Here's the list of needed details, you probably know where to find them.

reconnaissance.guide: In this quest you have to find the three office buildings on Lighthouse and get on their roofs. The office buildings are located at the water treatment plant area in the north. The roofs can be accessed via outside stairs. You need to get close to the outside ladders of each building while being on their roofs to get quest progress. The roofs need to be visited in one raid. reconnaissance.briefing: Hey there, warrior, I've got an important assignment for you. I won't sugarcoat it, it's pretty dangerous. Not everyone is willing to risk their skin under the noses of the Rogues. Ah, here's the fighting spirit! Yeah, I know, you're a tough guy. Alright, so listen. I want to know the situation on Rogues' defenses. Go to the water treatment plant, climb the roofs, check the mounted weapons. Note every little detail, even things that don't seem that important. Is the task clear, war dog?

redemption.briefing: It's nice to know the Skier finally gets it. You're fulfilling his latest whim? That's good. Bring me the phone, and I'll take it from there.

objectives.text: Eliminate 20 infected while using melee weapons on Interchange

reduce-the-distance.guide: In this quest you have to kill 20 infected on Interchange while using a melee weapon. File:InfectedPMC.png|Infected PMC
reduce-the-distance.briefing: Come on in. How long do you think this will last? Anyway, our job is to survive for as long as we can. Take as many of the infected with us as we can if we can't cure them. As long as we still have ammunition. What happens when we're out of firepower? That's right. It's either us or them. A lot of people have already died with no ammo, left with only a knife against crowds of infected. But my point is, even they have a weakness, we just need to find it. Can you help with that? I can't trust anyone else to do this, they'll get themselves killed for nothing. Study their tactics and find a way to defeat the infected in close combat. There's a lot of them near the Ultra shopping mall now, so go there.

requirements: Obtain level 4 loyalty with Prapor

Hand over 1 military battery to Prapor
Find 3 OFZ 30x165mm shells in raid
Hand over the 3 OFZ shells to Prapor

rewards.text: Unlocks craft for 6-STEN-140-M military battery at Workbench level 1

regulated-materials.guide: The items required for this quest need to be found in raid. They can be found as Loose Loot on Lighthouse and Reserve, but can be found in containers elsewhere, as well as a small chance for a Scav to have it in their backpack. The 6-STEN-140-M military battery is a large 4x2 slot item that resembles a black/brown box. It can most commonly be found sitting on or near tanks. The OFZ 30x165mm shells can be found throughout the Reserve on tables, shelving and at the rear side of every tank on the map, on the ground. Both of the items required for this quest can also be obtained from the Scav Case in the Hideout. File:OFZ 30x160mm shell location on Reserve.png|A OFZ 30x165mm shell on a tank on Reserve File:Location of a 6-STEN-140-M military battery.png|A 6-STEN-140-M military battery next to a tank on Reserve
regulated-materials.briefing: Come on in, warrior! Still breathing aye? Good to hear. Here's a task for you. There's this customer, showed up outta nowhere with an urgent order and the bitch wants specific equipment, the one our glorious mother Russia produced, and my heart aches that the good of the state has to be sold to whoever. Judging by the accent, the fucker is from abroad. But the cash is noble and the connections he provides are no joke. Anyway, you need one military battery, the heavy one, and several OFZ shells. I feel you'll have to sneak on the military base for it... The place is inhospitable, I know, but you won't regret it when the checkout time comes. Plus, I’ll provide you with a special gift for this. Will you take the risk?

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the cure
Hand over the cure

remedy.guide: Kill Sanitar on Shoreline and obtain the cure, then hand it over to Therapist. The bottle is not guaranteed.
remedy.briefing: If you can get the cure from Sanitar, bring it to me first. Of course, he and I are colleagues and have worked together for a while, but it's better to verify everything beforehand.

Survive and extract from the location

reserve-quest.guide: On Reserve, enter the north-western located underground storage warehouse marked with "Д". File:Reserv_guide.jpg|Warehouse "Д" marked on map File:ReserveQuestWarehouse.png|Warehouse "Д" File:Reservquest2.png|Food storage cage with wooden crates inside
reserve-quest.briefing: Look who we've got here! Hello there! Listen, you know about the military base close to the health resort? Probably were there yourself. So, I've got some news. They say the old warehouses there still have a lot of food left in them, and that bandit groups began roaming there, not your regular Scavs, they are well-equipped. I want you to check out if there's anything left in those warehouses. But be careful, there really are a lot of dangerous people there.

reserve-expert.briefing: Come on in, brother! I've got a job for you. There's a couple soldier barracks at the Reserve base, and according to regulations, they should have armories and storage rooms inside. I need to know what's left in there, whether it's worth putting together a serious team or if someone's already cleaned the place out. Can you head over there and scout it out? And just so I'm not taking your word for nothing, bring me something from there. I'll take a look.

objectives.text: Obtain and hand over 10 locked smugglers' weapon cases

rewards.text: 15× 7.62x54mm R SNB gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)

restocking-supplies.briefing: Hello. I've heard someone's been dropping NATO shipments into Tarkov, and it has nothing to do with Peacekeeper. Looks like people don't trust him as much as they used to. Or maybe that's the result of his own actions. Personally, I doubt someone like Peacekeeper got where he is by entirely honest means. But the details don't really interest me. There were weapons among those shipments, right? If those samples are in good condition, I could make use of them. Think you can bring me a few weapon cases? I'd like to go through them myself and pick out what I need. As for the contraband, that's Peacekeeper's problem to deal with. I have no interest in it.

return-the-favor.guide: In this quest you first have to kill 15 PMCs around the mountain area on Woods. Afterwards you have to hide 2 TerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials in the "USEC camp" which is located in the northwest. The west and north-west approaches to the camp are covered with landmines. One has to be stashed on the passenger side of a black SUV in the south of the camp, and the second one has to be stashed at the wooden crates next to the satellite antenna in the north of the camp. File:ReturnTheFavorMap.png|Kill area and stashing locations marked on map File:RTTBlackSVU.png|The black SUV File:RTTBlackSVU2.png|SUV stashing spot on the passenger side File:RTTCrates.png|Wooden crates next to the satellite antenna stashing spot Mined areas to avoid File:Woods USEC camp northwest approach mines.png|North-west approach view that leads to the mined forested area File:Woods USEC camp northwest approach mines2.png|View on the mined forested area from the camp, recognized by tree stumps, corpses and craters File:Woods USEC camp west approach mines2.png|West rocks approach view with detonated mine spots File:Woods USEC camp west approach mines.png|West ramp approach view with detonated mine spots
return-the-favor.briefing: The whole thing is starting to become clearer. It seems that the customer is not from around here, as I initially assumed. The order came from the beyond the border. I have contacts who are willing to assist, but they will need a favor in return. They own a certain, shall we say, facility, located in the Priozersky Natural Reserve. You can see the facility from everywhere, but nobody has a clue what is hiding under the mountain. If you've been in those places, you must have seen the hill that towers over the entire forest. So, some curious tourists began to flock around that hill, and they are itching to open all the doors they see. As you know, curiosity killed the cat. Do the right thing and get rid of those cats. And while you're there, leave the documents for the USECs in their camp. Remember, these documents must not fall into the wrong hands.

reverse-gear.briefing: You haven't gone after any more of those guys in black, have you? We're in deep shit... As soon as I handed over their gear, I got a call. From the top brass. They told me to stay out of it, not to engage that unit, and to remove every observation point. And who's gonna answer for the men I lost, huh? You tell me, are those rear-echelon rats gonna step in and replace the dead? But there's nothing I can fucking do. If we keep digging, there'll be consequences. They made that crystal clear. They can wipe me out along with everything I've built, and they'll chew you up as an afterthought. Don't doubt that for a second. So the cameras have to come down. Can you handle it?

revision-reserve.briefing: Good day. As you know, the blue helmets are here to lower the level of aggression in the region. That is why I want you to assess the danger levels. Infiltrate the military base and search it for anything that could present military danger. After all, the blue helmets are supposed to keep the peace. I think they want to safely dispose of it, or something else, I don't know. Anyway, you have to find the machinery and mark it with beacons. riding-the-wave.briefing: Heya, brother! I'm not even gonna ask if you've run into those black uniform "visitors". I figured you didn't come here by accident. You knew I'd have a job for you on this, didn't you? From every sample that's made its way to me, it's obvious these guys are the real deal. So it's no surprise I've been flooded with people asking for gear with the same features or at least the same camouflage... I'd be a fool to let an opportunity like this slip away. I need a complete inventory of everything they wear. Once I've got that, I can put together my own versions, or maybe even make an exact copy of their whole kit. And don't worry, you'll be the first one to get your hands on it! Just don't let me down, alright?

objectives.text: Win a match in any game mode

rigged.briefing: Hey, champion. You can't even imagine the value I place on my people. Recently, I was given a lucrative proposition. They asked me to put my men in the fight, but set up things so that their gear would fail to let the enemy win. I acted like I was considering it, naturally. You can understand, it's business, first and foremost. But I turned down the proposition. Kinda regret it a little now. Money's one thing... but nobody turns down people like them. Don't worry though, I don't betray my own. Now go and show me what I've lost so much money for!

rigged-game.briefing: Hey you, tough guy! C'mere, I have a job for you. I've heard Prapor sent you to get a supply of drugs from some Sanitar dude. Don't make that face! I ain't got no interest in those drugs, let Prapor collect it and put it up his ass, you have already received profit from him anyway, haven't you? You just need to put these smart little things in containers that are in Sanitar's stashes. Prapor won't get wind of anything, it's a two-minute job, but the profit is good. Just gotta do it fast, before they move those containers.

risks-of-small-business.briefing: So, the cameras worked just right. The ex-USECs are receiving help from the Scavs, and my man was able to ID them. They're two of Kaban's men, Gus and Basmach. I'm not certain if their boss knows about this side gig, but now is not the time to look into it. The reputational damage is already too high, and I need to take these two fucks down, ASAP. An old rival of mine has decided to take advantage of the situation, so we have to work fast!

rite-of-passage.briefing: Hello, merc. I have a new task, though I cannot tell yet if you are fit for a real job. But you seem eager to help, so I might give you a chance to prove yourself. The more experienced warriors who are already working for the good of Tarkov need to replenish their fuel reserves. So you have a chance to do a good deed and prove to me that some drunken thug won't be a problem for you. Bring me two cans of fuel. But don't run from the fight. To clean the city of filth, you must be ready to face the enemy head-on.

The ambush spot is an area that reaches from the green container with the AGS-30 grenade launcher behind the car dealership to the northeastern part of the car dealership. road-closed.briefing: Mercenary, there is a task for you. There's been a large firefight in the city. Someone ambushed a convoy carrying critical cargo. I'm sure it's the treacherous BEARs, but we'll have to make sure. At this point, it's not as critical to eliminate these war criminals as it is to make sure the cargo is still intact. Go there and report back.

root-of-all-evil.guide: File:Root of All Evil Map.png|The location marked on a map. File:Discombobulate Spot 1.png|The stashing location.
root-of-all-evil.briefing: Hey there, ahper! I'm in a real mess this time, not something I'd wish on anyone… You've probably already heard Peacekeeper's version of the story. But it's not as simple as you think. Everyone's got a weak spot, and this Edward dude found mine, you get me? Peacekeeper doesn't give a damn about any of that, but you know me! Anyway, I talked to him, and it looks like there's a way out of this mess. Peacekeeper isn't just planning to stop Edward, he wants to shut him down for good. For a long time. If that happens, my risks disappear with him. The problem is, Peacekeeper doesn't have enough proof that Edward's been quietly writing off perfectly good gear, electronics, weapons, all that shit. That's where I can help. The shipments are so tangled up that a single package won't prove anything on its own. We need several of them together so we can piece the equipment back together and match the serial numbers. And for that, we need someone like you. Think you can haul some contraband crates over to the sawmill? Shturman seems to have cleared out for now, so grabbing the cargo from those UN guys shouldn't be a problem. I need at least ten boxes. Leave them next to the green shipping container, there's only one like it there. I've still got a few unopened crates myself, I'll give those to you right away.

The safest way to fulfill the objective is to get inside the camp from the north, east or south and walk up to the sandbags between the big rocks in the west of the camp that block off a path to the mines. File:Rough Tarkov Woods Map.png|Mined area marked on map File:RoughTarkovSandbags.png|The sandbags that block the path to the mines Mined areas to avoid File:Woods USEC camp northwest approach mines.png|North-west approach view that leads to the mined forested area File:Woods USEC camp northwest approach mines2.png|View on the mined forested area from the camp, recognized by tree stumps, corpses and craters File:Woods USEC camp west approach mines2.png|West rocks approach view with detonated mine spots File:Woods USEC camp west approach mines.png|West ramp approach view with detonated mine spots ===Ground Zero claymore mine=== The claymore mine is located on the first floor of the Tarbank building, in the customer desk booth no. 3. To fulfill the objective you only have to get in front of the booth, there is no need to enter it. File:Rough Tarkov Ground Zero Map.png|Claymore mine marked on map File:Tarbank Building.png|The Tarbank building File:Rough Tarkov Ground Zero Approach1.png|Way to the customer desk booths File:Rough Tarkov Ground Zero Approach3.png|Way to the customer desk booth no. 3 File:Rough Tarkov Ground Zero Approach2.png|The booth with the claymore
rough-tarkov.briefing: Hello there. I see you've become very confident in your survival skills. That's what gets people killed. Overconfidence weakens your senses, and Tarkov doesn't tolerate it. I was talking to an old comrade of mine, and let me tell you, tripwires are the ultimate test of alertness. Partisan has driven a great many bastards out of existence, and most of the time it was only a matter of catching the enemy inattentive. Yes, his methods are extreme, he's been like that since Afghanistan. Even if you're on my friend's good side, there are still plenty of "gifts" in Tarkov even without him. Not just in the woods, too. Sometimes even a random room can come with an explosive surprise. That's why I advise you to cut down on your eagerness and take a closer look at such places. You'll live longer if you learn to recognize mortal danger.

route-deviation.briefing: Yeah-yeah, your previous job was about the BTR driver. So what? It makes no difference to you. We made a deal, but the kid's still looking for ways around it. If I didn't know how to manage lads like him, I wouldn't have gotten on top myself. You need good intel to manage them so you can nail them in time. There are no issues in Priozersk, but in the city he often deviates from my routes. I need to know where the BTR goes and why. run-aground.briefing: Looks like we've been chasing the wrong fish, mate... We've hit five convoys already, and every one of 'em was carrying old rewards from previous seasons. Not bad, sure, but if we want to really win this, we need to cut off the one with the new gear. My lads spotted some PMCs hanging around our river. Could be that main convoy's passing through there. Trouble is, someone wiped out half my crew on site, so we've got no solid intel left. I'm sending in some reliable boys with a couple of machine guns to set up an ambush. But they'll be moving light if they're gonna make it in time. So if you're really ready to back me and screw Ref over, get some ammo and grenades stashed for my lads. Thrown in some big mags while you're at it. Where to hide it? There are a few containers by the road along the shore, stash it around there. Just keep it out of sight, bushes'll do. And just so we're clear: if you tip Ref off about this, you're done mate. No discussions.

safe-corridor.briefing: Oh, here you are, just in time! I could use your help. My dudes tried to borrow some supplies from the warehouses on the reserve base, but no luck. Some serious guys dug in there, and these reserve fellas are tough as fuck, not just regular smartasses. And I feel that unless you fuck them up, my guys can't steal any supplies from there... I don't give a shit about the whole base, but the underground warehouses are where the good stuff is. You'll help us, won't you? Yeah, go there and back up my guys while they search the place.

objectives.text: Eliminate 20 enemies with point fire in SBEU HERO mode

safety-first.briefing: Got a little trick for you. Between us, alright? Don't let it go to your head. Here's the deal: don't bother aiming down sights with those monsters. You'll save your eyes, and you'll still drop people. Firing from the hip's easier, and a hell of a lot more reliable. Now go show me what you've got.

safety-guarantee.briefing: Hey. Got some news from Luka. The intel was right, the USECs left a fuckload of equipment there when they abandoned the base. But the scumbags who found the place first, they're still holed up there, ready for war. To take the base, our lads need proper protection, otherwise the risk is too high. We need to help them with gear, because without us they'll attract too much attention on the big land. You seem to be interested in the development of our little venture, so I trust you'll be able to procure what we need. We need Zhuk armor and Vulkan helmet sets, shouldn't be too hard. Oh, and also... Luka asked for something extra... He says he needs helmets like Killa's. To avoid the military, they need to take the base as quickly as possible. The crime world's known about Killa for a long time, even outside Tarkov. If we convince them that Killa and his gang are now operating even outside the cordon, they'll leave with their tails between their legs right away.

sample-iv-a-new-hope.briefing: We have managed to decipher the diary! This Vladimir was a true man of science, and realized in time that they were creating something terrifying. He secretly began to develop an antidote all by himself. The work was in its final stages, he even synthesized several prototypes! It seems he made one mistake in estimating the length of the virus' incubation period... That is what probably made him the first victim of a project he himself had been involved in. We have reason to believe there's a sample of antidote number 4 in the sealed section. With it, we can recreate the vaccine formula and synthesize more. We can't lose that sample. That's why I had to arrange a deal with that car service mobster to deliver the sample to my group. You'll need to cross from the Lab to the city, and then leave the vaccine at his, uh, workstation.

samples.guide: The fastest way to acquire all these stimulants is using the Keycard with a blue marking in The Lab. Alternatively, you could kill Sanitar, although he is not guaranteed to have them. Alternatively, either the two chalets or the rogue base on Lighthouse have multiple stimulants spawn which require no key.
samples.briefing: Hello. Straight to the point. Yes. There is news about new stimulators. They make a person not feel any pain, give them strength. They are being sold somewhere on the shoreline, Sanitar, yes, that's the merchant's name. He sells medicine and stimulants to the local junkies... I mean residents. I need to get this medication. Developing new stimulants is expensive, especially difficult with testing on humans. But here, we can say that testing is already in progress and gives results. Many of my acquaintances will be interested in such results. Please bring me samples of these drugs. Make sure that they are sealed and untouched.

sanitary-standards.guide: The Gas analyzer has to be stashed on the second floor of the laboratory on Daytime Factory, specifically at the window of the second room. File:ITARStrategyGamesMap.jpg|Room location marked on map File:SanitaryStandardsStashingLocation.png|Stashing location at the window
sanitary-standards.briefing: Good afternoon, young man. I'm glad you were the one who came. I have an urgent and extremely important task for you. It concerns everyone still living in Tarkov. You know where the chemical plant is, don't you? I have strong reason to believe that something hazardous from that facility is seeping into the groundwater. This is a critical issue for us, especially since humanitarian aid deliveries are constantly being disrupted. We all rely on that water. Do you understand? Even filtration is no longer enough. If this isn't addressed soon, it could cost all of us our lives. To determine exactly what's happening, I need readings from a gas analyzer. You can find one at the plant. Leave the device in the laboratory there, and my people will retrieve it afterward.

requirements: Must be level 8 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find 2 Gas analyzers in raid
Hand over the 2 Gas analyzers to Therapist

sanitary-standards-part-2.briefing: Hello. Good that you are here. I have a job just for you since you are already familiar with it. Our engineers have successfully neutralized the chemical leak from the factory, but the water is still not fully purified. Although the only remaining pollutants are specific to petroleum products. We assume that this is connected to the TPP fuel oil storage next to the factory. Know these? It's hard to miss, there's a big pipe there. Technical rooms of fuel oil storage and furnace facility must be nominally equipped with the same radio- and gas analyzers you found in the factory, if, of course, they weren't stolen yet. Locate and bring them in, and we will solve the water problem in the region, at least for a while.
