(Optional) Locate the lab scientist in the TerraGroup complex
Locate and obtain the scientist's hard drive
Hand over the hard drive

saving-the-mole.guide: In this quest you first have to locate the lab scientist in the main building of the TerraGroup building complex. He can be found in a hallway behind the big TerraGroup sign in the entrance hall, buried under rubble. Inside the body, a TerraGroup science office key can be found which unlocks office no. 4 on the second floor. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid, but can be taken by other players. File:Saving the Mole Map.png|TerraGroup buildings locations marked on map File:Ground Zero TerraGroup Building.png|The TerraGroup building complex File:SavingTheMoleWay.png|Way to the scientist from the entrance hall File:Terragroup Scientist.png|The scientist body Afterwards you have to find a hard drive in the scientist's office (no. 4) on the second floor. The office can be unlocked with the TerraGroup science office key. Once you are inside the office, the hard drive can be found at the only desk with turned on screens. It can be located on the desk top, or in the right side shelf. File:Scientist's Office.png|Door to the scientist's office on the second floor File:Saving the mole hard drive desk.png|The wanted desk File:Saving the mole hard drive location.png|Spawn #1 on the desk top File:Saving the mole hard drive location 2.png|Spawn #2 on the desk top File:Saving the mole hard drive location 3.png|Spawn #3 on the right side shelf
saving-the-mole.briefing: Hello, mercenary. I've got a lot of work, so I'll be brief. TerraGroup sent a USEC task force after one of their employees. He was accused of leaking information and they wanted him removed. I don't know if they succeeded or not, which is why you need to investigate this. Check the TerraGroup complex in the city center, look for traces of both the squad and the employee. I used to work with him, so I want to know what happened in the end. He almost always carried a drive with his important data on it, so if you find it, bring it to me.

objectives.text: Claim at least 5th place in SBEU HERO mode

sbeu-mimicry.briefing: Just showing up for this circus isn't enough anymore. Stakes keep getting higher and all that. So don't just sit around waiting for everyone else to do the work. I need you dropping people too. Yeah, I know, with a gun like that you'd rather not pull the trigger any more than you have to. But those are the rules. Adapt, or you won't see a dime.

requirements: Must be level 29 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Hand over any Found in Raid items from the Facecovers category x15
Hand over any Found in Raid items from the Headgear category x15
Hand over any Found in Raid items from the Headests category x15
Hand over any Found in Raid items from the Eyewear category category x15
Hand over any Found in Raid items from the Body Armor category category x15

scavenger.briefing: Listen brother, I've got a job for you. You know I'm pretty much the only guy who deals in all kinds of nylon. Well, I was. Lately, some competition has started popping up... I can't afford to lose my edge. And wouldn't you know it, one of my shipments is fucking delayed! Can you go around Tarkov and bring me some stuff to sell? I really need this, brother! Don't worry, I'll pay you for the goods. Here's the list of what I need.

requirements: Must be level 12 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the first Factory extraction
Locate the second Factory extraction
Locate the third Factory extraction
Locate the fourth Factory extraction
Survive and extract from the location

scout.guide: In this quest you have to visit the 4 listed Factory extractions. You need to visit all locations and extract in the same raid. File:FacExit0.png|Extractions marked on map File:FacExit2.png|1: Cellars extraction in the underground File:FacExit3.png|2: Gate 0 extraction File:FacExit1.png|3: Gate 3 extraction File:FacExit4.png|4: Med Tent Gate extraction
scout.briefing: Someday we will get rid of the invisible hand, which used to brand us with employee badges and now has caused this mess, and I think it leads us to a great war. At least, all current event look like preconditions to it. I worked here for the chemical plant, as an ordinary foreman. It was a good time, everyone thought so, including me. Now it’s full of Scavs and swarming with brigands and outlaws. I want to make use of some of the factory premises, find out what exits can still be used. Go there and check it out.

requirements: Must be Loyalty Level 2 to start this quest

objectives.text: Mark the first T-90 tank with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline
Mark the second T-90 tank with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline
Mark the third T-90 tank with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline

scrap-metal.guide: Note that you do not have to plant all markers in the same raid. As with previous quests, once you have survived the required amount of time after each plant, you can die and do the remaining objectives and extract in subsequent raids. File:Scrap Metal Locations.png|Tanks marked on map File:Secondtankshoreline.png|The first tank is located next to the bunker northern of the resort, near the river. File:Firsttankshoreline.png|The second tank is located on the road that goes from the tunnel extraction through the village. File:Thirdtankshoreline.png|The third tank is located on the bridge between the power station and the weather station. You can find it by following the dirt road.
scrap-metal.briefing: Good day! As you can understand, the conflict here was rather serious and there is some heavy machinery left on the Shoreline. There are at least three T-90 of which I am aware, and I am sure there are many military devices remaining on them, such as laser rangefinders for example. Those models are not for export, and equipped with optics for domestic use. My customers would be very interested in comparing it to the samples owned by them. Mark the tanks with beacons, and my people will do the rest.

requirements: Must be level 5 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate Prapor's missing convoy on Woods
Locate the temporary USEC camp on Woods

search-mission.guide: In this quest you have to locate Prapor's missing convoy and the USEC camp on Woods. ====Convoy location==== The convoy is located in the north, on the road between the lakes that leads to the "Scav Bunker" extraction. Make sure to get close to the vehicles for the objective to trigger. File:Search Mission map.jpg|Convoy location marked on map File:Search Mission Convoy.png|The convoy ====USEC camp location==== The USEC camp is located in the northwest. The west and north-west approaches to the camp are covered with landmines. File:Search Mission map.jpg|Camp and landmine locations marked on map File:Search mission camp.png|The USEC camp Mined areas to avoid File:Woods USEC camp northwest approach mines.png|North-west approach view that leads to the mined forested area File:Woods USEC camp northwest approach mines2.png|View on the mined forested area from the camp, recognized by tree stumps, corpses and craters File:Woods USEC camp west approach mines2.png|West rocks approach view with detonated mine spots File:Woods USEC camp west approach mines.png|West ramp approach view with detonated mine spots
search-mission.briefing: Hey there, warrior! One of my squads has been radio silent for a while now. When all this mess started, I sent them out near the Priozersk forest to move an important shipment. I'm afraid they got hit: last time we managed to get through, they reported USECs closing in on them from the hills. Go check it out, see if anyone's still alive. The convoy definitely had a BRDM car, a Bukhanka, and some truck, can't remember which one. Chances are the USECs have dug in somewhere nearby, so keep your head on a swivel. Oh, and so you don't get yourself lost among the scary square kilometer of trees, I'm issuing you a compass. Dismissed.

requirements: Must be level 17 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find the informant's briefcase on Lighthouse
Hand over the found package

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Aluminum splint at Therapist LL3

seaside-vacation.guide: Note: If you are a BEAR player, or in a group with a BEAR player, walking by the beach, going to the other house by the docks or coming near the water treatment plant, there's a chance that the Rogues will start firing their stationary weapons at you. Therefore it is recommended to get in and get out as quick as possible. This will also happen if you are an USEC tagged as an enemy by the Rogues. You are tagged as an enemy if you shot any Rogues in the previous 3 raids. The briefcase is located under a bed on the second floor of one of the western houses that is directly located at the shore. File:SeasideVacationMap.png|House marked on map File:SeasideVacationHouse.png|The wanted house File:SeasideVacationRoom.png|First room on the left when you use the little bridge File:SeasideVacationClose.png|The briefcase is located underneath the bed on the window side
seaside-vacation.briefing: Good afternoon, young man, I have a special assignment for you. Unfortunately, I cannot entrust it to my workers. Knowing your previous feats in searching for data that interests me, you can easily be made into a private investigator! So, there was a person who I had been working closely with, he lived somewhere at the cape Dalniy territory. He always carried a briefcase with him containing his medical studies and research. The issue is that he hasn't been contacting me the last two weeks - I'm starting to worry. If his studies get into the wrong hands, I will have to pay a high price to silence the information spread. Please, mercenary, I am asking you to find my contact's briefcase. He used to drive a red merin sports coupe and was always telling me that he'd love to relax somewhere by the sea, farther away from all the city noise. Are you ready to take on this task, young man?

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the new charity recruiters' notes
(Optional) Scout the Scav checkpoints on Customs, Shoreline or Woods
Hand over the found information

secret-benefactor.guide: In this quest you have to find the charity recruiters' notes on Customs or Shoreline or Woods. ===Customs=== On the first floor of the Scav base (ZB-013 extraction) building, in the southern room. File:EasyMoneyPart1CustomsMap1.png|Scav base marked on map File:Secret Benefactor Spawn Customs.png|Notes in the shelf between the beds ===Shoreline=== On one of the green tables inside the northern warehouse in the smuggler base. File:Secret Benefactor Shoreline Map.png|Warehouse marked on map File:Secret Benefactor Spawn Shoreline.png|Notes on the table ===Woods=== On a table inside one of the containers located in the northwestern container camp. File:Secret Benefactor Woods Map.jpg|Container camp marked on map File:Secret Benefactor Spawn Woods.png|Notes on the table
secret-benefactor.briefing: Greetings. You know, during recovery, my patients often share news and rumors about what is happening in Tarkov. Most of the time it is simple everyday talk, however nowadays I have noticed a tendency that concerns me greatly. People are talking about a person or group of people in town who are willing to provide sustenance and protection for the citizens. At different times, I myself would have tried to reach out and cooperate for a noble cause. Yet you and I both are aware that there are very few honest people left in Tarkov. The ordinary citizens are already on the brink of survival. I am afraid that too many people may trust loud claims without any guarantees. We must find out who is luring people in with generous offers and for what purpose. If you are willing to help me, search the Scav checkpoints and outposts for information.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the precision tools package in the laboratory on Customs
Use the transit from Customs to Factory (In one raid)
Eliminate 3 Scavs on Factory (In one raid)

secrets-of-polikhim.briefing: Been waiting for you, friend. My workers found a rare ultrasonic thickness gauge at the customs warehouse, along with some equally useful equipment. There's nothing better that can give me that kind of precision in my measurements! I can't risk it, so I'm trusting you with this recovery mission. Pick up the package at Customs and deliver it to the designated point at Polikhim. There's something I've been wanting to test for a while... Wait, you didn't know about the industrial area shortcut? I used it back when I worked at Polikhim. It was the only way to get equipment to the plant that would otherwise be stuck in customs for months. A fellow forester showed me this path. He said that people were afraid to pick mushrooms near the plant, so it was always full of good pickings.

The room can also be entered through the window by climbing on the canopy from any second floor window, not requiring the key. There are multiple hard drive spawns throughout the room. seeking-information.briefing: Hey! Got an update on that locked room. Rumor has it the ex-USECs have been seen around there for a while. Maybe they know how to open the doors. The other question is, what happened to whoever was inside? Either they escaped or they are already dead. We should find out. See if you can find anything interesting there while you're at it.

Survive and extract from Shoreline

seizing-the-initiative.guide: The transit is located behind the "Sniper Roadblock" Scav extraction, inside the bus. Transits are only available 1 min after raid start. File:CustomsTransitToShorelineMap.png|Transit location marked on map File:Sniper Roadblock.png|The roadblock File:CustomsTransitToShoreline.png|The transit
seizing-the-initiative.briefing: The operational situation in the city is ever-changing, meaning I always have to stay on top of what is happening. My people have reported that some operatives have started using the new path from the customs terminal to the gulf coast. Previously the passage was inaccessible there, but I've already had two targets evade my groups in that area. I have to see what is going on at that passage. If you accept this task, you will have to travel all the way from the customs terminal to the coast and extract from there. You can count on an appropriate reward!

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 Scavs at the train depot on Woods
(Optional) Do not kill any PMC operatives at the train depot

self-employed.guide: In this quest you have to kill 5 Scavs at the train depot on Woods. Killing any PMCs at the depot will reset the quest. The depot can only be accessed via the BTR Driver's taxi service. It is also possible to leave the depot through walking on top of the western train. When walking on top of the train it is important to stick to the center to not get hit by snipers or mines. File:WoodsTrainDepotExit.png|Way to the train File:WoodsTrainDepotExit2.png|The train
self-employed.briefing: I was waiting for you! With these frosts and the new heater, business has been booming like never before. PMCs are lining up just to warm up or catch a ride somewhere. And trust me, that’s a lot easier and more profitable than running under the traders. So I started a rumor that my BTR was down, just to keep them from dragging me into their contracts. Figured I’d work for myself for a bit, help out the regular folks too. Only one problem though. I don’t hit the Depot often these days, but I can’t avoid it completely. There’s a bunch of important equipment still there, stuff you can’t just move in one go. And if any rats from my "partners" crew start snooping around, the whole thing goes to hell. So I need your help again. Make sure there are no extra eyes in the Depot, yeah? Just don’t touch the PMCs! They’re my main customers right now, they won’t rat me out.

semiconductor-crisis.briefing: Yesterday, as I was installing a reflex sight onto an M4, I spotted some weird local on the monitor, he seemed to be praying. He painted different signs on the wall and on the floor, then walked into the middle of the circle these symbols formed, and started placing weapons there. To be honest, it didn’t even look strange, it made perfect sense to me. It’s natural for people to offer the most valuable things they have to their gods, and these days it’s weapons. Those are cultists, you might've already encountered them. I have enough power capacity for now. Look for some more graphics cards and coolers. And thanks for the package, by the way.

objectives.text: Obtain the item: Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine
Go to Woods or Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine to BTR Driver

rewards.text: 2× Safariland Liberator HP 2.0 Hearing Protection Headset (FDE)

sensory-analysis-part-1.guide: In this quest you have to hand over a Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine to the BTR Driver. Ragman provides one via in-game mail. To complete the second objective, you have to kill a Scav on Woods or Streets of Tarkov.
sensory-analysis-part-1.briefing: Hello my brother! Okay, okay, not so loud, I'm hung over as shit. Don't know how the BTR guy's still driving after last night. The engine is surely screeching louder than fucking generators! By the way, you came at a really good time, almost like you knew I'm gonna need help. So, about the meeting we had yesterday. I have a moonshine supplier, he makes legit good stuff! We've been working together for six months now, everything was fine. And now, customers started complaining that I was selling them fake stuff. So, I had to check the product quality, and no one in our region knows as much about liquor as the BTR driver. So I invited him over for... let's call it sampling, hehe. And there he was, saying that no one starts with hard hitters right off the bat, he needed a warm-up. Then another. Then another... So after all that, I checked the moonshine in the morning, and we didn't even open it! Long story short, the driver didn't finish the job. I'm not gonna live through this kind of sampling party a second time, so I'll let him taste everything by himself. Can you pass him this bottle? Don't lose it, alright?

objectives.text: Find a Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine
Hand over a Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine

sensory-analysis-part-2.guide: In this quest you have to hand over a Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine to the BTR Driver and ask him about the facility under the health resort and the keycards to access it.
sensory-analysis-part-2.briefing: I miscalculated my abilities yesterday at a friendly get-together. Don't worry, we've sailed in worse storms than this. One time I was so wasted I couldn't find the gearbox in this thing. So I tied my hand to the lever with a bandage! Inventiveness is the main principle for a machinist! Ragman needed to check some goods, and I'm a veteran in this field. Except I can't remember, for the life of me, whether we finally got to his test sample or not. Well, whatever. If it's so important, we can get together again. Such an evening is a sin not to do again, I know you'd like it too! But still, if you need to visit Ragman, ask him about the moonshine, I promised I'd help him. And now I don't even know if I did help him or not.

serious-allegations.briefing: Hey! Remember the client with the game magazine? I have a new order. I need a data disk, it's all related to the same game. Some scam artist said that the people who created the game had stolen user data from 2 million accounts! And as proof he showed a hard drive to everyone, allegedly with this leak. But the publishers are serious guys, they would not allow such bullshit. So the client is looking for the drive to clarify the situation. My guys said the drive should be in an old wooden house near the health resort, there is a toilet on the left and a rag above the entrance.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 PMC operatives while using an active headset without wearing any armor
Eliminate 10 PMC operatives while wearing the TSh-4M-L soft tank crew helmet without wearing any active headset

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Ballistic plate case at Mechanic LL4

setting-priorities.guide: Bug: All earpieces from the Arena Season 2 BattlePass, the Factory Tactical Map and the Echo Belli crate do not currently work for this quest. For the first objective you must not wear any armor vest, armored chest rig, armored headwear or armored face cover.
setting-priorities.briefing: Hello. One of your people stopped by recently and tried to convince me that the most important part of a fighter's gear is armor, and that situational awareness doesn't matter nearly as much. Frankly, I don't share that view. Sure, you can't see or hear absolutely everything. But armor will never give you complete protection either, especially if you walk into an ambush. Personally, I'd take a good headset over heavy, reinforced armor any day. Fortunately, I don't have to make that choice myself. So what would you choose? You've got enough experience to test this properly in the field. Better yet, let's try this: you gather some real statistics using two different loadouts, and in return I'll arrange a supply of some unique items from Peacekeeper. He owes me a favor, you see. Try neutralizing PMC operatives while wearing a headset but no armor. Then do the opposite, say... using a tank crew helmet. That should put you at a serious information disadvantage.

setup.guide: In this quest you have to kill 8 PMCs with any of the following guns while wearing one of the above hats and chest rigs: * ADAR 2-15 5.56x45 carbine * MP-133 12ga pump-action shotgun * MP-153 12ga semi-automatic shotgun * MP-155 12ga semi-automatic shotgun * MP-18 7.62x54R single-shot rifle * MP-43 12ga sawed-off double-barrel shotgun * MP-43-1C 12ga double-barrel shotgun * Molot Arms Simonov OP-SKS 7.62x39 carbine * Molot Arms VPO-101 Vepr-Hunter 7.62x51 carbine * Molot Arms VPO-136 Vepr-KM 7.62x39 carbine * Molot Arms VPO-209 .366 TKM carbine * Molot Arms VPO-215 Gornostay .366 TKM bolt-action rifle * Mosin 7.62x54R bolt-action rifle (Infantry) * Mosin 7.62x54R bolt-action rifle (Sniper) * PPSh-41 7.62x25 submachine gun * Saiga-12K 12ga automatic shotgun * Saiga-12K 12ga automatic shotgun (Redline) * Saiga-12K ver.10 12ga semi-automatic shotgun * Saiga-9 9x19 carbine * TOZ KS-23M 23x75mm pump-action shotgun * TOZ Simonov SKS 7.62x39 carbine * TOZ-106 20ga bolt-action shotgun
setup.briefing: Alright, mater. Heard what the Scav are arguing about lately? Proper war going on between them. Wouldn't be a problem, except my lads keep getting caught in the middle of it. They ain't exactly helpless, but a bit of backup wouldn't hurt. Here's what I came up with: those idiots have their own dress code. The big shots walk around showing off in ushankas, Scav vests, and those bloody JayPC carriers. What a bunch of clowns, eh? You dress up like one of them, grab their weapons, and start dropping PMCs left and right. Doesn't matter who exactly, just make sure they end up blaming those idiots. You get what I'm saying, yeah?

sew-it-good-part-1.briefing: Hi there homie, I have a solid business proposal for you. Don't you worry, I’m not bullshitting you, it's the real deal. Can’t say what it is right now, but if it starts off good, I’ll be sure to tell you. I need a big backpack, the purple "Pilgrim" one, and a ski hat, you know, with ninja-type slits. Look for them yourself though, no traders, brother. I need to keep this in secret, don't want anyone to find out about our little thing, you know?

sew-it-good-part-2.briefing: Well, looks like I’m through with armor, took a bit of an effort, though. If I need some more, you’ll help me out, right? Anyway, now I have to get my hands on tactical rigs, and some of them are pretty hard to come by, but you’ll pull through, right? I need grey BlackRocks and green TVs. Bring at least a couple of each, and it'll be fine. Look for them yourself though, no traders, okay?

Hand over the armor
Obtain BNTI Gzhel-K armor in 50-100% durability
Hand over the armor

sew-it-good-part-3.guide: In this quest you have to hand over 2 BNTI Gzhel-K body armors. One with 0-50% durability and one with 50-100% durability. The armors require no inserted armor plates since the condition is measured by the integrated soft armor. Since friendly fire is always active, you can easily complete this quest with the help of a another player through the use of a Blicky pistol. Another way to complete this quest solo is to let border snipers shoot you so that your character dies far outside the playable space of the map. You can insure the armor with Prapor to receive it back in roughly a day to a day and a half, but it will be quicker if you use Therapist to insure it. You may have to do this method multiple times for the same armor to get it down to the required durability. Another option is to shoot the orange propane containers found on The Lab or Customs whilst being inside the radius. The hot gas damage will damage all parts of your armour, this will however also deal a lot of body damage and may kill you if you are not being careful. It is best not to stand directly next to the propane while it explodes, and to only use one explosion at a time. Take in extra gear and meds to swap to so that you do not fight with broken armour or low health.
sew-it-good-part-3.briefing: Hey, what's up. You've dealt with hats quick and clean, good stuff. Now let's move onto some serious things, you've got to be agent 007 for this one. I need a couple of Gzhel body armor pieces for my thing, and the trick is that I need one to be fucked up badly, and another one in a mint condition. Get them however you want, it doesn't really matter now. Can you do it?

sew-it-good-part-4.briefing: Oh, brother, I'd be neck-deep in work without you. I'm doing it all so the city keeps on living, mind you, that's why I do all the moves. Alright, I'll tell you about my secret affair, since it has been going so smoothly so far. I'm thinking of setting up garment manufacture, to sew and sell vests, holsters, armor. As in the best fashion houses in Europe, haha. This time I need to understand what exactly is inside the 6B43 armor, the green one, it's also heavy as shit, you probably know. I want to figure out how it breaks down, and what it's based on. Just like the last time, bring me a couple of those, one totaled, and one a bit more pristine.

shady-business.briefing: Hey, come here for a minute. There is this shady guy in Tarkov. Folks call him Skier, a really slippery person, I’m sure he doesn’t disdain the crime either. I need to watch him. They say he's looking for some flash drives. I have no idea what's on them. Knowing his type I bet there's something rakish going on. I’d like to know it for sure. I don’t know what kind of flash drives he is looking for exactly, just bring me several of any you can find, and then we'll figure it out. Just make sure you get them yourself, we can't let those traders trick us. Mechanic will help us uncover what's on them.

File:Shady Contractor Map.png|Car location marked on map File:Shady Contractor Car.png|The car File:Shady Contractor Spawn 1.png|Spawn #1 on the dashboard File:Shady Contractor Spawn 2.png|Spawn #2 on the driver seat File:Shady Contractor Spawn 3.png|Spawn #3 in the trunk
shady-contractor.briefing: Hey. You may be aware that TerraGroup's aggressive expansion in Tarkov has raised quite a few questions in its time, no doubt? Back then, they were buying out properties and companies left and right in the Norvinsk region, and some of the deals were clearly shady in nature... TerraGroup has had a particularly interesting contractor, a company called Knossos. Officially they build amusement parks, playgrounds, and other family entertainment venues. But tell me, what possible connection can TerraGroup's scientific research and playgrounds have? That's exactly why this smells fishy to me. Knossos could be hiding TerraGroup documents or equipment. Yet to know for certain, we'd have to examine their facilities. And to do that, we'd have to find some kind of record... Knossos definitely had managers overseeing the facilities. You should check out the vehicles in the city center and look for any internal records there.

A Dorm room 203 key is required to enter it. File:Shaking up teller customs map.png|3 story dorms and room 203 marked on map File:Bank case location.png|The bank case under the bed
shaking-up-the-teller.briefing: Hail, the knave of axe and gun. Some curious info came up recently. Smells like solid profit without running around too much. Ready? Look. There was that wisecrack who ran the stores, lived in a dorm by the factory. And, as usual, sidelined some cash. He lived in room 214. But that's not the point. I don’t think you will find much there if anything at all. Though he swore there’s something. Something else has surfaced: In the same dorm, he owned one more room, 203, but wasn’t babbling about it and, as a matter of fact, used it for storage. Now that’s where he had something of value for sure, more than one of his errand runners perished there. Also, he had a garage. Don’t know the number, but it was certainly two-digit - I have a listing of owners starting with 100, and his name is not there.

sharpest-shooter.briefing: There's a new twist. Now people are betting not just on wins or kills, but on how fast you're getting them. You get where this is going, right? You've gotta kill fast! Faster! Without aiming, even! Think you can handle that? Go prove it!

sheep-in-wolf-s-clothing.briefing: Time for some serious work. I've managed to pinpoint the location of one of the sites nobody knows about except these operators. And if my calculations are right, they haven't been there themselves yet. I'm sending my own people to that site. You didn't really think I'd let you inside my operation, did you? Don't worry, I've still got a job for you. Take it, and you won't regret it. For my boys to get in and out cleanly, we need to keep those operators distracted and stir up some chaos. I figure you've collected a fair bit of their gear by now? Use it to throw their operation into disarray.

We're short-handed for this bullshit, so you're gonna come in handy. If you can't find the keys from the smugglers, go to Ref, he's already fucking selling them anyway. I only want my goods, you can have the rest. My buyer's pissed as shit, waiting for his order. So if you do everything quick, you'll get both the goods and some nice cash.

shipping-delay-part-1.briefing: Hey, do you know the BTR driver who's driving around Tarkov? I ordered an important delivery from him, but he just vanished somewhere. I need to find that bastard and show him what responsibility means. But the package is more important at the moment. Go find it and hand it over to me. We'll deal with the driver later.

shipping-delay-part-2.briefing: So Mechanic sent you, huh? Cool. So I used to have a base, with a hangar, spare parts, cargo shipments even. The most important one is a package for Prapor, he's really anxious for it, and the box is still at the depot near the sawmill in Priozersk. If you're down to help me, look for this package and deliver it to Prapor. I can give you a ride to the depot, but I ain't leaving the BTR. I don't like it outside, it's more comforting inside this armor.

shoot-first.briefing: Glad you came by. I wanted to talk to you about something. We've got a fuck ton of new recruits. New blood is the key to exciting fights, you see. We need to keep things moving, otherwise we can't keep the audience for long. Well, you already know that, we've been over this. So, to the point. The newbies aren't experienced, but they're arrogant as hell. Show them what a real hardened fighter's capable of. I hear the new blood are already fantasizing about overthrowing the current Arena champions. They've got their sights set on you. And you know the best way to avoid trouble in the Arena is to shoot first.

Take eliminating several highly trained fighters in an unconventional situation, for example... It's not just about the choice of weapon and attachments, there are other factors to consider as well. My friend Dima thinks you could become a capable sniper. He just wants to make sure. If you're not afraid, complete his assignment.

shooting-cans.briefing: Greetings! I hear you're looking for a little extra cash. That's perfect, because I have a job for you... I know that the city center is where AGSs and KORDs were deployed during the hottest fights. Find me one of each and report back. Also, sweep the area around them, make sure no one gets to the firing positions before my guys do. I think five bodies will be enough. Scavs, PMCs, whatever. Less trespassers, less chance of an ambush, you know?

shootout-picnic.briefing: Alive and well? Atta boy! Not everyone can boast the same nowadays. You can handle a thing or two since you're standing here alive. That’s good. You have an idea of tactics, so here is the challenge. Do you know the sawmill area in the Woods? Yeah. Some trusted people have matters to attend to in the area, but local scum who, in lack of good sense, think of themselves as masters of the place, keep interfering with them. According to my intel, there are at least 15 of those dickheads. I need you to deal with those morons, the others will run away anyway. The right approach decision should not be a problem for a mercenary like you. To work then, soldier.

short-on-hands.briefing: You getting bored, mate? 'Cause I'm short on hands right now. Wanna know why? 'Cause Ref, that bloody prick, started poaching my people! Looks like his Arena's been raking it in with those new Seasons, so now he's looking to expand. Problem is, his staff keeps getting themselves killed on cleanups and other crap. So he figured he'd start pulling workers from people who actually matter. But I've got my own connections, yeah? Didn't crawl outta the gutter yesterday. Managed to get my hands on the routes for his new supply runs. If we hit those shipments, his shiny new season's dead in the water. No rewards, no hype, no money. He'll be eatin' dirt instead of profits. And my people'll see clear as day that sticking with Skier's the smarter, safer bet. We've already intercepted a few convoys, but now some mercs showed up outta nowhere, like they got tipped off. They're making things difficult. You gonna handle that for me, good lad?

shortage.briefing: Hello, mercenary. Are you interested in a little part-time work? It's not a difficult task, but it's quite lucrative. Don't forget, you can get both food and drink from me, as well as expert medical care. But first, let's talk about the job. I require three emergency medical kits. They're called Salewa - the red western ones. I need you to obtain them yourself, not buy them off someone else. Just to prove that we're serious about this. We may know each other, but not enough for me to trust you yet. Are you up for the job?

sightseeing.briefing: Hello my brother in crime! We got some real action coming up, you hear about the new trails? Mister Fence is planning to set up a real network, and he needs a little help from our end. Here's the plan: I'll give you the locations, you mark them. signal-part-3.briefing: I've recently tried to build a neural network to control the cameras. Teaching it to differentiate between faces and look for matches in the database didn't take much time. Then I wondered, what if we ever create a mind, which will realize itself, what it will be like? In the last many years of civilization, humans kept becoming more humane. They started treating each other better, started caring for nature, animals. An opinion was formed that principles of human duty go side by side with highly developed civilization and reason. Then, shall it turn out that the mind of the computer, which of course will very quickly evolve into an over-mind due to its high learning capabilities, will also be most humane at the same time? Interesting, right? But we need to deal with these pests already. Install suppressors on the antennas you found, and, just in case, another one on the tower, also there on the Shoreline.

objectives.text: Reach the required Attention skill level of 8

signal-part-4.briefing: I've been thinking about that thing we discussed last time. Have people really become kinder with the development of civilization? Do they really go hand in hand? All this time, where we believe there is civilization, life has become more comfortable, easier. There were increasingly fewer worries about safety or getting something to eat. It's easy to be humane when nothing is threatening you. The answer to these questions was right before my eyes. The situation in Tarkov has shown us how much kinder we have become. Once the issues of survival came to the front, it turned out that decent people aren’t more common than maybe 500 years ago. There're probably even less of them now. What do you think, are you one of them? Okay, don’t overthink it. I need you to do something for me. However, you will need to remember quite a lot for this job. Practice in memorizing large volumes of information, I’ll contact you later.

silent-caliber.briefing: Hey there, how's life treating ya? You know, sometimes you have to come in and shoot the shit out of someone in CQC, and you have to do it quietly and efficiently. I prefer 12 gauge for example, and I got no clue why the hell BEARs and USECs don't appreciate it, it's a straight caliber, you know? You just gotta get as close as possible, and if you have silencer, man, you can drop people and the guy on other side of the wall wouldn't flinch. It hits silently and it hits hard. You gotta master this, while I figure out what fish we could pull out with your "talent".

objectives.text: Locate and obtain Lightkeeper's cargo crate on the roof of the military hospital on Reserve
Stash the cargo at the Scav house on Woods

simple-side-job.guide: Completing the quest Protect the Sky from the BTR Driver automatically fails this quest. In this quest you first have to pick up Lightkeeper's case from the roof of the hospital building (White Bishop) on Reserve. There are multiple spawns. Afterwards you have to stash it in the Scav house on Woods. The house can be found near the "Outskirts" extraction in the southwest of the location. ====Reserve Case location==== File:HospitalMap.jpeg|Hospital location marked on map File:Simple Side Job Spawn 4.png|First case spawn on the ground facing north File:Simple Side Job Spawn 3.png|Second case spawn in the circular sandbag fortification File:Simple Side Job Spawn 1.png|Third case spawn on the table facing north File:Simple Side Job Spawn 2.png|Fourth case spawn on the ground facing east ====Woods Stashing location==== File:Simple Side Job Woods Map.png|Scav house location marked on map File:Scav House.png|The Scav house
simple-side-job.briefing: I am not interested in localized conflicts and I am not going to help either side. But since you are already here, I have a job for you. The task is simple: pick up one cargo from the roof of the military hospital at the reserve base and deliver it to the transfer point. Be careful with the cargo and do not open the crate. This shipment might be of interest to certain people, so I need a man with special skills. Someone like you.

objectives.text: Eliminate PMC operatives in Ushanka ear flap hats while wearing a Pompon hat

skiing-with-skier.guide: In this quest you must eliminate as many PMC operatives who wear the Ushanka ear flap hat as possible while wearing the Pompon hat yourself. In the PvE mode you must eliminate PMC operatives while wearing the Pompon hat.
skiing-with-skier.briefing: Looks like our comrade general crawled out of hibernation and started handing out hits for my lads! Not great that he's making a move, but there's no backing out now. You get me? If we dig in on these new lines, Prapor will never push us out. So get ready. We need to move fast and hit hard. Forget my route for now, that fucker's littered it with TNT charges, you'll just blow yourself up. Your job's simple. Drop everyone fighting on his side, as many as you can. Sounds like Prapor's handing out ushankas, so use that as your marker. I'll pull in more good lads from your lot too. Every gun counts now. Just don't forget to wear a pompon hat yourself. That's how we tell our own apart now.

requirements: Must be level 40 to start this quest.

slaughterhouse.briefing: Well, hello there, mercenary. Come to see the old man? Sit down, would you like some tea? No? All right, then. Listen, a gang of looters showed up in the area again. We've got to get them away from this place for good, so that even those who come after them would have a heart attack. So I'm thinking, why don't you take an axe and chop them the fuck up, eh? Can you do that? I don't think any bastard's gonna dare get into that bloodbath afterwards.

small-business-part-1.briefing: Hello. I have an errand for you. One of our people decided he could use my distribution lines on his own. It looks like our "entrepreneur" is marketing to cultists with souvenir figurines. Find them and bring them back, and I'll examine their insides.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 10 Boss guards without killing the Bosses

small-business-part-2.guide: In this quest you have to kill 10 boss guards without killing any bosses. Killing any boss will fail the quest. Refer to the respective boss pages for their behavior and strategy to eliminate their guards. A relatively risk-free way to complete this quest is, to kill Kaban's sniper guards on the roof of the LexOs car dealership on Streets of Tarkov from a distance.
small-business-part-2.briefing: You remember my "entrepreneur"? I found him, he's one of the local gang bosses. Who? You don't need to know that. Your job is to go to each of them and remind them that my trade routes are mine alone. Don't touch the chiefs themselves, they're more useful alive. But their guards should be cut down for a clear show of force.

small-things-big-help.briefing: Salam, brother. So there's this guy, he was selling me some stuff he found near the lumber mill, and so he told me that he found some stashes filled with fuel barrels, you see? We don't know if it was PMCs or Scavs who stashed them there, those barrels might even be empty, but it's still worth checking out. Mechanic throws some serious cash for fuel these days, he spilled that he has some kind of a farm that needs fuel 24/7. So anyway, the guy said that he's seen three of those fuel stashes on Woods, and I want you to mark them with beacons, alright?

snatch.guide: *This item will only appear in your next Lighthouse raid after accepting this quest. In this quest you have to obtain the forged intelligence on Lighthouse and exchange it with the original intelligence on Reserve. Afterwards you have to bring the original intelligence to Lightkeeper. ====Forged intelligence locations on Lighthouse==== The forged intelligence can be found in either a green or blue container near the western entrance of the water treatment plant. File:SnatchContainerMap.png|Containers marked on map File:SnatchContainer.png|The green container File:SnatchContainerInside.png|Inside the green container File:SnatchForgedIntel.png|Forged intelligence between the weapon box and the barrels File:SnatchContainerBlue.png|The blue container File:SnatchContainerBlueInside.png|Inside the blue container, forged intelligence on the couch ====Original intelligence and exchange spot location on Reserve==== The original intelligence can be found tucked in the right side tracks of a BMP-2 which is located in a locked room inside the bigger of the two garage buildings at the repair center (white knight) on Reserve. A RB-ST key is required to open the door. The forged intelligence has to be placed at the back of the BMP-2. File:SurplusGoodsGarageMap.jpg|Garage marked on map File:SurplusGoodsGarage.png|The wanted garage File:RB-ST door inside.png|The locked door File:SnatchBMP2.png|The BMP-2 File:SnatchOriginalIntel.png|Original intelligence in the right side tracks
snatch.briefing: You're here, good. Now listen carefully. My men went to the meeting place, their job was to replace the folder these snakes were so diligently preparing with the one I had arranged, but it's already been several hours since my group stopped responding. The last time they contacted me, they reported seeing a group of Rogues. Knight and his men are not aware of this operation, perhaps one of them interfered with the delivery. The first thing you must do is to check the Rogues' base and find the lost data, but don't go to them right away, or they'll figure out I'm involved and will start asking questions. Then you'll have to deliver it to the federal reserve base, a meeting place has been set up at the machinery and equipment repair center. Find that folder and leave at the base, and bring the real one to me. It's crucial to deliver this information to me. It's time to find out who these suicidal moles are.

spa-tour-part-2.briefing: Good day, my friend. While you were bringing justice, you surely noticed the helicopter standing at the health resort pad. We need to hurry and pick up everything of value that is left in it. For now, it's wide open and dangerous in there. Your task is to mark the helicopter with a beacon and, most importantly, find the safe path to access it with a vehicle, preferably through the woods. Mark it, I mean the path, with a beacon as well. After that, it’s Blue Helmets’ job.

It's time I let you in on a delicate operation I'm running at the resort. However, first, I would like you to prove your loyalty to me, bring me an ear necklace. Haha! Just kidding about the ears, but seriously. If you want in on this operation you'll need to prove your loyalty to me, but not necessarily with blood, if you know what I mean.

special-comms.briefing: Salutations! An important assignment has just come from the high-ups. Top priority and all that jazz. There's a path from Priozersk to the Reserve base, and our guys need communication in those parts urgently. The path? Ah well, I'll share it with you, but make sure nobody else knows about it! When the Contract Wars were in full swing, some artisan managed to lay a path parallel to our road. We tracked the guy down and started interrogating him on who he was working for, what kind of mission he was on, you know the drill. We thought we'd captured a spy! Yet he kept calling himself a mushroom picker and grinning like a moron. We wanted to send him to headquarters. But at night our mushroom picker disappeared, no one saw him again after that. So, with your help, we'll build a communication line along this path, and you'll be responsible for the equipment. You'll deliver a part of it to the place, go to the Reserve base, and leave the second part there.

special-offer.briefing: Got another job for you, brother! I see the demand for backpacks, can't lose profit now. I've only got basic backpacks, so I need to bring in some exclusive items. That'll bring in more customers. You know what I mean, right? If you get some really rare rigs and backpacks, I'll be in your debt!

special-order.briefing: Hey there, soldier! Got a job for you that I wouldn't trust to just anyone. Special order, you could say. I need an ice axe. Wipe that look off your face! And keep your mouth shut about this job, or we'll both catch hell. So don't go checking the Flea Market or asking the other traders. You need to find one yourself, quietly. No unnecessary witnesses. Got it? Word is Shturman was seen carrying the right kind of ice axe. The Cultists might've stashed one away in their hideouts, too... But that's unconfirmed. Either way, that's your problem now, not mine! Get this done, and I'll arrange access to a very special weapon, just for you. Ever since the Contract Wars, these things have become almost impossible to get. I'm giving you a one-of-a-kind opportunity here. Don't waste it.

objectives.text: Play 3 matches in the Last Hero or LH: Revolvers game mode

spinning-the-drums.briefing: Yo, champion! You probably know yourself that revolvers aren't exactly loved in Tarkov. So my buddies hooked me up with some extra gear, just like that. A whole fucking mountain of good guns! I got an idea: gunfights like in the Wild West. I'll provide the revolver, you provide the entertainment. I pay as always – meaning, well. Waiting for you on the arena, fighter!

spotter.briefing: The situation takes an interesting turn. The data you delivered to me suggests that these moles were involved in the attack on the government convoy in the city, at the intersection of Nikitskaya Street and Primorsky Avenue, which means that from time to time they inhabit those parts. Your job is to scout the area, prepare and equip some good positions to monitor the area. Nothing more than that for now. I already have a marksman for the job. You will need a silencer for .338 from AI and a Trijicon thermal imager.

objectives.text: Eliminate 35 infected while using grenades or grenade launchers on Ground Zero

spread-the-damage.guide: In this quest you have to kill 35 infected on Ground Zero while using grenades, grenade launchers or the stationary AGS-30 grenade launcher. File:InfectedCivilian.png|Infected civilian File:InfectedPMC.png|Infected PMC
spread-the-damage.briefing: Good thing you stopped by, warrior. The city center got pretty tough. But I did some digging at our stockpiles and found some explosives. That's what we've been missing! The only problem is, there's no one to deliver this package to those freaks. Help us out, soldier! Now is not the time to save your supplies. We've got to use everything we have. Go out there and blow those bastards up. We've got to stop them.

objectives.text: Light up the bonfire on any location

spring-never-changes.guide: In this quest you have to light up a bonfire. 3 per raid appear in different locations on Ground Zero, Customs, Woods, Shoreline, Interchange, Reserve, Lighthouse and Streets of Tarkov. File:Winter Tales Event Bonfire.png|Appearance of a bonfire To light a bonfire, it must be shot 4 times with tracer ammunition from maximum 20 meters away. Near them, Followers of Morana can be found. They are neutral to players until they are harmed or a bonfire in their vicinity is lit.
spring-never-changes.briefing: Alright, listen up. These bonfires of Morana's whateverthefucks must be burned down. Every last one of them. I'm not a religious man, but I can smell something sinister about all this. There's a reason for all this commotion. We don't want any more instability in the region, do we now? Do the right thing then.

objectives.text: Eat a can of squash spread
Eliminate 6 spirits of winter in one raid
Drink a bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine
Survive and extract from the location

spring.guide: In this quest you first have consume a can of squash spread and a bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine in raid. Afterwards you have to kill 6 followers of Morana in one raid and extract. Followers of Morana can be found near bonfires. They are neutral to players until they are harmed or a bonfire in their vicinity is lit. 3 bonfires per raid appear in different locations on Ground Zero, Customs, Woods, Shoreline, Interchange, Reserve, Lighthouse and Streets of Tarkov. File:Winter Tales Event Bonfire.png|Appearance of a bonfire File:Followers of Morana Infobox.png|Appearance of a Morana follower
spring.briefing: Okay, so, we have a very interesting picture. Might even start believing in all this. If you light a bonfire just as I told you before, three at the same time, and simultaneously keep them lit for a minute or two, then some kind of freak appears. All green, like a Leshy, with horns. Kind of looks like Lightkeeper's chain dog. He's kind of peaceful and doesn't bother anyone. I guess he comes when the campfires signal. Shares some goodies, doesn't talk much, though. Try to keep three fires burning for a couple of minutes to find out if it's all true or just exaggerations. They've already named this freak "Vesna", ha! It's like a Maslenitsa, you burn bonfires, or rather effigies of Morana, you kill the spirits of winter, and then spring comes. What a freak show. Only thing missing now is pancakes with caviar. Oh, and that scary story I promised will come a bit later, now is not the time for that. So long.

objectives.text: Eliminate 7 Scavs in one raid on Ground Zero
Survive and extract from the location

rewards.text: 1× IOTV Gen4 body armor (Assault Kit, MultiCam)

stabilize-business.guide: In this quest you have to eliminate 7 Scavs on Ground Zero in a single raid and survive.
stabilize-business.briefing: I told you the driver knows the right paths! That's where I'll send the shipment, although I don't have time for that at present. First I have to deal with those who killed my couriers. I already found the culprits, so now it's for Ragman to send his regards. I can't do anything to help the driver until this matter is handled. That's why I suggest you take care of it. Quicker you start, quicker you finish.

objectives.text: Locate and neutralize Partisan
Eliminate 10 PMC operatives

staff-shortage.briefing: Hey there mate! Did'ya hear about my master plan? Alright don't get pissy, I don't employ people for nothing. And if anyone doesn't like the terms, they can file a fucking complaint against me. This isn't Moscow. It's time for everyone to come down to earth and accept our grim fucking reality. Alright, so here's what this job's about. That bloody forest freak is getting active and bothering my mates. His friend Partisan has ruined the supply routes, and they're also hunting my recruiters. So I thought you'd be a good fit for this counteraction. Cover my mates at the checkpoints, and bury this Partisan fuck in the ditch somewhere. I'll make it worth your while. I need these recruits urgently, mate.

requirements: Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.
