stay-clear-of-blast-zone.guide: In this quest you have to plant 3 TP-200 TNT bricks on each fences entry points around the resort on Shoreline File:Stay Clear of Blast Zone Map.png|All fences entry point of the resort on map File:Stay Clear of Blast Zone West Fence.png|The west fence. File:Stay Clear of Blast Zone North Fence.png|The north fence. File:Stay Clear of Blast Zone East Fence.png|The east north.
stay-clear-of-blast-zone.briefing: Come on, have a seat, no point standing around... You didn't run into those black-clad soldiers on your way here, did you? Good. Partisan crossed paths with them while pulling back not long ago, barely made it out alive. Something has to be done about them, or this will end badly. And I'm not talking about pillaging like the Scavs do. This is a far more serious threat. Those fsoldiers are more dangerous than anyone else we've dealt with. Which is exactly why meeting them head-on would be a mistake. Hunters set traps instead of charging wolves with a knife for a reason. These soldiers keep searching around our local health resort. That's where we'll hit them. I need you to plant TNT charges at every entrance to the grounds. Partisan will take up a position in the nearby forest and finish off the group once the explosions have done their work.

objectives.text: Eliminate PMC operatives in Pompon hats while wearing a Ushanka ear flap hat

stay-frosty.guide: In this quest you must eliminate as many PMC operatives who wear the Pompon hat as possible while wearing a Ushanka hat yourself. In the PVE mode you must eliminate PMC operatives while wearing a Ushanka hat.
stay-frosty.briefing: Bad news, warrior. You may have thinned out Skier's people, but now he's started hiring PMCs. And the bastard's not backing off one bit. We need to put Skier back in his place. I hear all his so-called allies wear those pompon ski hats. Anyone using it is to be treated as a hostile on sight. Looks like this profiteer wants a real war. Fine then, he'll get one! Until I say otherwise, this task is your top priority. You're not the only one getting this order, so watch your fire alright? Our guys will be wearing ushankas. And you don't go outside without one yourself anymore. Don't take pointless risks.

objectives.text: Eliminate 50 enemies in BlastGang or TeamFight mode

stay-on-top.briefing: You really think once you're on top, no one's going to throw you off? No way! Blink and you'll be swept down. And then you have to start all over again. So keep looking over your shoulder. And get used to defending your status every day. Kill! Survive! That's what the Arena's all about. Remember that. Show everyone what you're worth!

objectives.text: Eliminate any 100 targets

rewards.text: 1× SWORD International Mk-18 .338 LM marksman rifle
1× Sako TRG M10 .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle
1× Aklys Defense Velociraptor .300 Blackout assault rifle
1× U.S. Ordnance M60E6 7.62x51 light machine gun
1× TDI KRISS Vector Gen.2 .45 ACP submachine gun
1× Diamond Age Bastion helmet armor plate
1× LBT-1961A Load Bearing Chest Rig (MAS Grey)
1× .338 Lapua Magnum AP ammo pack (20 pcs)
4× Glock .45 ACP KRISS G30 MagEx 30-round magazine
2× SIG Sauer ALPHA4 30mm ring scope mount

staying-light.briefing: You came at the right time. I just finished a patrol, and I'll tell you this — something strange is starting. Too many people have been moving through the forests lately, and they're better equipped than usual. I haven't burned through this many rounds on a single run in a long time. Don't even think about leaving your hideout without a solid stock of ammo. I can feel they're preparing for something. I can't sleep at night. Last time it felt like this was right before that blue blast in the city center. Feels like something's about to happen — something that'll change Tarkov forever. Uneasy times are upon us. An extra pair of hands won't go amiss. Help me thin out this infestation in our city, and I won't forget the favor.

objectives.text: Mark any of the weather stations with an MS2000 Marker on Woods

steady-signal.guide: In this quest you have to mark any weather station on Woods with an MS2000 Marker. File:Steady Signal Map.png|Weather stations marked on map File:Steady Signal 1.png|Weather station 1 File:Steady Signal 2.png|Weather station 2 File:Steady Signal 3.png|Weather station 3 File:Steady Signal 4.png|Weather station 4 File:Steady Signal 5.png|Weather station 5
steady-signal.briefing: Hm, you'll be perfect for this. You know the weather stations in Woods? They monitor the atmosphere, and they have power supplies for their sensors inside. And I coincidentally have to power the transmitters. I doubt they've been disturbed since the start of the conflict. Which means there could be power supplies inside in operational condition. Find the weather stations and set up the trackers. Then I'll have my crew attach the transmitters to them.

objectives.text: Stash 2 Radar station spare parts at the weather station on Woods
Stash 2 Radar station spare parts in the specified bunkhouse on Customs
Stash 2 Radar station spare parts in the specified bunkhouse on Streets of Tarkov

rewards.text: 3× AR-15 5.56x45 HK Steel Maritime STANAG 30-round magazine

stealing-the-stolen.guide: Stash 2 Radar station spare parts each on Woods, Customs and Streets of Tarkov. Radar station spare parts can be found in the backpacks of Rogues on Reserve. File:Full Speed Ahead Reserve Rogue Spawns.png|Reserve Rogue pawns marked on map ====Woods stashing location==== Next to the cabin at the USEC checkpoint. File:Stealing the Stolen Woods Map.png|Cabin location marked on map File:Discombobulate Spot 2.png|The wanted cabin ====Customs stashing location==== Inside the cabin located on top of the hill southwest of the new gas station. File:Hobby Club Customs Stashing Map.png|Cabin location marked on map File:Hobby Club Customs Stashing Location.png|The wanted cabin ====Streets of Tarkov stashing location==== Inside the cabin next to the concrete mixer near the collapsed crane. File:Stealing the Stolen Streets Map.png|Cabin location marked on map File:Route Deviation Collapsed Crane.png|The wanted cabin
stealing-the-stolen.briefing: We've managed to obtain recordings of communications between the Rogues and Glukhar. They were attempting to buy out equipment from the radar complex, hardware that survived the EMP strike and was being stored in the bunkers. Looks like Glukhar refused to cooperate, and after that Knight decided to storm the bunkers. I don't want ex-USEC operatives getting any chance to establish contact with my European partners. I could also make use of reliable communication equipment myself. The Rogues have already done half the work for us, all that's left is to take those crates off their hands. Most likely, the units carrying the cargo haven't made it far from the warehouses at the Reserve base. Once you secure the equipment, leave it at locations where my people can retrieve the boxes. Look for worker shacks... or whatever you call them. The first point is near the abandoned USEC checkpoint on the main road through the woods. The second is on the hill by the gas station on the customs territory. The last one is downtown, at the collapsed construction crane.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 30 targets on any location

stick-in-the-wheel.guide: In this quest you have to eliminate any 30 targets on any location.
stick-in-the-wheel.briefing: Here about the BTR driver again? Listen, it's not that simple. But things are slowly progressing, thanks to you. By the way, the Scavs are really coming down on my soldiers right now. I don't know if it's Skier who has learned something about our plans, or if someone is actively recruiting new bandits, but it's impossible to do business like this, that's for sure. If you want your comrade and I to work together, you have to remove this hindrance.

requirements: Talk to the scientist on level 1 via the intercom.
Reach the damaged door on level 3.

objectives.text: Eliminate 30 Rogues

stick-to-it.guide: In this quest you have to kill 30 Rogues on any location.
stick-to-it.briefing: I already told you everything in the car. But if you really wanna get the smugglers to put in a more comfortable transport option to Icebreaker, you'll need to help them out with their fight against the Rogues first. Looks like things between them are pretty serious, and honestly I have no idea where it's going worst. So you can take initiative anywhere you want, just make sure there are fewer Rogue fighters left. Otherwise the smugglers won't even listen to you, they've got bigger problems right now.

requirements: Must be level 8 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 10 target with pistols on Factory

stirrup.briefing: Ah, it's you again. Decided to stick around and do more business with me, eh? Fair enough, mate. I've got a bit of a situation I need sorted out around the region. There's always some random lot getting in the way, firing shots, taking valuable gear off my lads, and putting them down without a second thought. Doesn't exactly fit with my, let's say, business model. So I need them to understand they've stepped into something serious. Thin their numbers out with pistols and let them know there's professionals working around here. I'll pay you for every head you bring down.

objectives.text: Eliminate 12 PMC operatives who are dressed in Santa or Ded Moroz hats

stop-the-fight.briefing: Have you heard of the recent commotion, mercenary? The soldiers are not only killing bandits but now even ones of their own! Too much celebratory vodka or something? Or some patriotic movements... Well, it doesn't matter. I have sent a USEC mercenary to guard a group of valuable refugees, but he got killed by our fellow countrymen. Just because he was a USEC! Well, they are to blame as well: they shot my hired BEARs on another mission. All my plans went to waste! The survivors say that the most aggressive ones were wearing Santa Claus and Ded Moroz hats. Please, mercenary, get rid of them all.

objectives.text: Complete the task "Remedy"

straw.briefing: Another note for you: "My interns are not hindered from their work, now I can deal with your problem. I already have my suspicions about the chemical compounds in the river. Your blood tests only confirm my suspicions. I have a solution, but you'll have to come in person to get it. Go to the Shoreline and I'll meet you there. And wear an ushanka so we can recognize you from afar. We won't shoot at you, but don't try any tricks. It's in your best interest. If you come over, I'll give you everything you need."

requirements: Must be level 35 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate and eliminate Knight
Locate and eliminate Big Pipe
Locate and eliminate Birdeye

rewards.text: 1× S I C C organizational pouch
1× SWORD International Mk-18 .338 LM marksman rifle
1× .338 Lapua Magnum FMJ ammo pack (20 pcs)

stray-dogs.guide: In this quest you have to kill Knight, Big Pipe and Birdeye.
stray-dogs.briefing: Good day to you, soldier. Though could I actually say it's good? As a wise person used to say, people are made to torment each other. When I first read it, I didn't honestly believe it. But now my heart bleeds every time I remember this quote. Some new renegades are terrorizing the city. I've sent a man to negotiate with them, maybe even guide them to the right path, but those savages decapitated him and sent his head back to me, with the letter I wrote for them... They're not locals, all came from USEC. Long renounced from their own people too. They must be hunted down. This is our land. No more peace talks.

objectives.text: Eliminate an enemy with a melee weapon while wearing a Ghoul mask

rewards.text: Unlocks Crash Axe in the Armory
Unlocks achievement Legend of the Arena

superhuman.briefing: Hey, fighter. I won't waste time, let's get straight to it. We've got a very, very important sponsor. The guy's a bit of a nut, but he pours in serious money. I take his requests extremely seriously, and I don't just hire anyone for these things. Recently, he pitched me an unusual idea, and, well you get the picture, it needs to happen. You're perfect for the job.

requirements: Must have Ragman LL2 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Stash the Goshan cash register key at the BIZARRO store fitting rooms on Interchange.
Stash the IDEA cash register key at Register #9 on Interchange.
Stash the OLI cash register key at Register #7-8 on Interchange.

supervisor.guide: For this quest you have to place a Goshan cash register key, IDEA cash register key and OLI cash register key on Interchange.
supervisor.briefing: Good Day, brother! I've got a job for you. Have you seen how many cash registers at Ultra are locked up? You can't just break into them. I've got a feeling there's still something valuable left inside. If you can help me get the keys, I'll give you access to some better gear. And of course, I'll share the loot. Look for the keys somewhere near the cash registers, they might've been left behind there. My guys are too busy right now to dig around themselves. Leave those keys somewhere nearby, please.

requirements: This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.
Must reach Loyalty Level 2 with Skier to obtain this quest.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the chemical vial on Customs
Hand over the container
Find 4 Respirators in raid
Hand over 4 Respirators to Skier
Find 3 Medical bloodsets in raid
Hand over 3 Medical bloodsets to Skier

supplements.guide: The chemical vial can be found in the experiments area on the second floor of the laboratory on Customs. File:MarathonSecretsOfPolikhimCustomsMap.png|Lab location marked on map File:Supplements Chemcont Location 1.png|Container location 1|On the table in the corner with the pinboards File:Supplements Chemcont Location 2.png|Container location 2|On the table in the corner with the display
supplements.briefing: Alright, tourist, you're here at the right time. Got a sixth sense or something? Never mind, listen up. Word on the street is there's some new merchandise making the rounds. Some weird stuff in these fancy-looking chemical containers. Looks a bit like your gun suppressor, just bigger. No clue what's inside: some new narcotic, or bloody Omega-3 or something. That's what we need to find out. The containers showed up at Customs, in the med lab. Get them for me. I've already got a couple of eggheads lined up to examine them. Oh, and one more thing: they asked me to throw in a few respirators and some blood transfusion kits.

requirements: Obtain level 1 loyalty with Skier

objectives.text: Hand over 1 found in raid Module-3M armor to Skier
Hand over 1 found in raid TOZ-106 shotgun to Skier

supplier.briefing: What'chu want, merc? A job? Ha! Looking for a good net salary and a full social package? Alright then, I'll give you a job. I still barely know you, so let's see what you can do. I'll give you this: find me a white body armor, the one that looks like paper, and one Toz shotty. Gonna gear up my guys a little. But make sure to get the fresh ones, got it? Don't need no haggler shit. So anyway, if you do fine, we can talk further about your employment, mister "operator".

objectives.text: Eliminate PMCs with your favorite weapon

supply-and-demand.guide: In this quest you must eliminate as many PMC operatives as possible while using any weapon.
supply-and-demand.briefing: Judging by the latest news, the situation in Tarkov cannot be called stable. We have to make do with what we have. However, I have a unique proposition for you. A new phase of the conflict is about to develop. History repeats itself in cycles, and my predictions never fail me. I have just received a good shipment of all kinds of stuff, and thanks to you, I can finally breathe freely. I've decided to invest in a major market research. Just like the last time, I need you to use your favorite weapon, but now you'll be wearing a special tracker that will help us stay in touch. I've recruited some of your other colleagues to do the same. The most popular weapons will be put on sale. If it works out well, I'll even try to get a discount on the rest of the stuff. So, you in?

requirements: Must be level 13 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Obtain the Secure Folder 0052 in the sawmill cabin on Woods
Hand over the folder

supply-plans.guide: The documents are located at the lumber camp on Woods, under a bed in the wooden cabin #3. File:SupplyPlansMap.png|Map with cabin location marked File:Cabins in the lumber yard.png|The cabins inside the lumber yard File:Docs 0052 Location.png|The docs under the bed of cabin #3
supply-plans.briefing: Hello, young man. Truly glad to see you. I have a very important assignment, not for everybody to take on. Will you take it? Then listen. Do you know the sawmill in the Woods? So, during the Contract Wars period, it was used as one of the makeshift backup supply bases for TerraGroup. And I am very interested in TerraGroup supply plans in this region. I think they should be somewhere on the territory as well. Try to search for the temporary quarters for workers - there should be a secure case for documents with a special symbol.

objectives.text: Obtain the MBT Integrated Navigation System on Reserve
Hand over the navigation system to Mechanic

surplus-goods.guide: In this quest you need to pick up and extract with an MBT Integrated Navigation System. It can be found inside a locked room in the bigger of the two garage buildings at the repair center (white knight) on Reserve. A RB-ST key is required to open the door. The item can be found inside a wooden crate in the back left of the room. File:SurplusGoodsGarageMap.jpg|Garage marked on map File:SurplusGoodsGarage.png|The wanted garage File:RB-ST door inside.png|The locked door File:Surplus goods 1.png|Pile of crates File:Surplus goods 2.png|The wanted crate File:Surplusitem.png|Close up of the item inside the crate
surplus-goods.briefing: Hello. I've decided to get involved with military electronics, it's quite a promising business, and I've got interested people for that. And the army, as you know, has the most secure communication: digital encryptions, GPS, GLONASS and all kinds of other things. So anyway, I've got info about some device on Reserve, usually seen in workshops, I think it's used in machinery, it's some kind of control and navigation block. I want you to find this block and bring it to me. Would be interesting to see what it has inside of it. I'll reward you of course.

objectives.text: Hand over 3 found in raid class 4 or higher ballistic plates to Ref

rewards.text: 58 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
63 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2

surprise.guide: Bug: The 6B13 custom ballistic plates (Back) do currently not work for this quest.
surprise.briefing: I came up with a great idea to make the Arena even better. And I need your help. I need to find some armor plates for a guy. He's a frequent performer, so it's time to give him an upgrade to get the crowd excited. That's the thing about shows, you don't add wood in time, the fire goes out. Well, now go get me some armor plates. The crowd's gonna squeal when they see him!

requirements: Must be level 35 to start this quest.
Must accept Fence's quest Between Two Fires to obtain this quest.

objectives.text: Return to the old champion's hideout on Customs
Locate and obtain the compromising information on Ref
Hand over the found info

surprise-gift.guide: By completing Between Two Fires or Decisions, Decisions, you will fail and lose access to this quest. The champion's room is located on the second floor of the three-story dorms building on Customs, between the rooms 209 and 211. A Dorm overseer key is required to enter it. File:DormOverseerKeyMap.png|Room location marked on three-story dorms map File:DormOverseerKeyDoor.png|Door to the room The compromising information can be found on the floor in a puddle of blood next to the wardrobe. File:CompromisingInformationLocation.png
surprise-gift.briefing: I heard you got involved in this affair with Fence and Ref. So of course you decided to come to me. You want to mess with Ref? Hmm, that would be beneficial to me. Bring me the dirt on him, and I'll find a way to use it.

requirements: Must be level 25 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Obtain the data on vehicle movement at the Concordia residential complex parking lot on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the information

surveillance.guide: In this quest you have to find a hard drive on Streets of Tarkov. It can be found inside the Concordia security room which is located in the basement parking garage of the Concordia building. There are multiple spawns throughout the room. File:SecurityRoomKeyMap.png|Room location marked on map File:ConcordiaBuilding.png|The Concordia building File:ConcordiaEntranceNr1.png|Way to the parking garage via house no. 1 staircase File:HouseNr1Staircase.png|The staircase File:SecurityRoomKeyStaircaseDoor.png|Door location near the staircase File:SecurityRoomKeyDoor.png|Door to the room ====First spawn==== On the computer under the left side of the corner desk. File:HDDonPC.png ====Second spawn==== Between the desktop and the drawers on the right side of the corner desk. File:HDDUnderDesk2.png ====Third spawn==== In the pizza box on the safe in the back left. File:HDDPizzaBox.png ====Fourth spawn==== In the compartment under the right side desk. File:HDDUnderDesk.png
surveillance.briefing: Hello, friend... You know, I wasn't always alone. Loneliness does not bother me, of course, especially since I have a neural net if I want to talk to someone really intelligent... Still, lately it's been weighing on me to think about my relatives. My brother and his wife and kids - will you look them up? The Samoylovs, they lived in Concordia. My brother drove a very recognizable car with a tiger aerography... It might be easier to find them through his car.

requirements: Must be level 50 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 15 PMCs without using any armor or helmets on Woods

rewards.text: 2× .338 Lapua Magnum AP ammo pack (20 pcs)

swift.guide: This quest takes place on Woods. You are required to kill 15 PMCs without wearing any armor vest, armored chest rig, armored headwear or armored face cover. Armored eyewear is allowed. Bug: The ANA Tactical Alpha chest rig (MultiCam) is currently considered armored for this quest even when it's not. If you want to protect yourself during this quest you can choose to still wear armor, but unequip it before killing a PMC.
swift.briefing: We've come a long way together, you've learned a lot. Now prove to me that it doesn't matter how much armor you wear, what's important is experience, agility, and intellect, the hunter spirit. How can an enemy harm you if they don't even see you? They'll be tricked by a more experienced warrior. When you realize this truth, you'll be harder than steel.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 Scavs on Woods

swift-retribution.guide: In this quest you have to eliminate 10 Scavs on Woods.
swift-retribution.briefing: So? Feel how smooth it runs now? You did me a solid with the wheels. Now we can start thinking about the fuckers who robbed my base. They can't have gotten far, they're probably still in the nature reserve. Go and punish those fucks, will you?

objectives.text: Hand over Documents with decrypted data

take-two.guide: In this quest you have to hand over the documents with decrypted data to Skier. To obtain them, multiple encrypted flash drives need to be decrypted at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout. It is possible that a decryption process yields no progress at all, making the total amount of required flash drives variable.
take-two.briefing: Hey, bruv! Thought the flash drive job was over? No way it is! We took the shell off, but there's another one underneath. All the files are encrypted too. Tell me, do you have a computer in your cave? Sweet. I talked to Mechanic again and got instructions on how to decrypt them with a computer. I can't do it myself, and my boys would sooner break it than decrypt it.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 pillagers
(Optional) Do not assist Skier with preparing the ambush on Customs
Stash 4 painted CQCM masks in the specified spot on Shoreline

rewards.text: 79 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
86 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2

taking-what-s-mine.guide: The masks have to be stashed at the destroyed room in the house on the Shoreline island. File:FallingSkiesFlightRecorderStashMap.png|House location marked on map File:FallingSkiesFlightRecorderStashLocation.png|Stashing location {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="6" |Painted CQCM masks |- !Icon !Item name |- !link=Atomic Defense CQCM ballistic mask (Scars) |Atomic Defense CQCM ballistic mask (Scars) |- !link=Atomic Defense CQCM ballistic mask (Target) |Atomic Defense CQCM ballistic mask (Target) |- !link=Atomic Defense CQCM ballistic mask (Skull) |Atomic Defense CQCM ballistic mask (Skull) |- !link=Atomic Defense CQCM ballistic mask (Demon) |Atomic Defense CQCM ballistic mask (Demon) |- !link=Atomic Defense CQCM ballistic mask (El Día de Muertos) |Atomic Defense CQCM ballistic mask (El Día de Muertos) |- !link=Atomic Defense CQCM ballistic mask (Demonic Face) |Atomic Defense CQCM ballistic mask (Demonic Face) |-}
taking-what-s-mine.briefing: Tell me, are you ready to help save Arena? As long as you don't switch sides and run to Skier, the reward will be generous. I'll even dig up a couple of rare pieces from my stash just for you. There are still convoys in Tarkov that never made it to their destination because of those pillaging assholes. We need to hit back properly so they don't try this again. And yeah, we also need to make up for the missing reward gear from previous collections. At least partially. I'm setting up a new convoy to collect whatever's left along the coast. That's where you come in. Bring all the masks you can find. You'll need to cross over to the fishers' island using the old barge, there's an old house still standing there. Stash my gear somewhere inside it.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain Sanitar's surgery kit marked with a blue symbol on Shoreline
Hand over Sanitar's surgery kit to Therapist
Locate and obtain Sanitar's ophthalmoscope on Shoreline
Hand over Sanitar's ophthalmoscope to Therapist

tarkov-style-diplomacy.guide: In this quest you have to find Sanitar's Surgery kit marked with a blue symbol and his Marked Ophthalmoscope on Shoreline. The surgery kit can be found on the second floor of the office building at the pier, located on top of a wardrobe. File:PierOfficeBuildingShorelineMap.png|Office building marked on map File:PierOfficeBuilding.png|The wanted building File:Surgery kit.png|Surgery kit on top of the wardrobe The ophthalmoscope can be found inside the locked villa in the western part of the map, near the swamp. You need a Cottage back door key to unlock the back door to enter the villa. The ophthalmoscope can be found in the left hand room on the second floor, inside a potted plant on the table. File:LockedVillaShorelineMap.png|The wanted villa marked on map File:ShorelineLockedVillaBackEntrance.png|The wanted villa from the backside with back door File:Ophtalmoscope.png|Ophthalmoscope inside the potted plant
tarkov-style-diplomacy.briefing: The loss of my people on the Shoreline is certainly a very unpleasant event, but a new source of medicine is more important. We just need a different approach to this case. My assistant managed to bribe a local from the Shoreline to tell us about Sanitar, the medic we're looking for. He has a small security detail, a few spots on the shoreline, but what's strange is that he performs surgery right on the street, and often hides his tools near such places, in buildings nearby. Get me these tools. Sanitar will be more cooperative if he realizes that we can stop his trade at any time and take control of the territory.

objectives.text: Play a game of TeamFight or BlastGang
Play a game of LastHero
Play a game of Checkpoint
Win a match in any game mode or claim the First place in Last Hero once
Eliminate 35 enemies

teacher.briefing: Always arriving just when I need you! Long story short, we've got lots of rookies joining us. I love young blood, the crowd does even more so. However, we need to make sure they don't all get iced in the first fight. Show them the ropes, how to shoot and win the crowd's attention. Obviously, you're not gonna work for free! I've saved something interesting for you. A cool little show-off gift.

requirements: Must be Loyalty Level 4 to start this quest

objectives.text: Find Sanitar's workplace in the Lab
Obtain information about Sanitar's work
Hand over the Flash drive marked with blue tape to Peacekeeper

rewards.text: 1x Mesa Tactical Crosshair Hydraulic buffer tube
Unlocks purchase of Mesa Tactical Crosshair Hydraulic buffer tube at Peacekeeper LL4
Unlocks purchase of AR-15 Magpul ACS Carbine stock (FDE) at Peacekeeper LL4
Unlocks purchase of AR-15 Magpul ACS Carbine stock at Peacekeeper LL4

terragroup-employee.guide: The Flash drive marked with blue tape can be found in Sanitar's room in The Lab. The room is located on the second floor, directly across from the laboratory block (G22) and requires a Keycard with a blue marking to enter. In Sanitar's room, the Flash drive marked with blue tape is stuck into the laptop that is located on the left desk after you enter. File:TheLabSanitarsRoom.png|Location marked on map File:SanitarsRoom.png|Door to Sanitar's room File:Marked with tape flash drive-position.png|Flash drive plugged into the laptop
terragroup-employee.briefing: Good day to you, mercenary. Because the day is actually good. I was right, the new stimulants are connected to TerraGroup. Mechanic found information about Sanitar. Not too much, and it was very expensive for us, but it's better than nothing. Sanitar worked for TerraGroup, and not as an ordinary employee. Graduated in medicine, specialist in infectious diseases, divorced... Well, that's all the information we have on him. Give me more, my friend, I'm very interested in where he got access to such resources. Find his workplace and find out more.

requirements: Must reach Loyalty Level 4 with Ragman to obtain this quest.

objectives.text: Find 5 Aramid fabrics in raid
Hand over 5 Aramid fabrics to Ragman
Find 10 Ripstop fabrics in raid
Hand over 10 Ripstop fabrics to Ragman
Find 3 Paracords in raid
Hand over 3 Paracords to Ragman

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of IOTV Gen4 body armor (Assault Kit, MultiCam) at Ragman LL4
Unlocks purchase of BEAR TIGR lower clothing at Ragman LL3
Unlocks purchase of USEC Commando lower clothing at Ragman LL3

textile-part-1.guide: Aramid fiber fabric can commonly be found in clothing stores on Interchange. Ripstop fabric can be found in the same locations, though more rarely. They can also be found inside of Sport bags, Buried barrel caches, and Ground caches. Paracord can be found in Sport bags. They can also be found spawning on the map Reserve. For more specific spawn locations visit the Paracord page. File:Textile 1 and 2 locations.png|Pieces of fabric locations on Interchange
textile-part-1.briefing: Oh, brother, come in. Wanna get something cool? I have some new clothes in store for you, but it's rare and not cheap. Bring me these things, and make sure they're pristine, no traders. My supplies are completely out and I'm overwhelmed with orders. You can check Ultra, they used to sell those materials there back in the day, but the looters probably took it all over Tarkov. Let me make a list for you, I need a lot of stuff.

requirements: Must be level 42 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find 10 Fleece fabrics in raid
Hand over 10 Fleece fabrics to Ragman
Find 10 Cordura polyamide fabrics in raid
Hand over 10 Cordura polyamide fabrics to Ragman
Find 5 KEKTAPE duct tapes in raid
Hand over 5 KEKTAPE duct tapes to Ragman

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of BEAR TIGR upper clothing at Ragman LL3
Unlocks purchase of USEC TIER2 upper clothing at Ragman LL3

textile-part-2.guide: The Cordura polyamide fabric and Fleece fabric can commonly be found in clothing stores on Interchange. They can also be found inside of Sport bags, Buried barrel caches, and Ground caches. KEKTAPE duct tape can be found anywhere construction supplies spawns, drawers, and inside of toolboxes. File:Textile 1 and 2 locations.png|Pieces of fabric locations on Interchange
textile-part-2.briefing: So, here's another list of the stuff I need. As soon as you have it - bring it here, and make sure it's in good condition. No traders and all, well, you know the deal. I'm thinking about some new outfits for you, something recognizable, warming the Russian heart. I have no idea what's the business between you and the yanks, but these days your life is as shitty as theirs. Shit happens. Anyway, good luck to you.

objectives.text: Locate and hand over 3 locked cases with cargo

that-s-a-great-plan-walter.guide: In this quest you have to find 3 locked cases and hand them over to Skier. They can be found on Smugglers and in different locations all over Tarkov, for example: ===Factory=== *On the 1st floor in the office area File:LCFactoryMap1.png|Location marked on map File:LCFactorySpawn1.png|Spawn #1 in the open office section File:LCFactorySpawn2.png|Spawn #2 in the middle storage section File:LCFactorySpawn3.png|Spawn #3 in the office with the breachable door *On the second floor of the laboratory File:LCFactoryMap2.png|Location marked on map File:LCFactorySpawn4.png|Spawn #1 in the first room File:LCFactorySpawn5.png|Spawn #2 in the first room File:LCFactorySpawn6.png|Spawn #3 in the second room ===Ground Zero (Level 21+)=== *On the third floor (labeled 5) of the Tarbank building File:Tarbank Building.png|The Tarbank building File:LCGZSpawn1.png|Spawn #1 on the filing cabinets File:LCGZSpawn2.png|Spawn #2 on the back left desk File:LCGZSpawn3.png|Spawn #3 on the floor next to the flower pot *In the underground parking utility room File:LCGZSpawn5.png|Spawn #1 on the ladder File:LCGZSpawn4.png|Spawn #2 on the ground next to the blue barrels ===Interchange=== *At the power station *In the IDEA store *In the Goshan
