that-s-a-great-plan-walter.briefing: Hello, gangster! My overseas colleague and I were working out a little deal, but things didn't seem to go according to plan. We needed to get a shipment across town, but it was too risky to move it all at once. So they split up the big shipment into lots of little ones and locked the cases. Even if some loser finds it, they won't be able to open it! Peacekeeper said the shipment's already in Tarkov, but my guys at the drop points haven't seen shit yet. Be a good boy and go check it out. Scour around, and if you find our cargo, bring it here. Easy day's work, yeah?

requirements: Must be level 33 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 20 PMC operatives while using grenades or grenade launchers

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of RShG-2 72.5mm rocket launcher at Prapor LL4

the-art-of-explosion.guide: In this quest you have to kill any 35 targets with grenades, underbarrel grenade launchers, grenade launchers or rocket launchers. Kills with the stationary AGS-30 grenade launcher do not count. Note: The 40x46mm M576 (MP-APERS) grenade does not work for this quest, because it is a buckshot cartridge instead of an actual grenade.
the-art-of-explosion.briefing: So, I see you're pretty well with the hand grenades, warrior. Recently I was able to negotiate a supply of weapons of the same nature, but much more dangerous. You can't give them to just anybody, these babies require self-control. Plus they're very rare commodities. So if you want to buy such a serious piece of weaponry from me, prove to me that in your hands the explosives always hit the target. No other way around this, hehe. Otherwise you're gonna blow yourself up with one of those, or even kill your teammates, if you have any. You can use anything that makes things go boom: underbarrels, handmades, anything. It's up to you, just make sure you get the results I want to see.

objectives.text: Play a match in SBEU HERO mode

the-bad-batch.briefing: Howdy there, champion! Got some news for ya. One ridiculously rich guy's decided he wants to host a tournament with us. He's offering serious cash, plus he's a good fella too... Helped us get the Arena off the ground. Can't exactly turn him down. He's supplying the weapons himself, and that's where things get interesting. These things kick so hard they'll break your fingers after a couple of shots. No idea where he got them, but I've already signed on. So get in on it too. You'll make a fortune.

requirements: Must be level 23 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find 4 Fuel conditioners in raid
Hand over 4 Fuel conditioners to Ragman

rewards.text: Unlocks craft for Ars Arma A18 Skanda plate carrier (MultiCam) at Lavatory level 2

the-blood-of-war-part-2.briefing: Hi brother, how are you? At least you're in good health, that's what's really important. Besides the gear, my customers are taking interest in diesel fuel and all that stuff. Can you bring a few cans of fuel conditioners? They are usually used to improve the quality of fuel for the portable generators. I already have the buyers ready to take it off our hands immediately. I need new unused ones, so look for them yourself. See you around, brother.

objectives.text: Observe a boss meeting and extract from location with "Survived" status"

the-bosses-gathering.guide: Simply survive a raid on Reserve to complete this quest.
the-bosses-gathering.briefing: Hey, there's an emergency for you. I got a tip that all the local gangsters are gathering. Well we all ain't saints now. In short, folks say the bosses will all gather to talk business. At Reserve base. But the information is not accurate. Go there, observe, check out the situation. And then let me know what's all the commotion about. If you make it out alive, of course.

requirements: Must reach Loyalty Level 3 with Prapor to obtain this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the underground bunker on Reserve
Locate the control room in the underground bunker on Reserve
Locate the hermetic door leading to the hospital (White Bishop) on Reserve
Locate one of the two hermetic doors leading to the academy building (Black Bishop) on Reserve
Locate one of the two hermetic doors leading to barracks #1 (Black Pawn) on Reserve
Locate one of the two hermetic doors leading to barracks #2 (White Pawn) on Reserve
Locate the hermetic door leading to the air control center building (King) on Reserve

the-bunker.guide: The control room is located in the center of the Reserve underground bunker system. You can reach it by using any staircase of your choice. File:Bunker pt1.png|Control room marked on underground map File:Bunker Part 1 Guide 1.png|The control room The hermetic doors are the entry doors to the underground bunker system on Reserve. File:Bunker pt2.png|Door locations marked on underground map File:HermeticDoorExample.png|Appearance of a hermetic door
the-bunker.briefing: Greetings, warrior. I'll get straight to the point. Word is they've uncovered an entrance to an underground bunker beneath our reserve military base. Where the hell it came from, I've got no idea, but the place ought to be interesting. I'm not sending my own boys into the unknown, they're more useful to me alive. So head over there and take a look around, search for entrances and exits as well. If it turns out this bunker wasn't built for grunts, but for the top brass, report back to me.

requirements: Must be level 15 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the hermetic door leading to the hospital (White Bishop) on Reserve
Locate one of two hermetic doors leading to the academy building (Black Bishop) on Reserve
Locate one of two hermetic doors leading to barracks #1 (Black Pawn) on Reserve
Locate one of two hermetic doors leading to barracks #2 (White Pawn) on Reserve
Locate the hermetic door leading to the building of the air control center (King) on Reserve
Survive and extract from the location

rewards.text: 1× AK-74M CAA AKTS AK74 buffer tube

the-bunker-part-2.guide: For this quest you have to locate and visit hermetic doors in the underground bunker system on Reserve. For the subtasks 2, 3 and 4 you only need to find one of each which leaves 5 in total. The doors have to be visited in the same raid. File:Bunker pt2.png|Locations marked on underground map File:HermeticDoorExample.png|Appearance of a hermetic door
the-bunker-part-2.briefing: Hey, merc, you are just in time, you are exactly who I need. Do you remember that fucking command bunker you found under the Reserve base? Long story short, my guys went there, and it turned out to be a real nasty place. Built with a high level of protection: filters, generators, all entrances are blocked by extremely strong hermetic locks, it's like an underground fortress. But the raiders opened the fucking thing and dug in like Alabama ticks. So, my men got in serious trouble, less than half made it out of there. But you know, now it's even more intriguing, for fuck's sake. So my people will not go there anymore for no reason, but if you could find a safe route for them... You are an experienced guy, so I need you to quietly, on those soft paws of yours, find out where all the entrances are. The guys said the entrances had those big hermetic doors. So it's up to you to scout the way in.

requirements: Must be level 50 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Handover Secure container Epsilon

the-choice.briefing: Greetings, mercenary. As I see, you are not wasting your time and have achieved a lot on your way. Sometimes in life, you know, we have to lose something to achieve something bigger in the end? Not everyone is ready for this. Many aren't willing to take risks in their entire life, they are afraid, they don't believe in themselves. What about you, are you ready for this yourself? Are you ready to sacrifice something of value to achieve a bigger goal?

requirements: Obtain level 3 loyalty with Peacekeeper

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 Raiders or Black Division operatives on Reserve or The Lab

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of 7.62x51mm M80 at Peacekeeper LL4

the-cleaner.guide: Scav Raiders may sometimes be found in the command area of the underground tunnel system at the start of a raid, and additional ones may appear after the "D-2" extraction power switch has been activated. The arrival of the train may also spawn them at the train yard. Additionally, pulling the "Bunker hermetic door" extraction lever may spawn them at the train yard.
the-cleaner.briefing: You know, I have foreign partners who are working on evacuating important assets from Tarkov. They are especially interested in Reserve and the laboratory beneath the city. But recently, they have encountered some competition... Can you help and eliminate these obstacles?

requirements: Obtain level 1 loyalty with Mechanic

objectives.text: Stash a Trijicon REAP-IR scope behind the trash containers at the "new" gas station on Customs

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for Ammunition case at Mechanic LL1

the-courier.guide: In this quest you have to place a Trijicon REAP-IR thermal scopes on Customs. The scope can't be placed in your secure container. The scope has to be placed behind the "new" gas station at a pile of barrels. File:The Courier Map.png|Location marked on map File:The Courier Barrels Location.png|Barrels where the scope needs to be placed
the-courier.briefing: Hello. I have a client who urgently needs a new optic, but all my usual couriers are tied up with other jobs. If you can deliver the package to the designated location, I'll make it worth your while. Here, take the optic. Head to the newer gas station on the customs territory. You'll find a set of dumpsters there - leave it there. Once you're done, come back for your payment.

requirements: Obtain level 2 loyalty with Peacekeeper

objectives.text: Locate the missing informant on Shoreline
Survive and extract from the location

the-cult.guide: The informant is located in a ruined house in the swamps of Shoreline. You can find it by locating the church and following a blood trail. File:CultPart1Map.png|Church and house marked on map File:Shorelinechurch.png|The church with the ruined house in the background File:Shorelinebloodtrail.png|The start of the blood trail File:Shorelineinformanthouse.png|The wanted house File:Shorelineinformant.png|The informant inside the house
the-cult.briefing: You know, I don't work only with you. I have one very useful and resourceful informant, but he has not checked in for quite some time. The last information I received from him mentioned a strange glow and mysterious voices near the old village. He said he would investigate what was happening, and then disappeared. Find him, or at least find out what may have happened to him.

requirements: Must be level 5 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Scout the Shestyorochka store at Nikitskaya street
Scout the Sparja store at Primorsky ave
Scout the Sparja store in Pinewood hotel
Scout the Goshan store in Concordia
Hand over 1 found in raid Salty Dog beef sausage

the-delicious-sausage.guide: In this quest you have to visit the 4 the stores listed in the quest objective on Streets of Tarkov and hand over a found in raid Salty Dog beef sausage. The stores can be visited in different raids, and progress is saved upon death. For the store objectives to register, walk up to the center of them. The beef sausage can be found at any food spawn. File:TheDeliciousSausageMap.png|Stores marked on map File:TheDeliciousSausageShestyorochka.png|The Shestyorochka store File:SparjaStoreOutside.png|The Primorsky ave Sparja store File:TheDeliciousSausagePinewoodSparja.png|The Pinewood hotel Sparja store File:TheDeliciousSausageGoshanOutside.png|Outside Concordia house no. 3, Goshan store marked File:TheDeliciousSausageGoshanInside.png|Inside Concordia house no. 3, door to the Goshan store
the-delicious-sausage.briefing: Оh! Come on in, I've got a job for you! Listen, how long ago have you been in town? Well, I got a job for you. Run through the supermarkets, see if they've been looted. And do the old man a favor and look for the Salt Dog sausage or something like that. Mechanic kindly introduced it to me, and now I'm craving it. It's killing me!

objectives.text: Locate the cause of the signal jamming on Streets of Tarkov
Install a WI-FI Camera to watch the door
Install a WI-FI Camera to watch the stairwell

the-door.guide: In this quest you have to place two WI-FI Cameras in the Klimova 16A building on Streets of Tarkov. A Rusted bloody key is required. One has to be placed in the staircase in front of the locked door on the fourth floor, and the other one has to be placed at the heater next to the chained door in the area behind the locked door. File:Klimova 16A Map.png|Klimova 16A building location marked on map File:Klimova 16A Astronaut Painting.png|Cosmonaut painting on the south side of the building File:Klimova 16A Main Entrance.png|Main entrance to the building File:Klimova 16A Back Entrance.png|Back entrance to the building File:Klimova 16A 3 To 4 Floor Stairs.png|Third to fourth floor stairs with trash that has to be climbed over File:Rusted Bloody Key Door.png|Locked door on the fourth floor File:The Door Camera Location 2.png|First camera location at the heater next to the chained door File:The Door Camera Location 1.png|Second camera location at the trash bags in front of the locked door
the-door.briefing: Hi, I have a delicate matter. I'm a man of science and I'm used to always find an explanation for everything. As you know, I'm interested in all sorts of signals coming from the territory of our beautiful city. There is a strange place where all my scans are strangely muffled, as if there is nothing there, empty, which is impossible from a scientific point of view. The source itself is in the second or third floor of a certain building. Why don't you go check it out, see if there's some kind of equipment? Set up a couple cameras for me for surveillance. The reference point will be the house with the astronaut mural on the wall.

requirements: Must be level 7 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Obtain the hidden valuable cargo on Customs
(Optional) Locate the messengers body
(Optional) Find the place where the messenger hid the cargo
Hand over the valuable cargo to Skier

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Remington Model 870 12ga pump-action shotgun at Skier LL1

the-extortionist.guide: In this quest you have to pick up a folder from a locked cabin on Customs. The required Unknown key can be found on a dead Scav that is also located on Customs. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid, regardless of whether or not a player in the raid has this quest active. File:Customs.PNG|Dead Scav and cabin marked on map File:The bush where the hidden body is.png|The dead Scav is located in a bush behind garages File:The cabin that is opened by the unknown key.png|The cabin that is opened with the key File:Docs 0048-The Extortionist.png|The folder is located under a jacket on the floor
the-extortionist.briefing: Kinda busy right now! Although... Hang on a sec. There is an urgent matter. There was a firefight about an hour ago in the garages across the river. Just where my errand boy was headed. To hell with him, he was a total moron anyway. But he had with him one particular key. A mighty complex key, I might add. To the door that can be freaking anywhere, you know? This clown was delivering one very valuable thing to me. The bastard hid it somewhere and locked it with this arsetormenting key and came to me to talk up the price. What a bitch! I even raised the pay a little for the smart move, but this wanker still hasn’t told me where it was and went to get it for himself. And I’m almost sure he’s got done in there. Find the key, and then find me that package even if you have to check all doors from the center to the port.

requirements: This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.
Must be level 27 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 PMC operatives while using Colt M4A1 or M16, 6B43 body armor, and Kiver-M helmet on Factory

the-good-times-part-1.guide: In this quest you have to use a either the M4A1, the M16A1 or the M16A2 to kill 10 PMCs on Factory while also wearing both the FORT Kiver-M bulletproof helmet and the 6B43 Zabralo-Sh body armor (EMR). You can modify the weapons and bring additional items to what is required.
the-good-times-part-1.briefing: Hello again! Remember the good old time when all the major fighting took place at Polikhim? People were buying tons of gear from me back then. There was a kit, the most popular among PMCs. I was wondering how it performs in the field nowadays. Check it out for me and tell me how it is, yea?

requirements: This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 10 targets while using the golden TT-33 pistol

the-good-times-part-2.guide: The Tokarev TT-33 7.62x25 TT pistol (Golden) can be obtained by killing Reshala on Customs.
the-good-times-part-2.briefing: The factory run was amazing, your stories made my memory come flooding back! The gunfights are one thing, but when the bandits' leaders showed up, that's when it got real hot. Reshala was the first to show up, always bragging about his gold TT. Back then, everyone wanted one of these in their holster. But now, for some reason, the demand for TTs is going down. Can you remind everyone what kind of weapons real men fight with?

objectives.text: Locate and neutralize the Oni
Locate and neutralize the Harbinger
Locate and neutralize the Ghost

rewards.text: 1× SIG Sauer ECHO1 1-2x30mm 30Hz thermal reflex scope

the-graven-image.guide: The special Cultists Oni, Harbinger and Ghost appear between 22:00 and 7:00 in the same spawn locations as the Goons. They can be found on the following locations: ====Customs==== In the construction area around the Scav base and the laboratory. File:CustomsGoonsMap.png ====Woods==== At the antenna in the northwest (Scav Bunker extraction). File:WoodsGoonsMap.png ====Shoreline==== At the weather station on the hill in the southeast. File:ShorelineGoonsMap.png ====Lighthouse==== At the water treatment plant in the north, and at the blue chalet. File:LighthouseGoonsMap.png
the-graven-image.briefing: Alright, I've got good news for you. Partisan managed to eavesdrop on the cultists' conversation before the tripwire killed them. The Harbinger, as they call him, is in charge of this whole terror parade. He promised them that if they did what he told them, they'd receive the new Gift of the Unheard. What the hell? I have no idea what this means. But I'm certain that if you let them perform the damn ritual, there'll be countless victims amongst the decent folk. People have started fleeing the Streets, they say a ghost is hunting for souls. We don't know the details of this mystery, but it's definitely connected to the whole thing! And we know who's behind it. We need to take out the Harbinger, and if you find any creepy crap near him, try to bury it deep in the ground. Maybe that'll keep the cultists in line.

requirements: Must be Loyalty Level 4 to start this quest

objectives.text: Survive and extract from Woods or Interchange with the "Survived" exit status
Survive and extract from Factory or Customs with the "Survived" exit status
Survive and extract from Shoreline or Reserve with the "Survived" exit status
Survive and extract from The Lab or Lighthouse with the "Survived" exit status
Survive and extract from Ground Zero or Streets of Tarkov with the "Survived" exit status
Eliminate 15 targets

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Velocity Systems SLAAP Plate (Tan) at Peacekeeper LL4
Unlocks craft for 4.6x30mm AP SX at Workbench level 3

the-guide.guide: You must survive a raid at each location consecutively without dying, disconnecting, or running out the timer. If you do any of these you will have to start again. If you extract from the raid with a "Run Through" status, you will not reset the quest, but that raid will not count as being completed. To avoid the "Run Through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting. You do not have to do the maps in any order, they can be done in any fashion as long as you survive. This quest can also be completed in a single raid when using transits.
the-guide.briefing: Come in, I have a high-paying assignment for you. Some important people from outside the region... require the services of a professional guide. Someone who can lead a group to their destination, provide cover, and not ask unnecessary questions. They are willing to pay very well for this. Do you think you are suitable for the job? Prove yourself, and I will vouch for you.

requirements: Must be level 20 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the hideout of Jaeger's friend on Lighthouse
Find and obtain the message for Jaeger
Hand over the message to Jaeger

the-hermit.guide: The wanted message is located below the door to Jaeger's friends' hideout that can be found in the village on the eastern island. You need to extract with the message to complete the quest. File:Lighthouse The Hermit.png|Hideout marked on map File:Hermit spawn.png|Hideout with message location File:Letter beneath door of stash.png|Closeup of the hideout with the message
the-hermit.briefing: Hello, soldier. You know, I've lost almost everyone close to me because of this carnage around. There's nobody to even talk to at dinner. There's you who comes by for an hour or two, but you go back to that war of yours, even if there's no point in fighting anymore. Eh, I won't burden you with my talks. I have a request for you. I had a good friend, we always were very close together - similar in character, understood each other perfectly. He's set up at the Cape Dalniy, in that old village, but far from the people - made a nice dugout for himself at the outskirts. I don't know if anyone still lives in that village, but I do want you to find my friend. I'll be waiting to hear from you, kid.

objectives.text: Eliminate 2 PMC operatives on Woods

the-higher-they-fly.briefing: Hello-hello. I've got a worker guy who's gotten a little carried away with his ambitions. Obviously, I'll handle it later. The problem right now is that some PMCs are getting involved. I don't know if they've been bribed, or maybe they're in cahoots with this mule of mine. Thing is, I don't need any extra faces in this matter, so these good little helpers need to be taken out of the picture. Last time they "operated" in the Priozersk area, so you're gonna start there.

requirements: Must reach Loyalty Level 3 with Jaeger to obtain this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 6 targets at the train depot on Reserve
Launch a yellow signal flare at the train depot on Reserve
Launch a yellow signal flare at the train station on Lighthouse
Eliminate any 6 targets at the train station territory on Lighthouse

the-huntsman-path-administrator.guide: In this quest you first have to shoot a yellow flare into the sky while being inside the train area on Reserve or Lighthouse, depending on your faction. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which can be bought at Prapor LL1 or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. Afterwards you have to kill any 6 targets in the area in the same raid. File:TheHuntsmanPathAdministratorMapBEAR.png|BEAR: Reserve kill and flare areas marked on map File:TheHuntsmanPathAdministratorMapUSEC.png|USEC: Lighthouse kill and flare areas marked on map
the-huntsman-path-administrator.briefing: In our line of work, we can't afford to rest or slow down. Evil won't be defeated that way. So here's my next task for you. I've been told that something suspicious is happening at the Reserve base, around the loading area. Head there and deal with whatever filth has gathered there. And don't forget to fire the signal flare first, so I know you've begun your work. I'll take care of anyone who tries to run.

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 PMCs in the Dorms area on Customs

the-huntsman-path-angry-watchman.briefing: Good afternoon. I have a task for you. Before all this, customs and factory personnel lived in the dormitories on Customs, but now there are only looters, the Scavs are one thing, these fools have their brains completely beaten off. But the mercenaries often go there too, and this is not good at all. They just rob the place, I hate those damn looters! Whatever times are, you must always remain human. Clear the dorms area, let the place breathe in peace again.

objectives.text: Locate and eliminate Kaban
Locate and eliminate Basmach
Locate and eliminate Gus
Eliminate 5 of Kaban's guards at the car dealership on Streets of Tarkov

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for Armasight Zeus-Pro 640 2-8x50 30Hz thermal scope at Jaeger LL4
Unlocks Hog Hideout shooting range target style

the-huntsman-path-big-game.guide: In this quest you have to kill Kaban, his bodyguards Basmach and Gus as well as 5 of his guards.
the-huntsman-path-big-game.briefing: I was out hunting the other day and picked up a family in the woods, father and son. Both were exhausted, the boy had a bullet wound. I brought them to my place, treated the kid's wound as best as I could, fed them both. Then I talked to the father - name's Sanych - and it made me disgusted. They both lived in their apartment opposite the car dealership in the city, and for some reason stayed there after the evacuation. Don't know why, but that's not the point. While Sanych went to look for food, some bandits found their house, tied up the kid, and then him when he returned. They brought them both to this car shop and made them work for them, or else they'd both get put down like dogs. The leader's name is Kaban - everybody respects him there, Sanych said. At night the family managed to break out under fire and made it to the woods, where I found them. The son didn't survive - the wound was too severe... Oh, right, to the point. If there's another bandit in town, you and I are the only ones who can act. Avenge the father's grief and make it so that it doesn't happen to anyone else ever again.

objectives.text: Eliminate 2 PMCs while they are suffering from the stun effect

the-huntsman-path-controller.guide: You can use the M7290 grenade, the Zarya grenade or a KS-23M with the Zvezda flashbang round to cause the stun effect for this quest. Factory is a recommended location for this quest, as there are ample opportunities to engage PMC's at close distance, thus reducing their chance to escape the stun effect.
the-huntsman-path-controller.briefing: Come on in. As a hunter, I can tell you for sure that holding control over the target is really important. Sometimes if you manage to blind the animal, even the most dangerous one, it stops being dangerous to you. This works with humans as well. Who cares how pimped out their guns are if they're as blind as moles? I want you to show me if you're able to properly blind your enemy.

requirements: Obtain level 2 loyalty with Jaeger

objectives.text: Locate and neutralize Kollontay
Hand over the found in raid Kollontay's police baton

the-huntsman-path-crooked-cop.guide: In this quest you have to kill Kollontay as well as find his PR-Taran police baton in raid.
the-huntsman-path-crooked-cop.briefing: Come in, sit by the fire. We need to talk. Tarkov needs to cleansed. Our next target is a former cop known as Kollontay. He was causing trouble even before everything fell apart, and now he's only gotten worse. Find him and deal with him. They say he's holed up in the MVD academy downtown.

objectives.text: Eliminate Glukhar

the-huntsman-path-eraser.guide: In this quest you have to kill Glukhar.
the-huntsman-path-eraser.briefing: Come on in, sit down, there is a special task for you. Do you know the military base south of customs? One character set up there, a former marine. Even before the trouble in Tarkov occurred, he found himself interested in the crime business. They got everything under control back then: the security, customs services, everything. Then most of the gang fled, but not him... He gathered the most loyal of his men, also former soldiers, and they dug in somewhere at the base. He fumbles with warehouse reserves and sells them abroad, that bastard. Doesn't like uninvited guests either. He must be stopped, but this one will not be an easy walk. His fighters are well-trained, so think with your head how to deal with them.

objectives.text: Eliminate Tagilla
Find 1 BOSS cap in raid
Hand over 1 BOSS cap to Jaeger

the-huntsman-path-factory-chief.guide: In this quest you have to kill Tagilla (Not Shadow of Tagilla) and find his cap in raid.
the-huntsman-path-factory-chief.briefing: Good day to you. There's a special task for you today. A new individual dug in the old chemical plant, the one TerraGroup used for their shady business, locals call this man Tagilla. Either breathed in some chemicals or got hit in the head - the fellow went completely off the rails. Murdering both his own people and the others. He uses a sledgehammer, and he's good with it, even a professional shooter would begrudge him. He's finished many people in that factory's corridors. Scavs respect him and don't get in his way. There's no place for such as him on this earth... You know what to do, hunter.

requirements: Obtain level 3 loyalty with Jaeger

objectives.text: Eliminate 50 Scavs all over the Tarkov territory

the-huntsman-path-forest-cleaning.briefing: Greetings. For years I've been hunting in these woods, and among other things, I've learned that animals are way more humane than humankind itself. When shit hit the fan, all that's left of those remains of humane in people just vanished. There are so many monsters out there, that I can't even imagine. Those are no longer people, nor they are animals, they are something way worse... We can't let them destroy our city, we have to sort this out. Deal with this, hunter.

objectives.text: Eliminate 3 Scavs dressed in police uniform (Reshala's bodyguards)

the-huntsman-path-justice.guide: In this quest you have to kill 3 of Reshala's followers.
the-huntsman-path-justice.briefing: Ah, it's you? Glad to see you, friend. Ever tracked your prey on a hunt? When all this fuss started here in Tarkov, lots of things changed, brothers started fighting one another - it’s the usual thing now. And the same works for the authorities, those who had to protect the law before became unscrupulous creatures, some haven't even changed from uniform, can you imagine? I have a personal score with them. Well, if you send some Scavs to hell, it will be for the better, there has been nothing human left in these men for a long time anyway. Get rid of the remains of Reshala's gang, they're dressed in police uniform, can't miss them.

objectives.text: Eliminate 6 Raiders

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for MP-155 Ultima thermal camera at Jaeger LL4

the-huntsman-path-liberation.guide: Find and kill 6 Scav Raiders in The Lab or on Reserve.
the-huntsman-path-liberation.briefing: The most shitty situations usually quickly make it clear on who is who. Some people stay the same, some people don't. And recently I've heard the rumors about the new forces in the area. They come out of nowhere, tear places apart, take whatever they want and vanish as if they never were there. They call themselves Raiders. People say that they are mostly ex-military and ex-PMCs. I've also heard that they have someone really powerful behind them, pulling the strings from abroad. Calm down those Raiders.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 Rogues on Lighthouse

rewards.text: Unlocks craft for 12/70 AP-20 armor-piercing slug at Workbench level 3

the-huntsman-path-outcasts.guide: In this quest you have to kill 10 Rogues on any location.
the-huntsman-path-outcasts.briefing: Hey there, kid, I have bad news. Word reached me that a bunch of scum had settled somewhere on the coast beyond the collapsed tunnel. They do whatever the hell they want, harass the whole territory - like a pack of wild wolves. And it's not even some local bandits, but your former work colleagues. As I understand it, when the whole conflict began, their main base was somewhere on the cape. Unlike you, these do not want to return home, but to plunder our land to the last, those bastards! Get rid of them and be careful, soldier.

requirements: Obtain level 4 loyalty with Jaeger

objectives.text: Eliminate Tagilla
Eliminate Killa
Eliminate Reshala
Eliminate Shturman
Eliminate Glukhar
Eliminate Sanitar

rewards.text: 1× Armasight Zeus-Pro 640 2-8x50 30Hz thermal scope (Unlocked for purchase)

the-huntsman-path-relentless.guide: In this quest you have to kill all described bosses in one "life". This means that you have to kill them all, and extract successfully to complete the quest. For the locations of the bosses check their respective pages.
the-huntsman-path-relentless.briefing: Come on in, kid. Got anything interesting to tell? Eh, forget it, don't want to listen about your war. Got enough of it here. I don't have much to teach you anymore, you know how to stand up for yourself, and you know of justice well. Met the local bandit leaders too. But have you tried getting them all at once? The task in not an easy one, but the goal is worth it. The most important thing is what mark we leave behind us.

objectives.text: Eliminate Sanitar

the-huntsman-path-sadist.guide: By completing A Difficult Choice, you will fail and lose access to this quest. In this quest you have to kill Sanitar.
the-huntsman-path-sadist.briefing: Hey there, kid. Something nostalgic came over me. I remembered how I walked along the coast, it was beautiful there, the waves roll in, the sun, the beach, and the sunsets there were outstanding, and now what? The smell of rot and desolation everywhere, can't even breathe properly in the city... And on top of all that, a new moron showed up. They call him Sanitar. This scum conducts experiments on people and perhaps does even more terrible things. You can't leave it like this, such people.. such abominations should not walk our ground. The world will only become cleaner. Deal with this.

objectives.text: Eliminate 6 PMСs in the office area (any floor) on Factory

the-huntsman-path-secured-perimeter.guide: In this quest you have to kill 6 PMСs in and around the office area on Factory. Only the enemy PMCs have to be in the highlighted area for the kills to count towards this quest. File:The Huntsman Path - Secured Perimeter Map.jpg|Kill area marked on map
the-huntsman-path-secured-perimeter.briefing: Well, fighter, it's time to start cleaning Tarkov from all this trash. You and I have come a long way and you still have a lot to learn. Well then, let's start with the area of ​​the chemical plant? A lot of useful things were being produced there, I had been working there for half a year as the security chief until the TerraGroup arrived. Since then, weird shit started happening there, I'm telling you, they gave up on producing cleaners and went on for something different, something dark. And as the lawlessness began and they left, the marauders began tearing the factory apart. It's sad to see it like this, I still remember every nook and cranny there. Long story short, it's wrong. So go teach the bandits a lesson. If something useful still remains there, it would definitely be in the office area, you won't miss it. Make the looters forget the way there, at least for a while.

requirements: Must be level 32 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate Killa
Find 1 Killa's Maska-1SCh bulletproof helmet in raid
Hand over 1 Killa's Maska-1SCh bulletproof helmet to Jaeger

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for RPK-16 5.45x39 light machine gun at Prapor LL2

the-huntsman-path-sellout.guide: In this quest you have to kill Killa (Not Vengeful Killa) and find a Maska-1SCh helmet in raid.
the-huntsman-path-sellout.briefing: Be well, soldier. Do you like shopping? I used to love it too, we had a shopping center here. It was nice to spend time there, but as everything collapsed, there was no time for entertainment anymore, the stores quickly got looted, and what didn’t get looted got taken over by all kinds of scum as their mainstays. I heard that there was that one person - a former athlete, he's already been racketing before the war, and now as he has felt more power than ever, he's killing everyone indiscriminately. People call him Killa, and his helmet... you won’t miss it. Get rid of him, everybody will say thank you. And take his helmet with you, just in case.

objectives.text: Eliminate Reshala
Find 1 Reshala's Golden TT in raid
Hand over 1 Reshala's Golden TT to Jaeger

the-huntsman-path-trophy.guide: In this quest you have to kill Reshala and find his golden TT pistol in raid.
the-huntsman-path-trophy.briefing: Oh, it's you? I have something special for you today, a new hunt. There is this bastard, folks call him Reshala. You've definitely heard of him. He's got that golden pistol, one of a kind. This moron with the gang of his has been there for a while - robbing and killing people. He himself is just a coward, always hiding behind his guards. Help people get rid of him, the whole Tarkov will breathe easier. And take his pistol, It will be a good gift for Mechanic and his collection. But be extremely careful, many good fighters have already been killed by his gang. Good luck, hunter.

objectives.text: Eliminate Shturman
Find 1 Shturman's stash key in raid
Hand over 1 Shturman's stash key to Jaeger

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle (variant ARCH) at Jaeger LL3
Unlocks purchase of Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle (variant AICS) at Jaeger LL3
Unlocks purchase of Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle (variant PRO) at Jaeger LL4
Unlocks barter for Remington Model 700 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle (variant MRS) at Jaeger LL4

the-huntsman-path-woods-keeper.guide: In this quest you have to kill Shturman and find his stash key in raid.
the-huntsman-path-woods-keeper.briefing: For many years working as a gamekeeper, I know that if there is an infection in the forest, then you need to get rid of it immediately before the whole forest gets infected. One such infection settled here, they call it Shturman, he and his crew set up at the sawmill, so now I don't feel safe even in my own reserve. Deal with it, it will be for the better for the forest and the people. But be careful, Shturman has friends, and they all can shoot well.

requirements: Must be level 35 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 15 targets that are using a 20+ container size backpack

the-invisible-hand.guide: In this quest you have to kill any 15 targets that are wearing a backpack with 20+ slots.
the-invisible-hand.briefing: Hey, bro. My friendly competitors are poaching my customers. If they want to declare a trade war on me, then my answer has to be very serious. I found out how they transport their goods. They hire guys with big backpacks. Take care of those mules, will you?

requirements: Must be level 26 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Obtain the Clothes design handbook - Part 1 on Interchange
Hand over the Clothes design handbook - Part 1 to Ragman
Obtain the Clothes design handbook - Part 2 on Interchange
Hand over the Clothes design handbook - Part 2 to Ragman

the-key-to-success.guide: The first book is located in a store called "МУЗЕЙ ИСТОРИИ" ("Museum of History") on the second floor of the shopping mall on Interchange. It can be found in a pile of books on the floor. File:The key to success Marked.png|Store location marked on second floor map File:The key to success Book1Store.png|The store that contains the first book, arrow marks the pile of books File:The key to success Book2.png|First book location The second book is located in a book store on the first floor of the shopping mall on Interchange. It can be found on the middle shelf, in the lowest row that contains books. File:The key to success Marked2.png|Store location marked on first floor map File:The key to success Book2Store.png|The store that contains the second book, arrow marks the middle shelf File:The key to success Book1.png|Second book location
the-key-to-success.briefing: Good day to you! We already went so far together, you're like a brother to me. Like family, see, don't get me wrong. So, like a brother, answer frankly, do you like reading? I devoured books back then, as a kid. But now I need a serious book, for business. A rare bitch for sure, but I know you can get a devil from under the ground if you'd want. Get me the book about designing clothes from special fabrics, all that military stuff has to be made with aramid fabric, which has its own tricks to it. There should be a manual for them, in two volumes. If you can get it, that'd be capital. Should probably check in the book stores, they must be there.

objectives.text: Eliminate 30 opponents with headshots in CheckChamber mode

the-old-fashioned-way.briefing: Let's make the show even more spectacular. The rules are simple: one head, one round. Put them together and you've got yourself a bloody firework. The Arena crowd never gets tired of clean headshots. So let's keep it classic—and make every shot count. Get to work, operator.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 PMC operatives who are wearing the Christmas armband

the-price-of-celebration.guide: In this quest you have to kill 10 PMCs who are wearing the Khorovod armband. Note: The objective in the PvE mode is to eliminate 10 PMC operators while not wearing the armband yourself.
the-price-of-celebration.briefing: Can you fucking believe this? First they tried to steal my gas cans, and now they're gathering at the Christmas trees directly on my gang's routes! Because of this, I have to change my plans and organize other paths for the couriers. They're gonna freeze to death with all those long-ass detours. I'm not gonna wait for them to get done with the celebrations and go to their holes after. This bullshit has to stop right now. The ones who take part in this "Khorovod" wear special armbands. Those tossers made glowing targets of themselves! I need the job done quickly, so I'm gonna call other mercs as well. You can work as a group if you want, but I can't guarantee they won't shoot at you. You know, every man for himself, and all that.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the incriminating letter on Customs
Use the transit from Customs to Reserve
Stash the letter on the third floor of the military headquarters on Reserve
Use the transit from Reserve to Woods
Eliminate any 3 targets on Woods
Use the transit from Woods to Lighthouse
Launch a yellow signal flare at the train station warehouse on Lighthouse
Launch a yellow signal flare at the pier on Lighthouse
Survive and extract from Lighthouse
Eliminate 10 Scavs while completing the other objectives

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Blue) at Mechanic LL2
Unlocks barter for Graphics card at Mechanic LL3

the-price-of-independence.guide: In this quest you first have to find the Incriminating letter on the third floor in the northern building of the industrial plant on Customs. Afterwards you have to transit to Reserve and stash it on the third floor of the military headquarters (Black Bishop). Next you have to transit to Woods and kill any 3 targets there. Lastly you need to transit to Lighthouse and launch a yellow flare at the train station and the pier, and extract. While doing these objectives, 10 Scavs also need to be killed. Dying or extracting at any point before completing all objectives will reset fulfilled objectives besides collecting the Incriminating letter. ===Customs Letter location=== The letter can be found in different spots in the office on the third floor of the northern building at the industrial plant. File:Provide Viewership map.png|Building location marked on map File:Provide Viewership building.png|The industrial plant File:TPoI Letter Office.png|Door to the office on the third floor File:TPoI Spawn 1.png|First spawn behind the switch box to the left after entering File:TPoI Spawn 2.png|Second spawn in the center fuse box Note: Proning required File:TPoI Spawn 3.png|Third spawn floating next to the fallen over table File:TPoI Spawn 4.png|Fourth spawn on the shelf directly next to the desk File:TPoI Spawn 5.png|Fifth spawn on the desk ===Customs to Reserve transit=== Next to the Military Base CP extraction. File:CustomsTransitToReserveMap.png File:CustomsTransitToReserve.png ===Reserve Letter stashing location=== On the third floor of the military headquarters (Black Bishop), at broken crates on the western side of the building. File:TPoI Letter Map Reserve.jpg|Building location marked on map File:TPoI Reserve Stashing Location.png|Stashing location ===Reserve to Woods transit=== At the map border northwest of the train yard. File:ReserveTransitToWoodsMap.png File:ReserveTransitToWoods.png ===Woods to Lighthouse transit=== File:WoodsTransitToLighthouseMap.jpg File:WoodsTransitToLighthouse.png ===Lighthouse Yellow flare launch locations=== Shoot a yellow flare into the sky while being in the specified areas. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. File:TPoI Flares Map.png|Flare areas marked on map
the-price-of-independence.briefing: We foiled Skier's plans, and I'll tell you this - we can't let this opportunity slip away. When he recovers, he will never let me out of his sight. That's why we need to think of a defensive plan now, because you and I are both going to get nailed! So listen, I've got a plan all worked out. Except I don't have anybody else I'd trust to do something this complex. I was able to dig up some background intel on Skier. The kind of information that could compromise him real bad if it fell into the right hands. It's all in this letter, and it's our guarantee. You need to pick it up at the customs area. The letter will be on the top floor of the building by the construction site. You know, the one near the railroad platform, you'll see it. Hopefully. From there, go straight to the reserve base and leave it in the headquarters on the third floor, at the fortified point with windows. The key is to make sure that Skier's men don't intercept the letter. That is why after stashing the letter, run to Priozersk and make some noise. After you kill a couple of Scavs, go to the lighthouse peninsula and shoot a flare. You need a yellow one, don't get it mixed up! The best place to do it is on the pier at the vacation houses and on the platform at the train station, it'll distract the guys from Skier's nearest base. After that, you run out of there! I've written all the instructions on a piece of paper to make sure you don't fuck it up. You gotta do it all at once, you understand?

objectives.text: Eliminate 50 PMC operatives
Hand over 50 found in raid level 25+ dogtags

rewards.text: 1× T H I C C item case
Unlocks purchase of 4.6x30mm AP SX at Peacekeeper LL1
Unlocks purchase of 5.45x39mm 7N40 at Peacekeeper LL1
Unlocks purchase of 5.56x45mm SSA AP at Peacekeeper LL1
Unlocks purchase of 7.62x39mm MAI AP at Peacekeeper LL1
Unlocks purchase of 7.62x51mm M993 at Peacekeeper LL1
Unlocks purchase of 9x19mm PBP gzh at Peacekeeper LL1

the-punisher-harvest.guide: In this quest you have to kill 50 PMCs and hand over 50 found in raid dogtags from players of level 25 or higher.
the-punisher-harvest.briefing: You're finally in touch, mercenary. I was just approached by a man who calls himself a Master. He asked to find you, because from his words you understand the essence of the matter and deserve Their respect. The master asked me to tell you that there is a new job for you. It is necessary to eliminate experienced colleagues throughout Tarkov. I will give you the necessary equipment to complete the task. Let me be honest with you, my friend. I do not approve Master's methods, but the benefits offered are very attractive. I can't tell you everything, but I can give you some advice: special times are coming, save your ammunition if you want to survive. Our work with you is very productive, and I would not like you to die in this massacre.

requirements: Must be level 19 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 25 Scavs while using an AKS-74U series assault rifle on Customs

rewards.text: 1× Lobaev Arms DVL-10 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle (variant Urbana)
Unlocks craft for 5.45x39mm PP gs at Workbench level 2

the-punisher-part-1.guide: In this quest you have to kill 25 Scavs on Customs with short AK series assault rifles. You can use any of the following: *AKS-74U *AKS-74UN *AKS-74UB *SAG AK Short
the-punisher-part-1.briefing: Hey there, man. Well, my friends are clearly up to something. Last time you dropped some Scavs, they called me almost instantly, and, you know, it seemed like they had a bit of entertainment going on. Making bets, making cash. Long story short, they want you to decimate Scavs again, but this time on Customs and using a good old AKS-74U. I don't really want to know what kind of show they are making of it, but they offer some top cash. So, you in?

requirements: Must be level 17 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 15 Scavs while using an AKM series weapon on Shoreline

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of SV-98 7.62x54R bolt-action sniper rifle at Prapor LL2
Unlocks purchase of 7.62x39mm PS gzh at Prapor LL3

the-punisher-part-2.guide: In this quest you have to kill 15 Scavs on Shoreline with AKM series weapons. You can use any of the following: *AKM *AKMN *AKMS *AKMSN *AK-103 *AK-104 *VPO-136 File:Shoreline Scavs.png|Scav locations marked on map
the-punisher-part-2.briefing: Hello soldier, I have a job for you. Well then, it's about time we make this world a better place. The shoreline is under increasingly frequent attacks by different bandit gangs, this seriously interfered with my friends' operations. Help them with their Scav problem and we'll send a handsome reward your way. But I have one condition: you have to sort this one out using an AKM series gun, my friends have to see who helped them.

requirements: Must be level 18 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 12 Scavs with 9x39mm caliber weapons on Reserve
Find 7 Lower half-masks in raid
Hand over the 7 half-masks

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of 7.62x39mm PS gzh at Prapor LL3

the-punisher-part-3.guide: In this quest you have to kill 12 Scavs with suppressed weapons on Reserve and find 7 lower half-masks in raid.
the-punisher-part-3.briefing: My friends were mighty pleased with what you did on Shoreline. And they definitely want some more. More profit in it for you, too. Some extra gear too, so go on, keep doing good things for good people. Ah, almost forgot. They are asking for half-masks, you know, those that Scavs hide their faces with. Grab them from the bodies, they won't need them anymore, but my friends do. No idea what they need them for, probably to make a point or something. One more thing, this time it should be done silently, with a suppressor, so that they don't even know what killed them. To work, soldier.

requirements: Must be level 20 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 Scavs while using an SVDS 7.62x54R sniper rifle or TKPD 9.3x64 carbine on Lighthouse
Eliminate 10 Scavs while wearing a Scav Vest on Lighthouse
Find 5 Bars A-2607 95Kh18 knives in raid
Hand over the 5 Bars A-2607 95Kh18 knives

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of 7.62x54mm R PS gzh at Prapor LL4
Unlocks purchase of 9x39mm SP-6 gs at Prapor LL4
3x 7.62x54mm R PS gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)

the-punisher-part-4.guide: Either the Scav Vest or the Security vest can be used for the Scav kills. The Bars A-2607 95Kh18 knives are carried by Scavs. Make sure to not confuse them with the similar looking Bars A-2607 Damascus knives.
the-punisher-part-4.briefing: Oh yeah, your last Scav massacre was something else! People keep coming up to me asking what the hell's going on. Turns out my buddies struck a deal with the locals and are putting together some kind of staged fights. Gladiator-style, you could say.Anyway, you're basically their... what's the word... test guy. They come up with ideas, watch how you handle them, then tweak things based on what they see. And now they want to keep it going.This time the jobs are a bit tougher. Hunt down Scavs wearing chest rigs and take them out with an SVD or a TKPD. Bring me their knives as trophies, too. So, what do you say, soldier?

requirements: Must be level 20 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Find any Kalashnikov AK-74 assault rifle in raid
Hand over the AK-74
Find a Colt M4A1 assault rifle in raid
Hand over the M4A1
Find any 2 Makarov PM pistols in raid
Hand over the pistols
Eliminate 10 PMC operatives with Light machine guns
Eliminate 20 Scavs with Light machine guns

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Kalashnikov AK-308 7.62x51 assault rifle at Prapor LL4
Unlocks purchase of AK-308 7.62x51 QD sound suppressor at Prapor LL4

the-punisher-part-5.guide: To hand over a weapon it must be in usable condition. If a weapon's icon is red, it is missing vital parts and can not be turned in.
the-punisher-part-5.briefing: The Masters - that's what my friends have started calling themselves - are moving onto the next stage. Now they need gear for this whole gladiator business. I'd help them myself, but I've got more important things to deal with. So you find what they need, and I'll make sure it gets to them in your name. Oh, one more thing: they wanted to see how good the machine guns look in action... I'm sure you've already figured out what that means. Good luck out there, warrior!

requirements: Must be level 21 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 30 PMC operatives while using specified weapons (Light Machine Guns, 9x39mm weapons such as AS Val or SR-3M, SVDS 7.62x54R sniper rifle, TKPD 9.3x64 carbine, Kalashnikov AKS-74U series weapon or Kalashnikov AKM 7.62x39 assault rifle series weapon) on Lighthouse, Shoreline, Reserve, Ground Zero or The Lab
Hand over any 10 BEAR or USEC dogtags
Locate and Neutralize any 5 Bosses

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of SR-3M 9x39 compact assault rifle at Prapor LL4

the-punisher-part-6.guide: You need to eliminate 30 PMC's on Lighthouse, Shoreline, Reserve, Ground Zero or The Lab while using any of the specified weapons such as SVDS 7.62x54R sniper rifle or Kalashnikov AKS-74UB 5.45x39 assault rifle. You also need to eliminate any boss 5 times. It can be 5 different bosses, or 1 boss 5 times such as Killa or Tagilla - Can be done on any map, with any weapon.
the-punisher-part-6.briefing: Hey, soldier. You know ... I think I'm done with these jobs from the Masters. The PMCs have teamed up with the local bosses and started putting the squeeze on them. And they're not just trying to shut them down ... They want to take over! Getting caught in the middle of that is way too risky. So this is my last job for them. After this, I'm done. This time they want us to thin out the PMCs across the whole region. Thirty kills should satisfy them. Use machine guns, 9x39 weapons, SVD, TKPD, AKS-74U series, or AKM series, so everyone who needs to gets the message. They also want proof this time. Bring me ten PMC dogtags, any faction, and I'll make sure they end up where they're supposed to.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the virus sample in The Lab
Hand over the found item

the-root-cause.guide: To complete this quest, you need to find a TG-Vi-24 sample in the locked laboratory area inside the containment block on the first level of The Lab. There are multiple sample spawns throughout the area. File:DontBelieveYourEyesMap.png|Containment block location marked on map File:DontBelieveYourEyesArea.png|The containment block File:DontBelieveYourEyesLockedDoor.png|The locked door File:DontBelieveYourEyesSwitch.png|The switch to open the door File:DontBelieveYourEyesLockedArea.png|Doorway to the laboratory area ====Computer room==== The sample has 3 possible spawns in the computer room. File:TheRootCauseIndicatorRoom1.png|Way to the computer room from the doorway =====First/Second/Third spawn===== File:TheRootCauseRoom1.png|The 3 spawns in the room File:TheRootCauseSpawn2.png|1: In the test tube holder on the desk to the left after entering File:TheRootCauseSpawn3.png|2: Next to the stapler on the desk to the left after entering File:TheRootCauseSpawn1.png|3: In the open refrigerator ====Left side glass laboratory==== The sample has 1 possible spawn in the left side glass laboratory. File:TheRootCauseIndicatorRoom2.png|Way to the left side laboratory from the doorway =====Fourth spawn===== In the center of the middle desks.
