the-root-cause.briefing: Greetings. I figure you're already aware of the recent situation, granted you've found the blood samples Jaeger brought me. I've analyzed them, but it's not sufficient. In order to get started, I need a sample of the virus itself. This is extremely dangerous, so use every precaution during the mission! Come and see me as soon as you find it. This is to minimize the time the virus is out in the open.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the secret ingredient at the TerraGroup office on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the chemical additive

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Zenit RK-1 tactical foregrip on B-25U mount at Skier LL4

the-secret-recipe.guide: *Not all spawn locations for the quest item require this key. It is not entirely needed to complete the quest. In this quest you have to find the secret component on Streets of Tarkov. There are multiple spawns throughout two buildings. File:BeyondMeat2.png|Buildings marked on map ===TerraGroup security post=== ====First spawn==== Turn right immediately after entering the front door, then left at the end of the corridor. Back left corner desk, next to the phone. File:TerraGroup security post Building.png File:TerraGroup security armory Way 1.png File:TerraGroup security armory Way 2.png File:Beyond the Red Meat Location 1.png ====Second spawn==== Inside the TerraGroup meeting room, directly on the left when you enter the building. Located on the shelf in the back right. File:TerraGroup_MeetingRoom_LockedDoor.png File:2023-09-07-14-30- 44.3, 1.7, -59.4 0.1, -0.2, 0.0, 1.0 6.51 (0).png File:Beyond the Red Meat Location 2_2.png ===TerraGroup office=== ====Third spawn==== Turn left after entering, go to the desk in the back left corner. The vial is located inside a file organizer. File:Beyond_the_Red_Meat_2_31.png File:Image_(51).png File:Image_(52).png ====Fourth spawn==== In the backmost cubicle, located on the desk in the back right. File:Beyond the Red Meat 2 42.png File:Beyond the Red Meat 2 43.png ====Fifth spawn==== In the meeting room at the back right of the office, tucked in a rolled up blueprint. File:Beyond_the_Red_Meat_2_32.png File:Beyond_the_Red_Meat_2_33.png
the-secret-recipe.briefing: We took a look at that diary you found. Addresses, shipments of some bullshit from the TerraGroup offices. Anyway, to make good food, these assholes were adding some obscure lab-grade ingredient. It was made to be extremely addictive, so more people would come to give these pricks money. And to make them more compliant. It's some murky shit. Why don't you check to see what they were shipping from the offices? Maybe some of it is still there. There's a mention of some kind of red vial in the notes.

objectives.text: Unravel the secret of the IT firm's employees' high morale on Streets of Tarkov
Survive and extract from the location

the-secret-to-productivity.guide: In this quest you have to find and enter the "Hive" hookah lounge in the Malevicha street no. 5 building on Streets of Tarkov. A Relaxation room key is required to access it. File:The Hive Map.png|Hive hookah lounge location marked on map File:The Hive Door.png|Door to the hookah lounge Dying before extracting will reset the first part of this quest.
the-secret-to-productivity.briefing: Hello, merc. I've been thinking about that torture room you found. I can't believe it was the only thing that kept that thing going. The stick isn't enough, we need a carrot. I'm sure the employees had a way to cheer themselves up and relieve stress. See what else you can find out, maybe you'll find some more info.

objectives.text: Eliminate Killa 50 times

the-stylish-one.guide: In this quest you have to kill Killa 50 times.
the-stylish-one.briefing: So there's this dandy asshole in Ultra mall. Lurking around, cleaning the supplies, gunning everyone down right on spot. Folks out there are hella scared of him. I tell you what, you punish him properly, and I will get you a nice stylish jacket just like his one so you could give it a proper use. Could cosplay as him and shit. Just be careful, the dude is hella dangerous.

objectives.text: Eliminate 2 PMC operatives with headshots while suffering from the tremor effect

the-survivalist-path-cold-blooded.guide: In this quest you have to kill 2 PMC's with headshots while suffering from 46px|Hands tremor|link=. Hands tremor is caused by 45 seconds of untreated pain. You can also use a SJ9 TGLabs combat stimulant injector to get the effect on demand.
the-survivalist-path-cold-blooded.briefing: Come here, I've got a test for you. You must always maintain your composure, in every situation. You lose control or panic - you die. And no matter what happened - whether you've caught a bullet or just got drunk. But even with shaky hands, you have to shoot sharp. Prove to me that you can do this.

objectives.text: Reach the required Vitality skill level of 5

the-survivalist-path-combat-medic.guide: You can raise your Vitality level by: * Taking damage * Bloodloss You can use an eTG-change regenerative stimulant injector or a Propital regenerative stimulant injector and run through fire or obtain a heavy bleed to level up your vitality
the-survivalist-path-combat-medic.briefing: I just can't count how much shit have I seen while working as a gamekeeper. So many different people used to get lost in these woods. Some of them made it out alive and well, some of them didn't. You have to be one hell of a tough asshole to get out of the woods alive. Let's make a real survivalist out of you. Come to me when you're ready.

objectives.text: Eliminate 6 Scavs in the time period of 21:00-04:00 without using any NVGs or thermal sights (Excluding Factory)

rewards.text: 3× Armasight Vulcan MG 3.5x Bravo night vision scope

the-survivalist-path-eagle-owl.guide: In this quest you have to kill 6 Scavs on any map aside from Factory in the time period of 21:00-04:00 without using any night vision devices, thermal vision devices, night vision scopes or thermal vision sights. Equipped but switched off devices still prevent quest progress.
the-survivalist-path-eagle-owl.briefing: As I've read in one article, the human eye can get used to the darkness. You know, I wanted to check, and I almost broke my leg in a deadfall. Guess I'm a little old for such a metamorphosis. But you, I think, are in the prime of life. A well-trained night eyesight can help us very much in our difficult tasks. So take care of this. You're a tough guy, you can take a punch. But what if you can't see anything at night and suddenly get ambushed by some scum? Those things happen quite often, not everyone can take NVG's into their raids. So, show me how you see in the dark, without any gadgets.

objectives.text: Eliminate 15 Scavs while under any stimulant effect on Woods

the-survivalist-path-junkie.guide: In this quest you have to kill 15 Scavs on Woods while having any buff or debuff from stimulants or provisions active. The 46px|on painkillers effect does not count.
the-survivalist-path-junkie.briefing: Times are harsh these days, you know it well. You have to survive by all means, even if those means are not the safest for your health. For example, those stimulants, folks started seeing them more frequently in the region. In reality, it's a narcotic of some sort, I feel that TerraGroup is involved here for sure. But anyway, want it or not, but you will have to learn how to use them in combat, these drugs do not only kill, but sometimes help you survive.

objectives.text: Stash 1 Iskra ration pack in the ZB-016 bunker on Woods
Stash 1 Bottle of water in the ZB-016 bunker on Woods
Stash 1 Iskra ration pack in the ZB-014 bunker on Woods
Stash 1 Bottle of water in the ZB-014 bunker on Woods

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Iskra ration pack at Jaeger LL2

the-survivalist-path-thrifty.guide: In this quest you have to stash 1 Bottle of water (0.6L) and 1 Iskra ration pack each in the bunkers ZB-016 and ZB-014 on Woods. File:ZB Bunker location.png|Bunker locations marked on map ====ZB-016==== File:Zb-016 entrance.png|ZB-016 bunker entrance File:The survivalist path - Thrifty Crate overview.png|Stashing location in the bunker File:The survivalist path - Thrifty Crate close-up.png|Wooden crate where the items have to be stashed ====ZB-014==== File:ZB-014-Bunker.png|ZB-014 bunker entrance File:The survivalist path - Thrifty Crate overview2.png|Stashing location in the bunker File:The survivalist path - Thrifty Crate close-up2.png|Wooden crate where the items have to be stashed
the-survivalist-path-thrifty.briefing: Hello there! You came right in time, I'm just packing up to go hunting. Do me a favor, not for service, but as a sign of friendship. Arrange a couple of rest spots for my way back: the trip is long, so I'll have to stop for a breather somewhere. The places should be safe, leave a Russian MRE and a bottle of water for each, agreed? At the same time, remember how to survive if you get caught with your pants down. I've got some stashes hidden here and there, for example, but you don't need to know about them yet.

objectives.text: Eliminate 3 Scavs in a single raid without using any medicine on Woods

the-survivalist-path-tough-guy.guide: *Do not use any Medical items while in a raid while the quest is active. *If you complete the objective to kill the three Scavs without healing the task will still fail if you heal before handing it in. In addition, if you complete the objectives but do not click complete with Jaeger, then healing in a later Woods raid will cause failure of the quest. *Surviving the raid is not necessary for the quest to be completed. *Off-raid healing does affect this quest. *Drinkable alcohol is a painkiller that will not fail this quest.
the-survivalist-path-tough-guy.briefing: You know, in combat - as in hunting, there are only two behaviors. You are either a hunter or prey. And since you intend to become a real hunter, you must learn to track prey without exposing yourself.

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 Scavs without wearing any body armor on Woods

the-survivalist-path-unprotected-but-dan.guide: In this quest you have to kill 5 Scavs on Woods without wearing any armor vest or armored chest rig. Armored headwear, face cover and eyewear is allowed. If you want to protect yourself during this quest you can choose to still wear armor, but unequip it before killing a Scav. To keep yourself safe while doing this quest, you should try and remain as far away as possible from the Scavs and consider using a scoped weapon.
the-survivalist-path-unprotected-but-dan.briefing: Hello there, come in, take a sit. The path of ours is not easy, not easy at all. Fighting scum is dangerous and requires extraordinary skills. For example, being fast, quiet, agile and deadly. Flanking the enemy, outplaying them on their own field. Your buddies chained in their body armor will never be able to master these skills. Therefore, before embarking on serious tasks, hone this skill.

objectives.text: Eliminate 3 Scavs while suffering from pain effect

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Benelli M3 Super 90 12ga dual-mode shotgun at Jaeger LL2
Unlocks Bear Hideout shooting range target style

the-survivalist-path-wounded-beast.guide: * Dehydration and broken bones cause pain. Easiest way to break your leg bones is to fall a few meters or to intentionally fail the Hideout gym training to break your arm. ** Using a Jar of DevilDog mayo is an easy way to achieve pain through dehydration, although it comes with the side effect of constant damage over time. * Using painkillers, morphine and/or similar medication will remove the status effect, and as such kills will not count towards the quest.
the-survivalist-path-wounded-beast.briefing: Hello there. Has it ever happened to you that you got into trouble, but there is no time to take care of the wound as you have to save your skin? Self-control in the most difficult situations is the key to survival. This is a very important skill in these difficult days for our city. Show me how well you handle pain.

objectives.text: Kill 2 PMC operators while being blinded by flashbang grenade

the-survivalist-path-zatoichi.briefing: I tell you what. If your opponent is blind - there's nothing he can do against you. No matter what gear he has on him. Same works for you. Only the skill and confidence can help one get over such a situation.

objectives.text: Survive for 5 minutes while suffering from complete dehydration (Excluding Factory)
Survive and extract from the location

the-survivalist-path-zhivchik.guide: You can consume certain items that decrease your hydration to quickly get into the dehydration state. For example, a Jar of DevilDog mayo gives -99 and a Can of condensed milk -65 hydration. You can also use the gym module in your hideout to drain energy and hydration before starting a raid. Alternatively, if you play with friends, you can ask them to shoot you in the stomach, which will get you into the dehydration state too. Keep in mind that this will also decrease your energy rapidly. Don't forget to bring enough Meds or a Propital regenerative stimulant injector to outheal the damage, and enough Drinks to continue the raid afterwards. If you extract from the raid with the "Run Through" extraction status, the quest will not count as being completed. To avoid the "Run Through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting. If you happen to get a run through, you can survive and extract from another raid on any location to complete the quest.
the-survivalist-path-zhivchik.briefing: Hello there, warrior! The hunt went as planned. You know, the water you prepared for me did really come in handy. By the way, how good are you at handling dehydration? Show me how long PMCs can stay without water.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the chemical container on Ground Zero
Stash the container by the police station on Streets of Tarkov

the-tarkov-butcher.guide: In this quest you first have to find a chemical container inside a truck trailer in the underground of Ground Zero. Afterwards it has to be stashed in front of the ministry of the interior academy on Streets of Tarkov. ===Ground Zero Container location=== File:The Tarkov Butcher Ground Zero Map.png|Trailer location marked on map File:The Tarkov Butcher Ground Zero Truck.png|The trailer File:The Tarkov Butcher Ground Zero Spawn 1.png|First spawn in the pig carcass opposite the first corpse File:The Tarkov Butcher Ground Zero Spawn 2.png|Second spawn in the back of the trailer in the trash bag File:The Tarkov Butcher Ground Zero Spawn 3.png|Third spawn in the back of the trailer in the snout of the pig head ===Streets of Tarkov Stashing location=== File:The Tarkov Butcher Streets of Tarkov Map.png|Stashing location marked on map File:The Tarkov Butcher Streets of Tarkov Location.png|Stashing location
the-tarkov-butcher.briefing: Have you heard the stories about the serial killer who was operating in the city? The first rumors about the "Tarkov Butcher" appeared during the Contract Wars. But because of the conflict, the investigation was abandoned. An acquaintance of mine has taken an interest in this case and is looking for traces left by the Butcher. To track him down, we need to understand his motives and what drove him. The documents we managed to recover from the police department state that the Butcher worked as a driver for one of the meat processing plants. The victims' bodies were discovered in refrigerated trucks used for transporting meat… If you can find anything that could help with the investigation, I would be grateful. And one more thing: my acquaintance requires certain medications. Deliver him a chemical container with everything he needs.

objectives.text: Eliminate PMCs with SR-25 with Hybrid 46 suppressor and S&B PM II 1-8x24 scope on Lighthouse or Reserve

rewards.text: Unlocks craft for 9x39mm PAB-9 gs at Workbench level 2

the-tarkov-import.briefing: Greetings, soldier! Here's the situation. I ordered a batch of imported rifles from Mechanic for some clients. Personally, I still prefer our own weapons. Homegrown gear's always been closer to an old soldier's heart, you know?\n\nAnyway, it's an SR-25 fitted with a Hybrid 46 suppressor and a Schmidt & Bender PM II 1-8x24 scope. I need it properly field-tested. And don't waste your time shooting Scavs. I want to know how it performs against fighters who can actually shoot back. I'll issue you one. Put it through its paces, then come back and tell me what you think.

objectives.text: Find the encrypted flash drive in raid
Hand over the encrypted flash drive to Skier

rewards.text: 3× AR-15 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG 30 GEN M3 STANAG 30-round magazine

the-tarkov-mystery.guide: The flash drive can be found in: *Pockets and bags of Scavs *Buried barrel cache *Common fund stash *Dead Scav *Drawer *Ground cache *Jacket *Plastic suitcase *Safe *Sport bag *Weapon box (5x5)
the-tarkov-mystery.briefing: Hey. Something interesting came up. You see all these flash drives popping up all of a sudden? It's like some wanker's been dumping them on purpose. Get me one. Let's see what's so interesting about them. Anyway, these thumb drives are lying around with all the electronics. Roger-roger?

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 Scavs from over 40 meters away while using a bolt-action rifle with iron sights

the-tarkov-shooter-part-1.guide: To do this task, grab a bolt-action rifle or an MP-18 and do not attach any scopes or sights. Use only the iron sights. Factory is not recommended for this quest as there are not many places where you can effectively engage at 40m or further. Only Scavs count towards this quest, not PMCs. Woods, Shoreline, and Customs are good maps because of the sniper Scavs that can be spotted from a far distance.
the-tarkov-shooter-part-1.briefing: Here you are. Only you and Sniper can survive that long in the field, raid after raid, it looks like. He was recently looking for a reliable guy, who can be entrusted with a task and won't let him down. He says the best way to test a person for his task is to check their skills with bolt-action rifles. He's a serious man, so I think he needs a fighter for something important. What do you think, can I recommend you? Try yourself in as the "Tarkov Shooter". if you pass all Sniper's tests, I’ll arrange you a contact with him. So, here's the first task he prepared: we need to test your accuracy with iron sights from a medium distance, let's say 40 meters.

objectives.text: Shoot any target in the legs from over 40 meters away while using a bolt-action rifle 3 times
Shoot any target in the head from over 40 meters away while using a bolt-action rifle 2 times

rewards.text: 1× Mosin Rifle AIM Sports MNG rail mount
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle AIM Sports MNG rail mount at Jaeger LL1

the-tarkov-shooter-part-2.guide: In this quest you have to use a bolt-action rifle or MP-18 to land 3 hits on any entities legs, and 2 hits on any entities heads from over 40 meters away. The leg hits can all be done on the same target. Hits on group members don't count.
the-tarkov-shooter-part-2.briefing: My friend, Shabelsky was his last name, used to write stories about the war. Even I had a fun time reading them sometimes. So recently he sold the rights to the entire series of books, and they made a movie after them in the West. But now he wants more money from the movie company, he hit the hard times, apparently. Even messaged me to look up some decent fighters here in Tarkov. It seems the whole world has forgotten about our city... They only remember us when they need a hired gun, and while things are going good they prefer to not notice our situation at all. Anyway, I digress. Are you ready for the second task from Sniper? You have to shoot at heads and legs from the same distance, 40 meters.

objectives.text: Eliminate 3 PMCs from less than 25 meters away while using a bolt-action rifle

rewards.text: 1× Mosin Rifle Tacfire Tanker Style 7.62x54R muzzle brake
1× Mosin Rifle AIM Sports Recoil Pad
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle Tacfire Tanker Style 7.62x54R muzzle brake at Jaeger LL2
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle AIM Sports Recoil Pad at Jaeger LL2
Unlocks craft for .366 TKM AP-M at Workbench level 3
Unlocks Colored Hideout shooting range target style

the-tarkov-shooter-part-3.guide: To do this quest, grab a bolt-action rifle or an MP-18. Factory is a recommended location for this quest, as there are ample opportunities to engage PMC's at 25m or closer. You can use the M7290 grenade, the Zarya grenade or a KS-23M with the Zvezda flashbang round to flash and stun PMC'S and make them easier targets.
the-tarkov-shooter-part-3.briefing: I see you're quite a good shot, kid. Sniper said he wants to test your reaction time. The faster one wins, as he says. As in that film, remember, "The Good, the Bad and the Ugly", only with a bolt-action rifle instead of a revolver. Life here certainly isn’t a movie, but the reaction and the choice of position are very important in the firefight, especially in urban conditions. If you survive this, help yourself to my cowboy hat, I have one around here somewhere. You choose yourself, who you want to be: the good, the bad, or the ugly.

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 PMC operatives from over 80 meters away while using a bolt-action rifle

rewards.text: 1× Mosin Rifle AIM Sports Tri-Rail mount
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle AIM Sports Tri-Rail mount at Jaeger LL2
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle Tacfire pistol grip at Jaeger LL2

the-tarkov-shooter-part-4.briefing: It's good that you're alive, tasks from Sniper are not easy. Let's wait for a little before the next test. There is going to be a lot more complicated sniper work from now on, so my advice is that you master your bolt-action rifle handling skills some more. Come back when you're ready.

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 Sniper Scavs while using a bolt-action rifle

rewards.text: 1× Mosin Rifle ATI Monte Carlo stock
1× Ski hat with holes for eyes
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle ATI Monte Carlo stock at Jaeger LL3

the-tarkov-shooter-part-5.guide: Although they don't spawn 100% of the time, sniper Scavs can currently be found in the following locations: ===Streets of Tarkov=== ===Customs=== ===Shoreline=== ===Woods===
the-tarkov-shooter-part-5.briefing: As Sniper likes to say: "The best tool against a sniper is another sniper". It is not a rare case in combat, but you have to keep in mind that the enemy is a well-trained and well-prepared shooter. They are smart, will take up tricky positions, and try to deceive you. Even if they're not a professional military man, but a former gamekeeper or so. You need to "tie down" the enemy sniper, make them show themself - then, they're all yours. Well, these are recommendations I was asked to give you. Scavs just find rifles with scopes and climb up on the roofs or rocks, thinking they're actual snipers. Those are the ones you have to eliminate.

objectives.text: Eliminate 5 PMCs while using a suppressed bolt-action rifle

rewards.text: 1× Mosin Rifle Witt Machine 7.62x54R muzzle brake
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle Witt Machine 7.62x54R muzzle brake at Jaeger LL3
Unlocks craft for 7.62x54mm R BT gzh at Workbench level 3

the-tarkov-shooter-part-6.guide: Maps with a large number of open spaces where you can effectively engage at 45 m or further such as Woods and Shoreline are recommended for this quest.
the-tarkov-shooter-part-6.briefing: Neutralizing your target is more effective without any noise, from a safe distance. The next test from Sniper is a practice in this kind of business. Get a suppressor and shoot experienced enemies from medium distances.

objectives.text: Eliminate 3 PMCs with a headshot and without dying while using a bolt-action rifle

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle ProMag Archangel OPFOR PRS chassis at Jaeger LL4
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle 7.62x54R ProMag Archangel OPFOR 10-round magazine at Jaeger LL4
Unlocks barter for Vortex Razor HD Gen.2 1-6x24 30mm riflescope at Jaeger LL4

the-tarkov-shooter-part-7.guide: The kills can be done over multiple raids, but dying at any point before actually handing in the completed quest will fail it.
the-tarkov-shooter-part-7.briefing: Do you like classic literature? Why do you think Dostoevsky is so popular with those who've never been to Russia? I've been wondering about it for a while until this TerraGroup scandal emerged. Its executives, I assume, were very familiar with classics and what they do to us. Such a situation can only be pulled in a society where people can combine both lies and betrayal and irrational, unexplainable self-sacrifice, which are more abundant in Tarkov than in any other place. Dostoevsky wrote about it, these people can live with the highest commitment to other people and at the same time be the best at killing. Sometimes we forget about this. The next task from Sniper is your personal count, and not in cash, obviously.

objectives.text: Locate Fence's men who went missing on Shoreline
Survive and extract from the location

the-terragroup-trail-part-1.guide: In this quest you have to find Fence's missing men on Shoreline and extract. They are located at a military truck between the swamp village and the health resort. File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 1 Map.jpg|Location marked on map File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 1 Location.png|The truck
the-terragroup-trail-part-1.briefing: Got a job for you. My men found a big cache in the Health Resort area. The group was not small, but even they couldn't take everything: money, weapons, jewelry. But the main thing - information and components of something, and what exactly - you do not need to know yet. I'll make sure to inform you after we're done here. The head of the group got really carried away, I never seen him like that. They haven't been in touch since, and they talk nonsense over the radio.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 30 targets while using VSS Vintorez 9x39 special sniper rifle in the car dealership area on Streets of Tarkov
Plant Sanitar's bag on the second floor of the car dealership near Kaban's office

the-terragroup-trail-part-10.guide: In this quest you have to kill any 30 entities with a VSS Vintorez 9x39 special sniper rifle in the vicinity of the LexOs car dealership on Streets of Tarkov. Afterwards you have to place a Sanitar bag near Kaban's office in the closed section on the second floor of the car dealership. A Car dealership closed section key is required to enter it. File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 10 Map.png|Kill area and LexOs location marked on map File:CarDealer.png|The LexOs car dealership File:CarDealerClosedSectionDoor.png|Closed section grate door on the second floor File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 10 Placement Location.png|Placement location
the-terragroup-trail-part-10.briefing: Establishing a foothold in the region is not just about money and weapons, mercenary! It's also about diplomacy. We continue our plan with the local authorities. Let's make it look like Sanitar took what should have gone to the other bosses. Yes, we'll set him up. Leave a bag of evidence on Sanitar in a conspicuous place, I've already prepared the bag. And to draw attention to it, you're gonna have to do some damage to one of the Bosses' territories. I suggest we go into the territory of Kaban, who used to be neutral before.

objectives.text: Plant a radio repeater inside the Mi-8 helicopter at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse
Plant a radio repeater inside the abandoned USEC cottage on Lighthouse
Plant a radio repeater on the hill in front of the Lighthouse island
Plant a radio repeater on the roof of the landing stage on Lighthouse

the-terragroup-trail-part-11.guide: In this quest you have to place 4 radio repeaters in different locations on Lighthouse. It is recommended to place them in separate raids, carrying them in your secure container. If you have a Secure container Epsilon, you can safely place 2 per raid. After placing the repeater you'll have a 40 second countdown during which someone can pick it up and prevent you from finishing the task. File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 11 Map.png|Placement areas marked on map File:MI-8HelicopterPlacement.png|Inside the MI-8 helicopter File:AbandonedUSECCottagePlacement.png|Inside the USEC cottage on the desk File:HighElevationPlacement.png|On a plateau where a ground cache is located File:SunkenBuildingRoofPlacement.png|On the roof of the sunken building
the-terragroup-trail-part-11.briefing: Hello. I did the job, but the information from this device has nothing to do with me. And you didn't bring anything to me, understand? Hand the files over to Lightkeeper. But there's a little hitch - only part of the data was on the laptop, and the other part was probably stolen, and without it, this puzzle can't be put together. And you won't believe whose digital footprint was on the laptop. Sanitar's. Looks like he still has the rest of the data. But okay, for now, another thing. As you know, Lightkeeper is not easy to get to, but it's urgent, so I think I can help you with that. So, I've assembled the transmitters to get in contact with the Lightkeeper. Now we need to install them in the Lighthouse area. I figured out where a good place might be. Number one: inside the helicopter at the water treatment plant. Another one: an abandoned USEC cottage, it should have the right equipment, and you can tap into it to boost the retransmitter's output. And number three and four: somewhere high up, closer to the Lighthouse itself, and another one by the beach. And be careful. Don't get too close to the lighthouse itself just yet. A customer told me there was a sniper up there.

objectives.text: Hand over a Piece of plexiglass
Hand over an Insulating tape
Hand over a Military circuit board
Hand over a Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitter

rewards.text: 1× Decoded Digital secure DSP radio transmitter

the-terragroup-trail-part-12.briefing: So, I got in touch with the Lightkeeper, now you will have to get yourself a transmitter to reach the Lighthouse. There's a case somewhere in the warehouse, I'll look for it. But unfortunately, I don't have the necessary resources for the internals, and I wasn't planning on looking for them. So all my hope is on you. And the job isn't really all that difficult.

objectives.text: Obtain the V4 Flash Drive on Customs
Reflash the Radio transmitter
Hand over the V4 Flash Drive to Mechanic
Visit the lighthouse building

the-terragroup-trail-part-13.guide: There are two possible locations for the V4 flash drive on the northern second floor section of warehouse #6 (USEC stash building) on Customs. After obtaining it, you have to reflash the transmitter at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted. After the reflashing is done, the transmitter is fully functional and can be used to bypass the Claymores and Zryachiy guarding the bridge to the lighthouse peninsula, allowing you to visit the lighthouse building and meet Lightkeeper. Note: If not all members of your lobby-made group have an encoded transmitter, it will have the "blocked" state and the bridge can't be passed. File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 13 Map.png|Warehouse #6 location marked on map File:Flashdrive v4 spawn 1.png|First spawn on the bench next to the door File:Flashdrive v4 spawn 2.png|Second spawn on the desk next to the greenscreen
the-terragroup-trail-part-13.briefing: All right, hand me the transmitter. Just a moment. There's a problem, it's not tuned in. You need to re-flash it. And look for the flash drive in the streamer room at the customs office, they might have it there.

objectives.text: Obtain Reagent Omega from the testing area in The Lab
Obtain Reagent Beta from the laboratory zone in The Lab
Obtain Reagent Alpha from the laboratory testing area in The Lab
Hand over Reagent Omega
Hand over Reagent Beta
Hand over Reagent Alpha

the-terragroup-trail-part-14.guide: In this quest you have to find three reagent containers on The Lab and hand them over to Lightkeeper. Note: You need at least one 2x2 and one 1x1 free inventory slot as you hand the containers to Lightkeeper to receive the quest rewards and continue to the next part. ====First reagent container==== On a table near the dome on the first level. File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 14 Map.png|Locations marked on map File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 14 Reagent 1-1.png File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 14 Reagent 1-2.png ====Second reagent container==== In the laboratory block/zone on the second level. TerraGroup Labs keycard (Green) required to enter. File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 14 Map.png|Locations marked on map File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 14 Reagent 3-1.png File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 14 Reagent 3-2.png ====Third reagent container==== In the laboratory testing/experiments area on the first level. TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black) required to enter. File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 14 Map.png|Locations marked on map File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 14 Reagent 2-1.png File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 14 Reagent 2-2.png
the-terragroup-trail-part-14.briefing: Well met. What brings you here, mercenary? Oh, so that's how it is. Well, this kind of data is indeed useful. So here's the deal: I'll help you get the last piece of the puzzle, but not for free. So you'll do a favor for me. I've been wanting to go to the TerraGroup lab for a while now, but I haven't gotten around to it. You'll go there and look for special reagents left behind by the scientists and staff. Your Sanitar was involved in their development. I'll be waiting for you with reagents in hand. Bon voyage.

objectives.text: Obtain the first part of the encoded intel on Woods
Obtain the second part of the encoded intel on Woods
Transfer the first part of the data from the manager's terminal in The Lab
Transfer the second part of the data from the USEC terminal on Lighthouse

the-terragroup-trail-part-15.guide: The encoded intel is found as two flash drives which are located in the Scav bunker under the antenna in the northwest of Woods. Each flash drive has 2 possible locations. After obtaining the flash drives, they have to be placed in the manager's office (Manager's office key required) in The Lab and in the black (southern) chalet on Lighthouse. ====Flash drive locations - Woods Scav bunker==== File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 15 Antenna Location.jpg|Scav bunker location marked on map File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 15 Stick 1 Nightstand.png|Flash drive one location 1 on the nightstand File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 15 Stick 1 Table.png|Flash drive one location 2 on the wooden table File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 15 Stick 2 Mattress.png|Flash drive two location 1 on the folded mattress File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 15 Stick 2 Sofa.png|Flash drive two location 2 on the sofa armrest ====Flash drive #1 placement location - The Lab Manager's office ==== File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 15 Managers Office Map.png|Manager's office location marked on map File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 15 Labs Placement Location.png|Placement location on the desk with the two screens ====Flash drive #2 placement location - Lighthouse Black (southern) chalet==== File:BlackChaletMap.png|Black chalet location marked on map File:MissingCargoChalet.png|The chalet File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 15 Lighthouse placement location.png|Placement location on the first floor ontop of the dining table with the laptops
the-terragroup-trail-part-15.briefing: You were able to get all the information, my people were able to use it. I'm going to take the contents of the cache and all the information to the big earth. To the highest bidder. To verify the authenticity of the information, you must download it piece by piece through several Terminals in Tarkov's territory. The data is encrypted, but security first, you understand. You can find them in the Priozersk protected area, under the cell tower.

objectives.text: Hand over 10 found in raid "Obdolbos of Truth" injectors

the-terragroup-trail-part-16.guide: In this quest you have obtain 10 "Obdolbos N" cocktail injectors from weird Scavs and hand them over to Therapist. They can be found in the proximity of a military truck between the swamp village and the health resort on Shoreline, and in the dilapidated village on the eastern island on Lighthouse. The injectors are located inside the pockets of the Scavs, but they are not guaranteed. File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 1 Map.jpg|Shoreline truck location marked on map File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 1 Location.png|The truck The TerraGroup Trail - Part 1 Map2.png|Lighthouse village location marked on map
the-terragroup-trail-part-16.briefing: Ah, you again, young man! You want to help, you say? For free? Well, I won't object. There is one thing you can do for me. You helped me identify the crap in that nasty Sanitar drug, but the victims are still infected. I want to cure these Scavs and maybe get them on my side... Ah, yes. Please find me, say, ten copies of this serum, that should be enough for full-scale research.

objectives.text: Place a WI-FI Camera to watch the sliding gate in the supply warehouse on Reserve

the-terragroup-trail-part-17.guide: On Reserve, enter the north-western located underground storage warehouse marked with "Д". After you head down one of the ramps, you need to place a WI-FI camera on the forklift closest to the sliding gate. File:Reserv_guide.jpg|Warehouse "Д" location marked on map File:ReserveQuestWarehouse.png|Warehouse "Д" File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 17 Forklift Map.png|Forklift location marked on map File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 17 Forklift.png|The wanted forklift
the-terragroup-trail-part-17.briefing: Hey. Listen, I could use your help with something. There's a big increase in demand for domestic stuff, and my supplier is somehow making it easy to export. I can't imagine where he's getting it from. I have an idea. Why don't you put a camera in the basement of the Federal Reserve for me? Maybe he gets his supplies from there.

the-terragroup-trail-part-18.briefing: Hello, warrior. You heard what's going on? Apparently our military conducted a successful raid on Scavs in the suburbs just the other day! You don't happen to know those kind souls, do you? Why don't you ask them about a little job for me? If they could cut down on the Raiders sniffing around, that'd be great...

objectives.text: Eliminate any 7 targets during night time on Shoreline (in one raid)
Send a signal with a flare from the top of the small lighthouse on the coast to the ship waiting in the bay (in one raid)
Survive and extract from the location

the-terragroup-trail-part-19.guide: On Shoreline in the same raid: Kill any 7 entities in the time period of 22:00-10:00 and shoot a yellow flare into the sky from the top of the lighthouse at the pier. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which can be bought at Prapor LL1 or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. Afterwards, survive and extract from the location. File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 19 Lighthouse Map.jpg|Lighthouse location marked on map File:Lighthouse.png|The lighthouse
the-terragroup-trail-part-19.briefing: So, it looks like this is gonna be the end of this particular mess. Everyone got what they wanted, the traders will keep it quiet, the Bosses have been appeased. My men have access to the item, and the buyers from the "big land" have been found. The transfer is complete, the only thing left to do is to get the shipment out of Tarkov's territory. But we have to do it at night and without witnesses, even if it's my people... We can't allow any leaks, you understand.

objectives.text: Eliminate 2 weird Scavs
Find the source of their abnormal behavior
Hand over the found evidence

the-terragroup-trail-part-2.guide: In this quest you have to kill 2 weird Scavs and obtain a "Obdolbos N" cocktail injector from them to hand it over to Therapist. They can be found in the proximity of a military truck between the swamp village and the health resort on Shoreline, and in the dilapidated village on the eastern island on Lighthouse. The injector is located inside the pockets of the Scavs, but it is not guaranteed. File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 1 Map.jpg|Shoreline truck location marked on map File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 1 Location.png|The truck The TerraGroup Trail - Part 1 Map2.png|Lighthouse village location marked on map
the-terragroup-trail-part-2.briefing: Hello, mercenary, how's your health-- From Fence, you say? You know I don't do business with him. What does he want from me?.. Okay, I get it. How can I stay out of this? Human lives are at stake. Although I'm 99% sure drugs are involved. You know Fence's gang, what else could have happened to them if not this? You need to go back to the scene again, examine the bodies. Find anything that might help the investigation.

objectives.text: Obtain the mysterious laptop at the water treatment plant
Hand over the laptop

the-terragroup-trail-part-3.guide: In this quest you have to find the mysterious laptop at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse and hand it over to Prapor. It can be found at one of three different locations near the western entrance. File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 3 Location Map.png|Locations marked on map File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 3 Location 2.png|1. Ontop of the sandbags next to the portable toilet File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 3 Location 1.png|2. Inside the portable toilet File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 3 Location 3 1.png|3.1. Inside the red container File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 3 Location 3 2.png|3.2. Under a crate in the red container
the-terragroup-trail-part-3.briefing: Problem with the Scavs? No, they have a problem with us! Yeah, I've heard you're trying to deal with the stoners, too, the doctor said. My men already caught one and interrogated him at the checkpoint. He's a total freak! When he snapped back to reality, he told us they had a big fight with the Rogues. Listening to him, it was a hell of a fight. But he kept talking about some fuck all laptop. The problem is, he didn't have any sort of hardware on him. I'm sensing it's a big deal, so you better find me that laptop in no time.

objectives.text: Locate the place of Rogues' meeting spot on Shoreline
Disrupt the deal
Survive and extract from the location

the-terragroup-trail-part-4.guide: In this quest you have to find and disrupt the meeting between Sanitar and the Goons. The meeting is held at the cottage area on Shoreline. You need to enter the quest area to fulfil the first quest objective and kill at least one of the Goons or Sanitar for the quest to complete. File:The TerraGroup Trail - Part 4 Map.jpg|Location marked on map
the-terragroup-trail-part-4.briefing: Okay, back off! Since when have you become a computer engineer, you counselor fuckwit? I've tried your "on and off" thing ten times already! I've unplugged it too. Why don't you go deal with these tourists while I'm at it, don't just stand here! Explain them whose land they're walking on. Make sure they lose interest in doing business with that beaten-up surgeon.

objectives.text: Ask Mechanic to decode the laptop

the-terragroup-trail-part-5.guide: Complete the quest The TerraGroup Trail - Part 6 from Mechanic.
the-terragroup-trail-part-5.briefing: Okay, the laptop you gave me is all fucked up, my guys have no clue how to unlock it. My best techs can't decipher it, so I need the best of the best. I'll pass it on, and you take care of the rest.

objectives.text: Hand over 5 Physical Bitcoins

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for Kalashnikov AK-74M 5.45x39 assault rifle at Mechanic LL1

the-terragroup-trail-part-6.briefing: Hello, friend! Yes, I've already received the package with the laptop. The task doesn't look easy. I will need certain decryption programs. I even know which of our foreign colleagues we can get them from. But it's going to cost us.

objectives.text: Deal with Peacekeeper

the-terragroup-trail-part-7.guide: Accept the quest The TerraGroup Trail - Part 8 from Peacekeeper.
the-terragroup-trail-part-7.briefing: Come in, mercenary. I suppose you're anxious to know what the analysis shows. Simply put, after the drug is administered, control between the dorsolateral and dorsomedial prefrontal cortex is increased, the medial superior cortex is inhibited and-- Okay, I understand. I'll make it even simpler. It's a truth serum, mercenary. Or an intermediate version of trying to create one. Because even after a short time after administration, the opposite effect occurs: the patient stops distinguishing truth from fiction, becomes delusional, cognitive impairment takes place. This serum has Sanitar written all over it, I'll tell you that. Please explain the situation to Peacekeeper. This diabolical drug must not leave Tarkov, or better yet, it must be completely destroyed.

the-terragroup-trail-part-8.briefing: Good day, mercenary! So, you're asking for my help. Yes, I could arrange it, but not for free. And I'm afraid you don't have the resources to buy a favor of this magnitude from me. The blue helmets in Tarkov need more resources: weapons, financial, human. Can you at least get me three tank battalions so I can finally stop the bloodshed in the region? Exactly. Only the government structures have those resources. What we can do is get HQ to decide to increase my funding sooner rather than later. Let's make it look like the Russian Armed Forces have started pouring huge sums of money into supporting the Tarkov group. Then Visser will definitely sign the necessary papers, and then it's all done. So, mercenary, a favor for a favor?
