the-terragroup-trail-part-9.briefing: I tried contacting Sanitar and the Goons to solve your problem, but to no avail. I suggest we go another way: we start a war of authority. Believe me, in this confrontation, Sanitar won't have time for chemical experiments. First, let's make a small diplomatic gesture to increase the trust of the local Bosses in my humble person. I have chosen brothers Killa and Tagilla, as well as Reshala, Shturman and Glukhar for our diplomatic act. You will deliver gifts to them on my behalf, and I will additionally write letters inviting them to shop with me at a nice discount.

objectives.text: Install a WI-FI Camera in the first crane's cockpit on Factory
Install a WI-FI Camera in the second crane's cockpit on Factory
Install a WI-FI Camera in the third crane's cockpit on Factory

rewards.text: 1× TDI KRISS Vector Gen.2 .45 ACP submachine gun
3× Glock .45 ACP KRISS G30 MagEx 30-round magazine
3× .45 ACP Lasermatch FMJ ammo pack (50 pcs)

the-walls-have-eyes.guide: In this quest you have to plant 3 WI-FI Cameras inside the crane cockpits on Factory. They can only be entered from the top via the rafters. Placing each camera requires you to be stationary for 40 seconds, so be sure to secure the area first. File:The Walls Have Eyes Map.jpg|Locations marked on map File:WallsHaveEyesPlantLocation1.png|Cockpit #1 above the "Gate 3" extraction. File:WallsHaveEyesPlacement2.png|Cockpit #2 above the "Med Tent Gate" extraction. File:WallsHaveEyes3rdPlacement.png|Cockpit #3 opposite the "Gate 0" extraction.
the-walls-have-eyes.briefing: You got here just in time, man! I remember you helped me a hell of a lot with surveillance in the suburbs. And now there's all this commotion at the chemical plant, I bet you're well aware of it! Be a true pal, arrange some eyes for me there too, yea? I've seen some cranes there, they would be a perfect place for a camera. Alright, chop chop.

objectives.text: Find 2 Propane tanks (5L) in raid
Hand over the items

thirsty-breadwinner.guide: The easiest way to complete this task is via utilizing your Scav character on Interchange to loot the OLI store, as propane tanks are commonly found on the shelving in the area.
thirsty-breadwinner.briefing: The Thirsty dude? You too?! Why are you all bringing him up all of a sudden? Yeah, I worked with this guy. Couldn't last five minutes without a drink. We made some good money with him back then. Always brought good loot, that guy. My respect to him. But he's been out of the game for a long time, at least in Tarkov. I can give you a tip on where he dumped his extra supplies, but not for free. I'm looking for two tanks of propane right now. Why don't you find it for me, and then we'll talk about your guy?

objectives.text: Locate the specified stash spot on Woods
Locate the specified stash spot on Customs
Stash the first Propane tank (5L)
Stash the second Propane tank (5L)

thirsty-delivery.guide: In this quest you have to stash the 2 Propane tanks (5L) provided by Skier via in-game mail on Woods and Customs. ===Woods stashing location=== File:ThirstyDeliveryWoodsMap.png|Scav bunker location marked on map File:ThirstyDeliveryWoodsLocation.png|Stashing location in the bunker ===Customs stashing location=== File:ThirstyDeliveryCustomsMap.png|Store location marked on map File:ThirstyDeliveryCustomsStore.png|The store File:ThirstyDeliveryCustomsLocation.png|Stashing location in the backroom of the store
thirsty-delivery.briefing: So, I keep my word. Before you, Sanitar was sniffing around that guy, too. But his business proposition was shite, so I didn't tell him anything. I'll tell you, but a bit later. Here are some nice propane tanks for you. Yeah, the ones you brought. Now you have to stash them. One in the nature reserve, in the Scav bunker with the radio tower. The other at the Customs area, in the little store by the crossroads. Just make sure to not shoot the tanks, okay? If you finish the job, you'll get more info.

objectives.text: Locate any information about Thirsty on Shoreline
Obtain the information in Thirsty's hideout
Hand over the found information

thirsty-echo.guide: In this quest you have to obtain Thirsty's battered diary in the basement of the health resort west wing on Shoreline. It can be found in a room near the pool. There are multiple spawns throughout the room. File:Vitamins1 Shoreline outdoor map.png|Health resort west wing location marked on map File:ThirstyEchoMap.png|Room location marked on west wing basement map File:ThirstyEchoRoom.png|The room File:ThirstyEchoLocation1.png|First spawn on the floor next to the trashcan directly left after entering File:ThirstyEchoLocation2.png|Second spawn inside the left drawer in the fridge File:ThirstyEchoLocation3.png|Third spawn in the red box attached to the blue locker
thirsty-echo.briefing: Thank you for reaching out. I know you're investigating a certain person called Thirsty. Sanitar is investigating him as well, for a specific reason. He's always hunting for any information on TerraGroup's activities. Surely it's all connected. If you can intercept the data first, bring it to me, I'll pay you handsomely. Besides, in my hands, it won't cause another disaster.

objectives.text: Eliminate 12 Scavs in the time period of 22:00-7:00 on Shoreline

thirsty-hounds.guide: Head to Shoreline between 22:00 and 7:00. It is recommended to go into the raid by at latest 5:00, so you have time to advance the quest before 7:00.
thirsty-hounds.briefing: We need to talk. Sanitar's goons have been prowling the shore area at nights. Obviously looking for something. Can't let it go unchecked. Scare them off while I try to find out what they're up to.

requirements: Unlocks 12-13 hours after completion of Thirsty - Echo

objectives.text: Hand over the 2 found in raid items: Adrenaline injector
Hand over the 4 found in raid items: Bottle of OLOLO Multivitamins
Hand over the 3 found in raid items: Bottle of saline solution

rewards.text: 6× 2A2-(b-TG) stimulant injector Note: Only obtainable by buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.
Unlocks craft for 2A2-(b-TG) stimulant injector at Medstation level 2

thirsty-secrets.briefing: Hello again. I was able to extract some scraps of information about a certain drug from the diary you brought. The owner of the diary used it frequently. It's some sort of combat stimulant, I think you might be interested in it. I can provide you with samples if you help me reproduce and test it. Here's a list of the items you'll need.

objectives.text: Eliminate 25 smugglers
Obtain and hand over 3 contraband boxes
Obtain and hand over 3 locked smugglers' weapon cases

thirty-pieces-of-silver.guide: In this quest you have to eliminate 25 Smugglers, hand over 3 Contraband boxes and 3 Sealed weapon casees. Smugglers can be found in groups of 3-4 on Customs, Woods, Shoreline, Interchange, Lighthouse, Streets of Tarkov and Ground Zero (Level 21+). File:Smuggler.png|Appearance of a Smuggler File:InterchangeSmugglerLocations2026.jpg|Interchange spawns marked on map File:ShorelineSmugglerLocations2026.jpg|Shoreline spawns marked on map File:WoodsSmugglerLocations2026.jpg|Woods spawns marked on map File:CustomsSmugglerLocations2026.jpg|Customs spawns marked on map File:LighthouseSmugglerLocations2026.jpg|Lighthouse spawns marked on map File:Streets of TarkovSmugglerLocations2026.png|Streets of Tarkov spawns marked on map
thirty-pieces-of-silver.briefing: We still do not know who the final recipient of all these drops is. The smugglers are unlikely to help us, they have already chosen their side. But there is another way to find out which of the local players decided to go against me. Bring me more of those shipments. I'll check the serial numbers and pull the records from the NATO bases in Finland while I'm at it. Some of those facilities fall under Edward's oversight, and if this kind of equipment ended up here, it means it had to be written off somewhere first. I'm only interested in the packages meant for the smugglers, so focus on sealed electronics boxes and weapon cases with NATO gear. And one more thing. Make it clear to those smugglers that if they want to do business with Europe, they'll have to go through me and no one else.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 PMC operatives without the Christmas armband in the Khorovod mode

this-is-my-party.guide: In this quest you have to kill 10 PMCs who are not wearing the Khorovod armband in the Khorovod mode.
this-is-my-party.briefing: I didn't think I'd call you again this year, but I need your help. People really loved our "Khorovod", we should do it again. Except that some asshole is turning on us, turning our soldiers against us. They're PMCs too, but they don't wear our armbands. You know we're doing the right thing. We need to save the celebration, and get those assholes away from our Khorovod. Shoot anyone who goes near the trees without the armband. No one's gonna get in the way of people doing good deeds.

objectives.text: Locate the torture room inside The Labyrinth
Locate and obtain any evidence of torture
Hand over the found information

this-tape-sucks.guide: In this quest you first have to find the torture room inside The Labyrinth. Afterwards you have to obtain evidence of the torture in form of a videotape. There are multiple spawn locations near the room. File:Labryrinth torture room map.png|Torture room location marked on map File:Labryrinth torture room.png|The torture room File:This Tape Sucks Spawn 1.png|Spawn 1: Under the door File:This Tape Sucks Spawn 2.png|Spawn 2: In the wall opposite the room File:This Tape Sucks Spawn 3.png|Spawn 3: In the hand of a dead Scav on the ground under the arch opposite the room Note: The body doesn't always spawn, but the tape can still be there File:This Tape Sucks Spawn 4.png|Spawn 4: On top of bloody barrels adjacent to the arch opposite the room
this-tape-sucks.briefing: Hello again. I received a patient who was recently wounded in the resort cellars and barely escaped from this monster in a bull mask... Obvious mental trauma, perhaps more than one. But besides the stories about this Minotaur, the patient also mentioned many confinement and even torture chambers. You surely recognize the unacceptable nature of such human confinement, even under wartime conditions, so I am counting on your cooperation. We must get to the bottom of what is or was going on in these cellars. Explore those jail rooms and try to uncover any information or evidence that will help us find out who is responsible for what happened. And most importantly, what was the purpose of all these "experiments".

objectives.text: Eliminate any 25 targets at the Rodina cinema while using SMGs on Streets of Tarkov

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for SR-2M Veresk 9x21 submachine gun (variant FSB) at Prapor LL4

tickets-please.guide: In this quest you have to kill any 25 targets at the Rodina cinema on Streets of Tarkov while using SMGs. File:gendticketspleasemap.png|Kill area marked on map
tickets-please.briefing: Right, let's get straight to the point. The new task is the Rodina movie theater. Clean it up properly, then report to me right away.

requirements: Must be Loyalty Level 1 to start this quest

objectives.text: Locate and mark any UN Tigr vehicle with an MS2000 Marker on Customs

tigr-safari.guide: MS2000 Markers can be bought from Prapor or Ragman. File:Markedcustoms.jpg|Vehicle locations marked on map File:TigerSafari2.png|First Tigr vehicle File:TigerSafari3.png|Second Tigr vehicle File:TigerSafari1.png|Third Tigr vehicle
tigr-safari.briefing: Okay, here's the next deal. Russia kindly supplied the UN peacekeeping mission with several Tigr vehicles. The mission has now been almost completely withdrawn, and those vehicles have been left sitting idle. I need you to find any one of them on Customs and mark it with a beacon. There are still plenty of valuable components left inside that can be removed and sold to American intelligence. I suggest searching along the main road. Unfortunately, I do not have any beacons available at the moment, so you will have to sort that out yourself.

objectives.text: Eliminate as many targets as possible while using Russian weapons

rewards.text: 10× 7.62x54mm R BT gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)
10× 7.62x54mm R PS gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)

time-tested.guide: In this quest you must eliminate as many targets as possible using any Russian weapons. The Russian calibers are: * .366 TKM * 5.45x39mm (Besides SAG AK, SAG AK Short) * 5.56x45mm NATO (Only ADAR 2-15, AK-101, AK-102) * 7.62x25mm Tokarev * 7.62x39mm (Besides Mk47, RD-704) * 7.62x51mm NATO (Only DVL-10, T-5000M, VPO-101) * 7.62x54mmR * 9x18mm Makarov * 9x19mm Parabellum (Only MP-443 Grach, PL-15, PP-19-01, Saiga-9, STM-9) * 9x21mm Gyurza * 9x39mm * 12.7x55mm * 12.7x108mm * 12/70 (Besides M3 Super 90, M590A1, M870) * 20/70 * 23x75mmR * 30x29mm * 40x53mm
time-tested.briefing: This is it, warrior! It's time for the decisive breakthrough in this arms race! Peacekeeper is in a vulnerable position, so we have to take him down for good. Show that there's nothing in Tarkov that's better than our domestic guns. I think you know full well how to demonstrate the quality of Russian weapons.

objectives.text: Win a match in CheckPoint or LastHero mode in Arena

rewards.text: 58 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
63 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2

to-great-heights-part-1.briefing: Well-well, you've finished your first assessment. I think it's right about time for a new champion of the Arena to rise. And it's going to be you. By consent, of course. We don't practice cruelty here, haha! I can help you reach heights and riches beyond your wildest dreams. You just have to take me up on my offer. But, you know, actions always trump words. So go ahead, enter the Arena and win. That's how I will know you're ready to push forward.

objectives.text: Win a match in TeamFight, BlastGang, or CheckPoint mode in Arena

rewards.text: 34 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
37 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2

to-great-heights-part-2.briefing: You're under my wing from now on, brother. I'll make sure you get progress good, but you're gonna have to get your ass in gear more often. Let's start with the basics. The Arena's in Tarkov, but the biggest sponsors are overseas. They watch every game, place bets, throw money at the favorites. And you need to get some of those big shots interested. Get their attention, show them you're worthy. Make a name for yourself. One win alone isn't enough to do it. Show them you can make a thrilling performance!

objectives.text: Win 2 matches while claiming at least 3rd place in TeamFight, BlastGang, or CheckPoint mode in Arena

rewards.text: 29 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
32 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
Unlocks the Arena item transfer service on Ref for main characters

to-great-heights-part-3.briefing: You're doing great! But it's too early to stop. Shine your face more often, impress the audience. Stand out. Become the one they talk about, the one they come to see. Then the cash will come, and then other goodies: cars, girls... Although Tarkov is a little short on the latter. Anyway, the Arena is a great career opportunity right now, ha!

objectives.text: Hand over 1,000,000 Roubles
Win three out of six matches in TeamFight, BlastGang or CheckPoint mode in Arena
Failure condition: Lose 4 matches

rewards.text: 37 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
40 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2

to-great-heights-part-4.guide: The 1,000,000 Roubles can be handed over from both the main game and the Arena stash. If 4 out of 6 matches are lost, the quest fails and the Roubles need to be handed over again for a new try.
to-great-heights-part-4.briefing: How's the mood? Battle-ready? Ready to shine in the Arena once more? Ready to shred some motherfuckers? The crowd is betting on you, so don't let the audience down! Speaking of that. You got some money? You gotta bet on yourself and then win a few times. You'll make tons of cash, and you'll be famous. Bring the money, I'll organize everything. Just be warned: if keep losing too often, you start again.

objectives.text: Win a match claiming at least 2nd place in the team in TeamFight, BlastGang, or CheckPoint mode in Arena

rewards.text: 42 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
46 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2

to-great-heights-part-5.briefing: I have good news! Excellent news, in fact! I hope you've already picked out a little apartment in Tarkov's elite neighborhood, because you'll have it soon with all this money! Kidding. All the houses in those neighborhoods are soon gonna collapse anyway. Anyway, some very powerful people from across the border are interested in you. Powerful and wealthy. I can't tell you their names, it's a business secret, and I'm not violating what I signed. So, these people are ready to take you under their wing and sponsor you heavily, but first they want guarantees. You need to become the champion. Fly high, soar above the rest. You're gonna have to spend more time in the Arena. I can see it in your eyes that you're ready.

objectives.text: Win 2 matches in a row in TeamFight, BlastGang or CheckPoint mode in Arena

rewards.text: 58 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
63 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
Unlocks barter for APOK Tactical Wasteland Gladius at Ref LL2

to-great-heights-part-6.briefing: So, you thought that was it, that you'd reached the top? Think again. Yeah, people are betting on you, but you've got to make sure they don't forget about you. Otherwise they'll wave goodbye and start tossing money at someone else. And we don't want that. I've got a solution for you. People remember victories best — especially a streak of them. Set up a streak like that for yourself, and you can relax after.

objectives.text: Locate and visit the Christmas tree on Customs
Locate and visit the Christmas tree on Reserve
Locate and visit the Christmas tree on Lighthouse
Locate and visit the Christmas tree on Interchange
Locate and visit the Christmas tree on Shoreline
Locate and visit the Christmas tree on Woods

to-the-tree.guide: The Christmas trees are located on each map as follows: ===== Customs ===== Located within the courtyard of the dormitories: ===== Reserve ===== Located next to the E2 bunker: ===== Lighthouse ===== Located in the Old Landing Scav extract: ===== Interchange ===== Located inside of the Scav Camp: ===== Shoreline ===== Inside of the resort, located in the center: ===== Woods ===== Next to the sawmill on the east side of the water, on the way to the Military Camp. It is located on a dock, so keep your eyes peeled when running near the shoreline:
to-the-tree.briefing: Hello there, happy holidays to you! So, how are you? Gonna celebrate? I've recently heard some rumors that the local banidts are gathering around Christmas trees, even hidhing gifts there, would you imagine? They won't even shoot at you on sight, it's holidays, after all! Although, who knows... Listen, can you go there and check it out? And then I'll send my people to inspect the gifts themselves after.

objectives.text: Locate the radar station commandant's office on Lighthouse
Obtain the military HDD with archived flight routes
Hand over the drive

top-secret.guide: In this quest you have to find a HDD which can be found in the radar station commandant's office on Lighthouse. A Radar station commandant room key is needed to enter it. The radar station is located at the lighthouse peninsula territory. The commandant's office is located on the first floor, recognizable by a red sign. The HDD is located on a desk in the back of the room. File:RadarStationMap.png|Radar station marked on map File:RadarStation.png|The radar station File:CommandersOffice.png|The way to the office File:CommandersOfficeClose.png|The wanted office File:Top Secret Table.jpg|The table with the hard drive File:Top Secret HDD.jpg|The wanted hard drive
top-secret.briefing: Now look who we have here. Do you even know what's going on in the city right now? Relax, nobody knows. But you and I are gonna start investigating. First, we gotta find out what air deliveries were made and by whom, things like air deployments before the chaos emerged. Also, that plane that got shot down in the woods is still bugging me. Find me the intel of this kind. I'll hook you up with a general direction so you don't hit a dead end. There was an active radar station at the Lighthouse island. It must have all the intel we need. After that, I'll take the lead. Oh, also, not a word to anyone about this, okay? It's shady stuff, you know what I mean.

objectives.text: Locate and eliminate Knight in a single raid.
Locate and eliminate Big Pipe in a single raid.
Locate and eliminate Birdeye in a single raid.
Survive and extract from the location

tourists.guide: In this quest you have to kill Knight, Big Pipe and Birdeye in the same raid and survive and extract. For the duration of the current event they can only be found in every raid on Day Factory.
tourists.briefing: Opa, warrior! Come on in, you've got a job to do. So listen up, there's been a fight between the Western bigwigs and our locals. We can't let an opportunity like this go to waste. So come on, get your boom stick and roll out. They were last seen at Polikhim, entrenched there like a bunch of ticks. Show them hell, make them get the fuck off our land.

objectives.text: Win a match in TeamFight or BlastGang mode
Claim at least 3rd place in LastHero mode
Win a match in CheckPoint mode
Eliminate 50 enemies in any game mode

rewards.text: Unlocks Tiger Stripe Twitch weapon camouflage

tournament.briefing: Hello challenger! My co-founders and I are organizing a tournament among the best of the best. There's even a place for you, but you'll have to pass the qualifiers first. Can't just take anyone, you know. Show us your abilities, and we'll decide whether or not we'll take you in. Either way, I'll give you a cool spray paint kit for your gun so everyone knows you were at least chosen for the qualifiers. You in?

requirements: Must reach Loyalty Level 3 with Peacekeeper to obtain this quest.

objectives.text: Locate the room with reservoirs in the Health Resort on Shoreline
Obtain any information about the second part of the cargo shipment
Hand over the retrieved information
Locate the hidden TerraGroup cargo in the Health Resort on Shoreline

tracker.guide: The secure folder is located on top of blue barrels in room 108 of the health resort east wing on Shoreline. File:HealthResortEastWing.jpg|Health resort east wing location marked on map File:CargoXPt2 FolderMap.png|East wing 108 location marked on room map File:Inside Room 108 in East wing of the Resort.png|The folder on the barrels The cargo is located near the pool in the basement of the health resort west wing on Shoreline. File:ShorelineCargoXPt3.png|Location marked on map File:CargoXPt3 Guide.png|Way to the pool from the center staircase File:CargoXPt3Hole.png|The cargo at the hole in the wall
tracker.briefing: Hello, my friend! I have a task for you. My men found some information about a TerraGroup shipment. According to the documents, it contains two parts. One is somewhere on the first floor of the east wing of the Health Resort, and the second is in the basement of the west wing. My men are currently occupied with other matters, so there is no one available to go there. So, go there and find both parts of the shipment.

objectives.text: Sell 15 barter items to Fence

trade-embargo.guide: The quest will fail if you sell any item to either Skier or Peacekeeper, and you will get the quest Trade Embargo - Last Chance instead.
trade-embargo.briefing: Okay, that alliance thing is settled. Now we need to subtly hint to Skier and Peacekeeper that they're trying to get in over their heads. We'll do it through their business. I've already informed all the PMCs that there's no trading with these two until I give further input. Anything you need to sell, give it to me. I'll give you a fair price. And once again, don't give a penny or a dime to Skier and Peacekeeper.

objectives.text: Sell 50 barter items to Fence

trade-embargo-last-chance.guide: Despite the quest dialogue suggesting it, it is actually not possible to fail this quest, even when selling items to Skier or Peacekeeper.
trade-embargo-last-chance.briefing: I know a lot of idiots, but I've never seen anyone as fucking stupid as you. I told you not to trade with them. All right, I'll give you one last chance. Last chance, you hear me? Otherwise, you get nothing once we've dealt with Skier and Peacekeeper.

requirements: Must be level 55 to start this quest.
Must be Loyalty Level 4 to start this quest

objectives.text: Find in raid and hand over 10 BEAR PMC dogtags of Prestige 1 or higher to Peacekeeper
Find in raid and hand over 10 USEC PMC dogtags of Prestige 1 or higher to Peacekeeper

rewards.text: Unlock purchase of Crye Precision AirFrame helmet (Tan) at Peacekeeper LL4

trophies.briefing: Mercenary, come here for a minute. I have an order of elimination of several groups of PMCs, the highly experienced ones. Sending my soldiers to this would be a suicide mission, so that is why i suggest you to handle this matter. What do you say? As proof of the work done, you have to bring me dogtags from both of these groups.

requirements: Unlocks 10 hours after completion of Make an Impression

objectives.text: Locate the transport holding the cargo on Streets of Tarkov
Secure the area from 50 hostile PMC operatives
Mark the cargo area with an MS2000 Marker
Launch a yellow flare near the armored convoy to confirm that the job is done
Survive and extract from the location

rewards.text: Unlocks barter for Advanced current converter at Mechanic LL4
Unlocks purchase of SIG MCX-SPEAR 6.8x51 assault rifle at Peacekeeper LL4
Unlocks purchase of AR-10 7.62x51 Lancer L7AWM 25-round magazine at Peacekeeper LL4
Unlocks purchase of 6.8x51mm SIG Hybrid at Peacekeeper LL4

trouble-in-the-big-city.guide: In this quest you first have to locate the armored convoy and kill 50 PMCs on Streets of Tarkov. Next you have to place a MS2000 Marker at the grate door inside the cargo truck trailer from the convoy. Afterwards you have to shoot a yellow flare into the sky while being in the convoy area. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which can be bought at Prapor LL1 or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. File:TroubleMap.png|Convoy location and flare area marked on map File:TroubleBigCity MarkSpot.png|Cargo truck trailer with grate door File:TroubleBigCity MarkSpot2.png|Marker spot
trouble-in-the-big-city.briefing: So much for Primorsky Avenue. What other secrets does this city hold? It turns out that these wretches have decided to make an attempt on my humble person because I could get my hands on the cargo which was carried by this very convoy. The simple-minded snakes don't even realize that they're the ones who led me to this cargo with their own hands. Did they really think they could scare me with some cheap blackmail? Me?! All right, listen to me, your job is to secure the area around the intersection and mark the location of the cargo with a beacon. My men will do the rest.

objectives.text: Hand over the decrypted flash drive

u-turn.guide: Hand over the decrypted flash drive to Peacekeeper.
u-turn.briefing: Hello, my dearest friend. I know you're helping Skier decipher the mysterius flash drive you found. Don't look so surprised. Walls have ears, right? So, I need that flash drive. Give it to me rather than your direct employer. I'll cover all expenses and add on top, don't worry.

requirements: Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

objectives.text: Stash Therapist's letter at the reception desk on the second floor of the TerraGroup office on Ground Zero (in one raid)
Extract from the location through the Nakatani Basement Stairs or Emercom Checkpoint exfil (in one raid)

unanswered-calls.guide: In this quest you have to stash a letter at the second floor of the terragroup office on Ground Zero behind the reception desk and extract from either Nakatani basement or emercom checkpoint in one raid. File:Unanswered Calls Map.png|Location of terragroup building on map. File:Unanswered Calls stash position.png|The place where to stash the letter, behind the reception desk.
unanswered-calls.briefing: Young man. I'm sure you have heard that a team of specialists from an unknown PMC has begun operating in Tarkov. According to my information, they aren't affiliated with any of the local factions, which makes them potentially useful. I would like to establish contact with them regarding a certain matter. I cannot disclose the details, and I won't ask you to negotiate. All I need is for you to deliver a letter containing my proposal. Leave the letter at the reception desk on the second floor of the TerraGroup headquarters. Try not to attract any attention. Under no circumstances should you use any signal flares or cross paths with Skier's driver! Your best option is to leave through the underground passage beneath the nearby high-rise or via the former Emercom checkpoint. And naturally, the contents of the letter are confidential. I will know if you try to open it.

requirements: Must reach Loyalty Level 2 with Prapor to obtain this quest.
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the case with military equipment
(Optional) Investigate the shack next to the sordi tower on Shoreline
(Optional) Investigate the second floor of the weather station building on Shoreline
(Optional) Investigate the hydroelectric power station on Shoreline

uninvited-guests-part-1.guide: In this quest you have to obtain a case with military equipment on Shoreline File:Uninvited Guests - Part 1 Map.png|Location of the case spawns on the map. The case is located at one of the 3 locations. File:Uninvited Guests - Part 1 Spawn 1.png|The case inside the sordi tower bunkhouse File:Uninvited Guests - Part 1 Spawn 2.png|The case on the second floor of the weather station in a corner next to drawers File:Uninvited Guests - Part 1 Spawn 3.png|The case inside the hydroelectric power station next to HEP station storage room key door After picking up the case, it will be placed in your quest items inventory. You must successfully extract with the case to hand it in. If you die before reaching the BTR Driver, you will have to retrieve it again. Hand the case over to the BTR Driver in Uninvited Guests - Part 2 to complete the quest.
uninvited-guests-part-1.briefing: Ah, it's you. Good to see you're still alive... Someone's been taking out my men, whole squads at a time, you get me? They just drop off the grid. And nobody's made any demands! I'll find the bastards responsible, no doubt about that. But right now I've got business that can't wait. Can you help me out? The most urgen thing is a piece of technical equipment I was supposed to get from the coast to a client up north. The plan was for my boys to pick it up from a contact at the port and hand it off to the BTR driver. But we've heard nothing from them! Can you look for my men, or at least the package? I figure they were hit somewhere along the shore, so that's where you should start looking.

requirements: Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

objectives.text: Obtain and hand over the case with military equipment

uninvited-guests-part-2.guide: In this quest you have to obtain and hand over to the BTR Driver a case with military equipment found on Shoreline File:Uninvited Guests - Part 1 Map.png|Location of the cases marked on map. The case is located at one of the 3 locations. File:Uninvited Guests - Part 1 Spawn 1.png|The case inside the sordi tower bunkhouse File:Uninvited Guests - Part 1 Spawn 2.png|The case on the second floor of the weather station File:Uninvited Guests - Part 1 Spawn 3.png|The case inside the hydroelectric power station
uninvited-guests-part-2.briefing: Prapor already filled you in. Heard plenty of gunfire coming from the shore, so I wouldn't count on his guys making it out. I'm waiting on you with that crate. It's an important delivery!

requirements: Must be level 35 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate any 50 targets while using an Aklys Defense Velociraptor on Customs

unique-experience.briefing: Warrior! It's clear that you really love to shoot new and exotic weapons. There is a new job on this subject for you. I found something interesting... No one's ever seen anything like this in Tarkov before! Where'd I get it? Trade secret, haha! Let me tell you this, this weapon certainly has potential. But without proper combat trials, all these specs and range reports are bullshit. So if you're interested in experiencing a real unique weapon, we may be able to help each other.

objectives.text: Capture 15 objectives in CheckChamber mode
Eliminate 30 opponents in CheckChamber mode

unsurpassed-skill.briefing: Nobody thinks about conserving ammo when they're sitting on a full magazine ready to dump lead into anything that moves. But even the craziest operator starts thinking differently when every round counts. Keeping track of your shots without leaving yourself defenseless when it matters most—that's a real skill. Now it's time to see if you've got it. An average performance won't cut it. It never does. Show me true professionalism.

objectives.text: Eliminate 15 hooded night people on Ground Zero
Eliminate 15 hooded night people on Lighthouse
Eliminate 15 hooded night people on Shoreline
Eliminate 15 hooded night people on Streets of Tarkov
Eliminate 15 hooded night people on Woods
Eliminate 15 hooded night people on Customs
Eliminate 15 hooded night people on night-time Factory

Unlocks barter for Benelli M3 Super 90 12ga dual-mode shotgun at Jaeger LL3

until-dawn.guide: In this quest you have to eliminate 15 Cultists on every of the specified locations.
until-dawn.briefing: I reckon you can see what's going on now that you're back. Not only have those brutes not dispersed, but they've begun to organize their preparations even more vigorously! I just got word that the poor kid Ryzhy has been captured by Zryachiy himself. They say he'll be the main sacrifice. That means we're running out of time! Partisan is still in the forest hunting for cultists, but even he can't do it alone. Now it's up to us to clean up the scum with our own hands. If there's nobody to carry out the ritual, maybe it'll be over.

requirements: Must be level 17 to start this quest.

Obtain the container with drug samples
Hand over the container

urban-medicine.briefing: Greetings, mercenary. The hospital continues to receive more intoxicated patients. Each day there are more and more of them, and that worries me. It feels like if you destroy one drug den, two new ones appear. We should go another route, try to cure those who are already addicted. In order to do that, I need a sample of the drug for analysis.

objectives.text: Eliminate 24 PMC operatives inside The Labyrinth

vacate-the-premises.guide: In this quest you have to kill 24 PMСs in The Labyrinth. Note: The objective in the PvE mode is to eliminate any 36 targets in The Labyrinth instead.
vacate-the-premises.briefing: That whole health resort thing went massive, didn't it? Thing is, as I told you, I had business there with Ref, in those cellars. I used to think Ref took all the equipment outta there, but now it turns out there's still tons of tech still down there. So I figured, what's the harm in taking some of it? Nah, you don't have to bring me those TVs and cameras, don't worry. Those need careful inspection and good packing. I got my own people for that. But I can't just send them out there right now! They're good with tech, but they're dogshit with guns. If a real professional, wink-wink, would make it down there and chase all the other mercs out of there, then we'd be in business. So just when I thought of that, I remembered you, brother! You ready to help with a good cause? Obviously, if you do the job properly, I'll give you some goodies in return!

requirements: This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

Install a WI-FI Camera at the pier tower on Shoreline
Install a WI-FI Camera at the office corridor on Factory

Note: Can not be completed at night at the current time. File:ViewerFactoryLocation.png|Placement location
viewer.briefing: Hello, soldier. I've met some rookies recently, here in Tarkov. They say people don't watch everything on tape anymore, they watch it live! Programs, stories, and some even show their everyday life non-stop. They even said a bunch of civilians are watching Tarkov's activities live! It seems that the whole world is interested in our city! I don't understand how they organized the broadcast to the outside world, but I wouldn't mind a second pair of eyes. It's a simple task - organize surveillance in some spots, and I'll return the favor.

objectives.text: Hand over medical tools

virtue.briefing: As I said before, you are not the only one who has come to me with poisoning by an unknown substance. This antidote is needed not just for soldiers, but for civilians as well. Leave Sanitar's medicine to me for more tests. That way I can be one hundred percent sure it's safe and figure out how to synthesize it myself. But be warned, it will take time and, most likely, it will require your help. The drug is yours, so the decision is up to you. I can only hope you won't turn a blind eye to civilian casualties.

requirements: This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.
Must reach Loyalty Level 2 with Skier to obtain this quest.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the chemical container on Factory
Hand over the container
Find 4 Respirators in raid
Hand over 4 Respirators to Skier
Find 3 Medical bloodsets in raid
Hand over 3 Medical bloodsets to Skier

vitamins.guide: The chemical container can be found on the second floor of the laboratory on Factory. File:One Less Loose End Factory Map.png|Laboratory location marked on map File:Vitamins Chemcont Location.png|Container location
vitamins.briefing: Alright, you're here at the right time. Got a sixth sense or something? Never mind, listen up. Word on the street is there's some new merchandise making the rounds. Some weird stuff in these fancy-looking chemical containers. Looks a bit like your gun suppressor, just bigger. No clue what's inside: some new narcotic, or bloody vitamin B or something. That's what we need to find out. The containers showed up at the Factory. Get them for me. I've already got a couple of eggheads lined up to examine them. Oh, and one more thing: they asked me to throw in a few respirators and some blood transfusion kits.

requirements: Hand over the hard drives from compartment C-1 on Icebreaker to Mechanic in the Boreas story chapter.

objectives.text: Find 10 Nooby Shield potassium iodide tablets in raid
Hand over the items

war-never-changes.guide: To complete this quest you need to gather 10 Nooby Shield potassium iodide tablets found in raid on Icebreaker. There are two guaranteed spawns on location on level 1 located in the middle of the infirmary. They can also be found in loose medical spawn locations or in Sports bags on the map.
war-never-changes.briefing: Hello, mercenary. In field conditions it is extremely important to anticipate any potential hazards in advance. Once a patient is already on the operating table, you can only work with whatever is available at hand. That is why I would like you to bring me high-dose potassium iodide tablets. Yes, these are used in cases of severe radiation exposure. And no, we have not recorded any leaks recently. I must ask you not to spread information about this order. You do not realize how severely panic among the population can complicate the work of my department. I am simply preparing for any incidents that may occur in the future. The issue is that in Tarkov itself we have never found this dosage. Such preparations are typically stored at nuclear facilities, as they are only relevant there. I hope your search proves more successful than that of my staff.

objectives.text: Eliminate 55 infected on Lighthouse

watch-the-watcher.briefing: Greetings. I'm not sure if you have a good understanding of the balance of power in Tarkov, but currently it doesn't matter. One of the key figures in this city is at the Lighthouse. You may not know him, but he sure knows all about you. The person is well protected, but his guards could use some help. Due to the huge losses, I cannot provide any of my own manpower resources, but this could be a lucrative job for you. Who knows, maybe you'll get some credit for it later. Either way, this loss will cost Tarkov too much if you don't do anything about it.

requirements: Must be level 20 to start this quest.

Obtain the observation results
Hand over the data

watching-you.guide: In this quest you have to find a surveillance spot and obtain a flash drive on Streets of Tarkov. It can be found in room 215 on the second floor of the northern Pinewood hotel building. A Pinewood hotel room 215 key is required to enter it. The flash drive has multiple spawns throughout the room. File:PineWoodHotelNorthMap.png|Building marked on map File:PineWoodHotelNorthBuilding.png|Northern entrance File:HotelRoom215Door.png|Door to the room File:RecordingsFlashSpawn1.png|Spawn location 1 on the window sill next to the book File:RecordingsFlashSpawn2.png|Spawn location 2 on the chest of drawers
watching-you.briefing: Friend, there is another task, an unusual one. One of my clients was living in the area of the hotel when the events began. And he had reason to believe he was being watched. He saw a couple of leaked photos from the hotel courtyard. We need to find the room where the rat is sitting. Most likely, you'll find something if you look for tech: cameras, bugs... Anything you find, give it to me. It'll come in handy.

objectives.text: Claim at least 4th place in LastHero mode twice
Win 3 matches claiming at least 4th place in TeamFight or BlastGang mode
Win 2 matches claiming at least 4th place in CheckPoint mode

weak-compromise.briefing: So you're back, huh? You look a little sour, warrior. This ain't fucking good. Regret what you're doing? Arena is no place for hesitation. This is war. You kill or get killed, and I don't need you to get killed. All right, have it your way. You can play at being a fucking softie, but keep your ass in the scoreboard. I'll try to talk to some people. With a little luck, no one will notice your shortcomings.

weapons-circulation.briefing: Recently, my men came across some strange occult symbols. After conducting a small investigation, we discovered that this cult is sacrificing weapons to their own deities. You know, in Tarkov, weapons are almost as valuable as oil. My people are currently occupied with other assignments. Can you locate these cultist circles and mark them for us?

objectives.text: Eliminate 150 enemies in CheckPoint or LastHero mode
Eliminate 50 enemies in TeamFight or BlastGang mode

weather-the-blizzard.briefing: We've got a problem. Not because of you - because of the Scavs. A shipment was on the way, new gear, guns, all that, but someone intercepted it. Looks like someone forgot to be scared. I've gotta remind them why stealing from me is a mistake. No, I don't need you for that. I'll handle it myself. What I do need is something else. Keep everyone tense while I'm gone. Shine in the Arena. Show them what kind of monster you are. That's all I need from you.

objectives.text: Eliminate as many targets as possible while using Western weapons

western-quality-standards.guide: In this quest you must eliminate as many targets as possible using any western style weapons. The western weapon's calibers are: * .300 Blackout * .338 Lapua Magnum * .357 Magnum * .45 ACP * 4.6x30mm HK * 5.56x45mm NATO (Besides ADAR 2-15, AK-101, AK-102) * 5.45x39mm (Only SAG AK, SAG AK Short) * 5.7x28mm FN * 6.8x51mm * 7.62x39mm (Only Mk47, RD-704) * 7.62x51mm NATO (Besides DVL-10, T-5000M, VPO-101) * 9x19mm Parabellum (Besides MP-443 Grach, PL-15, PP-19-01, Saiga-9, STM-9) * 12/70 (Only M3 Super 90, M590A1, M870) * 40x46mm
western-quality-standards.briefing: Good day to you! So, we have dealt with the cause of the negative rumors, but rumors still run through the city. And then there's that old soldier still campaigning his business. He thinks he can beat me in this fight. Let's prove to him that he can't. The advantages of imported weapons are obvious, and you must demonstrate them in action. It's time for a good show, my friend!

requirements: Must be level 14 to start this quest.

objectives.text: Eliminate 10 Scavs while using a suppressed M4A1, ADAR or TX-15 on Shoreline

rewards.text: Unlocks craft for .300 Blackout M62 Tracer at Workbench level 3

wet-job-part-1.briefing: Hello, my friend, glad to see you. It's great you're still alive, ha-ha. As you can see, my people and I have assimilated on Shoreline, and we also communicate with our partners and customers from here. We've managed to re-purpose the local meteorological equipment to transmit signals. Scavs, however -- and not only them -- always try to destroy or damage our antennas. We routinely deal with communication problems, even had to install surveillance cameras. However, it's common knowledge that those vandal gangs only understand violence. Your task today is what you do best. Explain to them that the weather station and the entire Shoreline is not the best place to damage the Blue Helmets' property.

requirements: Must be level 14 to start this quest.

Mark the fishing table with an MS2000 Marker

wet-job-part-2.guide: In this quest you have to find the fishermen's house on the Shoreline island and mark the fishing table with an MS2000 Marker. File:WetJob2IslandMap.png|Island location marked on map File:The house on the island with the weapon box in it.png|The fishing table next to the house
wet-job-part-2.briefing: It's good to see you, mercenary. Those very cameras that we've installed on the weather station filmed a lot of interesting things. For instance, among other things, they spotted a new group of Scavs. They looked like sailors or fishermen, dressed in tatters and waders mostly. Lately, however, they have stopped appearing. I am very interested in their activities as their turnaround seems rather impressive. Search the Shoreline for a place where they could possibly live and mark it with a beacon for my people.

requirements: Must be level 14 to start this quest.

Mark Artyom's car with MS2000 Marker

Unlocks ability to craft .300 Blackout M62 Tracer in hideout

wet-job-part-3.guide: In this quest you have to find Artyom's car on Shoreline. The car is yellow and located on the main road along the shore. It can be found next to a yellow bus and a police car. File:Wet job part 3.png|Car location marked on map File:WetJobPart3QuestLocation.png|The wanted car
wet-job-part-3.briefing: You hit the spot there, my friend. My partners are very interested in what this affair could bring us. The Helmets inspected the place you marked and found out that some fisherman lived there for a while. It seems, though, he is long dead, and people on cameras are his friends. However, we know that he was friends with a certain person called Artyom, who was often seen driving a yellow Daihyn. Their shared business was somehow linked to the Russian military, now you understand why it could prove interesting? Artyom’s car is most likely still on the Shoreline, I doubt he could've drove off on it after the conflict. Use the provided description to find it, write down the plate number, and we’ll use it to get the details on who that Artyom may be.

Hand over the list of tenants to Peacekeeper

rewards.text: Unlocks purchase of Desert Tech MDR 7.62x51 assault rifle at Peacekeeper LL4

wet-job-part-4.guide: The flash drive with the information can be found in the administration part (theatre wing) of the resort, on a desk in an office on the eastern side on the top floor. File:ShorelineWetJobPt4Map.png|Map showing the location of the office File:Health resort management office safe key office.png|The office (middle room) File:WetJob4OfficeLocation2.png|The desk where the flash drive is located File:Sliderkey flash drive location.png|The flash drive
wet-job-part-4.briefing: We have run this Artyom through our database. It seems he lived in the health resort after the conflict and may have been connected to TerraGroup, but it is unconfirmed, no precise info yet. The nature of their joint operation with the fisherman is also not completely clear, but, considering how secretive their meetings were, I'm pretty sure it's some kind of military tech. We need to find where exactly Artyom’s quarters were, the info could be in the list of tenants, which has to be in the administration office, if it is still intact, of course. Find those documents and bring them to me.

wet-job-part-5.briefing: A job well done gets well rewarded. From the documents we've learned that Artyom lived in room 328. I presume, he worked there as well. Find a way to get into his room and if there's anything left of his records, bring it to me. I'm waiting to hear from you, mercenary.

objectives.text: Eliminate 15 targets from over 50 meters away using a 7.62x51mm NATO DMRs on Shoreline or Lighthouse

Unlocks barter for FN40GL Mk2 40mm grenade launcher at Peacekeeper LL4

wet-job-part-6.briefing: Hello, my dear friend, it looks like we are really close to an interesting deal. On the drive we found part of the blueprints for a submarine engine from the Akula class, which supposedly is no longer being produced. There was also a detailed dossier on a sailor who served in the Baltic Fleet. He is currently somewhere in Tarkov and his connections to the naval command. According to the data, he occasionally trades with Scavs. We cannot approach him directly. We will have to operate covertly, from an ambush position. We only have one opportunity. It is important not to make a mistake and lose such a chance. You cannot imagine how important this is. You are an excellent fighter, but I want to be certain that you are equally capable in stealth operations. I need a sniper, and a sufficiently experienced one. Prove your skills

requirements: Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

objectives.text: Locate and obtain the Briefcase with documents
Hand over the found item

what-s-in-the-bag.guide: In this quest you have to find and hand over a Briefcase with documents to Fence. The briefcase can be found on Black Division.
what-s-in-the-bag.briefing: Your codes turned out to be useful, so you've earned yourself a little reward. Their radio operators picked up the unauthorized signal pretty quickly and went radio silent. Still, at least we've got something to work with now. That unit carries out several operations a day. Every one we intercepted involved extracting TerraGroup documents and materials. They also discussed destroying a couple of sites I didn't even know existed. Then again, maybe they'd already found the wiretap by then and were feeding us bullshit.Either way, now I need a sample of the materials they're trying to get out of the city. We need to figure out whether it's even worth spending resources over this data. Bring me something valuable, and you won't be disappointed with the reward.

Hand over 2 Secure flash drives to Skier

what-s-on-the-flash-drive.guide: ===Location=== *In the pockets and bags of Scavs *In Dead Scavs *In Common fund stash *In Plastic suitcases *In Safes *In Drawers *In Ground caches *In Buried barrel caches *In Airdrops *In PC blocks *A tent near the lumber camp on Woods has a dedicated spawn for up to 2 possible flash drives at once File:USB Tent Location.png|Tent marked on map File:USB Location.png|Flash drives inside the tent *A campsite near the two-story dorms on Customs has a dedicated spawn for up to 2 possible flash drives at once File:CustomsTentFlashDriveMap.png|Campsite marked on map File:Usb campsite customs.jpg|Flash drives at the campsite *On the bed of dorm room 110 in the two-story dorms on Customs File:SecureFlashDriveSpawn.png|Flash drive on the bed *Plugged into the front of PCs **Interchange has many computers located in the OLI, IDEA and Goshan offices File:Drive-in-PC.png|Flash drive plugged into a PC
what-s-on-the-flash-drive.briefing: Hey there, mister operator, come here. I got a little something for you. I'm not saying it's a real sure bet, but it might be interesting. One drunken punk's been blabbing that back during the Contract Wars, he guided a few groups of some VIPs who didn't want to be caught by our soldiers or cops. And I agree with the latter. You can still make deals with war dogs as there are many decent people there, but cops are no damn good! Anyway, he guided several such groups. Oh and a fool as he is, he managed to steal everything he could during their camping breaks. Now that deadbeat swears on his mom's name that he snatched two thumb drives on his latest run. What was on them - if anything at all - he's got no clue. And he's been permanently shit-faced for so long that he can't remember anything at all - no location, no landmarks, nothing. Yet he says those VIP were some big enough to even bring security with them, so this might be worth a while. Check any campsite you find. I know that these paths have been beaten through and through since, but what if, you know?

objectives.text: Hand over the 10 western Scav weapons with very low durability

what-s-your-evidence.guide: In this quest you need to hand over 10 western style Scav guns. Those are special weapons with very low durability (<15) that are modified and do not usually spawn on Scavs outside this event (and thus aren't listed on their equipment page). The western weapon's calibers are: * .300 Blackout * .338 Lapua Magnum * .357 Magnum * .45 ACP * 4.6x30mm HK * 5.45x39mm (Only SAG AK, SAG AK Short) * 5.56x45mm NATO (Besides ADAR 2-15, AK-101, AK-102) * 5.7x28mm FN * 6.8x51mm * 7.62x39mm (Only Mk47, RD-704) * 7.62x51mm NATO (Besides DVL-10, T-5000M, VPO-101) * 9x19mm Parabellum (Besides MP-443 Grach, PL-15, PP-19-01, Saiga-9, STM-9) * 12/70 (Only M3 Super 90, M590A1, M870) * 40x46mm
what-s-your-evidence.briefing: Hello, my friend. You've likely already heard rumors about my merchandise, yes? My guess is this Russian prick just can't stand the fact that the customers are choosing me over him. Or perhaps there's a new player trying to join the competition. In any case, this reputational damage must be dealt with immediately. Bring me some of this "poor-quality merchandise", and I'll look into it.

wild-wild-woods.briefing: Have you seen what's been going on in Priozersk lately? The bandits never had much discipline to begin with, but now it's turned into outright anarchy. From what I've heard, those rebels aren't even listening to Fence anymore, even though he used to hold some authority over most of them. Seems he even lifted the ban on Scavs killing Scavs. Probably figured it would help deal with the troublemakers faster. For some reason, all this trash keeps drifting onto my land. They even found one of my bolty stashes and cleaned it out! The forest is a mess right now, like something out of the Wild West. There's no real leader among them. The Scavs just drag their loot here and settle scores with each other. Still, some temporary leaders keep emerging among the survivors. They carry badges on them. Just like in those old westerns... Never cared much for those films, and I won't tolerate this rabble on my territory. If we take out enough of these so-called "sheriffs", the smaller gangs will scatter on their own. Will you help? And don't forget to take their badges! I'll spend some time thinking about what I can offer you in return.

Repair the equipment in the automation room under the engine room on Icebreaker
Repair the equipment in the automation room near the storage room on Icebreaker
Install the hacking device in the central control station room on Icebreaker

wiring-the-vessel.guide: This quest takes place on Icebreaker. You first have to repair 3 pieces of equipment in automation rooms with a Toolset and afterwards install a Local network hacking device in the central control station room. ===Equipment in the automation room leading to the engine - Level 0=== File:Wiring the Vessel Leading to engine Map.jpg|Room location marked on map File:Wiring the Vessel Leading to engine Equipment.png|The equipment ===Equipment in the automation room near the storage room - Level 0=== File:Wiring the Vessel Near the storage Map.jpg|Room location marked on map File:Wiring the Vessel Near the storage Equipment.png|The equipment Bug: This and the third repairing objective are incorrectly swapped in the game, repairing this equipment completes the objective related to the automation room under the engine room. ===Equipment in the automation room under the engine room - Level -3=== This room requires a code to be entered. The code can be found in a nearby overseeing cabin on a pinboard. The code changes every raid. wiring-the-vessel.briefing: It looks like you will have to return to the Icebreaker after all. The data from the nuclear power plant logbook was not sufficient. Our partners need real-time readings from the power unit, so I've purchased a special device from Mechanic for remote connection to the central control station. Before you install it, however, you must ensure that all equipment in the technical areas is functioning properly. Take tools with you and restore the circuit breakers that have been taken offline, then install this device in the control room. I have been informed that the damaged breakers are likely located in three areas. One is directly on the way to the engine room, near the locker rooms with coats. The second is directly beneath that section. The third is somewhere in the corridors running along the engine compartment. Once you have restored all breakers, return to the central control station. Install the device there and report back.

wolf-s-grip-consequences.briefing: You've already agreed to help, but there's another task. Just as important as the first. I've been around long enough, and I've seen men like Ref more times than I can count. We can't give him or his people any breathing room. If we do, they'll lick their wounds and come right back. Take down as many of them as you can. Every bit of help matters here. It won't be wasted.

wolf-s-grip-finale.briefing: Tell me, what kind of money is worth losing this many of your own people over? Power like that never brings anyone anything good. It only drives people mad. We won't get to Ref himself, but we can still take our land back. They say construction is already in its final stage, but we still have a chance to affect the outcome. Even if we can't drive him out completely, we can certainly slow him down and make it clear that he won't be staying here for long. You'll have others with you. Reliable people. To tell them apart from Ref's hired guns, we've agreed to wear green armbands. Try not to shoot your own, alright? And don't even think about switching sides. You'll have to live with that choice.

work-smarter.guide: In this quest you have to visit either of the 2 hidden extractions on Customs. The hidden ones are "Smugglers' Boat" and "Smugglers' Bunker (ZB-1012)". Extracting through them is not required. File:Work Smarter Map.png|Extractions marked on map File:Smuggler's Boat.png|The Smugglers' Boat extraction File:ZB-1012.png|The Smugglers' Bunker (ZB-1012) extraction
work-smarter.briefing: You know how heated it can be at the safe exits around here. Many die on the road back, not on the actual trip. That's why for a true hunter, it's important to always have something prepared, like a personal escape plan. Times are tough right now, so I don't advise taking unnecessary risks. Take customs for example. I heard that some of the exits are now under someone's control, and they're only letting in their own kind. Which means no more outsiders will be allowed in. You might want to find a way to secure those exits for yourself. It may take some finesse, but for a true warrior, such obstacles shouldn't be a problem.

worst-job-in-the-world.guide: In this quest you have to kill any 30 hostiles from a distance of over 100m with AR-15 platform weapons. You can use any of the following: *M4A1 *ADAR 2-15 *TX-15 DML *Radian Model 1 *M16A1 *M16A2 A recommendable spot to shoot from would be dome area on Reserve as you can get a good view of the Scav spawns around the map. File:WorstJob.jpg|Red squares mark common PMC and Scav traversing areas It is recommended to use a suppressor as shooting loud from this position can attract unwanted attention. AI Scavs tend to search and loot dead bodies. For a brief moment they will be stationary whilst looting, allowing for an easy headshot kill. Killing targets out in the open will leave their bodies as bait allowing for AI or players to loot them letting you gain more kills and establishing areas of interest to shoot at. Use a high zoom variable scope for better accuracy and non-tracer ammunition for better concealment.
worst-job-in-the-world.briefing: Hello mercenary! You know, the job of a peacekeeper is a very difficult one. Peacekeepers are expected to strike a strict balance between the warring parties, and often we find ourselves in the worst kinds of situations. In general, the UN is as interested in a speedy resolution of the conflict as the local authorities. But the local criminal elements are making it difficult. So my superiors require me to achieve new results in the fight against the looters. But how can I do it without casualties among the UN forces? Do you see where I'm going with this?

objectives.text: Visit The Lab

rewards.text: 2× Torrey Pines Logic T12W 30Hz thermal reflex sight

wrench-and-waterboarding.briefing: Alright, mate. Fancy getting involved in something serious? Ain't gonna be easy, I'll tell you that now. We're gonna strip that underground lab clean. Few days back, we grabbed a civvy who used to work at that TerraGroup site. Entrance security, or something like that… Didn't fancy talking at first, but we had a proper chat with him, and eventually he spilled. Says if the lab gets switched over to emergency power, every sealed section can be opened with the same access code. You get what that means? No one's ever walked in there with odds this good! We don't know much about the place, but I've already sent a couple of crews to smash anything we reckon might be feeding power to the lab. Now we need to find out if it actually switched over to emergency power, or if there's still something left to do. Might even be some switch inside the lab itself, for all I know. Think you can have a look? You've got a better chance of figuring that place out than any of my lads.

your-car-needs-a-service.guide: In this quest you have to find a flash drive on Streets of Tarkov. It can be found on a desk inside the LexOs car dealership director's office, which is located in the closed section on the second floor. A Car dealership closed section key is required to access the office, and the Car dealership director's office room key provided by Peacekeeper via in-game mail is required to open it. Be aware that the premises of the LexOs car dealership are riddled with Claymores. your-car-needs-a-service.briefing: Hello, soldier! He who has the information is the victor. You want peace to win, don't you? So it's time to find some information for the good guys. A company was laundering money in the car dealership. Find any data on them that might be useful. My man managed to get a copy of the key to the office. Here you go. The problem, though, is that the entrance to the section itself is also locked, and we haven't been able to find that second key.
